text: Nahibaluan nga may daan nga tradisyon sa China nga ginatawag nga child brides ukon ang “tong yang xi” kun sa diin naga-adopt ang pamilya sang bata nga babaye agud nga padak-on ini kag hanason para mangin maayo nga asawa sa ila bata nga lalaki.
english: It is known that there is an old tradition in China called child brides or the “tong yang xi” where the family adopts the girl to raise her and train her to be a good wife to their son.

text: Gin-ban na ini sang 1950 apang ini nga practice ang ginapadayon gihapon sa rural areas kaangay sa natabo natabo sa sini nga kaso.
english: It was banned in 1950 but this practice is still continued in rural areas as happened in this case.

text: Nagsarurot sa 46% ang porsyento sang mga Pilipino nga malipayon sa ila nga lovelife.
english: The percentage of Filipinos who are happy with their lovelife has dropped to 46%.

text: Sandig ini sa survey nga gin-conduct sang Social Weather Stations (SWS) sang Nobyembre 24-30, 2025 kag gin-release ang resulta antes ang Valentine’s Day subong nga tuig.
english: This is based on a survey conducted by the Social Weather Stations (SWS) on November 24-30, 2025 and the results were released before Valentine's Day this year.

text: Ini nga figure ang pinakamanubo nga SWS data sa sulod sang masobra duha ka dekada halin sang una ini nga na-record sang 2004.
english: This figure is the lowest SWS data in more than two decades since it was first recorded in 2004.

text: Sa amo man nga survey, 40% ang nagasiling nga nagapati sila nga mahimo sila mangin mas malipayon pa sangsa ila love life subong.
english: In the same survey, 40% say they believe they could be even happier than they are with their love life right now.

text: Ang nabilin naman nga 14% ang nagpahayag nga wala sila sang love life.
english: The remaining 14% said they had no love life.

text: As of November 2025, ang may pinakamataas nga nalipay sa ila love life amo ang kasado nga mga babaye nga may 57%; ginasundan sang kasado nga mga lalaki nga may 55 percent; mga lalaki nga may live-in partners nga yara sa 50 percent kag mga babaye nga may live-in partners nga yara sa 45 percent.
english: As of November 2025, those who are most satisfied with their love life are married women with 57%; followed by married men with 55 percent; men with live-in partners at 50 percent and women with live-in partners at 45 percent.

text: Sa mga babaye nga respondents, 22% ang nagsiling nga wala sila sang bana ukon partner subong nga tuig, mas manubo sang 2% sa 2024 SWS survey.
english: Among female respondents, 22% said they are not married or partnered this year, down from 2% in the 2024 SWS survey.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, 28% naman sang mga lalaki ang nag-report nga wala sila sang love life.
english: On the other hand, 28% of men reported that they had no love life.

text: Ini nga Fourth Quarter 2025 Social Weather Survey ang gin-conduct paagi sa face-to-face interviews sa 1,200 adults nga may sampling margin of error nga ±3 percent sa national percentages kag ±6 percent sa Metro Manila, Luzon sa guwa sang Metro Manila, Visayas, kag Mindanao.
english: This Fourth Quarter 2025 Social Weather Survey was conducted through face-to-face interviews with 1,200 adults with a sampling margin of error of ±3 percent in national percentages and ±6 percent in Metro Manila, Luzon outside Metro Manila, Visayas, and Mindanao.

text: Maganubo sa ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga semana ang presyo sang produktong-petrolyo.
english: Petroleum product prices will fall for the second consecutive week.

text: Base sa anunsyo sang fuel firms, mabuhinan sang P0.30 ang presyo sa kada litro sang gasoline; P0.90 kada litro sang diesel; kag P1.25 sa kada litro sang kerosene.
english: Based on the announcement of fuel firms, the price of gasoline will be reduced by P0.30 per liter; P0.90 per liter of diesel; and P1.25 per liter of kerosene.

text: Mangin epektibo ang adjustments umpisa alas sais buwas sa aga, Mayo 13.
english: The adjustments will be effective from 6 am tomorrow, May 13.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag sang Department of Energy – Oil Industry Management Bureau (DOE-OIMB) nga may rollback kasunod sang desisyon sang Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) nga pasakaan ang production levels sa Hunyo.
english: Earlier, the Department of Energy – Oil Industry Management Bureau (DOE-OIMB) announced a rollback following the decision of the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) to raise production levels in June.

text: Ginplastar man nga factor sa adjustment sa prsyo ang wala kasiguruhan sa resulta sang trade talks sa tunga sang United States kag China.
english: Uncertainty over the outcome of trade talks between the United States and China was also cited as a factor in the price adjustment.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, matandaan nga may P0.55 nga rollback sa gasoline, P0.65 sa diesel; kag P0.90 sa kerosene.#
english: Last week, there was a P0.55 rollback on gasoline, P0.65 on diesel; and P0.90 for kerosene.#

text: Nag-atubangay liwat si US President Donald Trump kag Chinese President Xi Jinping para sa isa ka bilateral talk sa South Korea.
english: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping met again for a bilateral talk with South Korea.

text: Nagkamustahanay sanday Trump kag Xi sa masobra isa ka minuto antes sila nagsugod sang ila pribado nga pag-istoryahanay nga naglawig sang duha ka oras.
english: Trump and Xi exchanged greetings for more than a minute before they began their private conversation that lasted two hours.

text: Gindayaw ni Trump ang ila meeting ni Xi kag gintawag ini nga isa ka daku nga kadalag-an.
english: Trump praised his meeting with Xi and called it a resounding success.

text: Ginpahibalo man ni Trump nga magapatuman siya sang mas manubo nga taripa sa mga Chinese imports kag nagsiling nga hatagan sang China ang Amerika sang mas maayo nga access sa ginatawag nga “rare earth” ukon mga mineral nga ginagamit sa paghimo sang mga electric cars, computer hard drives, TV screens, jet engines, kag iban pa nga electronics kag military weapons.
english: Trump also announced he would impose lower tariffs on Chinese imports and said China would give America better access to so-called “rare earth” or minerals used to make electric cars, computer hard drives, TV screens, jet engines, and other electronics and military weapons.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Trump nga pirmahan sang Amerika kag China ang isa ka trade deal sa masunod nga mga inadlaw.
english: Trump also said the United States and China will sign a trade deal in the coming days.

text: Ini amo naman ang una nga pag-atubangay nanday Trump kag Xi halin pa sang 2019 sang nagkit-anay sila sa G20 summit sa Osaka, Japan.
english: This is the first meeting between Trump and Xi since 2019 when they met at the G20 summit in Osaka, Japan.

text: Kilala ang Valentine’s Day sa pagpabutyag sang pagpalangga.
english: Valentine’s Day is known for expressing love.

text: Indi man madula ang paghatagay sang regalo kada Pebrero 14.
english: The gift-giving ceremony on February 14 is also inevitable.

text: Apang sa Japan, pinasahi ang pagselebrar sang Valentine’s Day.
english: In Japan, however, Valentine's Day is celebrated in a special way.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma direkta sa Japan, may yara sang customs kag traditions ang nasambit nga pungsod sa pagselebrar sang sini nga okasyon.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Josel Palma directly in Japan, the country has customs and traditions in celebrating this occasion.

text: Kun sa Pilipinas, kadam-an nga nagahatag sang regalo amo ang mga lalaki sa adlaw sang tagipusuon, apang didto sa Japan, babaye ang nagahatag sang regalo.
english: In the Philippines, most gift-givers are men on Valentine's Day, but in Japan, women give gifts.

text: Apang isa ka bulan pagkatapos sang Valentine’s Day pahayag ni Palma partikular sa Marso 14 nga kilala bilang White Day, tion naman sang mga kalalakihan nga hatagan sang regalo ang babaye nga naghatag man sa ila sang Valentine’s Day.
english: But a month after Valentine's Day, Palma said, particularly on March 14, known as White Day, it's time for men to give gifts to the woman who gave them Valentine's Day.

text: Masami nga regalo sang mga babaye amo ang tsokolate nga may yara sang nagkalain-lain nga sabor kag styles.
english: Frequent gift of women is chocolate which comes in different flavors and styles.

text: Apang indi basta-basta tsokolate ang ginahatag sang mga babaye bangud ang tagsa ka tsokolate ang may yara sang buot silingon depende sa sahi sang isa ka relasyon.
english: But women don't just give chocolates because each chocolate has a meaning depending on the type of relationship.

text: Suno kay Palma, ang “giri choco” ukon kilala nga “obligation chocolates” ang ginahatag sa kaupod sa trabaho ukon myembro sang pamilya.
english: According to Palma, the “giri choco” or known as “obligation chocolates” are given to colleagues or family members.

text:
Ang “honmei choco” naman ang ginahatag sa isa ka tawo nga ginahigugma sang babaye — ukon mas kilala nga “love chocolates.”

Apang indi man tanan ang nagaselebrar sang Valentine’s Day kag White Day bangud popular man sa mga babaye nga nagahatag sang tsokolate ukon “tomo choco” sa ila man abyan nga babaye.
english:
“Honmei choco” is given to someone the woman loves — or better known as “love chocolates.”

However, not everyone celebrates Valentine's Day and White Day because it is also popular for women to give chocolates or “tomo choco” to their girlfriends.

text: Gintawag ni Impeachment manager Rep.
english: Impeachment manager Rep.

text: Madeleine Dean nga “desperate president” si anay US President Donald Trump.
english: Madeleine Dean called former US President Donald Trump a “desperate president”.

text: Isa si Dean sa madamo nga mga myembro sang Kongreso nga naghalin sa sulod sang US Capitol sang natabo ang pagpang-atake sang Enero 6.
english: Dean was one of many members of Congress who left the US Capitol when the January 6 attack took place.

text: Suno kay Rep.
english: According to Rep.

text: Dean, ginpatawag mismo ni Trump ang mga public officials kag gin-imbitar nga magkadto sa Oval office sa diin ginpang-engganyo sila sang anay presidente nga baliskadon ang nangin resulta sang eleksyon.
english: Dean, Trump personally summoned public officials and invited them to the Oval office where the former president urged them to overturn the election results.

text: Apang pahayag ni Dean, nangin maisog ang mga opisyal kag napaslawan si Trump nga matigayon ang iya luyag nga matabo.
english: But Dean said the officials were brave and Trump failed to get what he wanted to happen.

text: Samtang pahayag naman ni Democratic Rep.
english: Meanwhile, Democratic Rep.

text: Ted Lieu, nadulaan na sang pamaagi si Trump nga mapabilin pa ang iya gahom bilang presidente sadto rason nga pagpamahog na lang ang ginahimo sini sa mga opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: Ted Lieu, Trump has lost the ability to maintain his power as president and is now threatening government officials.

text: Naglab-ot sa punto suno kay Lieu nga ginpakahuy-an pa ni Trump ang mga senador nga mismo kaalyado man lang niya sa Republican party.
english: Lieu said Trump even humiliated senators who are his allies in the Republican party.

text: Ginapaandaman man sila sang anay presidente nga kun indi mabaylo ang resulta sang eleksyon, indi man sini malimtan ang mga republican senator kag ginpahog pa nga magapangatubang ang mga ini sang konsekwensya.
english: The former president also warned them that if the election results are not changed, he will not forget the republican senators and threatened to face consequences.

text: Nagdepensa ang Office of the Building Official (OBO) nga wala sang lamod sang pulitika ang ila ginhimo nga pagkakas sang tarpaulin sang Team Sulong Gugma sa San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: The Office of the Building Official (OBO) defended that there was no political motive in the removal of the tarpaulin of Team Sulong Gugma in San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Mavi Gustilo, Head sang Office of the Building Official (OBO), iya ginpanindugan nga yara sila sa husto nga bahin bangud nagsunod lang sila sa pagsulundan sang syudad kag nagpadala man sang ‘notice of violation’.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Mavi Gustilo, Head of the Office of the Building Official (OBO), insisted that they were on the right side because they followed the city's rules and sent a notice of violation.

text: Suno kay Gustilo, private man ukon commercial establishments ang nagabayolar, ginapangbaklas gid sang talatapan.
english: According to Gustilo, whether private or commercial establishments violate, the office will crack down.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga kinahanglan anay makakuha sang permit halin sa ila talatapan antes magbutang sang nagakaigo nga tarpaulin, kon sa diin, tsekyaron anay nila kon nagasunod ini sa pagsulundan.
english: He also explained that they must first obtain a permit from their office before putting up the appropriate tarpaulin, where, they will first check if it complies with the rules.

text: Nahibaluan nga sa idalom sang Regulation Ordinance number 2013-330 gindumulian sa syudad ang pag-install sang tarpaulin nga wala sang commercial value.
english: Under Regulation Ordinance number 2013-330, the city prohibits the installation of tarpaulins without commercial value.

text: Ginadiskusyonan na sang World Health Organization kun bala mahimo ilakip ang mga tigulang sa mahatagan sang AstraZeneca-Oxford COVID-19 vaccine.
english: The World Health Organization is discussing whether to include the elderly in the AstraZeneca-Oxford COVID-19 vaccine.

text: Suno sa WHO, ang rekomenadasyon kun sin-o bala ang mahimo makagamit kag indi makagamit sang bakuna ang isapubliko subong nga semana.
english: According to the WHO, the recommendation on who can and cannot use the vaccine will be made public this week.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang mga regulatory authorities sa pila ka mga European nations ang indi pabor sa paggamit sang bakuna para sa mga naga edad 65 anyos pataas bangud sila ang makabig nga vulnerable age group.
english: It is known that the regulatory authorities in some European nations are not in favor of using the vaccine for those aged 65 years and above because they are considered a vulnerable age group.

text: Samtang isuspende naman sang South Africa ang COVID-19 vaccinations gamit ang AstraZeneca vaccine matapos natukiban sa pagtuon nga napaslawan ang bulong nga makalikaw sa mild ukon moderate cases sang virus variant nga nagtuhaw sa ila nga pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, South Africa will suspend COVID-19 vaccinations using the AstraZeneca vaccine after a study found that the drug failed to prevent mild or moderate cases of the virus variant that emerged in their country.

text: Gin-deliver na sang China ang 600,000 doses sang Sinopharm vaccine sa Cambodia sa pihak sang mga pagkabalaka sa ka-epektibo sang Chinese vaccine.
english: China has delivered 600,000 doses of the Sinopharm vaccine to Cambodia despite concerns about the effectiveness of the Chinese vaccine.

text: Gin-anunsyar sang tinalikdan nga bulan ni Cambodian leader Hun Sen nga ma-donate ang China sang one million doses sang ila nga COVID-19 vaccine sa diin ini ang maga-cover sa 500,000 ka tawo bangud duha ka dose ang kinahanglan sa kada indibidwal.
english: Last month, Cambodian leader Hun Sen announced that China would donate one million doses of its COVID-19 vaccine, which would cover 500,000 people because two doses are needed per individual.

text: Indi pa maathag kun san-o naman idul-ong sang China ang nabilin nga bakuna matapos ang una nga batch.
english: It is not clear when China will deliver the remaining vaccines after the first batch.

text: Suno kay Hun Sen, nagapasalamat ang Cambodian government sa China sa bulig nga ginhatag sa ila.
english: Hun Sen said the Cambodian government is grateful to China for the assistance given to them.

text: Isa si Hun Sen sa longest-serving leaders sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Hun Sen is one of the longest-serving leaders in the world.

text: Nagpabutyag ini sang kahandaan nga siya ang una nga magapabakuna apang indi na ini madayon matapos nahibaluan nga ang bakuna ang para lang sa mga tawo nga naga edad 18 tubtob 59 anyos sa diin siya ang naga-edad na sang 68 anyos.
english: He expressed his readiness to be the first to be vaccinated but it was canceled after it was learned that the vaccine is only for people aged 18 to 59 years old where he is 68 years old.

text: Gin-athag sang kampo sang Team Sulong Gugma nga nabaton sang ila kampo ang sulat sang ‘notice of violation’ kaangot man sa pagbayolar sa Regulation Ordinance number 2013-330.
english: The Team Sulong Gugma camp explained that their camp received a notice of violation in connection with the violation of Regulation Ordinance number 2013-330.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagtakod sang amo nga grupo sang ila tarpaulin sa Brgy.
english: This follows the group's erection of their tarpaulin in Brgy.

text: San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: San Rafael, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. R Leone Gerochi, katapo sang Team Sulong Gugma, iya ginpahayag nga sa kadamo sang mga tarpaulin nga nakatakod sa palibot sang Iloilo City, ngaa ang ila gid nga poster ang ginpunterya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. R Leone Gerochi, a member of Team Sulong Gugma, said that with so many tarpaulins posted around Iloilo City, why was their poster targeted.

text: Suno kay Gerochi, tuman ka ‘obvious’ nga pagpamulitika ang ginahimo sang city government sa ila nga grupo.
english: According to Gerochi, the city government is doing obvious politicking to their group.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga pakuno-kuno lamang ang pagkakas sang Office of the Building Official (OBO) sa mga commercial poster bangud ang tuyo gid nga baklason, amo ang ila poster.
english: He also said that the Office of the Building Official (OBO)'s removal of the commercial posters was a pretense because the real intention was to remove their posters.

text: Ginpakamalaut man sang natungdan ang ginapahayag may pinilian nga pagpangbaklas.
english: He also condemned the alleged selective dismissal.

text: Ginklaro man sang grupo nga wala na sila nakibot sa nangin tikang sang city government bangud expected na nila nga molestyahon ang ila tarpaulins.
english: The group also clarified that they were not surprised by the city government's move because they expected their tarpaulins to be molested.

text: Padayon ang protesta sang mga residente sang Myanmar matapos ang tensyon nga nagakatabo sa diin kontrolado subong sang militar ang pungsod.
english: Myanmar residents continue to protest after the tensions that are currently under military control in the country.

text: Matandaan nga pwersahan nga gindakop sang militar ang de facto leader sang Myanmar nga si Aung San Suu Kyi sa idalom sang iya titulo bilang state counsellor bangud sa ginapahayag paglapas sa import kag export laws sang pungsod.
english: The military forcibly arrested Myanmar's de facto leader Aung San Suu Kyi under her title as state counselor for allegedly violating the country's import and export laws.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Atty. Jobert Pahilga direkta sa Myanmar, iya ginpahayag nga kada gab-i, lapnagon ang ‘nationally coordinated noise barrage’ nga ginapatigayon sang mga pumuluyo sa katuyuan nga mapauntat ang pagkontrol sang militar sa pungsod.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Atty. Jobert Pahilga directly in Myanmar, he said that every night, the 'nationally coordinated noise barrage' conducted by the people will be spread with the aim of stopping the military's control of the country.

text: Suno kay Pahilga, ini nga civil disobedience movement ang gin-umpisahan sang professional nga sektor kaangay sang mga health workers, mga eskwelahan, kag government employees.
english: According to Pahilga, this civil disobedience movement was initiated by the professional sector such as health workers, schools, and government employees.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga ang isa sa protesta nga ginahimo sang mga tawo amo ang pagkanta kun gab-i sa mga dalanon sang protest song nga may lyrics nga ‘we will not forget and forgive the dictators’.
english: He said that one of the protests that people are doing is singing at night in the streets the protest song with the lyrics 'we will not forget and forgive the dictators'

text: Suno sa natungdan, sa Lunes, Pebrero 8 magapatigayon pa sang dako nga rally ang nasambit nga grupo.
english: He said the group will hold another big rally on Monday, February 8.

text: Halos tanan naman nga sektor suno kay Pahilga ang nagapanawagan nga ibalik sang militar ang gahom sang duly elected government.
english: Pahilga said almost all sectors are calling for the military to restore the power of the duly elected government.

text: Kakulba, kahangawa kag kabalaka ang nabatyagan sang mga residente sang Myanmar bangud sa tensyon nga nagakatabo sa diin kontrolado subong sang militar ang nasambit nga pungsod.
english: Myanmar residents are feeling nervous, anxious and worried about the tensions that are currently under military control in the country.

text: Una na nga nagmandu ang National League for Democracy (NLD) nga i-release si Aung San Suu Kyi, ang de facto leader sang Myanmar sa idalom sang iya titulo bilang state counsellor, matapos nga pwersa ini nga gindakop sang militar bangud sa ginapahayag paglapas sa import kag export laws sang pungsod.
english: The National League for Democracy (NLD) earlier ordered the release of Aung San Suu Kyi, Myanmar's de facto leader under her title as state counsellor, after she was forcibly arrested by the military for allegedly violating the country's import and export laws.

text: Apang Pebrero 15 pa posible nga paguwaon sa presohan si Suu Kyi.
english: But Suu Kyi is likely to be released from prison on February 15.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo kay alyas Ling, estudyante sa Myanmar, iya ginpahayag nga kadam-an sa ila ang wala na nakahibalo kun ano ang ila mangin palaabuton sa ulihe.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, alias Ling, a student in Myanmar, said that most of them do not know what their future will be.

text: Suno kay Ling, ginadumilian ang pagkadto sang mga tawo sa mga kaiping nga syudad ukon banwa sa Myanmar.
english: According to Ling, people are prohibited from traveling to neighboring cities or towns in Myanmar.

text: Matapos ang duha ka adlaw nga gindula ang telecommunication services, ini ang nagbalik na mangin ang mga banko ang nag-resume naman.
english: After two days of telecommunication services being cut off, it has returned and even banks have resumed.

text: Apang ang mga dalan ang malinong sa gihapon sa diin may mga security forces nga naka-deploy.
english: However, the roads are still peaceful with security forces deployed.

text: Nagakabalaka ini bangud pila sa mga kabataan sang mga nagaprotesta ang nag-halalin naman sa ila mga trabaho.
english: He is concerned that some of the children of the protesters have already left their jobs.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginapanindugan sang militar nga may yara sang dinayaay nga natabo sang eleksyon sang Nobyembre 2020 sa diin nakakuha sang 83% nga boto si Suu Kyi sang National League for Democracy party.
english: The military insists that there was fraud in the November 2020 elections in which Suu Kyi of the National League for Democracy party won 83% of the vote.

text: Gani subong nagapanawagan ang G7 countries sa militar sang Myanmar nga respetuhon ang resulta sang eleksyon.
english: So now the G7 countries are calling on the Myanmar military to respect the election results.

text: Ginsaysay sang green guard kon paano niya nakit-an ang duha ka mga lalaki nga naga-espadahay sa Garden of Love sa Nabitasan, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: The green guard narrated how he saw two men fighting at the Garden of Love in Nabitasan, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Ang mga lalaki amo sanday Alyas “Jun-jun” 29-anyos, isa ka gwardya kag Alyas “Totoy”, 42-anyos isa ka call center agent.
english: The men were identified as Alias ​​“Jun-jun”, 29, a security guard and Alias ​​“Totoy”, 42, a call center agent.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Sean Jabano, Team Leader sang green guard Esplanade 3, iya gin-athag nga sakop na sang Esplanade 3 ang ginpwestohan sang duha ka mga kalalakihan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Sean Jabano, Team Leader of the green guard Esplanade 3, explained that the two men were stationed in Esplanade 3.

text: Suno kay Jabano, ‘caught in the act’ gid niya mismo ang duha nga nagahimo sang sexual activity.
english: According to Jabano, he himself caught the two engaging in sexual activity.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang isa ang nagtuyo pa nga maglagyo, samtang ang isa ang nang-harass sang kaupdanan man nila nga green guard matapos sang sila ang nadakpan.
english: He also said that one of them tried to escape, while the other harassed their fellow green guard after they were arrested.

text: Una na nga ginhatagan sang warning ang duha nga indi magtambay sa dulom kon sa diin, ginpapauli pa.
english: The two were earlier warned not to hang out in the dark and were sent home.

text: Apang, matapos ang duha ka oras liwat sila nga nagbalik kag nagsulod sa lugar kon sa diin, ginbantayan sang otoridad kag natigayon nga nadakpan.
english: However, after two hours they returned and entered the area where, guarded by the authorities and managed to arrest.

text: Gilayon naman sila nga nagpakig-angot ang natungdan sa La Paz Police Station agud nga mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga pagtamod ang duha ka mga indibidwal matapos ang isa ang wala nakapakita sang identification card (ID).
english: They immediately contacted the La Paz Police Station to give proper attention to the two individuals after one of them failed to show his identification card (ID).

text: Ginpalawig pa sang isa ka bulan ang pagpatuman sang state of emergency sa Japan.
english: The state of emergency in Japan has been extended for another month.

text: Ini ang magapabilin tubtob sa Marso 7 bangud ginapahayag nga under pressure gihapon ang mga ospital apisar nakit-an nga naganubo na ang numero sang COVID-19 cases.
english: This will remain until March 7 as hospitals are still under pressure despite the decreasing number of COVID-19 cases.

text: Suno kay Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga, ang nasambit nga state of emergency ang magapabilin sa 10 prefectures.
english: According to Prime Minister Yoshihide Suga, the state of emergency will remain in 10 prefectures.

text: Ang Tochigi lamang ang nagaisahanon nga prefecture kun sa diin iga-lift na ang state of emergency sa Pebreo 7 bangud sang nakit-an nga pag-uswag sang ila nga sitwasyon.
english: Tochigi is the only prefecture where the state of emergency will be lifted on February 7 due to the improvement in their situation.

text: Ang Japan ang may yara na sang 391,626 ka total confirmed cases sang COVID-19; ang mga napatay ang yara na sa 5,794; samtang 339,377 naman ang nakarecover.
english: Japan has 391,626 total confirmed cases of COVID-19; the death toll stands at 5,794; while 339,377 have recovered.

text: Nagtuga sang huol sa trabaho ang malala nga snow storm sa New York City, USA.
english: A severe snow storm has caused work disruption in New York City, USA.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ludovico Baqueriza III, Bombo International Correspondent, direkta sa New York City, isa ka Ilonggo Nurse kag tumandok sang Ajuy, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga nag-umpisa ang malala nga snow storm sang Enero 31 kag nagbundak sang madamol sang Pebrero 1 umpisa las 10:00 sang aga tubtob las 5:00 sang hapon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ludovico Baqueriza III, Bombo International Correspondent, directly in New York City, an Ilonggo nurse and native of Ajuy, Iloilo, said the severe snow storm began on January 31 and fell heavily on February 1 from 10:00 am to 50:50 pm.

text: Suno kay Baqueriza, ginkansela ang subway operation sa diin ginpauntat ang byahe sang mga bus kag train bangud tuman kadanlog ang mga dalanon.
english: According to Baqueriza, the subway operation was canceled where buses and trains were stopped because the roads were too slippery.

text: Daw kaangay suno kay Baqueriza nga naga-eksperyensya sila sang bagyo apang snow lamang ang nagabubu kag tuman man kabaskog ang huyop sang hangin.
english: Baqueriza said it was like they were experiencing a typhoon but only snow was falling and the wind was very strong.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga kada oras, nagadangat sa duha ka pulgada ang kataason sang nagatumpok nga snow sa mga dalanon.
english: He said that every hour, up to two inches of snow piles up on the roads.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, ginsarado naman ang pila ka mga vaccination center bangud sa mabaskog nga pag-ulan sang snow.
english: He added that some vaccination centers were closed due to heavy snowfall.

text: Pagdako sang vital organs kaangay sang tagipusuon kag atay sa lawas sang tawo ang pila sa mga resulta sang balatian nga Beta thalassemia.
english: Enlargement of vital organs such as the heart and liver in the human body are some of the consequences of Beta thalassemia.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Joselito Caso, pediatric hematologist, iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga balatian ang heriditary.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Joselito Caso, pediatric hematologist, said the disease is hereditary.

text: 50 percent suno sa doktor ang posibilidad nga makaangkon sang Beta thalassemia ang isa ka indibidwal kun may yara sang kaangay nga balatian ang iya mga ginikanan.
english: The doctor said there is a 50 percent chance that an individual will develop Beta thalassemia if his parents have the same disease.

text: Suno kay Dr. Caso, ang Beta thalassemia ang isa ka balatian sa dugo nga nagabuhin sang produksyon sang hemoglobin nga amo ang responsable sa paghatag sang oxygen sa lawas sang isa ka tawo.
english: According to Dr. Caso, Beta thalassemia is a blood disorder that reduces the production of hemoglobin which is responsible for providing oxygen to the human body.

text: Ginpahayag ni Casa nga ang mga indibidwal nga nagusuprir sang amo nga balatian ang makaangkon man sang anemia ukon kakulang sang red blood cells, sa diin nagalapsi ang panit, nagahina ang immune system, gabuhin ang bug-at ukon wala nagadako, nagabatyag sang fatigue kag iban pa nga mga kumplikasyon.
english: Casa said individuals who suffer from the disease can also develop anemia or lack of red blood cells, where the skin becomes pale, the immune system weakens, weight loss or stunting, fatigue and other complications.

text: Dako man nga risgo suno sa iya nga mag-angkon sang abnormal nga blood clots kag paglapad sang mga organs sa lawas ang mga pasyente nga may Beta thalassemia.
english: He said patients with Beta thalassemia are also at high risk of developing abnormal blood clots and enlarged organs.

text: Yari naman ang pila ka mga pamaagi agud mabulong ang balatian nga Beta thalassemia:
english: Here are some ways to treat Beta thalassemia:

text: Halos indi kita mahubsan sang ideya kun paano maumpawan subong nga binulan na nga nagatagiti ang init.
english: We are almost out of ideas on how to cool off now that the heat has been scorching for months.

text: May yara nga pila ka beses nagapaligo sa isa ka adlaw, may nagahimo sang “do it yourself” nga air conditioner, may naga-paligo sa ice, may nagakonsumo sang halo-halo, kag madamo nga iban pa.
english: There are those who shower several times a day, there are those who make “do it yourself” air conditioners, there are those who take ice baths, there are those who consume halo-halo, and many others.

text: Sa Thailand, pinasahi pa gid ang napinsaran sang mga residente sa Phayuha Khiri District sa probinsya sang Nakhon Sawan agud nga bisan paano, makaulan man sa ila nga lugar kag matugnawan man ang palibot.
english: In Thailand, residents in Phayuha Khiri District in Nakhon Sawan province have thought of something special so that it can rain in their area and cool the environment.

text: Abi mo kun ano ang ila ginhimo?
english: What do you think they did?

text: Nagparada sila kag ang ila nga dala amo ang Japanese cartoon cat nga si Doraemon!
english: They paraded and they brought the Japanese cartoon cat Doraemon!

text: Naka-costume pa ang mga nag-upod sa parada samtang nga ginsulod naman si Doraemon sa hawla kag samtang nagapadayon sila sa parade, ginabasyahan sang tubig sang iban nga mga residente ang nasambit nga kuring.
english: The parade participants were still wearing costumes while Doraemon was put in a cage and while they continued the parade, other residents were sprinkling water on the dog.

text: Daan na ini nga dry season ritual nga kilala nga “Hae Nang Meaw” ukon ang literal nga pagparada sa babaye nga kuring, apang sini nga tuig, indi buhi nga kuring kundi si Doraemon kag HelloKitty dolls ang bitbit sang mga tawo.
english: It’s an old dry season ritual known as “Hae Nang Meaw” or the literal parading of the female cat, but this year, people are carrying not live cats but Doraemon and HelloKitty dolls.

text: Ini ang kabahin sa ila pagpati nga ang kuring ang naangot sa pag-ulan kag ang ila pag-“meow meow” bangud sa ila kaugot kun mabasa sila amo ang nagatawag sa pag-ulan.
english: This is part of their belief that the cat is associated with rain and their “meow meow” because of their anger when they get wet is what calls for rain.

text: Nahibaluan nga indi basta-basta ang init sa Thailand kun sa diin sa south nga bahin particular sa Nakhon Si Thammarat province,nagatiko na ang mga railway tracks kag kinahanglan pa nga mag-spray sang tubig ang railway workers agud nga mabalik ang husto nga shape sini.
english: It is known that the heat in Thailand is not easy where in the southern part particularly in Nakhon Thammarat province, the railway tracks are already cracking and railway workers have to spray water to restore their proper shape.

text: Temporaryo man nga ginsirado ang alagyan sang tren kag ginsuspende anay ang operasyon bangud ginkaayo ang tracks nga nag-misalign bangud sa stress nga tuga sang tuman nga kainit.
english: The railway was also temporarily closed and operations were suspended for the repair of tracks that misaligned due to stress caused by the extreme heat.

text: Nagapanawagan sang bulig ang mga residente sang Brgy.
english: Residents of Brgy.

text: Benedicto, Jaro, matapos ang nagluntad nga sunog sa ila barangay kahapon nga adlaw.
english: Benedicto, Jaro, after a fire broke out in their barangay yesterday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas Kath, isa man sa mga nasunugan, iya ginpahayag nga lawas lang gid nila ang ila nasalbar sa nagluntad nga sunog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Kath, one of the victims, said they only saved their bodies in the fire.

text: Nagapasalamat man ini nga luwas sila tanan sang iya mga kaupod sa balay, apang nagakasubo man ini bangud nga wala na sila sang puluy-an nga pagabalikan.
english: She is also grateful that she and her housemates are safe, but she is also sad because they have no home to return to.

text: Madumduman nga naglab-ot sa 4th alarm ang nasambit nga sunog antes ini nga napalong.
english: The fire reached the 4th alarm before being extinguished.

text: Nagdangat naman sa 52 ka mga balay ang natupok sang kalayo kun sa diin 48 diri ang totally damaged kag 4 naman ang partially damaged.
english: The fire destroyed 52 houses, 48 ​​of which were totally damaged and 4 partially damaged.

text: Sa subong, temporaryo nga nagadayon ang mga apektado nga mga residente sa Barangay Hall sang Brgy.
english: Currently, the affected residents are temporarily staying at the Barangay Hall of Brgy.

text: Benedicto, samtang ang iban naman ang nagtinir sa ila nga mga himata.
english: Benedicto, while others stayed with their relatives.

text: Nahibaluan nga naghatag naman sang bulig ang syudad sang Iloilo, lakip na ang pagpadala sang folding bed, foam kag tubig para sa mga residente.
english: The city of Iloilo provided assistance, including sending folding beds, foam and water for the residents.

text: INDI mahangpan sang mga alkalde sang lima ka banwa sang Guimaras kon ano gid ang ginapuntariya sang Executive Order No.
english: The mayors of the five towns of Guimaras do not understand what Executive Order No.

text: 67 ni Gov.
english: 67 of Gov.

text: Samuel Gumarin nga naga-require sang mga pumuluyo sa pagpa-testing batok sa COVID-19 kon maggwa sa isla sang Guimaras paagi sa mayor nga wharf sini sa mga banwa sang Buenavista kag Jordan.
english: Samuel Gumarin who requires residents to be tested against COVID-19 when leaving the island of Guimaras through its main wharf in the towns of Buenavista and Jordan.

text: Ina tungod ang pag-detect sini kon may COVID-19 ang byahero amo ang Rapid Testing (Antigen testing), nga sunu mismo sa Department of Health indi masaligan ang “accuracy”, nga indi katulad sang RT-PCR testing nga halos100% nga masaligan.
english: This is because the detection of COVID-19 in a traveler is Rapid Testing (Antigen testing), which according to the Department of Health is not reliable in accuracy, unlike RT-PCR testing which is almost 100% reliable.

text: Tungod sining reklamo, ginpa-suspendir anay ni Gov.
english: Because of this complaint, Gov.

text: Gumarin ang pagpatuman sang EO 67, nga tani effective na sadtong Oktubre 5, 2020 pa, tubtub maathagan ini sing lubos sa Implementing Rules and Regulations sang EO 67.
english: The implementation of EO 67, which was supposed to be effective on October 5, 2020, will be delayed until it is fully clarified in the Implementing Rules and Regulations of EO 67.

text:
***

Ginatumod, in particular, sining Rapid Testing ang mga pumuluyo nga (a) may trabaho sa Siyudad sang Iloilo, (b) may medical emergency, kag (c) ang naga-delivery sang goods and services nga nagakadto pabalik sa Guimaras.
english:
***

In particular, this Rapid Testing targets residents who (a) have jobs in Iloilo City, (b) have a medical emergency, and (c) are delivering goods and services going back to Guimaras.

text: Sunu sa hangop naton sa EO 67, ang natungdan nga mga pumuluyo nga may kasubong nga pagbyahe kag naka-tener sing tatlo ukon sobra pa ka adlaw sa siyudad pwede makasulod sa Guimaras, pero sa liwat nga paggwa sa Guimaras kinahanglan magpakita sing negatibo nga Rapid Test result.
english: According to our understanding of EO 67, the concerned residents who have such a trip and have stayed three or more days in the city can enter Guimaras, but when leaving Guimaras again must show a negative Rapid Test result.

text: Samtang kon maglapaw sa duha ka beses kada semana ang pagwa sa Guimaras, pasugtan lang liwat makagwa sa isla sa ila pagbalik kon may negatibo nga Rapid Test result.
english: Meanwhile, if they leave Guimaras more than twice a week, they will only be allowed to leave the island again when they return if they have a negative Rapid Test result.

text: Ngaa bala nga ining tatlo lang ka grupo sang mga byahero ang tumod?
english: Why are these three groups of travelers the focus?

text: Ngaa kinahanglan pa ang pagligad sang tatlo ukon sobra pa ka adlaw nga pagtener sa siyudad sang Iloilo bag-o sila mapa-Rapid Test sa ila paggwa sa Guimaras?
english: Why do they need to stay in Iloilo City for three or more days before they can be Rapid Tested when they leave Guimaras?

text: Ngaa kinahanglan nga lapaw pa sa duha ka beses nga paggwa kada semana agud ma-Rapid Test sila?
english: Why does it take more than two outings per week to Rapid Test them?

text: Ngaa indi na lang sa adlaw-adlaw nila nga paggwa sa Guimaras?
english: Why not just on their daily trips to Guimaras?

text: Kag ngaa Rapid Test gid ang gina-rekomendar sang kapitolyo, nga sunu sa mga alkalde indi “accurate”?
english: And why does the capitol recommend Rapid Test, which according to the mayors is not “accurate”?

text: Wala kita sing masanag nga paathag sa sining EO 67, luas lang sa siling ni Vice Gov.
english: We have no clear explanation for this EO 67, except that Vice Gov.

text: John Edward Gando nga ining Rapid Testing sa mga pantalan indi diagnostic, ukon ang paghibalo kon ang isa ka indibidwal infected sang COVID-19 ukon indi, kundi isa lang ka “surveillance testing”.
english: John Edward Gando said that this Rapid Testing at ports is not diagnostic, or determining whether an individual is infected with COVID-19 or not, but only a “surveillance testing”.

text: In other words, pangkadam-an lang ini nga “survey”.
english: In other words, this is just a general survey.

text: Ang nahibal-an ta sini amo nga ang isa ka “surveillance testing” isa lang ka “survey” kon ano kalawak ang pag-spread sang COVID-19 sa isa ka grupo ukon lugar gamit ang isa ka sample group agud matantiya ang paglapta sini sa kadam-an agud matagaan man sang bagay nga aksyon.
english: What we know is that a surveillance testing is just a survey of how widespread the spread of COVID-19 is in a group or area using a sample group to estimate its spread to the public in order to take appropriate action.

text: Kon gamay man lang nga grupo ang tumod, katulad sang mga empleyado sang city hall ukon munisipyo, pwede lang gani nga ma-surveillance testing ang bug-os nga empleyado katulad sang nahimo na sa Iloilo City Hall sining ulihi gamit ang mas masaligan nga RT-PCR test.
english: If the target is a small group, such as city hall or municipal employees, the entire employee can be surveillance tested as was done in Iloilo City Hall recently using a more reliable RT-PCR test.

text: Ang purpose amo ang pagbulag sang mga may COVID-19 nga empleyado halin sa wala Covid-19 agud indi maglapta ang infection kag matagaan dayon sing nagakaigu nga pagtatap ang may COVID-19.
english: The purpose is to separate employees with COVID-19 from those without Covid-19 to prevent the spread of infection and to provide appropriate care to those with COVID-19.

text: Sa kaso sang mga nagabyahe sa tunga sang Iloilo kag Guimaras, nga kinahanglan ang madasig nga pag-test sa pantalan, imposible ini gamitan sang RT-PCR tungod makagwa lang ang result sini pagkaligad pa sang pila ka oras tubtub pa gani sa duha ukon tatlo ka adlaw.
english: In the case of those traveling between Iloilo and Guimaras, who need a rapid test at the port, it is impossible to use RT-PCR because the result will only come out after a few hours to two or three days.

text: Sa kaso sang Rapid Test, 15 minutos makuha na ang result.
english: In the case of Rapid Test, the result will be available in 15 minutes.

text: Barato pa ang pag-acquire sang Rapid Testing unit ikumparar sa RT-PCR.
english: The Rapid Testing unit is cheaper to acquire than the RT-PCR.

text: Matuod nga indi “accurate” ang Rapid Testing, pwede mapa-sensyahan ang kakulangan sini sa “accuracy” kon pangkadam-an lang ang testing.
english: It is true that Rapid Testing is not accurate, its lack of accuracy can be tolerated if the testing is general.

text: Samtang makahatag ini sang false-negative, may mga expert nga nagasiling nga masaligan ini kon ang resulta sini “positive” kay gapakita na ini sing “high viral load” nga indi na mahinagu, kag ma-detect na, bisan sang Rapid testing.
english: While it can give a false-negative, some experts say it is reliable if the result is “positive” because it shows a “high viral load” that cannot be hidden, and can be detected, even by rapid testing.

text: Gani, pwede na lang mapabay-an ang “negative” result kag tutukan lang ang “positive” result, kag amo ina ang himuan sing 15-minute nga “repeat testing” kay amo man lang ang importante sa “survey” nga mahibal-an gid kon sin-o ang “positive” kag kon ano sila kadamo./PN
english: Therefore, we can ignore the negative result and focus on the positive result, and that is why we will do a 15-minute repeat testing because that is the only important thing in the survey to know who is positive and how many there are./PN

text: Wala na ginkakibot sang gobyerno ang pahayag sang Panay Alliance Karapatan nga wala gintrato sang maayo sang Philippine National Police ang gin-aresto nga wanted person nga myembro sang New People’s Army (NPA).
english: The government is not surprised by the statement of the Panay Alliance Karapatan that the Philippine National Police did not treat the arrested wanted person who is a member of the New People's Army (NPA) well.

text: Ini amo si Tomas Dominado nga may standing warrants of arrest sa kaso nga murder kag rebellion.
english: This is Tomas Dominado who has standing warrants of arrest for murder and rebellion.

text: Sa nangin statement sang Panay Alliance Karapatan, ila gin-alegar nga gindalukan sang medical care si Dominado magluwas pa nga kaangay nga nangin premeditated abduction ang natabo.
english: In a statement, the Panay Alliance Karapatan alleged that Dominado was threatened with medical care and that the incident seemed to be a premeditated abduction.

text: Gin-alegar man sang grupo nga naglala ang kondisyon ni Dominado kag bisan pa maathag ang medical recommendations para sa iya ospitalisasyon, gindala si Tomas sa Mambusao sa baylo nga sa ospital.
english: The group also alleged that Dominado's condition deteriorated and despite clear medical recommendations for his hospitalization, Tomas was taken to Mambusao instead of the hospital.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay retired MGen.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, retired MGen.

text: Rene Glen Paje, Regional Adviser on Peace and Security sang Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity, iya ginpahayag nga natural lang sa aktibista nga grupo nga magpagwa sang amo nga mga pahayag.
english: Rene Glen Paje, Regional Adviser on Peace and Security of the Office of the Presidential Adviser on Peace, Reconciliation and Unity, said it is natural for the activist group to issue such statements.

text: Suno kay Paje, luyag lamang sang grupo nga makuha ang simpatiya sang mga tawo kag ang ini nga taktika ang kabahin lang sang ila plano nga pakalainon ang gobyerno.
english: According to Paje, the group only wants to win the sympathy of the people and this tactic is only part of their plan to defame the government.

text: Ginatos ka mga tawo ang gindakop sang mga pulis sa Russia kasunod sang hublag protesta nga ginpatigayon bilang pagmandu nga paguwaon na sa presohan ang Kremlin critic nga si Alexei Navalny.
english: Russian police have arrested hundreds of people following a protest movement demanding the release of Kremlin critic Alexei Navalny.

text: Halin sa Vladivostoc sa Far East pakadto sa Saint Petersburg sa Baltic Sea, linibo ka mga pulis ang yara sa dalanon agud nga punggan ang madamo nga mga tawo nga naga-apin sa ginakabig “most prominent opponent” ni President Vladimir Putin.
english: From Vladivostoc in the Far East to Saint Petersburg on the Baltic Sea, thousands of police officers were on the streets to quell large crowds cheering for what is considered President Vladimir Putin’s “most prominent opponent”.

text: Si Navalny ang gindakop sa Moscow airport sang Enero sang ini na ang nagbalik sa Russia halin sa Germany sa diin siya nag-recover nagikan sa pagpanghilo sa iya kag ang ginabasol niya nga may kahimuan sini amo ang gobyerno sang Russia.
english: Navalny was arrested at Moscow airport in January when he returned to Russia from Germany where he was recovering from poisoning and blamed the Russian government.

text: Manubo ang pagsalig sang mga tawo sa Hong Kong sa mga bakuna sang China ipaanggid sa mga himo sang Europa kag Estados Unidos.
english: People in Hong Kong have low trust in Chinese vaccines compared to those made in Europe and the United States.

text: 1,000 ka mga tawo ang nagpartisipar sa survey sang University of Hong Kong.
english: 1,000 people participated in the University of Hong Kong survey.

text: Sa Sinovac vaccine, 29.5% lang sa mga respondents ang pabor sa Sinovac vaccine samtang 56% naman ang luyag nga makakuha sang bakuna gikan sa BioNTech sang Germany kag 35% naman ang pabor sa AstraZeneca & Oxford University.
english: On the Sinovac vaccine, only 29.5% of respondents were in favor of the Sinovac vaccine while 56% wanted to get the vaccine from BioNTech of Germany and 35% were in favor of AstraZeneca & Oxford University.

text: Nahibaluan nga nag-order ang Hong Kong government sang 7.8 million ka dose sang Sinovac vaccine.
english: The Hong Kong government has ordered 7.8 million doses of the Sinovac vaccine.

text:
Pagbukas sang Ungka flyover sa full capacity, Christmas gift sang DPWH sa mga motorista

𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Buksan na sa Disyembre 25, 2024 ang kontrobersyal nga Ungka flyover.
english:
Ungka flyover opens at full capacity, DPWH's Christmas gift to motorists

𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – The controversial Ungka flyover will open on December 25, 2024.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engr.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Engr.

text: Sanny Boy Oropel, regional director of the Department of Public Works and Highways-Region 6 (DPWH-6), iya ginpahayag nga full capacity ang pagbukas sa flyover sa diin tanan nga lanes ang mahimo na nga maagyan.
english: Sanny Boy Oropel, regional director of the Department of Public Works and Highways-Region 6 (DPWH-6), said the opening of the flyover is at full capacity where all lanes can be used.

text: Suno kay Oropel, kakason naman ang vertical limit sa flyover.
english: According to Oropel, the vertical limit on the flyover will be removed.

text: Apang indi sa gihapon pagpasugtan ang mga truck kag motorsiklo nga maglabay sa flyover.
english: However, trucks and motorcycles will not be allowed to pass through the flyover.

text: Samtang, ang pagbutang sang aspalto sa idalom sang flyover ang ipalagas lang sa tion nga indi ini mahingagaw sa Disyembre 25.
english: Meanwhile, the laying of asphalt under the flyover will only be postponed if it is not removed on December 25.

text: Magluwas sa rectification works, nag-request man ang Metro Pacific Iloilo Water agud nga mag-ilis sang ila nga pipeline sa idalom sang flyover.
english: Besides the rectification works, Metro Pacific Iloilo Water also requested to replace their pipeline under the flyover.

text:
Nahibaluan nga ang gasto sang gobyerno sa Ungka flyover ang nagdangat na sa P975 million halin sa original budget nga P680 million bangud sa ginapatigayon nga pagkaayo.Ceres bus

Ang contractor sang proyekto nga nagalaba sang 453.7 meters amo ang International Builders Corporation kag amo man sa gihapon ang nagdaog bilang contractor sa ikaduha nga phase sa pagkay-o sang flyover.
english:
It is known that the government's expenditure on the Ungka flyover has reached P975 million from the original budget of P680 million due to the ongoing repairs. Ceres bus

The contractor of the 453.7-meter project is International Builders Corporation and is still the winner as the contractor for the second phase of the flyover rehabilitation.

text: Katuyuan sini kuntani nga mapahagan-hagan ang trapiko sa intersection sang Sen.
english: The purpose of this was to ease traffic at the intersection of Sen.

text: Benigno Aquino Jr.
english: Benigno Aquino Jr.

text: Avenue kag President Corazon Aquino Avenue nga nagakonekta sa Barangay Ungka, Jaro, Iloilo City padulong sa Barangay Ungka 2, Pavia, Iloilo, apang naghatag ini sang huol sa publiko bangud sa palpak nga proyekto.
english: Avenue and President Corazon Aquino Avenue that connects Barangay Ungka, Jaro, Iloilo City to Barangay Ungka 2, Pavia, Iloilo, but it caused trouble to the public due to the failed project.

text: Gin-designar ni US President Joe Biden ang isa ka Filipino-American bilang White House Liaison sang Office of Personnel Management.
english: US President Joe Biden has designated a Filipino-American as the White House Liaison of the Office of Personnel Management.

text: Ang Fil-Am amo si Jason Tengco nga magatrabaho kaupod sa US Federal Government sa enterprise human resources management.
english: Fil-Am is Jason Tengco who will be working with the US Federal Government on enterprise human resources management.

text: Si Tengco ang nagtrabaho anay bilang Coalitions Department chief of staff sa Biden-Harris campaign.
english: Tengco previously worked as the Coalitions Department chief of staff on the Biden-Harris campaign.

text: Siya man ang Asian American and Pacific Islander Outreach Lead sa transition team.
english: She is also the Asian American and Pacific Islander Outreach Lead on the transition team.

text: Antes nagtrabaho sa Biden-Harris team, nagserbe si Tengco bilang executive director sang National Federation of Filipino American Associations, National AAPI Outreach Director sang 2016 presidential campaign ni Hillary Clinton, kag deputy director sang White House Initiative on AAPIs.
english: Prior to working on the Biden-Harris team, Tengco served as executive director of the National Federation of Filipino American Associations, National AAPI Outreach Director of Hillary Clinton’s 2016 presidential campaign, and deputy director of the White House Initiative on AAPIs.

text: Wala sang anuman nga Low Pressure Area (LPA) nga na-monitor sa Pilipinas.
english: No Low Pressure Area (LPA) was monitored in the Philippines.

text: Ang Shear Line ang nagaapekto sa eastern sections sang Central kag Southern Luzon.
english: The Shear Line is affecting the eastern sections of Central and Southern Luzon.

text: Ang Shear Line ang isa ka linya ukon makitid nga lugar sa diin may gulpi nga pagbag-o sa direksyon sang hangin.
english: A Shear Line is a line or narrow area where there is a sudden change in the direction of the wind.

text:
Bangud sa pagbunggu-anay ukon convergence sang hangin, nagaluntad ang masami nga pagpangilat ukon mga
pag-ulan sa shear line.
english:
Due to the collision or convergence of winds, there are frequent lightning or
precipitation along the shear line.

text: Samtang ang Northeast Monsoon ukon hangin amihan ang nagaapekto sa Northern Luzon kag sa nabilin nga bahin sang Central Luzon.
english: Meanwhile, the Northeast Monsoon is affecting Northern Luzon and the rest of Central Luzon.

text: Ang Easterlies ukon ang mainit nga hangin halin sa Dagat Pasipiko ang nagaapekto naman sa nabilin nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: The Easterlies or the warm winds from the Pacific Ocean are affecting the rest of the country.

text: Sa subong, manaya-naya ang panahon sa Western Visayas.
english: Currently, the weather in Western Visayas is pleasant.

text: Ginakabig sang Kabataan Partylist nga iligal ang nangin tikang sang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga pag-aresto kay Tomas Dominado.
english: The Kabataan Partylist considers the arrest of Tomas Dominado by the Philippine National Police (PNP) to be illegal.

text: Si Dominado ang wanted kag member sang New People’s Army (NPA) nga may standing warrants of arrest sa kaso nga murder with the firearm kag rebelyon.
english: Dominado is wanted and a member of the New People's Army (NPA) with standing warrants of arrest for murder with the firearm and rebellion.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Thea Dayata, myembro sang Kabataan Partylist, iya ginpahayag nga indi legal ang pag-aresto kay Dominado bangud sa sitwasyon sini subong ilabi na ang nagalala sini nga balatian.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Thea Dayata, a member of the Kabataan Partylist, said the arrest of Dominado is illegal due to his current condition especially his worsening illness.

text: Suno kay Dayata, ang immediate nga ginapangayo sang himata ni Dominado amo ang husto nga pagbulong.
english: According to Dayata, the immediate demand of Dominado's relatives is proper treatment.

text: Ginpakamalaut man sang natungdan ang indi pagsabat sang mga kapulisan sa pamilya ni Dominado.
english: He also condemned the police's lack of response to Dominado's family.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga isa ka injustice ang pagdala kay Dominado nga wala sang ihibalo ang pamilya sini kon sa diin ini dal-on.
english: He also explained that it is an injustice to take Dominado without his family knowing where to take him.

text: Una na nagpanindugan ang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) nga wala sang kamatuoran ang mga alegasyon natuhoy sa pag-aresto kay Tomas Dominado nga wala ini nahatagan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.
english: Earlier, the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) insisted that there is no truth in the allegations regarding the arrest of Tomas Dominado that he was not given proper treatment.

text: Tradisyon na para sa outgoing president ang magbilin sang sulat sa iya successor antes maghalin sa White House.
english: It is tradition for the outgoing president to leave a note with his successor before leaving the White House.

text: Apang sa nagalapta nga sulat sa social media nga ginapahayag letter ni anay US President Donald Trump para kay President Joe Biden, ini ang fake news.
english: But with the letter circulating on social media that is said to be a letter from former US President Donald Trump to President Joe Biden, this is fake news.

text:
Tubtob subong wala sa gihapon nahibaluan kun ano ang kaundan sang sulat ni Trump

Mangin ang prominent pro-Trump lawyer nga si Lin Wood ang nag-share man sang “fake letter” nga nagasiling “Joe, you know I won.”

Una nga ginpahayag ni Biden nga nga “very generous” ang kaundan sang sulat ni Trump para sa iya.
english:
The contents of Trump's letter are still unknown

Even prominent pro-Trump lawyer Lin Wood shared a “fake letter” saying “Joe, you know I won.”

Biden initially said that Trump's letter to him was "very generous."

text: Ini man ang ginkumpirma ni White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki apang wala pa sang naplano ang presidente nga makig-istorya kay Trump.
english: This was also confirmed by White House Press Secretary Jen Psaki but the president has not yet planned to meet with Trump.

text: Nagpangabay si US President Joe Biden sa mga Americans nga magsuksok sang mask.
english: US President Joe Biden has asked Americans to wear masks.

text: Suno kay Biden, ang pagsuksok sang face mask ang mangin requirement na sa ano man nga inter-state travel.
english: Biden said the wearing of face masks will be a requirement for any inter-state travel.

text: Dugang pa sang presidente, ang tanan nga international air passengers ang kinahanglan naman nga i-quarantine pag-abot sa Estados Unidos.
english: The president added that all international air passengers will be required to be quarantined upon arrival in the United States.

text: Wala man ginpalampuwas ni Biden ang administrasyon ni anay US President Donald Trump bangud sa pagresponde sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Biden also did not spare the administration of former US President Donald Trump for responding to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Pahayag niya, napaslawan ang sadto nga administrasyon nga tutukan ang pandemya sa diin nagalab-ot sa 3,000 tubtob 4,000 ka tawo ang nagakapatay kada adlaw.
english: He said the previous administration failed to focus on the pandemic where 3,000 to 4,000 people are dying every day.

text: Naghalad man ang presidente kag ang iya tiayon nga si Jill sang pangamuyo sa tanan nga mga Americans nga napatay bangud sa COVID-19.
english: The president and his wife, Jill, also offered prayers for all Americans who have died from COVID-19.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpasalamatan man ni Biden ang mga myembro sang military nga nagbulig sa iya sa pagsiguro nga mangin hilway ang iya inagurasyon.
english: Meanwhile, Biden also thanked members of the military who helped him ensure a safe inauguration.

text: Sa subong napirmahan na sang Presidente ang mga executive orders may kaangtanan sa COVID-19 response.
english: The President has now signed executive orders related to the COVID-19 response.

text:
Lakip sa mga executive orders amo ang mga masunod;

*Securing the supply chain*Keeping workers safe*Ensuring an equitable response*Promoting safe travel*Setting up the pandemic testing board*Covid data that has to be maintained and recorded*Making sure national guard support is available*Expanding access to Covid-19 care and treatment*Global response
english:
Among the executive orders are the following;

*Securing the supply chain*Keeping workers safe*Ensuring an equitable response*Promoting safe travel*Setting up the pandemic testing board*Covid data that has to be maintained and recorded*Making sure national guard support is available*Expanding access to Covid-19 care and treatment*Global response

text: Ginkwestyon ni Philippines Coast Guard (PCG) spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Cdre.
english: Philippines Coast Guard (PCG) spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Cdre.

text: Jay Tarriela kun sa diin ginakuha ni Cavite 4th District Rep.
english: Jay Tarriela where Cavite 4th District Rep.

text: Kiko Barzaga ang iya impormasyon tuhoy sa PCG.
english: Kiko Barzaga gave his information about the PCG.

text: Kasunod ini sang akusasyon ni Barzaga nga ginpalala sang PCG ang tension sa rehiyon bangud sa ginapahayag nga pagpanghilabot sa aways sang China kag Taiwan.
english: This follows Barzaga's accusation that the PCG has exacerbated tensions in the region over its alleged interference in the aways between China and Taiwan.

text: Suno kay Tarriela, nagataas ang tension bangud sa mga lihok sang China Coast guard kag Maritime Militia sa mga manugpangisda nga Pilipino.
english: According to Tarriela, tensions are rising due to the actions of the China Coast guard and Maritime Militia against Filipino fishermen.

text: Naglab-ot sa 52 ka mga balay ang apektado sang sunog kun sa diin 48 diri ang totally damaged kag 4 naman ang partially damaged.
english: A total of 52 houses were affected by the fire, of which 48 were totally damaged and 4 were partially damaged.

text: Ini matapos ang nagluntad nga sunog sa Brgy.
english: This is after a fire broke out in Brgy.

text: Benedicto, Jaro, hapon sang Pebrero 16.
english: Benedicto, Jaro, afternoon of February 16.

text: Base sa impormasyon, kalabanan sa mga residente ang wala na nakasalbar sang ila nga mga gamit bangud sa madasig nga paglapta sang kalayo.
english: According to reports, most of the residents were unable to save their belongings due to the rapid spread of the fire.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Kagawad Ronie Prusia sang Brgy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Kagawad Ronie Prusia of Brgy.

text: Benedicto kag isa sa mga nasunugan, iya ginpahayag nga ido lang nila ang iya nasalbar.
english: Benedicto and one of the victims, he said he only saved their dog.

text: Ini matapos nga kalabanan sa mga balay amo ang human sa mga light materials kag naga-ililingud lang ang mga ini rason man sa dayun nga paglapta sang sunog.
english: Ini matapos nga kalabanan sa mga balay amo ang human sa mga light materials kag naga-ililingud lang ang mga ini rason man sa dayun nga paglapta sang sunog.

text: Suno pa kay Prusia, gintinguhaan pa niya nga patyon ang kalayo sa ila nga chapel gamit ang fire extinguisher, apang wala gid ini napalong.
english: According to Prusia, he tried to extinguish the fire in their chapel with a fire extinguisher, but it was not extinguished.

text: Dugang pa niya, temporaryo sila nga magatinir sa iya nga utod matapos nga nasunog ang ila balay.
english: He added that they were temporarily staying with his brother after their house burned down.

text: Nagdaog ang former four-division world champion kag longest-reigning boxing titleholder sang Pilipinas nga si Donnie “Ahas” Nietes sa iya pagbalik sa ring sa labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang halos tatlo ka tuig.
english: Former four-division world champion and longest-reigning Philippine boxing titleholder Donnie “Ahas” Nietes won in his return to the ring for the first time in nearly three years.

text: Ginlutos sang 42-anyos nga boksidor ang kaangay man nga Pinoy fighter nga si Miller Alapormina, 27, sa six-round bantamweight clash sa Elorde Sports Center sa Parañaque City.
english: The 42-year-old boxer defeated fellow Filipino fighter Miller Alapormina, 27, in a six-round bantamweight clash at the Elorde Sports Center in Parañaque City.

text: Nagtakop ang hampang sa unanimous decision sa skor nga lunsay 59-55 pabor sa former champion.
english: The match ended in a unanimous decision with a score of 59-55 in favor of the former champion.

text: Nagsaka na ang professional boxing record ni Nietes sa 44-2-6 nga may 23 knockouts.
english: Nietes' professional boxing record has risen to 44-2-6 with 23 knockouts.

text: Katapusan nga nakahampang si Nietes sang 2022 kun sa diin nalutos ini via unanimous decision sa world title rematch batok sa Japanese rival sini nga si Kazuto Ioka.
english: Nietes last played in 2022 when he lost via unanimous decision in a world title rematch against Japanese rival Kazuto Ioka.

text: Antes sini, ginakilala man si Nietes nga isa sa most decorated Filipino boxers nga nakauyat sang WBO minimumweight title halin sang 2007 tubtub sang 2011 antes nakuha ang world titles sa flyweight kag super flyweight divisions.
english: Earlier, Nietes was also recognized as one of the most decorated Filipino boxers who held the WBO minimumweight title from 2007 to 2011 before winning the world titles in the flyweight and super flyweight divisions.

text: Nag-uswag ang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas sang 5.4% sa una nga tatlo ka bulan sang 2025.
english: The Philippine economy grew by 5.4% in the first three months of 2025.

text: Suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), ang nasambit nga numero ang mas mataas sangsa 5.3% nga pag-uswag sang Gross domestic product (GDP) sa ulihi nga katunga sang 2024.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA), the said figure is higher than the 5.3% Gross domestic product (GDP) growth in the latter half of 2024.

text: Suno kay PSA Undersecretary Dennis Mapa, ang quarter-on-quarter nga pag-uswag yara sa 1.2%, nga ginapangunahan sang manufacturing, retail trade, kag construction.
english: According to PSA Undersecretary Dennis Mapa, quarter-on-quarter growth was at 1.2%, led by manufacturing, retail trade, and construction.

text: Bisan pa nga mas manubo ini sangsa 5.9% nga pag-uswag sa amo man nga panahon sang nagligad nga tuig, ang National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) nagsiling nga nagapakita sang “steady growth” sa piyak sang world economic uncertainty nga gintuga sang mga tensyon sa negosyo sa tunga sang U.S. kag iban pa nga mga pungsod.
english: Although this is lower than the 5.9% growth rate in the same period last year, the National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) said that reflects “steady growth” despite world economic uncertainty caused by trade tensions between the U.S. and other countries.

text: Ang Pilipinas amo ang ikaduha nga pinakamadasig nga nag-uswag nga ekonomiya sa Asya sa una nga quarter sang 2025, sunod sa Vietnam (6.9%) kag kapareho sa China (5.4%).
english: The Philippines will be the second fastest growing economy in Asia in the first quarter of 2025, behind Vietnam (6.9%) and on par with China (5.4%).

text: May mga lugar nga istrikto gid ang pagsulundan pag-abot sa tattoo sa lawas, pagsuksok sang aritos, ukon mangin ang istilo kag color sang buhok.
english: Some places have very strict rules when it comes to body tattoos, wearing earrings, or even hair style and color.

text: Apang may mga kaso naman nga indi lang basta-basta, kag nagalab-ot pa sa punto nga makasuhan kag mamultahan bangud sa sini nga mga bagay.
english: But there are cases that are not trivial, and even reach the point of being prosecuted and fined for these things.

text: Kaangay sa sining natabo sa 25-anyos nga si Stanislav Netesov sa Russia nga nagpa-color sang iya nga buhok sang yellow kag blue nga natabuan man nga amo ang color sang flag sang Ukraine nga amo subong ang gina-atake sang Russian Army.
english: Like what happened to 25-year-old Stanislav Netesov in Russia who dyed his hair yellow and blue which happens to be the color of the flag of Ukraine which is now being attacked by the Russian Army.

text: Sang nagligad lamang nga semana, isa ka gab-i, samtang yara si Netesov sa bus stom sa Moscow, na-biktima siya sang kawatan, nadagit ang iya nga cellphone, kag natapungulan pa ini sang suspek.
english: Just last week, one night, while Netesov was on a bus stop in Moscow, he was the victim of a robbery, his cellphone was stolen, and the suspect even stabbed him.

text: Pagkasunod nga adlaw, nagkadto siya sa Ministry of Internal Affairs sa Tverskoy district agud nga i-report ang krimen.
english: The next day, he went to the Ministry of Internal Affairs in Tverskoy district to report the crime.

text: Apang sa baylo nga hatagan siya sang bulig, mas interesado ang otoridad sa iya bangud sa iya nga buhok nga kaangay gid sa color sang flag sang Ukraine.
english: But instead of giving him help, the authorities were more interested in him because of his hair that closely resembled the color of the Ukrainian flag.

text: Bangud nga ginakonsiderar ini nga simbolo sang Ukraine, makabig man ini nga insulto kag pagtraidor sa Russian army kag may penalidad sa idalom sang layi sa amo nga nasyon.
english: Because it is considered a symbol of Ukraine, it is also considered an insult and betrayal of the Russian army and is punishable under the law in that country.

text: Bangud sini, wala na nasapak ang iya nga report kag sa baylo, ginkuhaan pa siya sang fingerprints kag ginpakadto sa military registration kag enlistment office.
english: As a result, his report was ignored and instead, he was fingerprinted and sent to the military registration and enlistment office.

text: Gindeklarar pa sang otoridad nga pahalukon ini sa duta.
english: The authorities even declared that he would be kissed on the ground.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginakilala sang Russian courts ang mga anti-war statements nga isa ka pagbastos sa militar kag dapat nga multahan sang tubtub sa tubtub sa malapit P31,000 kag tubtub naman sa lima ka tuig nga pagkapreso kun sulit-sulit na nga madakpan.
english: It is known that Russian courts recognize anti-war statements as an insult to the military and should be fined up to nearly P31,000 and up to five years in prison if caught repeatedly.

text: Sang nagligad nga summer, may yara man sang kaso sa Penza kun sa diin namultahan man ang isa ka pensioner sang P62,000 bangud sa pag-like sini sang social media post kun sa diin may negatibo nga komento batok sa Russian military.#
english: Last summer, there was also a case in Penza where a pensioner was fined P62,000 for liking a social media post with negative comments against the Russian military.

text: Ginpasaka ang petition for indirect contempt batok kay Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III sa Korte Suprema kasunod sang nangin komento sini sa impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: A petition for indirect contempt was filed against Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III in the Supreme Court following his comments on the impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Ang nag-file sang petisyon amo ang mga abogado nga sanday Manuelito Luna, Ferdinand Topacio, kag Harold Respicio.
english: The petition was filed by attorneys Manuelito Luna, Ferdinand Topacio, and Harold Respicio.

text: Suportado sila ni ex-congressman Jing Paras nga anay Presidential Adviser on Political Affairs ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: They are supported by ex-congressman Jing Paras, former Presidential Adviser on Political Affairs of former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: “Para po sa amin ay ‘yun pong public statements ni SP Sotto, all due respect to him, ay lumalampas na po sa legitimate commentary at ito po ay nag ta-transgress na into the territory of statements that tend to… destroy the credibility, undermine the faith of the people in the SC,” suno kay Topacio.
english: “For us, SP Sotto's public statements, all due respect to him, are going beyond legitimate commentary and are transgressing into the territory of statements that tend to... destroy the credibility, undermine the faith of the people in the SC,” Topacio said.

text: Dugang niya: “Hindi po ito para patahimikin si Senate President Sotto katulad ng sinasabi ng iba.
english: He added: “This is not to silence Senate President Sotto as others are saying.

text:
He’s free to say what he wants basta ito po ay hindi bumabalangkas sa Rules on Contempt and what is permissible na sabihin.”

Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga bulan, nagdesisyon ang Korte Suprema nga palig-unon pa ukon i-uphold ang nauna nga desisyon sini nga nagadeklarar nga unconstitutional ang impeachment sang Kamara batok sa bise-presidente.
english:
He’s free to say what he wants as long as it doesn’t violate the Rules on Contempt and what is permissible to say.”

Last month, the Supreme Court decided to uphold its earlier decision declaring the House's impeachment of the vice president unconstitutional.

text: Nagdesisyon ang en banc sang may pinalidad nga ginabasura sini ang motion for reconsideration nga ginpasaka sang lower chamber.
english: The en banc decided with penalty that it dismisses the motion for reconsideration filed by the lower chamber.

text: Nagkomento naman si Sotto nga isa na ka imposible nga handum ang impeachment batok kay Duterte.
english: Sotto commented that impeachment against Duterte is an impossible dream.

text: Pahayag pa sini, ang ruling sang Korte Suprema ang maathag nga pagsulod ukon pagpahilabot sa gahum sang legislative branch.
english: He said the Supreme Court's ruling is a clear interference in the powers of the legislative branch.

text: Sa amo nga desisyon suno sa iya, naghimo ang Supreme Court sang bag-o nga pagsulundan nga sundon sang Kongreso kun may impeachment.
english: In that decision, he said, the Supreme Court made a new rule for Congress to follow in the event of impeachment.

text: “The decision is a clear judicial legislation.
english: “The decision is a clear judicial legislation.

text: The SC, as written in their decision, admitted of introducing a rule for Congress to follow in the conduct of impeachment.
english: The SC, as written in their decision, admitted of introducing a rule for Congress to follow in the conduct of impeachment.

text: A clear encroachment on the power of the Legislative branch, as provided for by the Constitution,” suno pa anay sa Senate President.#
english: A clear encroachment on the power of the Legislative branch, as provided for by the Constitution,” the Senate President said.

text: ANG bag-o nga classification sang Department of Health sang COVID-19 cases amo ang Suspect, Probable, kag Confirmed.
english: THE new classification of COVID-19 cases by the Department of Health is Suspect, Probable, and Confirmed.

text: Ang gapakita sintoma apang wala pa ma-testing ginatawag nga Suspect; Probable, ang nagahulat resulta sang testing; kag Confirmed, ang na-test positive.
english: Those who show symptoms but have not been tested are called Suspect; Probable, pending testing results; and Confirmed, those who tested positive.

text: Sunu sa DILG Memorandum Circular No.
english: According to DILG Memorandum Circular No.

text: 2020-063 ang tanan nga bangkay sang Suspect, Probable kag Confirmed dapat lang ipa-cremate, ukon sunugon, bag-o maglapaw ang 12 oras sang pagkamatay, luas lang sa mga Muslim – pati na seguro ang iban nga tumuluo – nga wala nagapati sa cremation.
english: 2020-063 all bodies of Suspect, Probable and Confirmed must be cremated, or burned, before 12 hours of death, except for Muslims – including probably other believers – who do not believe in cremation.

text: Ginkwestyon ini sang pila ka pamilya.
english: Some families questioned this.

text: Una na dira ang pamilya sang isa ka 9 anyos nga bata nga babaye nga biktima sang vehicular accident nga gindala kag napatay sa West Visayas Medical Center sa Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: Earlier, the family of a 9-year-old girl who was a victim of a vehicular accident was brought to the West Visayas Medical Center in Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Gin-testing ang iya bangkay, apang sang wala pa maggwa ang resulta lapaw sa 12 ka oras ginpa-cremate ini dayon sang WVMC.
english: His body was tested, but when the result did not come out for more than 12 hours, he was cremated by the WVMC.

text: Nagpa-angan-angan ang iloy kay luyag gid nila ihamyang anay ang bangkay sang iya anak sa ila puluy-an kon wala man lang ini sing COVID-19, apang wala gid mapunggan ang WVMC.
english: The mother hesitated because they wanted to bury her son's body at home if he didn't have COVID-19, but the WVMC couldn't stop him.

text: Gin-aku naman sang gobyerno ang pagpa-cremate sang bangkay.
english: The government acknowledged the cremation of the body.

text: Nagreklamo na sing tuod-tuod ang iloy sang maggwa ang resulta nga wala gali sing COVID-19 ang iya anak.
english: The mother complained when the result came out that her son did not have COVID-19.

text: Bati naton nagpasaka gani sing kaso ang pamilya batok sa WVMC.
english: We heard that the family even filed a lawsuit against the WVMC.

text: Angot diri, nagpagwa man sang ulihi sing pagpaathag ang DOH.
english: In this regard, the DOH later issued a clarification.

text: Siling sini nga gina-“encourage” sini ang cremation, apang ginatugot man kuno sini ang “quick burial” sang mga may kaso sang COVID-19.
english: He said he encourages cremation, but also allows quick burial of those with COVID-19 cases.

text: Tungod ina seguro sa paathag sang DOH nga ang isa ka senior citizen nga napatay man sa COVID-19 sa WVMC nag-amat-amat na baho ang bangkay sa morgue sa paghulat sa desisyon sang pamilya kon anhon ang ining bangkay.
english: This is probably because of the DOH's explanation that a senior citizen who also died of COVID-19 at the WVMC slowly smelled the body in the morgue while waiting for the family's decision on what to do with the body.

text: Nagpalya kuno ang freezing unit sang morgue, kon ngaa natabo ato.
english: The freezing unit of the morgue allegedly failed, which is why that happened.

text: Maathag nga daku nga problema ang makuri nga pagpagwa sang testing result nga ginatudlo naman sang mga testing health worker sa kadamuon sang gina-testing nila.
english: Clearly, the difficulty of issuing testing results is a big problem, which is pointed out by testing health workers in the number of people they are testing.

text: Tubtub subong indi pa mapaseguro sang DOH nga indi na matabo ining madugay nga pagpagwa sang testing result.
english: So far, the DOH cannot guarantee that this delay in the release of testing results will not happen.

text:
***

Indi naton maintiendihan ining mga hitabo sang pagsalingasag kon ano ang himuon sa bangkay sang isa ka may kaso sang COVID-19.
english:
***

We cannot understand these incidents of confusion about what to do with the body of a COVID-19 case.

text: Well, medyo okey na atong ginhimo sang WVMC nga hulaton ang desisyon sang pamilya samtang ginapabilin anay sa morgue ang bangkay sang tigulang, luas lang sa problema nga nanimahu na ang bangkay.
english: Well, it's okay for the WVMC to wait for the family's decision while keeping the body of the old man in the morgue, except for the problem that the body has already smelled.
