text: Of course, dapat man may limite ang nagakaigu nga paghulat sang pamilya.
english: Of course, there should also be a limit to the appropriate waiting time of the family.

text: Otherwise, mapilitan man ang mga otoridad nga ipa-cremate ini legally.
english: Otherwise, the authorities will be forced to have him cremated legally.

text: Ang indi gid naton mahangpan amo ang natabo sa bangkay sang 9 anyos nga bata nga ginpa-cremate samtang wala pa maggwa ang testing result.
english: What we cannot understand is what happened to the body of a 9-year-old boy who was cremated before the testing result came out.

text: Dapat mapaathag ini sing maayo sang WVMC.
english: WVMC should be able to explain this better.

text:
***

Samtang, wala man kita sing nahibal-an sa DOH kon paano ang pagpalubong sang mga bangkay nga may kaso sang COVID-19.
english:
***

Meanwhile, we do not know anything from the DOH about how to bury the bodies of COVID-19 cases.

text: Nagtilaw kita research sa internet pero wala gid kita sing natultulan sang kasubong nga impormasyon halin sa DOH.
english: We tried researching on the internet but we couldn't find any such information from the DOH.

text: Tungod sini, makabulig man seguro sa ihibalo sang pila naton ka kauturan ang ginapatuman sang New South Wales, Australia Ministry of Health sa pagpalubong sang mga bangkay nga may COVID-19.
english: Because of this, it will probably help some of our brothers and sisters to know the implementation of the New South Wales, Australia Ministry of Health in the burial of bodies with COVID-19.

text:
Medyo may mga technical terms ini, gani ginpakamaayo naton nga ipahayag ini sa orihinal nga texto sa Iningles, nga amo ang masunod, nga maintiendihan naman seguro sang aton bumalasa:

1.
english:
It has some technical terms, so we have decided to express it in the original English text, which is as follows, which our readers will probably understand:

1.

text: Contact and droplet precautions should be used when handling deceased bodies confirmed or suspected to have COVID-19.
english: Contact and droplet precautions should be used when handling deceased bodies confirmed or suspected to have COVID-19.

text: When handling deceased bodies wear appropriate PPE at all times without contaminating environmental surfaces.
english: When handling deceased bodies wear appropriate PPE at all times without contaminating environmental surfaces.

text: For transport and storage the body must be placed and secured in a bag or wrapping in a manner that prevents leakage; double bagging may be required to achieve this.
english: For transport and storage the body must be placed and secured in a bag or wrapping in a manner that prevents leakage; double bagging may be required to achieve this.

text: The body bag should be labelled “COVID-19 – Handle with care”.
english: The body bag should be labeled “COVID-19 – Handle with care”.

text: Avoid unnecessary manipulation of the body that may expel air or fluid from the lungs.
english: Avoid unnecessary manipulation of the body that may expel air or fluid from the lungs.

text: Embalming of a body confirmed or suspected to have COVID-19 is not recommended.
english: Embalming of a body confirmed or suspected to have COVID-19 is not recommended.

text: Family viewing of the deceased may occur; however, family members should avoid any contact with the body, if contact occurs advice to perform hand hygiene.
english: Family viewing of the deceased may occur; however, family members should avoid any contact with the body, if contact occurs advise to perform hand hygiene.

text: Maintain the recommended social distance from families and friends of the deceased./PN
english: Maintain the recommended social distance from families and friends of the deceased./PN

text: Yara na sa Mar-a-Lago Club resort sa Palm Beach sa Florida si anay US President Donald Trump matapos ini nagbiya sa White House.
english: Former US President Donald Trump is now at the Mar-a-Lago Club resort in Palm Beach, Florida, after he left the White House.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma ni Jennifer Brinklow, direkta sa Florida, isa sa mga correspondents sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo sa 50 ka mga estado kag isa ka distrito sang Columbia sa Estados Unidos.
english: This was confirmed by Jennifer Brinklow, directly in Florida, one of the correspondents of Bombo Radyo Iloilo in 50 states and one district of Columbia in the United States.

text: Suno kay Brinklow, kaupod nga ni Trump nga nag-abot sa Florida amo ang iya tiayon nga si Melania.
english: Brinklow said Trump was accompanied to Florida by his wife, Melania.

text: Pahayag niya, mahimo nga sa Florida na permanente nga maga-istar si Trump kaupod ang iya tiayon kag kabataan bangud nagbakal na ini sang mga propedad.
english: He said Trump may be living in Florida permanently with his wife and children because he has already bought properties.

text: Exciting para kay Brinklow nga ang anay presidente ang yara na sa ila nga estado kag apisar nga ang Florida ang ginadominar sang mga Republicans, nangin malinong ang dalan sa pihak sang mga nagapatigayon sang hublag protesta sa diin wala sang kinagamo nga natabo.
english: It is exciting for Brinklow that the former president is in their state and although Florida is dominated by Republicans, the road was peaceful despite the protesters where there was no violence.

text: Indi mabatyagan sang pila ka mga Filipino nga yara subong sa Estados Unidos ang sinseridad sa ginhatag nga speech ni outgoing President Donald Trump kadungan sang iya paghalin sa White House sa ulihe nga kahigayunan.
english: Some Filipinos currently in the United States do not feel the sincerity of outgoing President Donald Trump's speech as he left the White House for the last time.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Donnie Corado, isa sa mga correspondents sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo sa 50 ka mga estado kag isa ka distrito sang Columbia sa Estados Unidos, lain ang ginapahayag ni Trump sa ginapakita sini nga akto sa mga tawo rason nga indi mapatihan kun kaisa ang iya ginahambal sa publiko.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Donnie Corado, one of the correspondents of Bombo Radyo Iloilo in 50 states and one district of Columbia in the United States, Trump is saying something different from what he is showing to the people, which is why he sometimes does not believe what he says in public.

text: Apang pahayag ni Corado, ginatahod niya ang pagpati kag paglantaw sang mga supporters ni Trump ilabi na ang mga Filipino nga naga-idolo sa outgoing-president.
english: But Corado said he respects the beliefs and views of Trump's supporters especially the Filipinos who idolize the outgoing president.

text: Kun i-base lang sa kultura suno kay Corado, mas nakaangay ini sa Republican ipaanggid sa Democrats bangud kilala ang mga Filipino nga konserbatibo.
english: Based on culture, Corado said, it is more suitable for Republicans than Democrats because Filipinos are known to be conservative.

text: Nagalaum ini nga sa pagpungko ni Biden bilang bag-o nga Presidente, mahatagan sang igtalupangod ang COVID-19 pandemic sa diin nagpatay sa masobra 400,000 nga mga tawo sa Estados Unidos.
english: He hopes that with Biden taking office as the new President, attention will be paid to the COVID-19 pandemic that has killed more than 400,000 people in the United States.

text: Gintapos ni former US President Donald Trump ang iya farewell speech sa pagpahayag nga “Have a great life, we’ll see you soon” sa Andrews Air Base antes siya naglupad padulong sa Florida.
english: Former US President Donald Trump ended his farewell speech by saying “Have a great life, we’ll see you soon” at Andrews Air Base before he flew to Florida.

text: Nagpasalig si Trump nga magabalik siya sa diin wala niya gintumod kun ano bala ang iya buot silingon apang ginaluman nga sa masunod nga eleksyon, liwat naman ini nga magapadalagan bilang Presidente sang Estados Unidos.
english: Trump promised to return without specifying what he meant but is expected to run again for president of the United States in the next election.

text: Naglaum man ini sa bag-o nga administrasyon sang “great success” para sa palaabuton apang wala niya gin-mensyonar ang pangalan nanday President-elect Joe Biden kag Vice President-elect Kamala Harris.
english: He also wished the new administration “great success” for the future but did not mention President-elect Joe Biden and Vice President-elect Kamala Harris by name.

text: Lakip man sa ginpahayag ni Trump sa iya nga farewell speech amo ang pag-address sa coronavirus pandemic sa diin tuman nga na-igo ang Estados Unidos.
english: Trump's farewell speech also included addressing the coronavirus pandemic that has hit the United States hard.

text: Ginakabig niya nga “malala” ang COVID-19 kag liwat ini nga gintawag bilang “China virus” apang nagapakig-unong ini sa mga pamilya nga nadulaan sang palangga sa kabuhi.
english: He considered COVID-19 “serious” and again called it the “China virus” but expressed his condolences to the families who lost their loved ones.

text:
Nahibaluan nga masobra 400,000 ka tawo na ang napatay sa Estados Unidos bangud sa COVID-19

Samtang naga-take off ang Air Force One Plane sa diin sakay si Trump, matunog man nga nabatian ang ambahanon ni Frank Sinatra nga “My Way.”
english:
More than 400,000 people have died in the United States from COVID-1

As the Air Force One plane carrying Trump took off, Frank Sinatra's song "My Way" was also heard loudly.

text: Isa ka 52-anyos nga manugbaligya sang balut ang makahalanusbo nga nadulaan sang kabuhi matapos mabungguan sang madasig nga salakyan sa Koronadal City sang Sabado sang aga, Disyembre 7, 2024.
english: A 52-year-old balut vendor tragically lost his life after being hit by a speeding vehicle in Koronadal City on Saturday morning, December 7, 2024.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jenny Pabillona Asarcon, residente sang Purok Nursery, Barangay Sta.
english: The victim was identified as Jenny Pabillona Asarcon, resident of Purok Nursery, Barangay Sta.

text: Cruz, Koronadal City, ginatulod ang iya bisikleta sa higad sang dalan sang nabungguan sang madasig nga nagadalagan nga puti nga salakyan nga wala sang headlight.
english: Cruz, Koronadal City, was pushing his bicycle on the side of the road when he was hit by a speeding white vehicle without headlights.

text: Nagaguwa sa imbestigasyon sang kapulisan nga halin sa roundball area padulong sa Banga ang salakyan sang nagluntad ang aksidente sa Alunan Avenue malapit sa Barangay Zone IV.
english: Police investigation revealed that the vehicle was heading from the roundball area to Banga when the accident occurred on Alunan Avenue near Barangay Zone IV.

text: Gindala pa sa ospital si Asarcon apang gindeklarar nga dead on arrival sang mga nag-atender nga medical personnel.
english: Asarcon was rushed to the hospital but was declared dead on arrival by the attending medical personnel.

text: Boluntaryo naman nga nagsungka sa mga otoridad ang 23 anyos nga driver sang salakyan nga residente sang Banga, South Cotabato wala madugay matapos ang insidente.
english: The 23-year-old driver of the vehicle, a resident of Banga, South Cotabato, voluntarily surrendered to the authorities shortly after the incident.

text: WASHINGTON D.C – Nagsumpa na ang Democrat nga si Joe Biden bilang Presidente sang Estados Unidos.
english: WASHINGTON D.C – Democrat Joe Biden has been sworn in as President of the United States.

text: Ang bibliya nga ginatungtungan sang iya nawala nga kamot ang ginapanag-iyahan sang iya nga pamilya humalin pa sang 1893.
english: The bible he is resting in his left hand has been owned by his family since 1893.

text: Ini man ang gingamit niya sang siya ang nagsumpa bilang bise presidente sang 2009 kag 2013 kag bilang senador sa Delaware.
english: He also used it when he was sworn in as vice president in 2009 and 2013 and as a senator in Delaware.

text: Ang bibliya ang may yara sang 5 inches nga kadamulon.
english: The bible is 5 inches thick.

text: Si Biden, 78 anyos amo ang pinakatigulang Presidente sang Estados Unidos kag siya man ang ika-duha nga Roman Catholic President kasunod kay John F. Kennedy.
english: Biden, 78, is the oldest President of the United States and the second Roman Catholic President after John F. Kennedy.

text: Yari pamatian ang pagsumpa ni US President Joe Biden sa pagpanguna ni U.S. Chief Justice John Roberts .
english: Here's a listen to US President Joe Biden's swearing-in ceremony led by U.S. Chief Justice John Roberts .

text: Magluwas kay Biden, nagsumpa man si Kamala Harris bilang labing una nga babaye nga bise presidente sa kasaysayan sang Estados Unidos.
english: In addition to Biden, Kamala Harris was also sworn in as the first female vice president in US history.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Harris nga apisar siya ang una nga babaye sa nasambit nga posisyon, iya ginasiguro nga indi ini mangin katapusan bangud nagapati siya nga ang America ang pungsod sang madamo nga posibilidad.
english: Earlier, Harris said that although she is the first woman in the position, she is making sure that it will not be the last because she believes that America is the country of many possibilities.

text: Sa una nga mensahe nga ginhatag ni Biden sa iya pagpungko bilang Presidente, iya ginpasalamatan ang mga nagtambong sa inagurasyon gikan sa nagkalain-lain nga partido — sa Democratic party man ukon Republican Party sa diin yara sanday former US Presidents Bill Clinton, George Bush kag Barack Obama nga nagtambong sa seremonya.
english: In the first message Biden delivered as President, he thanked those who attended the inauguration from different parties — be it the Democratic party or the Republican Party where former US Presidents Bill Clinton, George Bush and Barack Obama were present at the ceremony.

text: Ginakabig niya nga adlaw sang Amerika kag adlaw sang demokrasya ang inagurasyon nga natabo.
english: He considers the inauguration that took place an American day and a democracy day.

text: Nagpasalig man si Biden nga iya amat-amat nga papason ang mga pagpangahangkat nga ginapangatubang sang Estados Unidos — lakip na ang pandemya.
english: Biden also pledged that he will phase out the challenges facing the United States — including the pandemic.

text: Apang nagpangabay ini sa publiko nga mag-isa kag magkooperar ang tanan agud nga mabalik ang America nga malinong.
english: But he asked the public to unite and cooperate to bring America back to peace.

text: Nagpangabay man si Biden sa mga rioters nga untatan na ang kinagamo bangud kun wala sang kooperasyon, indi gid malab-ot ang kalinongan nga ginahandom sang Estados Unidos.
english: Biden also urged the rioters to stop the violence because without cooperation, the peace that the United States dreams of will never be achieved.

text: “Let’s move forward,” ini ang nangin sentimento sang mga pumuluyo sa Washington DC sa nagahilapit na nga inagurasyon ni US President-elect Joe Biden.
english: “Let’s move forward,” was the sentiment of residents in Washington DC at the upcoming inauguration of US President-elect Joe Biden.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Anthony James Perez, Bombo International Correspondent direkta sa Washington DC, iya ginpahayag nga kapin 25,000 nga Armed National Guards lakip na ang mga kapulisan ang nagabantay na sa inagurasyon ni Biden.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Anthony James Perez, Bombo International Correspondent directly in Washington DC, said that more than 25,000 Armed National Guards including police are already guarding Biden's inauguration.

text: Suno kay Perez, may mga lugar nga normal lamang nga gina-agyan apang sa subong bantay sarado na sang mga otoridad sa diin may checkpoint na sa kada dalanon.
english: According to Perez, there are areas that are normally used but are now closed by the authorities where there are checkpoints on each road.

text: Ginpahayag ni Perez nga madamo sang mga tawo ang luyag na nga matapos sang matawhay ang transition ni outgoing President Donald Trump kag ni Biden sa inagurasyon.
english: Perez said many people want outgoing President Donald Trump and Biden to end their transition smoothly at the inauguration.

text: “Some just want to move forward, pero merong mga nagagalit pa rin, hindi parin matanggap ang bagong administrasyon,” pahayag ni Perez.
english: “Some just want to move forward, but there are those who are still angry, the new administration is still unacceptable,” Perez said.

text: Apang bangud sa supporters ni Trump nga hugot nga nagapati nga indi lehitimo ang pagdaog ni Biden, madamo sang nagaluntad nga mga protesta kag kinagamo.
english: However, due to Trump supporters who firmly believe that Biden's victory is illegitimate, there are many protests and unrest.

text: Apisar ginalauman na suno sa iya ang mga kinagamo sa inagurasyon, nagalaom sa gihapon ang mga tawo nga mangin matawhay ang tanan.
english: Although riots are expected at the inauguration, he said, people still hope that everything will be peaceful.

text: Matandaan nga una na nga nagpaandam ang Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) may kaangtanan sa posible patigayunon nga armed protest sang mga die-hard supporters ni Trump antes ang inagurasyon ni Biden.
english: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) had earlier warned of a possible armed protest by Trump's die-hard supporters ahead of Biden's inauguration.

text: Magapungko si Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, bilang head sang Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO).
english: Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos will take over as head of the Public Order and Safety Management Office (POSMO).

text: Ini kasunod man sang pag-appoint sa iya ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.
english: This follows his appointment by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas.

text: Si Garbanzos ang nagapungko subong bilang head sang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU).
english: Garbanzos is currently the head of the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Garbanzos, iya ginpahayag nga tan-awon sang ila talatapan ang mga unit nga under sa Public Order and Safety Management Office agud matagaan sang atensyon kag malab-ot ang ‘zero major incident’.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Garbanzos said his office will look into the units under the Public Order and Safety Management Office to give attention and achieve zero major incident.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, nagakoordinar na sila kaupod ang pila ka ahensya sang city government agud makahimo sang operational kag security plan kon may mga dalagko nga events sa Iloilo City.
english: Garbanzos said they are already coordinating with several agencies of the city government to develop an operational and security plan for major events in Iloilo City.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga hatagan sang prayoridad sang talatapan ang ‘best practices’ sa bag-o nga mga tikang.
english: He also explained that the office will give priority to best practices in the new measures.

text: Ginahikotar na sang Passi City Police Station ang kaso nga adultery batok isa ka Punong Barangay kag isa ka babaye nga pamilyado nga nagahimo sang sexual activity sa sulod sang isa ka Lodging House sa Barangay Imbang Grande, Passi City.
english: The Passi City Police Station is investigating a case of adultery against a Punong Barangay and a woman who is married for engaging in sexual activity inside a Lodging House in Barangay Imbang Grande, Passi City.

text: Ang Punong Barangay kag ang babaye, 30 anyos ang lunsay residente sang Calinog, Iloilo.
english: The Punong Barangay and the woman, 30 years old, are both residents of Calinog, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lt.

text: Col.
english: Col.

text: Atty. Benjo Clarite, hepe sang Passi City Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga ginahulat na lang ang ‘go signal’ sang Prosecutors Office agud nga opisyal na nga mapasaka ang kaso.
english: Atty. Benjo Clarite, chief of Passi City Police Station, said they are waiting for the go signal from the Prosecutors Office so that the case can be officially filed.

text: Suno kay Clarite, mahimo sa gihapon nga makapyansa ang duha ka mga indibidwal bangud sa bail, apang subong, indi pa matumod kon pila ang balor sini.
english: According to Clarite, the two individuals can still be released on bail, but as of now, it is not yet known how much it is worth.

text: Nakadependi naman sa Prosecutors Office ang balor sang bail nga ila idagdag batok sa duha ka arestado.
english: The amount of bail they will add against the two arrested persons is up to the Prosecutors Office.

text: Nagapati man si Clarite nga baskog ang ebidensya batok sa duha ilabi na nga nasaksihan gid sang bana ukon ‘caught in the act’ ang sexual activity.
english: Clarite also believes that the evidence against the two is strong especially that the husband witnessed the sexual activity.

text: Nahibaluan nga tuig 2022 sang ginkasal ang mag-asawa kag may isa ka anak.
english: It is known that it was the year 2022 when the couple got married and had one child together.

text: Nagsugod naman ang duda ang bana nga may karelasyon ang iya asawa sang makita sa cellphone sini nga may nagapadala sang indi amo nga mensahe.
english: The husband began to suspect that his wife was having an affair when he saw on her cellphone that someone was sending the wrong message.

text: Daw maano gid kita kun indi kita makapauli sa aton nga mga balay.
english: What will happen to us if we cannot return to our homes?

text: Siling nila, there is no place like home, kag amo man ini ang pinaka-safe nga lugar subong nga may pandemya.
english: They say, there is no place like home, and it is also the safest place now that there is a pandemic.

text: Baliskad ini sa natabo sa isa ka lalaki sa Estados Unidos kun sa diin tatlo ka bulan siya nga nagtinir sa isa ka secure area sa international airport sang Chicago bangud sang iya kahadlok nga magbyahe pauli sa ila nga balay California.
english: This is in contrast to what happened to a man in the United States where he spent three months in a secure area at Chicago's international airport because he was afraid to travel home to California.

text: Ang lalaki amo si Aditya Singh, 36.
english: The man was identified as Aditya Singh, 36.

text: Gin-aresto siya sang damlag lang bangud wala siya sang mapakita nga ID sang ginpangitaan siya sang isa ka airline staff.
english: He was recently arrested for not showing his ID when an airline staff searched for him.

text: Sa pagpangusisa sang mga pulis, Oktubre 9 pa sang nagligad nga tuig sang nag-abot si Mr. Singh sa airport apang ginapahayag nga nakulbaan siya magpauli bangud sang COVID-19.
english: According to police investigation, it was October 9 last year when Mr. Singh at the airport but was reportedly nervous about returning home because of COVID-19.

text: Sang ginpamangkot kun paano siya nabuhi sa sulod sang tatlo ka bulan, nagpanugid si Mr. Singh nga may mga maalwan man nga tawo sa airport nga naghatag sang pagkaon sa iya.
english: When asked how he survived for three months, Mr. Singh said there were also generous people at the airport who donated food to him.

text: Wala sang criminal backround si Mr. Singh sa ila lugar sa Los Angeles apang bangud sang iya pagtinir sa airport, napasakaan siya sang kaso nga felony criminal trespass kag misdemeanour theft.
english: Mr. has no criminal background. Singh in his hometown of Los Angeles but due to his stay at the airport, he was charged with felony criminal trespass and misdemeanor theft.

text: INDI kita dapat malipat sa aton experyensya sa Dengvaxia, ang vaccine kontra dengue nga ginbakal naton sa Sanofi Pasteur sadtong Nobyembre 2017, sa diin linibu ka kabataan ang napa-injectionan naton sini.
english: We must NOT forget our experience with Dengvaxia, the vaccine against dengue that we bought from Sanofi Pasteur in November 2017, where we injected thousands of children with it.

text: In fact, ang Filipinas gid ang una sa kalibutan nga nagbakal sini halin sa Sanofi Pasteur.
english: In fact, the Philippines was the first country in the world to buy it from Sanofi Pasteur.

text: Mga 600 ang gin-report nga kabataan ang napatay, although indi man seguro tungod lang sa Dengvaxia.
english: About 600 children have been reported to have died, although probably not just because of Dengvaxia.

text: Sa aton “panic” in the face sang nagadamo nga kaso sang dengue sa pungsod, nalipat kita sa paghibalo kon ano gid ang ginsudlan naton nga problema parti sa Dengvaxia.
english: In our panic in the face of the increasing number of dengue cases in the country, we have forgotten to know what the problem is with Dengvaxia.

text: Sang maghilibalo sa isa ka serye sang Congressional hearing, nagagwa gali nga ang Dengvaxia “safe” lang gamiton sang mga nakaagi dengue agud malikawan nga liwat sila iguon sini.
english: After learning from a series of Congressional hearings, it turned out that Dengvaxia is “safe” to use only for those who have had dengue to avoid being infected again.

text: Daku gali ang risgo ang pag-administer sini sa mga kabataan nga wala pa nakaagi dengue.
english: It is very risky to administer it to children who have not had dengue.

text: Ini ang wala gali naton natul-id sang gin-administer naton ini sa linibu naton nga kabataan sa elementarya sa pila ka rehiyon sang pungsod, nga wala naglakip sang Western Visayas.
english: This is what we did not correct when we administered it to thousands of our elementary school children in some regions of the country, which did not include Western Visayas.

text: In fact, sa pila ka nasyon nga nag-approve sang paggamit sangDengvaxia sang Sanofi Pasteur sa ila kabataan, lakip ang Singapore kag Estados Unidos, ginaathag gid nila sa ila public health advisory nga para lang ini sa mga kabataan nga nakaagi sang dengue agud indi liwat iguon.
english: In fact, in some countries that have approved the use of Sanofi Pasteur's Dengvaxia in their children, including Singapore and the United States, they make it clear in their public health advisory that it is only for children who have experienced dengue to prevent recurrence.

text: Ti, yara naman ang Chinese vaccine nga luyag maka-una sa palumba sa paghatag sang vaccine batok sa COVID-19.
english: Well, there is the Chinese vaccine that wants to be ahead in the race to provide a vaccine against COVID-19.

text: Ugaling kay isa lang ini ka “emergency vaccine”, nga ginahingagaw nga ipa-administer sa pila ka pumuluyo – katulad sang mga health workers, mga opisyales sang gobyerno, kag iban pa agud indi maulangan ang ila mga importante nga trabaho sa gobyerno kag kadam-an sang mga pumuluyo nga ila ginaserbihan.
english: However, it is only an “emergency vaccine”, which is being administered to some citizens – such as health workers, government officials, and others so as not to interfere with their important work in government and the majority of the people they serve.

text: Gamiton man kuno ini sang gobyerno sang China agud punggan ang pagbalik (re-infection) sang COVID-19 sa palaabuton nga tigtulugnaw, tungod ang immunity tubtub lang sa anom ka bulan ukon isa lang ka tuig.
english: The Chinese government will also use it to prevent re-infection of COVID-19 in the coming winter, as immunity lasts only six months or one year.

text: Ugaling man kay luyag pa ini ibaligya sa iban nga pungsod – sing mahal sangsa gina-offer sang iban nga pungsod nga naga-develop man sang vaccine – bisan wala ini sing approval sang  World Health Organization (WHO) kag sang mga FDA sang iban nga pungsod.
english: However, they still want to sell it to other countries – more expensive than offered by other countries that are also developing vaccines – even though it does not have the approval of the World Health Organization (WHO) and the FDAs of other countries.

text: “Iya lang ina sang China, kag wala kahilabtanan ang WHO,” siling gani sini.
english: “It belongs to China, and the WHO is not involved,” it said.

text: Apang ngaa bala wala ini pag-aprubahan sang WHO kag sang FDA sang iban nga pungsod?
english: But why is it not approved by the WHO and the FDA of other countries?

text: Labay man ang akon, kilala man ang China sa pag-export sang mga substandard nga mga produkto, lakip ang Christmas lights kag delikado nga hampanganan sang mga kabataan.
english: Aside from mine, China is also known for exporting substandard products, including Christmas lights and dangerous children's toys.

text: Kon wala ma-aprubahan sang WHO kag FDA sang iban nga pungsod ining Chinese vaccine, ina tungod wala pa lubos makumpleto ang final Clinical Trial 3 sini agud kilalahon nga “effective and safe”.
english: If the WHO and FDA of other countries have not approved this Chinese vaccine, it is because the final Clinical Trial 3 has not been fully completed to be recognized as “effective and safe”.

text: Tungod sini, posible nga “ineffective” ini, sunu sa pila ka health experts, kag maghatag sing false sense of security.
english: As a result, it may be “ineffective”, according to some health experts, and give a false sense of security.

text: Ukon may adverse effect sa ginadala nga balatian ukon allergy sang mabakunaan, nga natabo na sa pila ka kaso sang “unproven vaccine”.
english: Or there is an adverse effect on the underlying disease or allergy of the vaccine, which has happened in some cases of “unproven vaccine”.

text: Yara man ang problema sang “consent” ukon pagpahanugot sang mga participante sang vaccine inoculation.
english: There is also the problem of consent by participants of vaccine inoculation.

text: Sa mga Communist countries madamo nga sitwasyon nga sapilitan ginapatuman, which is not allowed in democratic countries sa ila respeto sa human right to give consent sa ila private rights.
english: In Communist countries many situations are forced to be implemented, which is not allowed in democratic countries in their respect for human right to give consent to their private rights.

text: If so, ang gwa sang mga participante diri mga guinea pigs ukon ano pa nga sapat nga sapilitan ginagamit sa experimento nga indi naton mahimo sa tawo.
english: If so, the outside of the participants here are guinea pigs or some other animal that is forced to be used in experiments that we can't do with humans.

text: Sa karon gani, ginatan-ay ining Chinese vaccine nga “emergency vaccine” sa global market.
english: Currently, this Chinese vaccine is considered an “emergency vaccine” in the global market.

text: Segurado, kon may offer man sa United States agud ibaligya ini sa mga US citizens indi ini ma-aprubahan sang US FDA.
english: Surely, if there is an offer in the United States to sell it to US citizens, it will not be approved by the US FDA.

text: Kag segurado, sang madamo man nga mga pungsod nga ga-respeto sang kinahanglanon sing lubos nga pagpangamlig sa ikaayong lawas sang ila mga pumuluyo.
english: And of course, by many countries that respect the need to fully protect the health of their citizens.

text: Ano ya ang tindug sang Filipinas?
english: What is the position of the Philippines?

text: Ambot sa kay Presidente Duterte, nga sadto nagpahayag sang iya luyag magkuha sang vaccine halin sa China?
english: I wonder about President Duterte, who then expressed his desire to get vaccines from China?

text: Kon ako kay Presidente, indi ko i-risgo ang ikaayong lawas sang aton mga pumuluyo sa isa lang ka “emergency vaccine”, samtang makahulat-hulat man kita sing diutay nga panahon sa tunay kag masaligan gid nga vaccine halin sa iban nga pungsod katulad sang US kag sa Uropa, pati na sa WHO, nga nagapatapos man sang ila Clinical Trial 3 sa karon./PN
english: If I were President, I would not risk the health of our people for a single emergency vaccine, while we can wait a little longer for a true and reliable vaccine from other countries such as the US and Europe, including the WHO, which is also completing its Clinical Trial 3./PN

text: Ginbantayan subong nga aga ang pagbalik sang basketball superstar guard nga si Luka Doncic sa Dallas, Texas, USA indi bilang isa ka Maverick kundi isa na ka kasumpong.
english: This morning watched the return of basketball superstar guard Luka Doncic to Dallas, Texas, USA not as a Maverick but already an opponent.

text: Ini ang una nga bes nga maga-bisita si Luka sa Dallas halin sang natabo ang blockbuster trade sang Pebrero 2, 2025 nga amo ang nagsaylo sa iya sa Los Angeles Lakers kabaylo sa 10-time All-Star nga si Anthony Davis.
english: This will be the first time Luka will visit Dallas since the blockbuster trade on February 2, 2025 that landed him with the Los Angeles Lakers in exchange for 10-time All-Star Anthony Davis.

text: Ini naman ang una nga tion nga magahampang si Davis kaupod ang Dallas batok sa Los Angeles.
english: This will be the first time Davis will play with Dallas against Los Angeles.

text: Kun matandaan, nagsuprer siya sang injury sang una nga nagkit-anay ang duha ka teams sang Pebrero 25.
english: He suffered an injury when the two teams first met on February 25.

text: Ang Dallas ang nagdaog sang titulo sa Western Conference sang nagligad nga season, apang nagapang-10 ini subong sa standings.
english: Dallas won the Western Conference title last season, but is currently 10th in the standings.

text: Ang Lakers naman ang nagapangatlo subong sa conference.
english: The Lakers are currently third in the conference.

text: Antes sini nga hampang, ginpaguwa si Luka sa hampang sang Lakers batok sa Oklahoma City Thunder bangud sa iya ikaduha nga technical foul.
english: Prior to this game, Luka was ejected from the Lakers’ game against the Oklahoma City Thunder for his second technical foul.

text: Nalutos ang Lakers sa amo nga game sa skor nga 136-120.
english: The Lakers lost that game 136-120.

text: Kinahanglan nga daugon sang Lakers ang duha sa ila nabilin nga tatlo ka mga hampang agud nga makakuha sang pwesto sa West.
english: The Lakers need to win two of their remaining three games to clinch a spot in the West.

text: Nag-post ang Pilipinas sang ginasuspetsahan nga digital fraud rate nga 13.4 percent sang 2024, kapin sa doble sang global average nga 5.4 percent kag ikaduha nga pinakamataas sa mga ginsurbey nga mga pungsod.
english: The Philippines posted a suspected digital fraud rate of 13.4 percent in 2024, more than double the global average of 5.4 percent and the second highest among the surveyed countries.

text: Suno sa global information solutions provider nga TransUnion, nalampasan na sang Pilipinas ang global fraud rate sa ikalima nga sunod-sunod nga tuig.
english: According to global information solutions provider TransUnion, the Philippines has surpassed the global fraud rate for the fifth consecutive year.

text: Nagpanguna ang India nga may pinakamataas nga digital fraud rate nga nagalab-ot sa 19 percent, ginasundan sang Pilipinas kag Dominican Republic nga may 10.9 percent.
english: India topped the list with the highest digital fraud rate of 19 percent, followed by the Philippines and the Dominican Republic with 10.9 percent.

text: Gintudlo man sang datos ang makaalarma nga pagtaas sang mga insidente nga may kaangtanan sa pagpangdaya nga nagapuntirya sa mga Pilipino.
english: The data also pointed to an alarming rise in fraud-related incidents targeting Filipinos.

text: Halos tatlo sa apat ka mga Pilipino (74 percent) nga ginsurbey ang nagsiling nga sila ang na-target sang mga fraud scheme paagi sa email, online platforms, tawag sa telepono ukon text messages.
english: Nearly three in four Filipinos (74 percent) surveyed said they have been targeted by fraud schemes through email, online platforms, phone calls or text messages.

text: Mas mataas ini sangsa 53 percent nga average sa 18 ka iban pa nga pungsod kag rehiyon.
english: This is higher than the 53 percent average in 18 other countries and regions.

text: Ginalauman na sang mga otoridad sang 50 ka estado sang Amerika kag ang District of Columbia ang posible nga pagkinagamo sang mga protesters antes ang natalana nga inagurasyon ni President-elect Joe Biden.
english: Authorities in 50 US states and the District of Columbia are already expecting potential violence from protesters ahead of President-elect Joe Biden's scheduled inauguration.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Arnel Noel Gellada, direkta sa Houston, Texas, USA, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sa supporters ni outgoing US President Donald Trump sa ila nga lugar ang nakabaton na nga pahalinon na ini bilang presidente.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Arnel Noel Gellada, live in Houston, Texas, USA, he said that many of the supporters of outgoing US President Donald Trump in their area have already accepted that he will be removed as president.

text: Apisar sini suno kay Gellada, indi mapaktan kun ano pa ang mga tikang nga himuon sang loyal kag die hard fans ni Trump.
english: Despite this, Gellada said, it is impossible to predict what further steps Trump's loyal and die hard fans will take.

text: Nakahanda na ang mga kapulisan apang wala sang kasiguraduhan kun ano ang mga mahimo magluntad sa adlaw mismo sang inagurasyon.
english: Police are prepared but there is no certainty about what might happen on the day of the inauguration.

text: “Wala kita kahibalo sang mga plano gid ya sang mga loyal Trump supporters nga mga die hard gid ya bala, amo na nga balantyan ini kay may mga balita nga mahimo sang mga tikang ang mga loyalist gid ya ni President Donald Trump sa pag-abot sang inauguration day,” pahayag ni Gellada.
english: "We don't know the plans of the loyal Trump supporters who are die hard, so watch out for it because there are news that President Donald Trump's loyalists will take steps on inauguration day," Gellada said.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Gellada nga posible gamay lang ang magatambong sang inagurasyon bangud sa pagkahangawa sang posible kinagamo.
english: Gellada also said that few people may attend the inauguration due to concerns about possible unrest.

text: Matandaan nga nagpaandam na ang Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) nga posible may mga armed protests nga patigayunon ang mga supporters ni US President Donald Trump sa nanuhay-tuhay nga mga estado sang pungsod.
english: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) has warned that there may be armed protests by supporters of US President Donald Trump in various states of the country.

text: Wala pa sang request nga ginpadala ang kapulisan sa Iloilo City Council agud magpatuman sang signal jamming sa Dinagyang Festival 2025.
english: The police have not yet sent a request to the Iloilo City Council to implement signal jamming during the Dinagyang Festival 2025.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, Chairman sang Committee on Public Safety, iya ginpahayag nga kon ‘signal jamming’ posible pa sila nga magpasugot ang council apang kon ‘signal shutdown’ mahimo nga madamo sang maapektohan rason nga sang nagligad nga Dinagyang, wala sang signal jamming/shutdown nga ginpatuman.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna, Chairman of the Committee on Public Safety, said that if there is a signal jamming, the council may agree but if there is a signal shutdown, many people may be affected.

text: Suno kay Cabaluna, tubtob subong, wala sa gihapon sang proposal sa nasambit nga mga tikang.
english: According to Cabaluna, so far, there is still no proposal on these measures.

text: Ginpahayag man sini masami Disyembre nagapadala sang sulat ang Philippine National Police (PNP) agud madiskusyonan ini sang temprano.
english: He said the Philippine National Police (PNP) usually sends letters in December to discuss the matter early.

text: Nagalaum man ang natungdan nga kon may pasilidad na ang kapulisan nga mag-signal jamming, mahimo ini nga mapahanugotan, apang kon wala lang man kag shutdown ang matabo, posible nga magaagi ini anay sa madamo nga rekisitos.
english: He also hopes that if the police have a facility to do signal jamming, it can be allowed, but if there is no shutdown, it is possible that it will go through many requirements.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang nagligad nga tuig, wala na ginpatuman ang signal jamming/shutdown bangud sa mga disbentaha nga natuga sini sang 2022.
english: It is known that last year, signal jamming/shutdown was not implemented due to the disadvantages it caused in 2022.

text: Nakabakal na ang Iloilo Provincial Government sang 20,000 vials sang anti-rabies vaccine nga gamiton para sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government has already purchased 20,000 vials of anti-rabies vaccine for next year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Darel Tabuada, head sang Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office, iya ginpahayag nga gin-gastohan sa gihapon sang Provincial Government sang P9 million sa pagbakal sang bakuna agud ihatag sa mga local government units.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Darel Tabuada, head of the Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office, said the Provincial Government still spent P9 million to purchase the vaccine to be distributed to local government units.

text: Suno kay Dr. Tabuada, 86% na ang nabakunahan nga mga ido sa probinsya sa diin lapaw na ini sa target nga 70%.
english: According to Dr. Tabuada said 86% of dogs in the province have been vaccinated, exceeding the target of 70%.

text: Maga-umpisa ang mass vaccination sa mga ido sa Pebrero 1, 2025 tubtob Abril 30, 2025.
english: Mass vaccination of dogs will begin on February 1, 2025 until April 30, 2025.

text: Pahayag niya, mas pabaskugon pa sang Provincial Veterinary Office ang pagpangbakuna sa mga stray dogs bangud amo ini ang pagpanghangkat sa ila subong.
english: He said the Provincial Veterinary Office will intensify the vaccination of stray dogs as this is the challenge they are facing now.

text: Sa subong, nagapabilin sa 28 ka mga island barangays halin sa Carles, Concepcion, San Dionisio kag Ajuy ang rabies-free.
english: Currently, 28 island barangays from Carles, Concepcion, San Dionisio and Ajuy remain rabies-free.

text: Ginalantaw ni Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar nga mangin masubo subong nga Disyembre ang pila ka mga Barangay Tanod sa probinsya bangud indi makabaton sang cash incentives apisar nga may pondo man nga ginpain ang Provincial Government para sa ila.
english: Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar expects some Barangay Tanods in the province to be sad this December because they will not receive cash incentives despite the fact that the Provincial Government has allocated funds for them.

text: Si Mondejar amo ang author sang Provincial Ordinance 2020-240 ang ordinansa nga nagahatag sang benepisyo kag incentives sa mga Barangay Tanod.
english: Mondejar is the author of Provincial Ordinance 2020-240 the ordinance that provides benefits and incentives to Barangay Tanods.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Board Member Mondejar, iya ginpahayag nga may yara pa sang 24 ka mga local government units ang wala pa makakuha sang incentives sa ila mga tanod sa diin 19 diri ang nagahikot na sang requirements kag lima pa ang wala gid nakapasa sang requirements agud makuha ang incentives sang ila mga tanod nga sa pagkamatuod Disyembre 2023 pa ini kuntani.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Board Member Mondejar said there are still 24 local government units that have not yet received incentives from their tanods, of which 19 are already implementing the requirements and five have not yet submitted the requirements to receive the incentives of their tanods.

text: Ang lima ka mga LGUs suno sa iya nga wala gid makapasa sang requirements sang ila Barangay Tanod amo ang Guimbal, Passi City, Leganes, San Miguel kag Pototan.
english: The five LGUs, he said, that have not submitted the requirements of their Barangay Tanods are Guimbal, Passi City, Leganes, San Miguel and Pototan.

text: P1,000 ang cash incentive nga nabaton kag mabaton pa sang mga barangay tanod para sa Disyembre 2023 samtang subong nga 2024, gindugangan ini sang P1,000 — buot silingon, P2,000 ang makuha sang mga barangay tanod sa mga LGUs nga naka-process na sang ila requirements para sa Disyembre 2024 nga incentive.
english: P1,000 is the cash incentive received and will be received by the barangay tanods for December 2023 while in 2024, it has been increased by P1,000 — that is, P2,000 will be received by the barangay tanods from LGUs that have already processed their requirements for the December 2024 incentive.

text: Gindiga sang Metro Roxas Water District ang ila ‘best practices’ sa nubo nga non-revenue water (NRW).
english: The Metro Roxas Water District has implemented its best practices in low non-revenue water (NRW).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Donnalee Deondo, Division Manager sang Metro Roxas Water District, iya ginpahayag nga gin-intensify sang ila talatapan ang pagpatuman sang orientation sa ila empleyado.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Donnalee Deondo, Division Manager of the Metro Roxas Water District, said the office has intensified the implementation of orientation to its employees.

text: Suno kay Deondo, ginakabig gid nila nga isa ka legasiya ang paghatag sang maayo nga kalidad sang tubig para sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Deondo said they consider it a legacy to provide good water quality for the residents.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga kon may makit-an sila nga mga leak sa ila tubo, gilayon nga ila ginasekyar ang mga linya agud mahatagan sang solusyon.
english: He also explained that if they find any leaks in their pipes, they immediately check the lines to provide a solution.

text: Ginhimo man ang talatapan ang pag-procure sang advance technology nga maka-detect sang mga leakages.
english: The office also made procurement of advance technology that can detect leakages.

text: Ginpadayaw man sang Metro Roxas Water District nga may mga personnel sila nga nagaguwa adlaw-adlaw agud nga maglibot kag mag-monitor sang mga leakages sa ila tubo.
english: The Metro Roxas Water District also boasted that they have personnel who go out every day to patrol and monitor leakages in their pipes.

text: Matapos ang maragtason nga performance sa Miami Open sang damlag lang, liwat na naman nga magahampang ang Pinay tennis sensation nga si Alex Eala sa French Open.
english: After a historic performance at the Miami Open recently, Pinay tennis sensation Alex Eala will play again at the French Open.

text: Suno sa 19-anyos nga tennis star, naumpisahan na niya ang clay training para sa 2025 French Open kun sa diin ginalauman nga mahimo niya ang iya first-ever main draw appearance sa professional ranks.
english: According to the 19-year-old tennis star, he has already started clay training for the 2025 French Open where he is expected to make his first-ever main draw appearance in the professional ranks.

text: Apang ginpakigbahin ni Eala nga madugay na siya nga wala nakahampang sa clay surface kag kalabanan sa hard kag grass courts sa nagligad nga pila ka bulan.
english: However, Eala shared that he has not played on a clay surface for a long time and mostly on hard and grass courts in the past few months.

text: Sa pihak sini, ginsiling sang world no.
english: Meanwhile, the world no.

text: 73 nga mataas ang iya confidence matapos ang dalayawon nga hampang sa Miami Open, kun sa dian nalab-ot niya ang semifinals paagi sa pagpierde sa mga nalakip sa top 10 players kaangay nanday Iga Swiatek kag Madison Keys.
english: 73 that his confidence is high after a great match at the Miami Open, where he reached the semifinals by defeating top 10 players such as Iga Swiatek and Madison Keys.

text: Magasugod ang French Open sa Mayo 25 tubtob Hunyo 8 kun sa diin ginalauman ang presensya ni world no.
english: The French Open will run from May 25 to June 8 where world no.

text: 1 Aryna Sabalenka kag iban nga top players.
english: 1 Aryna Sabalenka and other top players.

text: ISA NA seguro sa pinakasubo nga hitabo sa aton pungsod ang pagpaluntad sang Martial Law sadtong 1972-1986.
english: THE imposition of Martial Law in 1972-1986 was perhaps one of the saddest events in our country.

text: Natapos lang ini sang malagyo si Presidented Ferdinand Marcos kag ang iya pamilya sa Hawaii sadtong Pebrero 26, 1986 bunga sang “Bloodless EDSA Revolution” sang Pebrero 22-25, 1986.
english: It ended when President Ferdinand Marcos and his family fled to Hawaii on February 26, 1986 as a result of the “Bloodless EDSA Revolution” of February 22-25, 1986.

text: Gin-deklarar ni anay President Ferdinand Marcos ang gahom military sadtong Setyembre 21, 1972 sa rason, sunu sa iya, agud tapnaon ang padayon nga “violence”kag ang mga rally sa pungsod , labi na gid sa Metro Manila, batok sa “social injustice” nga ginareklamo sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Former President Ferdinand Marcos declared martial law on September 21, 1972 for the reason, he said, to curb the continuing violence and rallies in the country, especially in Metro Manila, against the social injustice complained of by the people.

text: Sa sina nga tion, lapnagon na ang kaimolon.
english: At that time, poverty will be widespread.

text: In fact,  ang istastika nagasiling nga diyes porsyento (10%) lang ang nagapanag-iya sang manggad sang pungsod samtang ang 90% wala sing matalauma nga ila kaugalingon, wala mabugsukan sing puluy-an, kag mataas ang “unemployment” ukon ang kawalan sang trabaho.
english: In fact, statistics say that only ten percent (10%) own the country's wealth while 90% are homeless, homeless, and unemployed.

text: Ang Kongreso dominado man sang mga manggaran kag poderoso nga mga pamilya nga, fuera los buenos, hakaban sa manggad kag poder kag ang kadam-an halos mga isklabo nila.
english: Congress is also dominated by rich and powerful families who, fuera los buenos, are greedy for wealth and power and the majority are almost their slaves.

text:
***

Nagpasalig si Marcos nga tadlong ang sitwasyon sa sosyedad.
english:
***

Marcos assured that the situation in society is right.

text: Ginpatuman niya ang land reform agud makuha sa mga manggaran ang sobra nga pagpasasa nila sa pagpanag-iya sang mga kaumhan kag ihatag ang kabahin sini sa mga gamay nga mangunguma.
english: He implemented land reform to take away from the rich their excessive ownership of farms and give part of it to small farmers.

text: Ginpalagas niya ang mga poderoso nga nagahupot sang mga private army agud mapahapos ang pagpatuman sang iban pa nga reforma pang-ekonomiya, pulitikal kag sosyal.
english: He expelled the powerful holders of private armies to facilitate the implementation of other economic, political and social reforms.

text: Ginpalagas man niya ang mga dalagku nga kriminal, labi na gid ang mga criminal syndicate kag ang drug cartel.
english: He also pursued big criminals, especially criminal syndicates and the drug cartel.

text: Ginpalagas man niya ang mga hublag komunista.
english: He also persecuted communist movements.

text: Kag iban pa.
english: And so on.

text: Apang ningas cogon kag pakulahaw man lang gali ang iya mga pangako.
english: But his promises are just a joke.

text: Liwat nga nagbalik ang mga gamhanan sa sosyedad, nga kon tawgon mga cronies sa iya panahon, nga ginsaligan ni Marcos sa pagdumala sang dalagku nga industriya sa kalamay, kalubihan kag mga plantasyon sa diin nagkita sila sing daku kag nangin bag-o nga mga “powerful elite”.
english: The powerful in society, the so-called cronies of his time, whom Marcos entrusted with the management of the large sugarcane, irrigation and plantation industries where they made huge profits and became new “powerful elites” returned.

text: Siling niya ibalik niya ang demokrasya paagi sa “honest election”.
english: He said he would restore democracy through “honest elections”.

text: Pero, manipulado gali niya ang resulta sang eleksyon ng nagpadaug sing landslide sa iya mga bata-bata.
english: However, he manipulated the election results and won a landslide for his children.

text: Agud maghuyang pa ang oposisyon, pinalagas ini sila tanan, ginpapriso, ukon napilitan sa pagpalagyo sa luas sang pungsod.
english: To further weaken the opposition, they were all expelled, imprisoned, or forced to flee abroad.

text: Gin-medyosan gid niya nga indi makahulag sing maayo ang oposisyon, labi na gid ang mortal niya nga kaaway sa pulitika nga si anay Senador Ninoy Aquino nga ginpa-asasinar niya, sunu sa pagpati sang iban, kag gintudlo ini sa isa ka kumander sang NPA nga indi mapatihan nga makasulod sa tarmac sang erport agud dira luthangon si Aquino.
english: He tried to prevent the opposition from moving properly, especially his mortal political enemy, former Senator Ninoy Aquino, whom he assassinated, according to some, and pointed it out to an NPA commander who could not be believed to enter the airport tarmac to shoot Aquino.

text: Madamo man sing violation sang human rights, katulad sang torture, forced disappearance nga indi na makita liwat, kag pagpatay sag mga suspetsado nga wala sing due process.
english: There are also many human rights violations, such as torture, forced disappearances, and killings of suspects without due process.

text:
***

Kag natabo ang Snap Election sang Pebrero 7, 1986, pagkatapos sang asasinasyon ni Aquino sadtong Agosto 1983 nga nagpa-alsa sang balatyagon sang mga pumuluyo.
english:
***

And the Snap Election took place on February 7, 1986, after the assassination of Aquino in August 1983 that raised the feelings of the people.

text: Madata ang dinayaan nga gintudlo sa grupo ni Marcos.
english: There was a lot of deception pointed out to the Marcos group.

text: Nag-walkout gani sadtong inisipay sang Pebrero 8, 1986 ang ginsiling nga Comelec 35 tungod sa hayag nga dinayaay sa inisipay.
english: The so-called Comelec 35 even walked out of the February 8, 1986 election because of blatant fraud in the election.

text: Bag-o sina, nangin  mainit ang kampanyahanay, sa diin ginhimo ang tanan sang diktadurya ni Marcos agud indi magdaug si Cory, balo ni Ninoy, sa Snap Election,  apang napadaug gid.
english: Before that, the campaign was heated, with the Marcos dictatorship doing everything to prevent Cory, Ninoy's widow, from winning the Snap Election, but she did.

text: Nangin mainit man ang eleksyon sang mga lokal nga opisyales.
english: Local official elections have also been heated.

text: Sa Antique gin-asasinar ang nagdaug nga si Gobernador Evelio Javier sadtong Pebrero 11, 1986.
english: In Antique, the winning Governor Evelio Javier was assassinated on February 11, 1986.

text: Sa Iloilo, ang Iloilo Chairman sang UNIDO – partido ni Doy Laurel nga nagsuporta kay Cory Aquino for President – kag Board Member Edwin Baldago gin-ambush sang mga soldado ni Marcos upod sang duha niya ka alalay samtang nagapauli sang kaagahon sang Mayo 26, 1983.
english: In Iloilo, the Iloilo Chairman of UNIDO – Doy Laurel's party that supported Cory Aquino for President – ​​and Board Member Edwin Baldago were ambushed by Marcos soldiers along with two of his supporters while returning home on the morning of May 26, 1983.

text: Sadto myembro man ako sang UNIDO, sa diin si Edwin ang amon tsirman sa Iloilo.
english: I was also a member of UNIDO, where Edwin was our chairman in Iloilo.

text: Ginkuha ako ni Edwin bilang personal secretary niya tungod sang akon trabaho sa media.
english: Edwin hired me as his personal secretary because of my work in the media.

text: Sa masami  ginadala niya ako sa kon diin siya maglakat.
english: He often takes me wherever he goes.

text: Apang, sadtong banda a las otso sa gab-i, nagsakit ang akon ulo kag naglisensya nga indi ako maka-upod.
english: However, around eight o'clock in the evening, I had a headache and asked permission not to go.

text: Nagsugot siya, kag amo na ato ang natabo kay Edwin sa kamot sang isa ka platoon sang soldado.
english: He agreed, and that's what happened to Edwin at the hands of a platoon of soldiers.

text: Salamat, Edwin, kay ginlikaw mo ako  sa hilaw nga kamatayon sang nagsugot ka nga indi anay ako mag-upod sa imo sadtong tion!/PN
english: Thank you, Edwin, for saving me from a raw death when you agreed not to come with me at that time!/PN

text: Magabalik na naman ang gyera sa Gaza.
english: The war in Gaza will resume.

text: Ini matapos nagmandu si Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu sa Israeli military nga mag-atake na naman sa amo nga lugar sa Palestine.
english: This comes after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ordered the Israeli military to attack the Palestinian area again.

text: Suno sa iya, kasunod ini sang ginhimo sang Hamas nga paglapas sa ceasefire.
english: He said this followed Hamas' violation of the ceasefire.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Israeli military officials nga nag-atake ang Hamas sa pwersa sang Israel sa Rafah sa area sang Gaza nga yara pa kuntani sa idalom sang control sang Israel.
english: Earlier, Israeli military officials said Hamas attacked Israeli forces in Rafah in the Gaza Strip, which was still under Israeli control.

text: Nauna man nga nag-akusar si Netanyahu nga wala nagsunod ang Hamas sa ceasefire sang naghatag sila sang lain nga bangkay samtang gina-turn-over sa Israel ang lawas sang mga bihag.
english: Netanyahu also earlier accused Hamas of not following the ceasefire when they provided another body while turning over the bodies of the hostages to Israel.

text: Suno sa prime minister, ang parte sang lawas nga ginhatag sang Hamas amo ang iya sang isa ka hostage nga na-recover na sang pwersa sang Israel sa Gaza halos duha ka tuig na ang nakaligad.
english: The prime minister said the body part handed over by Hamas belonged to a hostage that had already been recovered by Israeli forces in Gaza almost two years ago.

text: Nagsabat naman ang Hamas nga nagasunod sila sa nakasugtan nga ceasefire apang nagapangita lang si Netanyahu sang rason agud nga palagyuhan ang obligasyon sa idalom sang ila kuntani nga nakasugtan.
english: Hamas responded that it was complying with the ceasefire agreement but Netanyahu was just looking for an excuse to escape the obligation under their supposed agreement.

text: Matandaan nga Oktubre 10 sang ginpatuman ang ceasefire paagi sa pagpatunga sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The ceasefire was implemented on October 10 through the mediation of the United States of America.

text: Duha ka tuig ang gyera sa amo nga lugar sa Palestine nga nag-umpisa sang Oktubre 7, 2023.
english: Two years have passed since the war in that area in Palestine began on October 7, 2023.

text: Base sa health authorities sa Gaza, 68,000 ka tawo ang kumpirmado nga patay bangud sa pagpamomba sang Israel kag linibo ang missing sa sulod sang duha ka tuig nga may gyera.#
english: According to health authorities in Gaza, 68,000 people have been confirmed dead as a result of Israeli bombing and thousands are missing during the two years of war.

text: Husto kag bastante nga impormasyon ang ginakinahanglan sang mga tawo agud makumbinse nga magpabakuna batok sa COVID-19.
english: People need accurate and sufficient information to be convinced to get vaccinated against COVID-19.

text: Ini amo man ang ginatinguhaan nga himuon sang mga opisyal kag health authorities sa Ohio, U.S.A samtang amat-amat na nga ginalikop ang estado para sa vaccination.
english: This is also what officials and health authorities in Ohio, U.S.A. are trying to do as the state is slowly being cordoned off for vaccination.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Mary Drake direkta sa Ohio, U.S.A., bakuna sang Moderna kag Pfizer-BioNTech ang ginagamit sa Ohio.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Mary Drake directly in Ohio, U.S.A., Moderna and Pfizer-BioNTech vaccines are being used in Ohio.

text: Suno kay Drake, mismo ang mga hospital management top officials ang nagapresentar nga mag-una sa pagpabakuna agud maengganyo ang iban nga health frontliners nga mag-avail man sang dose.
english: According to Drake, the hospital management top officials themselves are presenting to take the lead in vaccination to encourage other health frontliners to also avail of the dose.

text: Bilang isa man ka nurse sa rehalibitation center sa Ohio, gin-ako ni Drake nga sang una, may mga pagpangduha-duha man siya sa bakuna nga gina-administer bangud sa posible halit nga dala sang doses.
english: Also a nurse at a rehabilitation center in Ohio, Drake admitted that in the past, she also had doubts about the vaccine being administered because of the potential harm caused by the doses.

text: Kaangay niya, may iban man nga nagapamatok sa bakuna bangud sa ila religious beliefs; samtang may iban naman nga wala gid nagaavail sang bisan ano nga bakuna halin sang una.
english: Like him, there are others who oppose the vaccine because of their religious beliefs; while there are others who have never availed of any vaccine since the beginning.

text: Apang ginpahayag ni Drake nga ang pagtuon kag paghibalo sang mga impormasyon sa vaccination ang nakabulig sa iya — rason nga amat-amat naman siya nga nagakakumbinse nga magsuporta sa mass vaccination program.
english: But Drake said learning and knowing vaccination information has helped him — which is why he is slowly becoming convinced to support the mass vaccination program.

text: Sa subong, 297,000 ka doses na sang bakuna ang na-administer sa Ohio.
english: So far, 297,000 doses of the vaccine have been administered in Ohio.

text: Ang Ohio amo ang ika-23 nga estado sa Estados Unidos sa may pinakamadasig nga transmission sang virus sa per-person basis.
english: Ohio is the 23rd state in the United States in terms of having the fastest transmission of the virus on a per-person basis.

text: Sa subong, masobra na sa 770,000 ka tawo sa amo nga estado ang infected sang coronavirus kag masobra 9,500 ang patay.
english: So far, more than 770,000 people in the state have been infected with the virus and more than 9,500 have died.

text: Wala pa sang kapat-uran kun mangin bastante ang suporta sang mga Republicans sa ginaduso nga pagpa-impeach kay U.S. President Donald Trump pila ka adlaw antes pormal nga matapos ang iya termino bilang presidente sang pungsod.
english: It is uncertain whether Republicans will have enough support for the proposed impeachment of U.S. President Donald Trump days before his term as president of the country formally ends.

text: Suno kay Bombo International Correspondent Sonia Provido Short direkta sa Mississippi, USA, lain-lain man nga opinyon ang nagagwa halin sa mga mangin-alamon sa Estados Unidos.
english: According to Bombo International Correspondent Sonia Provido Short directly in Mississippi, USA, different opinions are also coming out from intellectuals in the United States.

text: Bwas, Lunes nga adlaw, may iga-introduce nga articles of impeachment ang Democratic members sang House of Representatives.
english: Tomorrow, Monday, Democratic members of the House of Representatives will introduce articles of impeachment.

text: Ang ginaduso nga impeachment ang kasunod sang pag-engganyo ni Trump sa iya nga mga supporters nga magpadulong sa U.S. Capitol sang nagligad nga Enero 8 agud pamatukan ang pag-certify sang Kongreso sa pagdaug ni US President-Elect Joe Biden.
english: The proposed impeachment comes after Trump encouraged his supporters to march to the U.S. Capitol on January 8 to protest Congress' certification of US President-Elect Joe Biden's victory.

text: Ang kuntani peaceful rally nga patigayunon ang nagresulta sa isa ka riot kun sa diin nangin bayolente ang mga tawo kag narekord ang apat ka mga patay bangud sa aktibidad.
english: The peaceful rally that was supposed to be held resulted in a riot where people became violent and four deaths were recorded due to the activity.

text: Suno naman kay Short, wala pa sang kasiguraduhan kun ano ang mangin akto sang Republicans kasunod sang pagpaninguha sang mga Democrats nga pahalinon si Trump.
english: Short said there is still uncertainty about what the Republicans will do following the Democrats' efforts to remove Trump.

text: May mga Republican lawmakers nga nagpahayag nga dapat na manaog sa pwesto si Trump; samtang may iban naman nga high-ranking administration officials nga wala nagasuporta sa panawagan sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Some Republican lawmakers have said Trump should step down; while there are other high-ranking administration officials who do not support the call of the people.

text: Ginpahayag man sang iban nga ang pag-impeach kay Trump apisar masobra isa ka semana na lang ang nabilin sa iya termino ang makatuga lang sang pagtunga sa Estados Unidos.
english: Some have also said that impeaching Trump with more than a week left in his term will only create division in the United States.

text: May nagasiling man nga nahadlok lang ang mga Democrats kun ano pa ang masarangan nga mahimo ni Trump sa masobra isa ka semana nga nabilin sa iya nga termino.
english: Some say Democrats are just afraid of what Trump can do with more than a week left in his term.

text:
“We’re hopeful and prayerful nga mangin matalunsay ang transition of power”

Bilang isa man ka US Citizen, nagalaum kag nagapangamuyo man si Short nga matapos na ang kinagamo sa Estados Unidos.
english:
“We’re hopeful and prayerful that the transition of power will be smooth”

As a US citizen, Short also hopes and prays that the violence in the United States will end.

text: Vocal si Short sang iya suporta kay President Trump kag sa pagkamatuod suno sa iya, kun nahatagan sang kahigayunan, magapasakop man siya sa peaceful protest batok sa certification sang pagdaog ni Biden bangud suno sa iya, may mga ebidensya pa nga dapat lantawon agud mapamatud-an nga may dayaay nga natabo sa eleksyon.
english: Short was vocal in his support for President Trump and in fact said that if given the opportunity, he would also participate in a peaceful protest against the certification of Biden's victory because he said there is still evidence to look at to prove that there was fraud in the election.

text: Apang gin-athag ni Short nga suportado niya ang protesta apang maathag nga sala ang riot.
english: But Short made it clear that he supported the protest but that the riot was clearly wrong.

text: Sa subong, ginalauman nga madayon ang malinong nga transition sang power sa Biden Administration nga amo man ang una nga ginpromisa ni President Trump sa iya nga tweet.
english: In the meantime, it is expected that the peaceful transition of power to the Biden Administration will take place, which is what President Trump first promised in his tweet.

text: ILOILO – Nagguwa sa report sang Commission on Audit nga may yara sang 68 ka mga proyekto sa Iloilo nga nagabalor P130.148 million ang wala pa makumpleto as of December 31, 2023.
english: ILOILO – The Commission on Audit report revealed that there are 68 projects in Iloilo worth P130.148 million that have not been completed as of December 31, 2023.

text: Ang mga proyekto ang ginpondohan sa idalom sang Local Government Support Fund – Support to the Barangay Development Program (LGSF-SBDP) sang National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC).
english: The projects were funded under the Local Government Support Fund – Support to the Barangay Development Program (LGSF-SBDP) of the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC).

text: Apang sa 68 ka mga proyekto, 42 pa diri ang wala ma pondohan nga nagabalor P97.884 million.
english: However, of the 68 projects, 42 are still unfunded worth P97.884 million.

text: Bangud sini, ginrekomenda sang Commission on Audit sa Iloilo Provincial Government nga i-comply ang requirements sa idalom sang Department of the Interior and Local Government Memorandum Circular 2023-063 partikular na sa commitment sa pagpain sang local funds kag pagkumpleto sang proyekto kag pagpadasig nga pagkaayo sang mga proyekto nga ginpondohan sang LGSF-SBDP sang NTF-ELCAC agud malab-ot ang objectives sang programa.
english: In this regard, the Commission on Audit recommended to the Iloilo Provincial Government to comply with the requirements under the Department of the Interior and Local Government Memorandum Circular 2023-063 particularly on the commitment to allocate local funds and complete the project and accelerate the rehabilitation of projects funded by the NGSF-SBTF-EDPLC-NGSFAC-EDPLC to achieve the objectives of the program.

text: Base sa sabat sang Iloilo Provincial Government, nagpain ini sang P51.055 million agud makumpleto ang 57 ka mga proyekto kag as of July 26, 2024, yara na sa implementation stage ang 23 ka mga proyekto samtang ang nabilin ang yara sa procurement stage.
english: Based on the response of the Iloilo Provincial Government, it has allocated P51.055 million to complete 57 projects and as of July 26, 2024, 23 projects are already in the implementation stage while the rest are in the procurement stage.

text: Nagpain man ang Iloilo Provincial Government sang P29.200 million agud makumpleto ang dugang nga 10 ka mga ELCAC projects.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Government also allocated P29.200 million to complete an additional 10 ELCAC projects.

text: Nagpasalig ang Provincial Government nga padayon nga maga-request ang Provincial Engineer’s Office sang allocation agud makumpleto ang nabilin nga proyekto.
english: The Provincial Government assured that the Provincial Engineer's Office will continue to request allocation to complete the remaining projects.

text: Palawigon pa sang Iloilo City Government ang paghatag sang 40% nga discount sa Real Property Tax tubtob sa 2026.
english: The Iloilo City Government will extend the 40% discount on Real Property Tax until 2026.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Jerry Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ini ang magahatag sang dako nga tax relief sa mga negosyo kag landowners sa syudad.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Jerry Treñas said this will provide huge tax relief to businesses and landowners in the city.

text: Suno kay Trenas, ini nga inisyatibo ang may katuyuan ng i- assist ang mga stakeholders nga maka-adjust sa updated nga Real Property Tax rates base sa revised market values.
english: According to Trenas, this initiative aims to assist stakeholders to adjust to the updated Real Property Tax rates based on revised market values.

text: Suno pa sa alkalde, pagpakita man ini sang commitment sang syudad sa pagtukod sang business-friendly environment nga nagaduso sang pagpapag-on pa sang ekonomiya.
english: The mayor said this is also a demonstration of the city's commitment to building a business-friendly environment that promotes economic strengthening.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang 40% discount sa Real Property Tax ang tubtob lang kuntani sa 2025.
english: It is known that the 40% discount on Real Property Tax was only supposed to last until 2025.

text: Naghingyo naman si Treñas sa konseho nga magdihon sang ordinansa agud mangin pormal ang extension sang 40% discount sa Real Property Tax.
english: Treñas urged the council to pass an ordinance to formalize the extension of the 40% discount on the Real Property Tax.

text: Nagpabutyag si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sang tuman nga kakunyag sa natalana niya nga pagpauli sa Iloilo City sa Biyernes, Disyembre 6.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas expressed his excitement over his scheduled return to Iloilo City on Friday, December 6.

text: Ginhimo niya ini nga anunsyo kadungan sang iya kaadlawan subong nga adlaw.
english: He made this announcement in conjunction with his birthday today.

text: Suno sa alkalde, tuman ang iya pagpasalamat nga amat-amat na siya nga nagarekober kag nagaayo matapos ang malawig nga pagpahuway bangud sa iya pagpaidalom sa bile duct operation.
english: The mayor said he is very grateful that he is slowly recovering and healing after a long break due to his bile duct operation.

text: Nakatalana nga magbalik sa opisina si Treñas sa Lunes.
english: Treñas is scheduled to return to office on Monday.

text: Matandaan nga halos tatlo ka bulan man ang medical leave sang alkalde bangud sa iya pagpabulong.
english: The mayor is also on medical leave for almost three months due to his treatment.

text: Makabaton sa pinakauna nga tion sang P30,000 nga Collective Negotiation Agreement (CNA) Incentive ang mga regular nga empleyado sang Iloilo City Hall.
english: Regular employees of Iloilo City Hall will receive the P30,000 Collective Negotiation Agreement (CNA) Incentive for the first time.

text: Gin-anunsyo ini ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas kadungan sang ginpatigayon nga virtual press conference.
english: This was announced by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas during a virtual press conference.

text: Suno kay Treñas, bangud sa savings sang syudad subong nga tuig kun ngaa natigayon ang paghatag sang maximum incentive nga P30,000.
english: According to Treñas, the maximum incentive of P30,000 was given because of the city's savings this year.

text: Ginpahayag sang alkalde nga mabaton ini sa tunga-tunga sang Disyembre 15 kag 31.
english: The mayor said it will be received between December 15 and 31.

text: Dugang sang opisyal, preparado man ang syudad sa paghatag sang gratuity pay kag Service Recognition Incentive (SRI) sa mga casual employee kag jobhire apang ginahulat pa ang direktiba halin sa presidente.
english: The official added that the city is also ready to provide gratuity pay and Service Recognition Incentive (SRI) to casual employees and jobhires but is still waiting for the directive from the president.

text: SA PROSPECT nga maka-angkon na ang mga pumuluyo sang bakuna (vaccine) nga makaaway sa COVID-19, indi naton maindi-an ang posibildad nga mauna ang mga health workers – doktor, nars kag iban pa – nga makabaton sini.
english: IN THE PROSPECT that the people will have a vaccine to fight COVID-19, we cannot rule out the possibility that health workers – doctors, nurses and others – will be the first to receive it.

text: Ina tungod sila man ang una naton dalaganan sa aton problema sa ikaayong lawas, labi na gid sa sining away naton karon sa COVID-19.
english: That's because they are the first ones we run to in our health problems, especially in this fight against COVID-19.

text: Importante gid nga mauna naton mapaseguro ang ang ila ikaayong lawas kag kahimtangan agud makahatag man sila sing maayo nga serbisyo sa aton nga mga pumuluyo nga wala sing hadlukan sa SARS-CoV-2 virus nga nagadulot sang balatian nga COVID-19.
english: It is very important that we first ensure their health and condition so that they can provide good services to our citizens without fear of the SARS-CoV-2 virus that causes the disease COVID-19.

text: Otherwise, kon mauna pa sila tigok, basi wala na kita sing dalaganan luas sa mga gapa-doktor-doktor lang nga lawayan lang ang aton tiyan ukon agtang.
english: Otherwise, if they bite first, we might have no place to run except for those who are just going to the doctor to spit on our stomach or forehead.

text: Ang lain pa kay basi sa manughiwit pa kita magtupa nga kinahanglan halitan pa naton ang iban sa suspetso nga sila ang naghatag sang balatian sa aton.
english: Another thing is that we might fall into the trap of harming others on the suspicion that they gave us the disease.

text: In other words, okey lang ina para sa aton kon sa sunod lang kita.
english: In other words, that's okay for us if we're just next.

text: Tutal indi man seguro magdugay kag matagaan man kita sang vaccine agud makaaway man sing husto ang COVID-19.
english: After all, it won't be long before we get a vaccine to fight COVID-19 properly.

text: Labi na gid kay naghilisugot na ang mga myembro sang World Health Organization (WHO) nga matagaan gid ang tanan nga mga myembro nga pungsod kag teritoryo sang ma-develop nga vaccine.
english: Especially since the members of the World Health Organization (WHO) have agreed to provide all member countries and territories with the developed vaccine.

text: Ugaling lang kay basi sa utay-utay lang nga pagpanghatag, samtang ang iban kaya magbakal sang madamo sini sa mga WHO accredited laboratories sa iban nga pungsod.
english: However, it is possible to distribute small amounts, while others can afford to buy large quantities from WHO accredited laboratories in other countries.

text: Meatime, importante man seguro nga mapangitaan ta sing medyos nga mapabakud ang aton mga health workers sangsa basta isalig ta lang ang ila proteksyon sa mga Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) kag kasubong nga pag-amlig sa ila.
english: Meatime, it is also important that we find ways to strengthen our health workers rather than just relying on their protection in Personal Protection Equipment (PPE) and similar protection.

text: Sa subong, ang ginahimo ta lang sa pag-away sa COVID-19, sa bahin sang mga health workers, amo ang padayon nga pagpatuman sang diagnostic tests, katulad sang RT-CPR testing sa mga suspected tubtub sa  na-confirm nga infected; ang close-contact tracing sa mga posible malatnan dayon; kag ang community tracing sa mas malawak nga teritoryo, katulad sang bug-os nga barangay, kon indi na ma-track down ang mga suspected sa malapitan.
english: Currently, all we are doing to fight COVID-19, on the part of health workers, is the continuous implementation of diagnostic tests, such as RT-CPR testing for suspected to confirmed infected; close-contact tracing of those who are likely to be infected immediately; and community tracing in a wider territory, such as the entire barangay, if suspects cannot be tracked down nearby.

text: Ang madugang ta lang, tungod daw wala ini gina-seryoso pa sang Department of Health, amo ang Serology (antibody testing sa dugo) agud mahibal-an ta at least kon ang mga health workers  nakaangkon na ukon wala sang mga antibodies.
english: The only thing we can add, since the Department of Health doesn't seem to take it seriously, is Serology (antibody testing in the blood) so that we can at least know if the health workers have already acquired or not the antibodies.

text: Sa karon, ang antibody testing ginatutok lang sa blood plasma therapy halin sa dugo sang nag-alayo agud makabulig paayo sang mga critical cases.
english: Currently, antibody testing is only focused on blood plasma therapy from the blood of the recovered person to help cure critical cases.

text: Of course, ang iban nga pumuluyo sa ila inisyatibo maka-submit man sang ila kaugalingon sa antibody testing sa ila personal nga paghibalo kag pagpangamlig.
english: Of course, other residents on their own initiative can also submit themselves to antibody testing for their personal knowledge and protection.

text: Kalakip dira sa sining mga health workers ang na-infect kag nag-alayo na nga symptomatic (may sintoma) kag ang aymptomatic nga samtang wala nagapakita sing sintoma nagadala man gali sang COVID-19 virus.
english: These health workers include those who have been infected and have recovered symptomatic and those who are asymptomatic who while not showing symptoms are actually carrying the COVID-19 virus.

text: Kinahanglan naton ma-diskubre ini agud matun-an kon tubtub sa ano nga degree (by load and strength) kag duration sang adaptive immunity ang yara sila agud mapangunahan ang vaccine nga indi ta pa segurado kon san-o gid mapuslan naton.
english: We need to discover this to learn to what degree (by load and strength) and duration of adaptive immunity they have to lead the vaccine that we are not sure when we will really benefit.
