text: Pang-lifetime bala ini agud matagaan ta na sila sang risk-free certificate ukon immunity passport sa pagtrabaho sing talunsay nga wala sing kulba kag mangin mas masaligan sa ila serbisyo sa mga pumuluyo batok sa  COVID-19?
english: Is it for lifetime so that we can give them a risk-free certificate or immunity passport to work smoothly without fear and be more reliable in their service to the people against COVID-19?

text: Kon indi man pang-lifetime, kag tubtub lang sa kon pila ka bulan ukon tuig, nga matun-an pa gid ini kon bala na-enhance sini ang immune system despues kag nakatigayon sang ayuda sang cross-immunity batok sa iban nga balatian katulad sang MMR agud mangin mabakud gihapon sa pagpakig-away sa pagbalik (re-infection) sang COVID-19 infection.
english: If not for lifetime, and only for a few months or years, to learn more about whether it enhanced the immune system later and got the help of cross-immunity against other diseases such as MMR to be strong in the fight against re-infection of COVID-19 infection.

text: Kag kon indi man, nga mapasige ang pag-develop sang vaccine para sa re-infection katulad sang pagpabakuna kontra sa flu nga ginaliwat kada tuig.
english: And if not, to accelerate the development of a vaccine for re-infection such as the flu vaccination that is repeated every year.

text: Luyag ta man seguro himuon ang ining antibody testing sang aton bag-o tukod nga COVID-19 Research Center upod sa pagtuon kag pag-develop sang COVID-19 vaccine para mahibal-an dayon ang ikasarang sining antibodies agud awayon ang COVID-19 nga una naton hibaluon sa mga health workers./PN
english: We would also like to do this antibody testing of our newly established COVID-19 Research Center along with the study and development of the COVID-19 vaccine to know immediately the ability of these antibodies to fight COVID-19 which we will first learn from health workers./PN

text: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia — Nilagdaan ng China at Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) ang pinakabagong bersyon ng kanilang Free Trade Agreement (FTA) nitong Martes, Oktubre 28, na layong palawakin ang kalakalan sa mga larangan ng digital economy, green economy, at iba pang umuusbong na industriya.
english: KUALA LUMPUR, Malaysia — China and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) signed the latest version of their Free Trade Agreement (FTA) on Tuesday, October 28, which aims to expand trade in the fields of digital economy, green economy, and other emerging industries.

text: Ang ASEAN, na binubuo ng 11 bansa, ay nananatiling pinakamalaking trading partner ng China, na may kabuuang $771 bilyong halaga ng kalakalan noong nakaraang taon, batay sa datos ng ASEAN.
english: ASEAN, made up of 11 countries, remains China's largest trading partner, with a total of $771 billion worth of trade last year, according to ASEAN data.

text: Ayon kay Chinese Premier Li Qiang, kailangang pabilisin ang liberalisasyon sa kalakalan at pamumuhunan upang mapatatag ang ugnayang pang-industriya ng mga bansa sa rehiyon.
english: According to Chinese Premier Li Qiang, trade and investment liberalization must be accelerated to strengthen industrial relations between countries in the region.

text: “We must accelerate trade and investment liberalization and facilitation and strengthen industrial integration and interdependence,” ani Li sa pagpupulong ng mga lider ng ASEAN.
english: “We must accelerate trade and investment liberalization and facilitation and strengthen industrial integration and interdependence,” Li said at the meeting of ASEAN leaders.

text: Tinaguriang “3.0 version” ng ASEAN-China FTA, nilagdaan ang kasunduan sa summit sa Malaysia, kasabay ng pagbisita ni U.S. President Donald Trump sa Asya.
english: Dubbed the “3.0 version” of the ASEAN-China FTA, the agreement was signed at a summit in Malaysia, during U.S. President Donald Trump's visit to Asia.

text: Nagsimula ang negosasyon para sa pag-upgrade noong Nobyembre 2022 at natapos nitong Mayo 2025, sa gitna ng umiigting na tariff offensive ng Estados Unidos laban sa iba’t ibang bansa.
english: Negotiations for the upgrade began in November 2022 and will end in May 2025, amid the US's intensifying tariff offensive against other countries.

text: Ayon kay Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong, ang bagong kasunduan ay magpapababa pa ng mga trade barrier, magpapatibay ng supply chain connectivity, at magbubukas ng mga bagong oportunidad sa agrikultura, digital economy, at pharmaceuticals.
english: According to Singaporean Prime Minister Lawrence Wong, the new agreement will further lower trade barriers, strengthen supply chain connectivity, and open up new opportunities in agriculture, digital economy, and pharmaceuticals.

text: Parehong miyembro ang China at ASEAN ng Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) — ang pinakamalaking trading bloc sa mundo na sumasaklaw sa halos ikatlong bahagi ng populasyon at 30% ng global GDP.
english: Both China and ASEAN are members of the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) — ​​the world's largest trading bloc covering nearly a third of the population and 30% of global GDP.

text: Sa kabila ng positibong hakbang sa ekonomiya, nananatiling hamon para sa Beijing ang tensyon sa South China Sea.
english: Despite the positive economic steps, tensions in the South China Sea remain a challenge for Beijing.

text: Noong Lunes, binatikos ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: On Monday, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. criticized the

text: ang agresibong kilos ng China sa pinagtatalunang karagatan matapos ang serye ng mga insidente sa pagitan ng dalawang bansa.
english: China's aggressive moves in the disputed seas after a series of incidents between the two countries.

text: Tumugon naman ang Chinese Foreign Ministry, sinasabing ang mga insidente ay dulot umano ng “provocation” mula sa panig ng Maynila.
english: The Chinese Foreign Ministry responded, saying the incidents were allegedly caused by “provocation” from Manila.

text: Ayon kay Li, dapat palakasin ng rehiyon ang mutual trust at pabilisin ang pagbuo ng Code of Conduct upang maresolba ang mga sigalot sa karagatan.
english: According to Li, the region should strengthen mutual trust and accelerate the development of a Code of Conduct to resolve maritime disputes.

text: “We must strengthen strategic mutual trust and strive for an early conclusion,” giit ni Li.
english: “We must strengthen strategic mutual trust and strive for an early conclusion,” Li gave.

text: Ipinunto rin ni PM Wong na mahalagang mapanatili ang kapayapaan, kaligtasan, at kalayaan sa paglalayag at paglipad sa naturang waterway.
english: PM Wong also pointed out that it is important to maintain peace, safety, and freedom of navigation and flight in the natural waterway.

text: Patuloy pa rin ang trade war sa pagitan ng China at Estados Unidos simula nang manungkulan si Trump at magpatupad ng mataas na import tariffs sa mga produktong Tsino.
english: The trade war between China and the United States has continued since Trump took office and implemented high import tariffs on Chinese products.

text: Gayunman, kapwa bansa ang nagkasundo sa isang pansamantalang trade truce nitong weekend sa Kuala Lumpur.
english: However, both countries agreed to a temporary trade truce this weekend in Kuala Lumpur.

text: Muling magkikita sina Trump at Chinese President Xi Jinping sa Seoul sa huling bahagi ng linggong ito upang pag-usapan ang mas matagalang kasunduan.
english: Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping will meet again in Seoul later this week to discuss a longer-term agreement.

text:
Sa kabila ng mga sigalot, nanawagan si Li Qiang na ipagtanggol ng rehiyon ang malayang kalakalan at iwasan ang “law of the jungle.”

“We should more firmly uphold the free trade regime and advance regional integration,” aniya.
english:
Despite the tensions, Li Qiang called for the region to defend free trade and avoid the “law of the jungle.”

“We should more firmly uphold the free trade regime and advance regional integration,” he said.

text: Ang upgraded FTA ay inaasahang magpapalalim sa ugnayang pang-ekonomiya ng China at ASEAN sa gitna ng mga global na hamon sa kalakalan at seguridad.
english: The upgraded FTA is expected to deepen China-ASEAN economic ties amid global trade and security challenges.

text: Mabudlay apang pinasahi ang balatyagon nga mangin isa ka first-time mommy, apang ano pa gid ayhan kun sa imo una nga pagbusong, anum gid dayon ka lapsag ang imo ginbun-ag?
english: It's a difficult but special feeling to be a first-time mommy, but what if in your first pregnancy, you gave birth to six babies?

text: Tumalagsahon ini nga kaso kun sa diin nagakatabo lamang sang isa ka bes sa 4.7 billion — butang nga ginatawag sang iban nga isa ka milagro.
english: This is a rare case where it only happens once in 4.7 billion — something some call a miracle.

text: Apang amo ini ang natabo sa isa ka 27-anyos nga Pakistani nga mommy sang nagbun-ag ini sang nagligad lamang nga semana.
english: But this is what happened to a 27-year-old Pakistani mommy when she gave birth just last week.

text: Ang iya nga sextuplets ang ginalakipan sang apat ka lalaki kag duha ka babaye.
english: His sextuplets include four boys and two girls.

text: Ginbata sila ni Mommy Zeenat Waheed sa ospital sa syudad sang Rawalpindi, Pakistan.
english: Mommy Zeenat Waheed gave birth to them in the hospital in the city of Rawalpindi, Pakistan.

text: Isa ka oras lamang ang pagbun-ag sini sa anum ka lapsaog suno sa ospital.
english: She gave birth to six babies in just one hour, the hospital said.

text: Bangud sa ila kadamuon, yara lamang sa below two pounds ang ila nga bug-at kag ginbutang anay sa incubator samtang yara pa sila sa medical facility.
english: Due to their size, they weighed only below two pounds and were placed in an incubator while they were still in the medical facility.

text: Suno pa sa ospital, may mga kumplikasyon sa iloy sang tion sang labor, apang nangin estable na ang kondisyon sini makaligad ang pila ka adlaw sa bulig sang doktor kag iban pa nga paramedical staff.
english: According to the hospital, the mother had complications during labor, but her condition was stable after a few days with the help of doctors and other paramedical staff.

text: Nauyang na naman ang monster triple double sang Nuggets superstar nga si Nikola Jokic kadungan sang ikaapat nga sunod-sunod nga kalutusan.
english: Nuggets superstar Nikola Jokic's monster triple double was wasted again with his fourth consecutive loss.

text: Ginpierde sila sang Indiana Pacers, 125-120, sa mismo home court sang Denver.
english: The Indiana Pacers defeated them, 125-120, right on Denver’s home court.

text: Ini naman ang pang-apat nga sunod-sunod nga daog sang Pacers kag napabaskog ang ila pagkapyot sa ikaapat nga pwesto sa Eastern Conference.
english: It was the Pacers' fourth straight win and strengthened their grip on fourth place in the Eastern Conference.

text: Nagtapos si Jokic nga may 41 points, 15 rebounds and 13 assists nga amo na ang iya ika-32 nga triple-double sa sini nga season.
english: Jokic finished with 41 points, 15 rebounds and 13 assists, his 32nd triple-double of the season.

text: Bisan pa nga yara si Christian Braun nga may 20 sang iya 30 points sa second half, nalutos gihapon ang Denver kag subong may record nga 47-32.
english: Even with Christian Braun with 20 of his 30 points in the second half, Denver still lost and now has a record of 47-32.

text: Sa sini nga hampang, 21 points man ang nahimo ni Jokic sa opening period nga amo ang pagpang-apat nga tion sa iya karera nga naka-20 plus siya sa first quarter.
english: In this game, Jokic also scored 21 points in the opening period, marking the fourth time in his career that he scored 20 plus in the first quarter.

text: Ang amo nga game amo man ang pang-lima nga sunod-sunod nga hampang nga wala nakaupod si Jamal Murray bangud sa injury, apang nagalaum si Coach Michael Malone nga makabalik ang iya star point guard sa pagsugod sang NBA playoffs.
english: That game also marked the fifth consecutive game Jamal Murray missed due to injury, but Coach Michael Malone hopes to have his star point guard back by the start of the NBA playoffs.

text: Ikaw bala ang sahi sang tawo nga ginapeke ang yuhom sa mga tawo nga imo maatubang?
english: Are you the type of person who fakes a smile on people you meet?

text: Nagguwa sa pagtuon nga ginpublish sa journal nga Psychological Bulletin nga nagahatag sang malain nga epekto sa lawas ang pagpeke sang yuhom sang isa ka tawo.
english: A study published in the journal Psychological Bulletin found that faking a person's smile has a negative effect on the body.

text: Ang pagyuhom apisar nga indi ikaw malipayon ang indi makabulig sa mood sang tawo.
english: Smiling even though you are not happy will not help the person's mood.

text: Sa pgatuon, nagguwa nga sa 100 ka tawo nga nagapeke sang ila yuhom, pito lang diri ang nagabatyag sang kalipay.
english: The study found that out of 100 people who faked their smiles, only seven felt happy.

text: Santu naman sa mga researchers sang Penn State University sa Pennsylvania, pila man sa mga empleyado nga nagakapilitan magyuhom sa trabaho para sa mga customer ang may mataas nga risgo nga mangin heavy drinker.
english: According to researchers at Penn State University in Pennsylvania, some employees who are forced to smile at work for customers are also at high risk of becoming heavy drinkers.

text: Pahayag sang mga eksperto, nagaka-drain ang tawo bangud sa pagpeke sang positive emotions nga naga-resulta sa alcohol consumption nga malain sa ikaayong lawas.
english: According to experts, people become drained due to faking positive emotions that result in alcohol consumption that is bad for health.

text: Gani kun ikaw ang nagakabatyag sang kasubo, kalipay, kaakig kag excitement, ipakita ina sa tawo kag indi pagtago-tagoa ang imo ginabatyag.
english: So if you are feeling sad, happy, angry and excited, show it to the person and don't hide your feelings.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Kabug-usan nga 18, 457 ka mga rice farmers sa Western Visayas ang makabaton sang P5,000 nga financial assistance.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – A total of 18, 457 rice farmers in Western Visayas will receive P5,000 financial assistance.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay James Earl Ogatis, Regional Agriculture and Fishery Information Section chief sang Department of Agriculture – Western Visayas, iya ginpahayag nga kabug-usan nga P92.285 million ang ginpain nga pondo para sa mga beneficiaries sa 40 ka mga banwa sa Iloilo.
english: James Earl Ogatis, Regional Agriculture and Fishery Information Section chief of the Department of Agriculture-Western Visayas, said a total of P92.285 million has been allocated for beneficiaries in 40 towns in Iloilo.

text: Nag-umpisa ang pagpanagtag sang financial assistance sang Disyembre 3 kag magalawig tubtob sa Disyembre 19.
english: The distribution of financial assistance began on December 3 and will last until December 19.

text: Ini ang santo sa Republic Act 11203 ukon Rice Tariffication Law, ang Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund – Rice Farmer Financial Assistance sa diin nagakadapat nga makabaton ang mga rice farmers nga nalista sa Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture (RSBSA).
english: This is in accordance with Republic Act 11203 or Rice Tariffication Law, the Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund – Rice Farmer Financial Assistance which is entitled to rice farmers listed in the Registry System for Basic Sectors in Agriculture (RSBSA).

text: Sa idalom sang programa, ang mga rice farmers nga aktibo nga naga-cultivate sang .50 hectares  tubtob sa 2 hectares sang humayan kag rehistrado sa RSBSA ang makabaton sang financial assistance.
english: Under the program, rice farmers who are actively cultivating .50 hectares to 2 hectares of rice fields and are registered with the RSBSA will receive financial assistance.

text: Magluwas diri, makabaton man ang 390 ka mga rice farmers sang P3,000 nga fuel subsidy.
english: In addition, 390 rice farmers will also receive a P3,000 fuel subsidy.

text: Ini ang may kabug-usan tanan nga katinidad nga P1,170,000.
english: This has a total amount of P1,170,000.

text: Nagpasa ang China sa United Nations sang statement sa baselines sang ila teritoryo sa kadagatan kun sa diin nagalakip diri ang chart nga nagapakita nga ang Bajo de Masinloc ukon Scarborough Shoal ang kabahin ang ila territorial waters.
english: China has submitted to the United Nations a statement on the baselines of its maritime territory which includes a chart showing that the Bajo de Masinloc or Scarborough Shoal is part of its territorial waters.

text: Ang Bajo de Masinloc ang yara sa exclusive economic zone sang Pilipinas sa idalom sang United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.
english: Bajo de Masinloc is located in the exclusive economic zone of the Philippines under the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea.

text: Ang tubig sa palibot sang Bajo de Masinloc nga isa ka triangular coral reef formation, ang manggaranon sa natural resources.
english: The water around Bajo de Masinloc which is a triangular coral reef formation, is rich in natural resources.

text: Sa idalom sang Article 84 sang UNCLOS, obligado ang isa ka pungsod nga magbalhag sang charts nga nagapakita sang boundaries ukon limits sang ila continental shelf.
english: Under Article 84 of UNCLOS, a country is obliged to publish charts showing the boundaries or limits of its continental shelf.

text: Ginpakamalaot naman sang Philippine National Maritime Council ang claim sang China.
english: The Philippine National Maritime Council condemned China's claim.

text: Suno sa Council, ang nasambit nga baselines sang China ang nagalapas sa long-established sovereignty sang Pilipinas sa shoal sa kabilugan sini nga maragtas.
english: According to the Council, China's said baselines violate the Philippines' long-established sovereignty over the shoal throughout its history.

text: Ang pagtukod sang baselines sang China sa palibot sang shoal ang kasugpon sang 2012 illegal seizure sini sa shoal, nga padayon naman nga ginapamatukan sang Pilipinas.
english: China's construction of baselines around the shoal is in line with its 2012 illegal seizure of the shoal, which the Philippines continues to oppose.

text: Suno naman kay maritime expert Jay Batongbacal, ang pinakaulihi nga tikang sang China ang wala sang epekto sa lehitimo nga legal interests kag position sang Pilipinas sa Bajo de Masinloc.
english: Maritime expert Jay Batongbacal said China's latest move has no effect on the Philippines' legitimate legal interests and position in Bajo de Masinloc.

text: Nakahanda ang 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army, para sa palaabuton nga founding anniversary sang Communist Party of the Philippines/New People’s Army/National Democratic Front (CPP/NPA/NDF).
english: The 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army is ready for the upcoming founding anniversary of the Communist Party of the Philippines/New People's Army/National Democratic Front (CPP/NPA/NDF).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Colonel Erwin Rommel Lamzon, Assistant Division Commander for Administration, 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army, iya ginpahayag nga sa subong, may yara sila sang ‘firm system’ nga monitoring sa hulag sang nasambit nga mga grupo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Colonel Erwin Rommel Lamzon, Assistant Division Commander for Administration, 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army, said they currently have a firm system of monitoring the movements of these groups.

text: Suno kay Lamzon, nakakoordinar na sila sa Barangay Task Force sang National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) agud nga ma-verify kon may mga paghulag sa bahin sang mga rebelde.
english: Lamzon said they have already coordinated with the Barangay Task Force of the National Task Force to End Local Communist Armed Conflict (NTF-ELCAC) to verify if there are any movements on the part of the rebels.

text: Nagapati man ang natungdan nga kinahanglan nakahibalo sila sa mga nakalatabo sa tagsa ka mga barangay agud man nga mapalab-ot sa komunidad ang ‘awareness’ nahanungod sa posible matabo kon magasulod ang mga residente sa rebelde nga grupo.
english: He also believes that they need to be aware of what is happening in each barangay in order to raise awareness among the community about what could happen if residents join the rebel group.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga apisar nga dismantled na ang isa ka area ukon lugar sa probinsya, nagapabilin nga ‘established’ ang ila internal domestic security protocols.
english: He also explained that although an area in the province has been dismantled, their internal domestic security protocols remain established.

text: Gin-ako sang iloy sang construction worker nga gintiro-patay sa Gonzaga Street, Brgy.
english: The mother of a construction worker who was shot dead in Gonzaga Street, Brgy.

text: Purok 4, Pavia, Iloilo nga nakabisita pa ang ka-live-in partner sang iya anak sa ila puluy-an sa Guimaras.
english: Purok 4, Pavia, Iloilo that his son's live-in partner visited their home in Guimaras.

text: Ang biktima sa amo nga insidente amo si Joven Galvez Job, 35-anyos, ka live-in partner ni alyas “Joy” kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as Joven Galvez Job, 35, live-in partner of alias “Joy” and resident of Brgy.

text: Sapal, San Lorenzo Guimaras.
english: Sapal, San Lorenzo Guimaras.

text: Ang suspek naman amo si Arnold Mamon Viejo, 41-anyos kag residente sa Brgy.
english: The suspect was identified as Arnold Mamon Viejo, 41, resident of Brgy.

text: Cabugao Norte Pavia, Iloilo.
english: Cabugao Norte Pavia, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ursula Job, iloy sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga isa na ka tuig sang nagtaliwan ang legal nga asawa sang iya anak kon sa diin may duha sila nga kabataan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ursula Job, the victim's mother, said her son's legal wife passed away a year ago and they have two children.

text: Suno kay Job, nagapauli man sa Guimaras ang iya anak tagsa ka semana agud bisitahon ang iya kabataan.
english: According to Job, his son also returns to Guimaras every week to visit his children.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang iloy nga may nauna na nga ka-live in ang iya anak apang nagbulagay sila, tubtob nga ginpakilala sini si Alyas “Joy” sa ila.
english: The mother also revealed that her daughter had a previous live-in partner but they broke up, until she introduced Alias ​​“Joy” to them.

text: Una naman nga nagpaandam ang iloy kay alyas “Joy” nga masami lain-lain nga mga babaye ang ginadala sini sa ila puluy-an.
english: Earlier, the mother warned alias “Joy” that he often brought different women to their house.

text: Nahibaluan nga selos ang napanguna nga motibo ang ginalantaw sang otoridad kon ngaa nahimo sang suspek ang krimen.
english: It was learned that jealousy was the main motive behind the suspect's crime.

text: 14 ka tuig naman nga nag-updanay ang suspek kag si Joy kun sa diin mayara ini sang tatlo ka mga kabataan edad, 14, 12, kag 10 ka tuig.
english: The suspect and Joy have been together for 14 years and have three children, aged 14, 12, and 10 years old.

text: Samtang, tatlo naman ka bulan ini sila naga-updanay sang biktima.
english: Meanwhile, they have been dating the victim for three months.

text: Madugang ang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) sang ila mga personnel subong nga holiday season para sa mga Christmas Activites.
english: The Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit (ICTMU) will increase its personnel this holiday season for Christmas Activities.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, Head sang Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, iya ginpahayag nga ginalauman sang ila talatapan nga magadugang ang trapiko sa subong nga paskwa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, Head of the Iloilo City Traffic Management Unit, said his office expects traffic to increase this Christmas.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, tuyo man sang tikang nga mabuhinan ang pagpugok sang mga salakyan sa downtown area sang Iloilo City.
english: According to Garbanzos, the move also aims to reduce traffic congestion in the downtown area of ​​Iloilo City.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga 20% nga deployment ang idugang sa pwersa sang traffic personnel agud mapabilin nga tayuyon ang dalagan sang trapiko.
english: He also explained that 20% deployment will be added to the force of traffic personnel to maintain the smooth flow of traffic.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa mga motorista nga pangitaon ang designated parking areas agud nga indi mabiktima sang mga ‘basag kotse’.
english: He also advised motorists to find designated parking areas so as not to be victims of 'broken cars'

text: Nagpaathag ang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 sa motorista nga indi na sila mag-adjust ukon magdugang sang height sang vertical clearance signage sa Ungka Flyover.
english: The Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) Region 6 has explained to motorists that they will not adjust or increase the height of the vertical clearance signage on the Ungka Flyover.

text: Ini kasunod man sang insidente sang pagkahulog sang signage bangud sa pagsagaid sang modernized bus.
english: This follows the incident of the signage falling due to the collision of a modernized bus.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Sanny Boy Oropel, Regional Director sang Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga apisar sang nagapatuman sila sang rectification sa ibabaw nga bahin sang flyover, bukas sa gihapon ini para sa mga light vehicles.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Sanny Boy Oropel, Regional Director of the Department of Public Works and Highways Region 6, said that despite the rectification of the upper part of the flyover, it is still open for light vehicles.

text: Suno kay Oropel, gina-control sang talatapan ang movement sang flyover rason man nga wala ginapahanugutan nga makalabay ang dalagko nga salakyan.
english: According to Oropel, the office is controlling the movement of the flyover which is why large vehicles are not allowed to pass.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga sa Disyembre 25 pa ‘fully’ nga magabukas ang Ungka Flyover, kon sa diin mahimo na nga makalabay ang tanan.
english: He also explained that the Ungka Flyover will be fully opened on December 25, when everyone will be able to pass.

text: Liwat naman nga nagpangayo sang malawig nga pasensya ang talatapan sa publiko agud nga maintindihan ang sitwasyon sang Ungka Flyover.
english: The office once again asked for the public's patience to understand the situation of the Ungka Flyover.

text: UNFAIR ang Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Memorandum Circular (MC) 2020-063 sa mandatory nga pagpatuman sini sang cremation, ukon ang pagpasunog, sang bangkay sang pasyente bisan ginasuspetsahan pa lang, ukon bisan pa gani, nga may COVID-19.
english: The Department of Interior and Local Government (DILG) Memorandum Circular (MC) 2020-063 is UNFAIR in its mandatory implementation of cremation, or the burning, of the body of a patient even if he is suspected, or even, of having COVID-19.

text: Exempt sa cremation sa sining memorandum circular ang mga Muslim.
english: Muslims are exempt from cremation in this memorandum circular.

text: Sa kadam-an, 90% Kristiyano, ining MC nagapatuman sang cremation pagkatapos dayon sang 12 ka oras nga indi makahulat kon bala confirmed nga may COVID-19 ang namatay ukon wala.
english: Majority, 90% Christian, this MC implements cremation after 12 hours without waiting to see if the deceased is confirmed to have COVID-19 or not.

text: May ga-kwestyon gani sini tungod indi man ining MC isa ka  kasuguan (legislative act) nga dapat gid ipatuman.
english: Some even question this because this MC is not a legislative act that must be implemented.

text: Ang masakit pa dira kay indi man gani mapadasig sang gobyerno ang RT-CPR testing kon bala may COVID-19 ang pasyente ukon wala.
english: What's worse is that the government can't even speed up the RT-CPR testing to see if the patient has COVID-19 or not.

text: Kon kis-a sinema pa kag mahibal-an ang resulta.
english: Sometimes it's a movie and you know the result.

text: Nagakatabo ini tungod sa kadamo sang gina-testing nga ginapasunod pa nga wala pinilian.
english: This is because of the large number of testing that is still being conducted indiscriminately.

text: Kon ginapa-test dayon ang bangkay, sunu sa kilala naton  nga nagpa-test sa isa ka pribado nga ospital, indi ini kalab-ut 12 ka oras agud mahibal-an ang resulta.
english: If the body is tested immediately, according to those we know who tested in a private hospital, it takes less than 12 hours to know the result.

text: Ti, ano na lang kon wala COVID-19 ang namatay kag na-cremate na sa pagpati nga may COVID-19, kag luyag tani ipalubong sang himata sa duta ukon nitso, nga nakaugalian na sang kadam-an sang mga Filipino?
english: Well, what if there is no COVID-19 who died and was cremated in the belief that there was COVID-19, and the relative wanted to bury him in the ground or grave, which is the custom of most Filipinos?

text: Pwede bala masukot sing damages ang gobyerno?
english: Can the government claim damages?

text: Kag ano na lang ang namatay nga indi na ma-autopsy agud mahibal-an gid kon ano ang kabangdanan sang iya kamatayon, labi na gid kon bunga sang krimen?
english: And what about the deceased who cannot be autopsied to determine the cause of death, especially if it is the result of a crime?

text: Pabay-an na lang nga indi mahibal-an ang krimen nga natabo sa iya kag malagas ang mga kriminal?
english: Let the crime that happened to him go unknown and the criminals go away?

text: Ti, ano lang ang hustisya nga luyag maangkon sang pamilya kay ang mga ebidensya nangin abo na?
english: Well, just what justice does the family want to have since the evidence has turned to ashes?

text: In fact, ang World Health Organization (WHO) nagapahanugot nga ipalubong ang bangkay (sa duta ukon sa nitso) basta sundon lang ang protocol sa “Safe Management of Dead Bodies and Burial of Patients”, suspected man ukon confirmed nga may COVID-19, nga ginapanugyan sini paagi sa “12 steps” katulad sa kaso sadto sang mga Ebola patients nga nagduging sa Africa.
english: In fact, the World Health Organization (WHO) allows the burial of the body (in the ground or in the grave) as long as the protocol of "Safe Management of Dead Bodies and Burial of Patients", suspected or confirmed with COVID-19, is followed, which it recommends through the "12 steps" similar to the case of Ebola patients in Africa.

text: Tungod sini, pila ka pungsod gani ang gapatuman sining protocol katulad sang New South Wales (Ausralia) kag Brazil, sa diin ang pamilya luyag gid ipalubong sa tradisyonal nga paagi ang bangkay sang ila himata.
english: Because of this, some countries are even implementing this protocol such as New South Wales (Ausralia) and Brazil, where families want to bury the body of their relative in a traditional way.

text:
***

By the way, sa Sri Lanka, mandatory sa tanan ang cremation, Muslim ka man ukon indi.
english:
***

By the way, in Sri Lanka, cremation is mandatory for everyone, whether you are Muslim or not.

text: Tungod ini sa ila pagpati nga makalalaton kag makamamatay gid bisan ang bangkay nga may COVID-19.
english: This is because they believe that even a corpse with COVID-19 is contagious and deadly.

text: Sa ulihi nga balita nga nabaton naton, mga apat na ka Muslim ang na-cremate.
english: According to the latest news we received, about four Muslims have been cremated.

text: Isa sa ila babaye nga gin-cremate sa Modera, Colombo.
english: One of them was a woman who was cremated in Modera, Colombo.

text: Lakip ini sila sa pitu nga na-cremate na sa Sri Lanka.
english: They are among seven already cremated in Sri Lanka.

text: Isa pa ka rason kon ngaa gapamilit gid ang gobyerno sang Sri Lanka nga ipa-cremate ang bangkay sang isa ka Muslim nga may COVID-19 amo ang ila kahadlok sa mga terorista nga nagapanghasik sing “panic” diri.
english: Another reason why the Sri Lankan government is insisting on cremating the body of a Muslim with COVID-19 is their fear of terrorists who are spreading panic here.

text: Basi kuno gamiton nila ini bilang “biological weapon” batok sa kadam-an sang mga pumuluyo diri.
english: They might use it as a biological weapon against the majority of the people here.

text: Ang Catholic Church sadto wala man nagatugot sang cremation, ugaling tungod sa makamamatay nga mga balatian katulad sang Black Death kag Cholera ginpatuman na ini sang Simbahan.
english: The Catholic Church did not allow cremation, but because of deadly diseases such as the Black Death and Cholera, the Church implemented it.

text: Tungod man ini sa pagpati nga wala man gina-prohibir sang Bibliya ang cremation.
english: This is also because of the belief that the Bible does not prohibit cremation.

text: Gina-require lang ugaling sang Simbahan nga ang abo sang namatay ipabilin sa patyo ukon sa simbahan, sa diin mapahamtang ang ila mga tul-an ukon abo sa mga columbarium sang simbahan.
english: However, the Church requires that the ashes of the deceased remain in the cemetery or in the church, where their bones or ashes can be placed in the columbariums of the church.

text: Ang mga tumuluo sang Jewish Faith, ukon Judaism, wala man nagapahanugot sang cremation.
english: Believers of the Jewish Faith, or Judaism, also do not allow cremation.

text:
***

Sunu sa WHO, bag-o magsugod ang ano man nga procedure, ang pamilya dapat gid pahibaluon parti sa “dignified burial process” sunu sa “religious” kag “personal” rights sang tawo agud matagaan sang nagakaigu nga respeto ang nagtaliwan.
english:
***

According to the WHO, before any procedure begins, the family must be informed about the dignified burial process in accordance with the religious and personal rights of the person in order to give due respect to the deceased.

text: Tungod gani sining “personal rights” man sang isa ka tawo kon paano niya papahuwayon ang iya namatay, Muslim man ukon indi, sunu sa WHO, dapat lang nga itugyan naton ang ini nga desisyon sa pamilya sing wala pinilian.
english: Because of these “personal rights” of a person how to rest his deceased, Muslim or not, according to the WHO, we should leave this decision to the family without discrimination.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Unless, indi naton kaya ipalubong sing “safe” ang bangkay nga may COVID-19 para sa iban nga mga tawo.
english: Unless, we cannot “safely” bury the body with COVID-19 for other people.

text: Ugaling kay ginatugot naton ini sa mga Muslim diri sa pungsod, kaya naton seguro ini ipatuman man sa iban nga indi Muslim nga luyag ipalubong, kag indi ipa-cremate, ang bangkay sang ila himata./PN
english: But since we allow this to Muslims here in the country, we can probably implement it to other non-Muslims who want to bury, and not cremate, the body of their relative./PN

text: Nagtaas ang rangko ni Filipino tennis star Alex Eala sa Women’s Tennis Association (WTA), bisan wala pa nakabalik sa kompetisyon pagkatapos sang 2025 Miami Open.
english: Filipino tennis star Alex Eala has risen in the ranks of the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA), despite not returning to competition after the 2025 Miami Open.

text: Suno sa pinakaulihi nga listahan nga ginpagwa sang WTA, nagsaka si Eala sa No.
english: According to the latest list released by the WTA, Eala rose to No.

text: 73 halin sa iya una nga ranko nga No.
english: 73 from his previous rank of No.

text: 75 pagkatapos sang Miami Open.
english: 75 after the Miami Open.

text: Ginkilala sang WTA ang makasaysayan nga performance ni Eala sa nasambit nga hinampang, nga nagtulod sa iya sa pag-angat sa world rankings.
english: The WTA recognized Eala’s historic performance in the event, which propelled her up the world rankings.

text: Sa kabug-usan, nakalampuwas si Eala sang 67 ka rangko halin sa iya daan nga posisyon nga No.
english: Overall, Eala survived 67 ranks from his old No. 1 position.

text: Bangud sini, nagdako ang posibilidad nga makasulod na siya sa Grand Slam, kag posibleng mag-debut sa nagapahilapit nga French Open.
english: This has increased the likelihood that she will qualify for the Grand Slam, and possibly make her debut at the upcoming French Open.

text: Imagine kun nagapanginit ka na sa delay sa imo nga flight, tapos nahibaluan mo nga ang rason gali kun ngaa naatrasar ang byahe amo ang hubog nga piloto!
english: Imagine if you were angry about the delay in your flight, then you found out that the reason why the flight was delayed was a drunk pilot!

text: Pakamaayuhon mo ayhan nga magsakay pa, ukon “no thanks, I love my life!”?
english: Would you rather ride more, or “no thanks, I love my life!”?

text: Natabo ini sa Japan nga ginkumpirma mismo sang Japan Airlines Co.
english: This happened in Japan as confirmed by Japan Airlines Co.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginkanselar sang damlag lang ang isa ka flight halin sa Dallas, Texas, USA nga pakadto kuntani sa Tokyo matapos nahubog ang 49-anyos nga piloto sa sulod sang hotel.
english: A flight from Dallas, Texas, USA to Tokyo was reportedly canceled recently after a 49-year-old pilot got drunk inside the hotel.

text: Ang involved diri amo ang Flight 11 nga magahugpa kuntani sa Haneda airport sang Myerkules.
english: The one involved was Flight 11 which was supposed to land at Haneda airport on Wednesday.

text: Apang ang natabo: sang nag-abot ang pilot sa Dallas sang Lunes, nagpanyapon ini kaupod sa iban nga crew members sa isa ka restaurant.
english: But what happened: when the pilot arrived in Dallas on Monday, he had dinner with other crew members at a restaurant.

text: Ginpadayon pa ang party sa lounge sang hotel nga ila ginatiniran amo man sa iya nga kuwarto.
english: The party continued in the lounge of the hotel where they were staying as well as in his room.

text: Pasado 2:00 sa kaagahon sang Martes, nagsaway pa ang hotel staff sa ila nga hagan-haganon ang gahod, apang bangud daw indi na matolerar ang ginapahanghambal kag aktwasyon sang piloto, gintawag ang pulis.
english: Around 2:00 am on Tuesday, the hotel staff reprimanded them to reduce the noise, but because the pilot's words and actions seemed intolerable, the police were called.

text: Ginkadtuan gid sang pulis ang hotel kag ginpaandaman ang piloto nga indi na magliwat.
english: The police did go to the hotel and warned the pilot not to repeat it.

text: Naka-schedule naman kuntani nga maghalin ang flight 11:05 sang aga sang Myerkules, apang nag-desisyon ang airline company nga i-check anay ang pisikal kag mental status sang pilot.
english: The flight was scheduled to leave at 11:05 am on Wednesday, but the airline decided to check the physical and mental status of the pilot.

text: Ginbuligan na lamang ang 157 ka mga pasahero nga masaylo sa iban nga flights.
english: Only 157 passengers were helped to transfer to other flights.

text: Ang aircraft naman nga ginadala sang piloto ang ginpabalik sa Tokyo Haneda bilang flight JL11D kag wala sang sakay nga pasahero.
english: The aircraft carrying the pilot was returned to Tokyo Haneda as flight JL11D with no passengers on board.

text: Agud masiguro nga healthy ang hangin nga ginahaklo sang imo pamilya — mas kinahanglan mo bala sang humidifier ukon air purifier sa imo balay?
english: To ensure that the air your family breathes is healthy — do you need a humidifier or an air purifier in your home more?

text: May nagkalain-lain nga health benefits kag gamit ang humidifier kag air purifier.
english: There are various health benefits and uses of humidifier and air purifier.

text: Suno sa United States Environmental Protection Agency, ang humidifier ang nagadugang sang moisture sa hangin nga nagalikaw sa dryness nga mangin tuga sang irritation sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang lawas.
english: According to the United States Environmental Protection Agency, a humidifier adds moisture to the air which prevents dryness that can cause irritation to various parts of the body.

text: Ang humidifiers ang epektibo man sa pagbulong sang dryness sang imo nga panit, ilong, tutunlan kag bibig.
english: Humidifiers are also effective in treating dryness of your skin, nose, throat and lips.

text: Samtang ang air purifier naman ang makapadula sang harmful chemical halin sa indoor environment, nagapanubo sang tyansa sang Airborne Diseases, nagapanami pa sang imo tulog kag nagapalawig sang imo kabuhi.
english: Meanwhile, an air purifier can remove harmful chemicals from the indoor environment, reduce the chances of Airborne Diseases, improve your sleep and prolong your life.

text: Indi lang sa saguwa sang imo balay may polusyon kundi mangin sa sulod man sang imo nga balay.
english: Not only is there pollution outside your house but also inside your house.

text: Kag bangud sa indoor pollution, ini ang makaapekto sang imo cardiac, respiratory kag mangin neurological systems.
english: And due to indoor pollution, it can affect your cardiac, respiratory and even neurological systems.

text: Apang indi lang basta-basta magbutang sang humidifier kag air purifier sa sulod sang imo balay kundi updi man ini sang pagpaninlo.
english: But don't just put a humidifier and air purifier inside your house but also accompany it with cleaning.

text: Duha ka bulan matapos ang maragtason nga kadalag-an sang Pinoy singer nga si Sofronio Vasquez sa “The Voice USA”, may isa na naman ka Pinay singer ang nagtilaw sang iya kapalaran sa amo nga kompetisyon kag napa-impress ang mga coaches.
english: Two months after the historic victory of Pinoy singer Sofronio Vasquez in “The Voice USA”, another Filipino singer tried his luck in the competition and impressed the coaches.

text: Inj amo si Jessica Manalo nga nagkanta sang “Unholy” ni Sam Smith kun sa diin sa apat ka coaches, duha ang nag-agaway sa iya nga amo sanday Michael Bublé kag Kelsea Ballerini.
english: Inj is Jessica Manalo who sang “Unholy” by Sam Smith where out of the four coaches, two fought against her namely Michael Bublé and Kelsea Ballerini.

text: Si Bublé amo ang coach ni Vasquez sang nagdaug ini bilang grand champion sang season 26 sang Disyembre sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Bublé was Vasquez’s coach when he won grand champion in season 26 in December last year.

text: Naghimo si Sofronio sang maragtas bilang pinakauna nga lalaki nga Asyano kag Pinoy nga nagdaug sa amo nga international singing competition.
english: Sofronio made history as the first Asian and Filipino male to win the international singing competition.

text: Matapos nga naglab-ot sa million ang views sa audition ni Manalo, nagpasalamat naman ini sa suporta nga iya nabaton.
english: After Manalo's audition reached a million views, he thanked the support he received.

text: Sa subong, wala pa mahibaluan kun sin-o nga coach ang ginpili ni Manalo bangud sa masunod nga episode pa ini iga-anunsyo.
english: At present, it is not known which coach Manalo chose as it will be announced in the next episode.

text: ILOILO – Ginpasalig sang Iloilo Provincial Government nga bastante ang supply sang baboy sa Iloilo subong nga Holiday Season.
english: ILOILO – The Iloilo Provincial Government has assured that there is sufficient supply of pork in Iloilo this Holiday Season.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Darel Tabuada, head sang Provincial Veterinary Office, iya ginpahayag nga nadugangan sang ginabanta 10,000 heads sang swine sa inventory sang probinsya subong nga tuig.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Darel Tabuada, head of the Provincial Veterinary Office, said an estimated 10,000 heads of swine were added to the province's inventory this year.

text: Suno kay Tabuada, ang buhi nga baboy ang mabakal sa average nga P197/kilo samtang P343/kilo naman ang presyo sang karne sang baboy.
english: According to Tabuada, live pigs can be bought at an average of P197/kilo while the price of pork is P343/kilo.

text: Pahayag niya, padayon sa gihapon ang shipment sang baboy halin sa iban nga lugar sa Pilipinas agud maka-augment sa local supply sang probinsya.
english: He said the shipment of pork from other parts of the Philippines continues to augment the province's local supply.

text: Base sa monitoring sang Department of Agriculture, nagapakita nga ang pork ham kag liempo ang may presyo nga P330 tubtob P350 kada kilo sa nagkalain-lain nga merkado sa Western Visayas.
english: Based on the monitoring of the Department of Agriculture, pork ham and liempo are priced at P330 to P350 per kilo in various markets in Western Visayas.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., nga naga-amat amat pa recover ang probinsya gikan sa halit sang African Swine Fever.
english: Earlier, Iloilo Governor Arthur Defensor Jr. said the province is slowly recovering from the damage caused by African Swine Fever.

text: Sa 28 ka mga banwa nga naapektuhan sang ASF halin tuig 2022, 17 na ang na-upgrade halin sa RED zone nga nangin PINK zone.
english: Of the 28 towns affected by ASF since 2022, 17 have been upgraded from the RED zone to the PINK zone.

text: Ang Red zones amo ang mga lugar nga infected sang ASF samtang ang Pink zones naman amo ang mga lugar nga wala sang ASF apang adjacent ini sa infected nga lugar.
english: The Red zones are the areas infected with ASF while the Pink zones are the areas where there is no ASF but adjacent to the infected area.

text: Maga-upod ang replica sang imahe ni Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria sa 43rd Intramuros Grand Marian Procession subong nga hapon, Disyembre 1.
english: The replica of the image of Our Lady of the Candlemas will accompany the 43rd Intramuros Grand Marian Procession this afternoon, December 1.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga sunod-sunod nga tuig nga yara ang Patroness of Western Visayas ukon mas kilala nga si “Nanay Cande” sa amo sini kadaku nga Marian event.
english: This is the third consecutive year that the Patroness of Western Visayas or better known as “Nanay Cande” is present at such a large Marian event.

text: Si Nuestra Señora de la Candelaria amo ang naga-isahanon nga Marian Image sa Pilipinas nga ginkoronahan sang isa ka pope kag isa na ka santo nga si Saint John Paul II.
english: Our Lady of the Candlemas is the only Marian Image in the Philippines to be crowned by a pope and a saint, Saint John Paul II.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Intramuros Grand Marian Procession ang isa sa pinakabalantayan nga Marian events sa pungsod bangud ginatipon sini ang crowned Madonna Images sa Pilipinas sa isa ka eng-grande nga religious procession bilang selebrasyon sang Feast of the Immaculate Conception.
english: The Intramuros Grand Marian Procession is one of the most watched Marian events in the country as it brings together the crowned Madonna Images in the Philippines in a grand religious procession in celebration of the Feast of the Immaculate Conception.

text: Ginapatigayon ini sa kada una nga Domingo sang Disyembre sa Plaza de Roma sa facade sang Manila Cathedral sa Intramuros, Manila.
english: It is held every first Sunday of December at the Plaza de Roma on the facade of the Manila Cathedral in Intramuros, Manila.

text: Gina-organisar ini sang Cofradia de la Immaculada Concepcion kag sang Intramuros Administration.
english: It is organized by the Cofradia de la Immaculada Concepcion and the Intramuros Administration.

text: (December 3, 2023 image of Archdiocese of Jaro, Commission on Social Communications)
english: (December 3, 2023 image of Archdiocese of Jaro, Commission on Social Communications)

text: Ginpasigurado ni former Bayan Muna Representative Teddy Casiño nga may nagahikotar na sa ila nga bahin agud maka-draft sang impeachment complaint batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Former Bayan Muna Representative Teddy Casiño assured that someone is already working on their side to draft an impeachment complaint against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Teddy Casiño, iya ginpahayag nga sigurado na nga may legal team nga nagaproseso agud madagdagan sang nasambit nga complaint ang bise-president.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Teddy Casiño said he is sure that there is a legal team processing to add to the complaint against the vice-president.

text: Suno kay Casiño, magluwas sa pila ka grupo, si former Senator Antonio Trillanes ang may ginaprepar man nga dugang nga complaint batok kay Duterte.
english: According to Casiño, besides several groups, former Senator Antonio Trillanes is also preparing an additional complaint against Duterte.

text: Ginalantaw man sang natungdan ang mga grounds nga graft and corruption, bribery, betrayal of the public trust sa pagpanago sang bise-presidente sa ginapatigayon nga mga hearings, kag heinous crime sa pagpamahog nga ginhimo sini kay President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., First Lady Liza Marcos, kag House Speaker Martin Romualdez.
english: He is also looking into the grounds of graft and corruption, bribery, betrayal of the public trust in the vice-president's hiding from the ongoing hearings, and heinous crime in threatening President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr., First Lady Liza Marcos, and House Speaker Martin Romualdez.

text: Mahimo naman nga indi pa ma-file sa Lunes nga adlaw ang reklamo ilabi na nga madamo pa sang proseso nga dapat agyan.
english: The complaint may not be filed by Monday especially since there are still many processes to go through.

text: Ini agud man nga masigurado nga sige-sige ang dalagan sang kaso.
english: This is also to ensure that the case is running smoothly.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga wala pa sang pinal nga schedule ukon adlaw kon san-o sila maka-file sang impeachment complaint.
english: He also clarified that there is no final schedule or date when they can file an impeachment complaint.

text: Nagpanindugan man si Casiño nga tion na agud nga mapasabat ang natungdan bangud kon indi sini masabat, magapadayon lang ang “impunity” sa gobyerno.
english: Casiño also insisted that it is time for the concerned to be held accountable because if he does not answer, impunity will continue in the government.

text: TUNGOD may yara na gid man kita sa pungsod sing research center nga magatuon kag mag-develop sang COVID-19 vaccine, luyag na naton seguro mahibal-an kon ano na ang ila nahimuan.
english: SINCE we finally have a research center in the country that will study and develop a COVID-19 vaccine, we probably want to know what they have done.

text: Seguro pwede na ini sila maka-provide sang ila kaugalingon nga pagtuon kag pag-identify sang COVID-19 sa iya  nagakalain-lain nga strain ukon type base sa pag-grupo sang sintoma (cluster of symptoms) sang mga pasyente, agud maka-provide sang nagakaigu nga pagtatap sa mga pasyente sunu sa ila partikcular nga “set” sang ginabatyag.
english: Perhaps they can provide their own study and identification of COVID-19 in its different strains or types based on the cluster of symptoms of patients, in order to provide appropriate care to patients according to their particular set of symptoms.

text: Halin sa sining anom ka klase sang covid-19, pwede na nila seguro ma-identify ang COVID-19 virus sa diin ma-develop ang vaccine nga pwede magamit sang tanan, ukon ma-develop para sa nagakabagay nga grupo sang mga pumuluyo.
english: From these six types of covid-19, they can probably identify the COVID-19 virus and develop a vaccine that can be used by everyone, or developed for the right group of people.

text: Pwede naman seguro matun-an nila ang pagbaylo-baylo (mutate) sang kinaiya sang virus agud ma-develop ang vaccine bagay sa ila bag-o nga functionality, katulad sang nagakatabo sa flu nga kada tuig may lain nga vaccine ang dapat ma-develop.
english: They can probably learn to mutate the nature of the virus to develop a vaccine according to their new functionality, as happens with the flu where every year a different vaccine must be developed.

text:
***

Sunu sa COVID Symptom Tracker App sang King’s College London, kon diin gahatag impormasyon ang mga pasyente, ukon nangin pasyente, sang ila nabatyagan nga mga sintoma,

may  anom ka type (cluster of symptoms) ang COVID-19.
english:
***

According to King's College London's COVID Symptom Tracker App, where patients, or former patients, provide information on their symptoms,

COVID-19 has six types (cluster of symptoms).

text: Ini ang Flu-like with no fever; Flu-like with fever; Gastrointestinal; Severe level one, fatigue; Severe level two, confusion; kag Severe level  three, abdominal and respiratory.
english: It is Flu-like with no fever; Flu-like with fever; Gastrointestinal; Severe level one, fatigue; Severe level two, confusion; and Severe level  three, abdominal and respiratory.

text: Ang Tupe 1: Flu-like with no fever nagpakita sang mga sintoma sang pagsakit sang ulo (headache), pagkadula sang pagpanimaho (loss of smell), palanakit sang kalawasan (muscle pains), ubo, palanakit sang tutunlan (sore throat) kag palanakit sang dughan (chest pain).
english: Tupe 1: Flu-like with no fever showed symptoms of headache, loss of smell, muscle pains, cough, sore throat and chest pain.

text: Mga 1.5 ka porsyento (%) sini sa ila ang kinahanglan sing oxygen ukon ventilator.
english: About 1.5 percent (%) of them need oxygen or a ventilator.

text: Type 2: Flu-like with fever – nagalakip sang pagkadula sang gana sa pagkaon (loss of appetite), loss of smell, ubo, sore throat, hoarse kag hilanat (fever).
english: Type 2: Flu-like with fever – includes loss of appetite (loss of appetite), loss of smell, cough, sore throat, hoarse and fever (fever).

text: Mga 4.4% sini kinahanglan suporta sang pagginhawa (breathing upport).
english: About 4.4% of these needed breathing support.

text: Type 3: Gastrointestinal – wala ga-ubo; nagabatyag sing headache, diarrhea, loss of smell, loss of appetite, sore throat kag chest pain.
english: Type 3: Gastrointestinal – no diarrhea; experiencing headache, diarrhea, loss of smell, loss of appetite, sore throat and chest pain.

text: Ang mga  3.3% sa ila ang nagakinahanglan sang breathing support.
english: About 3.3% of them need breathing support.

text: Sa Type 4, ukon Severe level one, ang pasyente naga-sufrir sang loss of smell, ubo, hilanat, hoarseness kag chest pain.
english: In Type 4, or Severe level one, the patient suffers from loss of smell, cough, fever, hoarseness and chest pain.

text: Ang pasyente diri gakinahanglan sing breathing support at a rate of 8.6%.
english: The patient here required breathing support at a rate of 8.6%.

text: Ang Type 5 naman, ukon Severe level two, nagalakip sang sintoma sang Type 4 upod na ang loss of appetite, sore throat kag muscle pain, kag sang “confusion”, katulad sang indi pagkahibalo kon diin siya ukon diin siya nagapuyo.
english: Type 5, or Severe level two, includes Type 4 symptoms including loss of appetite, sore throat and muscle pain, and confusion, such as not knowing where he is or where he lives.

text: Mga 10% sini kinhanglan sang breathing support.
english: About 10% of them need breathing support.

text: Ang pinaka-severe nga type sang COVID-19 amo ang Type 6, Severe level three.
english: The most severe type of COVID-19 is Type 6, Severe level three.

text: Dala sini ang  tanan nga sintoma sang iban nga type upod na ang abdominal pain, shortness of breath kag diarrhea.
english: It carries all the symptoms of other types including abdominal pain, shortness of breath and diarrhea.

text: Mga 20% sini kinahanglan sing breahing support.
english: About 20% of these need breathing support.

text:
***

Partikular sa kaso sang mga kabataan (under age of 18), sunu sa Covid Symptom Study app, 52% sa ila wala nagpakita sang “adult classic symptoms” sang ubo, hilanat kag anosmia (loss of smell) before and after sang test.
english:
***

Particularly in the case of children (under age of 18), according to the Covid Symptom Study app, 52% of them did not show “adult classic symptoms” of cough, fever and anosmia (loss of smell) before and after the test.

text: Ang 33% sang kabataan nga na-test positive wala nagpakita sang bisan isa sang 20 ka sintoma sa kabilugan.
english: The 33% of children who tested positive showed none of the 20 symptoms overall.

text: Naga-suggest ini nga sila mga asyptomatic.
english: This suggests that they are asymptomatic.

text: Ang top five symptoms sa school-aged children nga nag-test positive amo ang kakapoy (fatigue) sang mga 55% sa ila, headache (53%), fever (49%), sore throat (38%) kag loss of appetive (35%).
english: The top five symptoms in school-aged children who tested positive were fatigue in about 55% of them, headache (53%), fever (49%), sore throat (38%) and loss of appetite (35%).

text: Ginkitaan man sang skin rash (pangatol kag pagpamula sang panit) ang 15% sang kabataan.
english: Skin rash (itching and redness of the skin) was also seen in 15% of the children.

text: Kon ikumparar sa mga adult, ang mga adult naga-sufrir sang fatigue (87%), headache (72%), loss of smell (60%), persistent cough (54%) kag sore throat (49%).
english: Compared to adults, adults suffer from fatigue (87%), headache (72%), loss of smell (60%), persistent cough (54%) and sore throat (49%).

text: Nagahatag ini sing ihibalo  sa mga doktor sang bagay nga pagtatap sang mga kabataan lain sa mga adult./PN
english: It gives doctors knowledge of how to treat children differently from adults./PN

text: Importante ang paghatag sang updates sa imo girlfriend ukon boyfriend agud mapabilin nga solid ang inyo nga relasyon kag agud makasalig ini nga safe lang ikaw pirme.
english: It is important to give updates to your girlfriend or boyfriend to keep your relationship solid and to make her believe that you are always safe.

text: May kilala ka bala nga halos oras-oras na nga nagapangayo sang update nga halos kada tikang kag liso sang karelasyon, dapat gid nga isugid sa iya?
english: Do you know someone who has been asking for an update for hours on end that almost every step and seed of the relationship, should be told to him?

text: Ini ang kaso sang 18-anyos nga babaye sa China nga gintago lamang sa pangalan nga Xiaoyu.
english: This is the case of an 18-year-old woman in China who was hidden only by the name Xiaoyu.

text: Una nga tuig sa kolehiyo si Xiaoyu sang nagseparar na ini sa iya ginikanan bangud kinahanglan sini magtinir malapit sa iya nga university.
english: Xiaoyu was in her first year of college when she separated from her parents because she needed to stay close to her university.

text: Didto man siya nakaangkon sang boyfriend kun sa diin nangin amat-amat na siya nga nangin clingy kag dependent tubtub sa punto nga naga-demand na ini nga kinahanglan nga pirme sila naga-istoryahanay.
english: There she also got a boyfriend who gradually became clingy and dependent to the point that he demanded that they always talk.

text: Halos indi naman makaginhawa si boyfriend bangud sa batasan sang babaye.
english: The boyfriend could hardly breathe because of the woman's behavior.

text: Nakaagi man nga sulit-sulit ang message ni Xiaoyu nga nagahingyo sa boyfriend nga buksan ang iya camera, kag sang wala naman nagsapak ang lalaki, wala gid nag-untat ang babaye.
english: Xiaoyu also repeatedly sent messages asking her boyfriend to turn on her camera, and when the man ignored her, the woman never stopped.

text: Naglala ang sitwasyon kag naglab-ot pa sa punto nga 100 ka beses gid sa isa ka adlaw ang pagtawag ni Xiaoyu sa lalaki.
english: The situation escalated to the point where Xiaoyu called the man 100 times a day.

text: Bangud sa pagka-upset sang dalaga, ginpangguba pa sini ang mga gamit sa iya nga aparment.
english: Because of the girl's upset, she even destroyed the furniture in her apartment.

text: Didto na kag nagtawag sang pulis ang boyfriend kag maayo na lang bangud nakaabot sila antes pa man nadayon ang tuyo sang babaye nga maglumpat sa balkonahe.
english: The boyfriend called the police and fortunately they arrived before the woman tried to jump from the balcony.

text: Gindala ini sa ospital kag sang ulihi nadiagnose nga may “love brain” ukon isa ka obsessive behavior sa romantic relationships.
english: She was taken to the hospital and later diagnosed with “love brain” or an obsessive behavior in romantic relationships.

text: Ini nga sahi sang borderline personality disorder ang nagaguwa sa tawo nga nagasuprer sa anxiety, depression, kag bipolar disorder.
english: This type of borderline personality disorder appears in people who suffer from anxiety, depression, and bipolar disorder.

text: Ginpahayag man sang doktor nga ini ang masami maangot sa unhealthy childhood attachments—ilabi na kun indi maayo ang relasyon sang isa ka tawo sa iya nga ginikanan ukon sa mga tawo sa iya palibot.
english: The doctor also said that this is often associated with unhealthy childhood attachments—especially when a person has a bad relationship with his parents or the people around him.

text: Ang mild cases sang love brain ang mahimo pa nga ma-manage paagi sa emotional management techniques samtang ang mga severe cases naman kaangay sa kaso ni Xiaoyu ang nagakinahanglan na sang medical intervention.#
english: Mild cases of love brain can still be managed through emotional management techniques while severe cases like Xiaoyu's case require medical intervention.

text: Handa nga mag-deploy sang mga personnel ang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office (ICTTMO) pananglitan istriktuhan sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) ang implementasyon sang “Anti-Sardinas Policy” sa tanan nga Public Utility Vehicles (PUV).
english: The Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office (ICTTMO) is ready to deploy personnel if the Land Transportation Office (LTO) strictly implements the “Anti-Sardinas Policy” in all Public Utility Vehicles (PUVs).

text: May kaangtanan ini sa naglapta nga video online kun sa diin makita nga ang isa ka modernized jeepney ang nagapasaka pa gihapon sang mga pasahero apisar nga puno na kag tuman na kagutok ang sulod sini.
english: This is in connection with a video that circulated online where it can be seen that a modernized jeepney is still picking up passengers despite being full and very crowded inside.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ret.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ret.

text: PCol.
english: PCol.

text: Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang ICTTMO office, iya ginpahayag nga nagahulat na lamang ang ila opisina sang pormal nga direktiba ukon operasyon halin sa LTO agud nga makapartisipar man sila sa implementasyon sang polisiya.
english: Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the ICTTMO office, said their office is waiting for a formal directive or operation from the LTO so that they can participate in the implementation of the policy.

text: Dugang pa ni Garbanzos nga indi na bag-o sa siyudad sang Iloilo ang isyu sang overloading sa mga modernized jeepney, gani kinahanglan gid ang mas istrikto nga pagpatuman sang kasuguan.
english: Garbanzos added that the issue of overloading in modernized jeepneys is not new in Iloilo City, so stricter enforcement of the law is needed.

text: Nagpasalamat man si Garbanzos sa concerned citizen nga nagpakigbahin sang amo nga hitabo sa social media, bangud nakabulig ini agud mahatagan sang nagakaigo nga solusyon sa amo nga problema.
english: Garbanzos also thanked the concerned citizen who shared the incident on social media, as it helped to provide a proper solution to the problem.

text: Bisan pa may anum ka autoimmune diseases, nagbalik sa trabaho ang ginakilala Queen of All Media nga si Kris Aquino.
english: Despite having six autoimmune diseases, Kris Aquino, known as the Queen of All Media, returned to work.

text: Suno ini sa writer-editor kag iya suod nga abyan nga si Dindo-Balares.
english: This is according to writer-editor and his close friend Dindo-Balares.

text: Apang dugang sini, maluya pa gihapon si Kris, gani ang isa ka adlaw nga trabaho ang katumbas man sang tatlo ka adlaw nga bed rest.
english: But in addition, Kris is still weak, so one day of work is also equivalent to three days of bed rest.

text: “She’s back working!
english: “She’s back working!

text: ‘Yan ang latest kay Kris Aquino.
english: 'That's the latest on Kris Aquino.

text: Sinubukan niya the other day,” suno kay Balares.
english: He tried the other day,” Balares said.

text:
“But we all realized ‘1 day of work means 3 days of bed rest.”

Wala na ini nagdugang sang detalye sa kahimtangan sang aktres kag sa upcoming project sini.
english:
“But we all realized ‘1 day of work means 3 days of bed rest.”

It did not add further details on the status of the actress and her upcoming project.

text: “Baka masabihan na naman ako ng, ‘Kung minsan daldal ka rin, Kuya Dindo,'” lahog sini.
english: “Maybe I'll be told, 'Sometimes you're talkative, Kuya Dindo,'” he said.

text: Una na nga ginsapubliko ni Kris nga may palaabuton siya nga show kun sa diin makit-an sang viewers ang iya reality, amo man si Bimb, ang iya best friends nga ginakabig niya nga extended family, kag iya mga doctor nga nangin mga abyan naman subong.
english: Earlier, Kris announced that she has an upcoming show where viewers will see her reality, as well as Bimb, her best friends whom she considers her extended family, and her doctors who have become friends now.

text: Nagselebrar si Kris sang iya ika-54 nga kaadlawan sang Valentine’s Day.
english: Kris celebrated her 54th birthday on Valentine’s Day.

text: Kaupod sini sa special day ang iya nga mga anak nga sanday Josh kag Bimb, kag kaupod man ang iya celebrity friends.
english: She was accompanied on the special day by her sons Josh and Bimb, as well as her celebrity friends.

text: “I want to thank all my friends for taking [the] time to greet me last night and my friends from OC, who flew in,” post sini sa Instagram.
english: “I want to thank all my friends for taking [the] time to greet me last night and my friends from OC, who flew in,” she posted on Instagram.

text:
“But above all – I thank you for being with me, Kuya Josh, and Bimb during my journey towards recovery.”

September 2024 sang nagpauli si Kris sa Pilipinas matapos duha ka tuig man nga nagtinir sa United States para nga mapabulong ang iya multiple autoimmune conditions.
english:
“But above all – I thank you for being with me, Kuya Josh, and Bimb during my journey towards recovery.”

In September 2024, Kris returned to the Philippines after two years in the United States for treatment of her multiple autoimmune conditions.

text: Ginsapubliko sini nga tatlo sa sini nga kondisyon ang makabig nga life-threatening: Churg-Strauss syndrome, systemic sclerosis, kag lupus.
english: It publicized three of these conditions as life-threatening: Churg-Strauss syndrome, systemic sclerosis, and lupus.

text: Tubig ina — importante ina sa imo nga lawas.
english: That’s water — that’s important for your body.

text: Apang lain naman ang istorya kun ang tubig ang nasulod sa amo man gihapon nga plastic bottle kag dira ka man gihapon naga-inom sang sulit-sulit.
english: But it's a different story if the water is in the same plastic bottle and you drink it over and over again.

text: May mga plastic bottles nga safe gamiton liwat bangud madala pa ini sa paghugas sang habon.
english: There are plastic bottles that are safe to reuse because they can be washed with soap.

text: Apang may mga food and drinks nga nakasulod sa amo nga containers ukon plastic bottles nga posible may yara sang trace amounts sang Bisphenol A (BPA), isa ka synthetic chemical nga makahalit sa natural hormone messaging system.
english: But some food and drinks have been packaged in such containers or plastic bottles that may contain trace amounts of Bisphenol A (BPA), a synthetic chemical that can disrupt the natural hormone messaging system.

text: Suno sa Environment California Research & Policy Center, ang BPA ang may posible maangot sa breast and uterine cancer, increased risk sang miscarriage ukon pagkahulog sang bata, kag nagapanubo man sang testosterone levels.
english: According to the Environment California Research & Policy Center, BPA is possibly linked to breast and uterine cancer, increased risk of miscarriage, and also lowers testosterone levels.

text: Ang BPA ang makaapekto man sa behavior sang kabataan.
english: BPA can also affect children's behavior.

text: Makahalit ini sa utok kag prostate glands ilabi na sa mga fetuses, infants, kag children.
english: It can damage the brain and prostate glands especially in fetuses, infants, and children.

text: Ginapamatukan man sang mga health advocates ang paggamit liwat sang bottles nga human sa plastic lakip na ang most disposable water, soda, kag juice bottles.
english: Health advocates also oppose the reuse of bottles made of plastic including most disposable water, soda, and juice bottles.

text: Panugyan sang mga eksperto, indi na pag-init initon pa ukon gamiton liwat ini nga mga bottles.
english: Experts advise not to reheat or reuse these bottles.

text: Nag-file sang criminal kag administrative complaint si Sangguniang Bayan Member Vincent Pascal De Asis sa Office of the Ombudsman batuk kay Mayor Samuel Gumarin sang Buenavista, Guimaras bangud sa ginapahayag pagbutang sang Local Government Unit sang “Tindahan ng Bayan” sa sulod sang Buenavista Public Market.
english: Sangguniang Bayan Member Vincent Pascal De Asis filed a criminal and administrative complaint with the Office of the Ombudsman against Mayor Samuel Gumarin of Buenavista, Guimaras for allegedly placing a “Tindahan ng Bayan” inside the Buenavista Public Market.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay De Asis, iya ginpahayag nga ang ginabaligya nga mga isda kag utan sang LGU-Buenavista ang yara sa manubo nga presyo kun ipaanggid sa ginabaligya sang mga vendors.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, De Asis said the fish and vegetables sold by LGU-Buenavista are at a lower price compared to those sold by vendors.

text: Suno sa SB Member, natukiban niya nga ang mga nagabaligya sa “Tindahan ng Bayan” amo ang mga empleyado man sang munisipyo kag ginagamit man ang salakyan sang LGU.
english: According to the SB Member, he discovered that the vendors in the “Tindahan ng Bayan” are also employees of the municipality and also use the LGU vehicle.

text: Ginsiling man ni De Asis nga ang kapital nga gingamit sang Tindahan ng Bayan sa pagbakal sang isda kag utan ang ginaalegar halin sa private funds sang alcalde kag indi halin sa LGU.
english: De Asis also said that the capital used by Tindahan ng Bayan to buy fish and vegetables allegedly came from the mayor's private funds and not from the LGU.

text: Bangud sini, nagsulat ang SB Member kay Mayor Gumarin nga nagapamangkot kun sa diin halin ang pondo nga gingamit sa proyekto kag ang numero sang mga empleyado nga amo ang magbaligya sa Tindahan ng Bayan.
english: Because of this, the SB Member wrote to Mayor Gumarin asking where the funds used for the project and the number of employees who will sell in Tindahan ng Bayan.

text: Base sa sulat ni Mayor Gumarin, ang Tindahan ng Bayan ang isa ka exclusifve prerogative sini agud ma-address ang impact sang inflation kag epekto sang El Niño Phenomenon.
english: Based on Mayor Gumarin's letter, the Tindahan ng Bayan is his exclusive prerogative to address the impact of inflation and the effects of the El Niño Phenomenon.

text: Apang pahayag ni SB Member De Asis, wala man lang sang layi ukon ordinansa nga gin-aprubahan ang Sangguniang Bayan sa pag-establisar sang Tindahan ng Bayan kag pagpain sang pondo para sa amo nga programa.
english: However, SB Member De Asis said there is no law or ordinance approved by the Sangguniang Bayan to establish Tindahan ng Bayan and allocate funds for the program.

text: Nagapati ang natungdan nga liable ang alcalde sa Technical Malversation sa idalom sang Revised Penal Code.
english: He believes that the mayor is liable for Technical Malversation under the Revised Penal Code.

text: Kadungan sang pagkomemorar sang Bonifacio Day subong nga adlaw, ginpadayon sang pila ka transport groups ang vigil protest agud pamatukan ang deadline sang extension sang compulsory consolidation para sa mga public utility vehicles nga gintalana kahapon, Nobyembre 29.
english: In conjunction with the commemoration of Bonifacio Day today, several transport groups continued the vigil protest to oppose the deadline for the extension of compulsory consolidation for public utility vehicles set yesterday, November 29.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Elmer Forro, lead convenor sang No to PUV phaseout coalition, iya ginpahayag nga nangin inutil ang Cooperative Development Authority kag Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board sa paghatag sang solusyon sa mga reklamo sang mga myembro sang kooperatiba.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Elmer Forro, lead convenor of the No to PUV phaseout coalition, said the Cooperative Development Authority and the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board have been useless in providing solutions to the complaints of cooperative members.

text: Suno kay Forro, may magasulod man nga Electric Bus Rapid Transit nga ginapanag-iyahan sang pribado nga mga dumuluong nga kompanya nga magapanginpulos sa Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program.
english: According to Forro, there will also be an Electric Bus Rapid Transit owned by private foreign companies that will benefit from the Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program.

text: Suno pa sa natungdan, sa subong, maathag nga ang Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program ang may katuyuan nga gub-on ang palangabuhian kag pabudlayan ang mga operators kag drivers sang traditional PUJs, agawon ang ila nga mga ruta kabaylo sang pagpabor sa dalagko nga mga korporasyon.
english: He said that at present, it is clear that the Public Utility Vehicle Modernization Program aims to destroy the livelihoods and make it difficult for the operators and drivers of traditional PUJs, taking away their routes in exchange for favoring big corporations.

text: Nahibalaun nga ang nasambit nga vigil protest ang dululungan nga ginpatigayon sa pila ka mga lugar sa Pilipinas sa pagpanguna sang Manibela kag Piston.
english: The vigil protest was held in several parts of the Philippines under the leadership of Manibela and Piston.

text: Katuyuan sang protesta nga depensahan ang palangabuhian sang operators kag drivers sang traditional nga mga PUJ sa pungsod.
english: The protest aims to defend the livelihood of operators and drivers of traditional PUJs in the country.

text: Nagnubo ang presyo sang karne sang baboy sa pila ka mga merkado sa Iloilo City.
english: The price of pork has dropped in some markets in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jerry Ibanez, isa ka vendor sa Mandurriao Public Market, iya ginpahayag nga 40 pesos gid ang ginnubo sa presyo kun sa diin halin sa P390, yara na ini subong sa P350.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jerry Ibanez, a vendor at the Mandurriao Public Market, said the price was reduced by 40 pesos from P390 to P3

text: Suno kay Ibañez, ang pagnubo sang presyo ang resulta sang bastante nga suplay sang baboy sa Iloilo.
english: According to Ibañez, the price drop is the result of the sufficient supply of pork in Iloilo.

text: Pahayag niya, duha na ka semana ang nagligad humalin sang nagnubo ang presyo sang karne sang baboy.
english: He said it has been two weeks since the price of pork went down.

text: Dugang niya, bangud sini, posible nga wala man sang dako nga pagbag-o sa presyo sa Disyembre samtang nagahilapit ang Paskwa.
english: He added that because of this, it is possible that there will be no major change in prices in December as Christmas approaches.

text: Gindala sa Calinog Municipal Police Station ang lalaki nga nagsulod kag nag-intra sa disco sang closing event sang Provincial Boy Scout of the Philippines (BSP) Jamboree sa Calinog, Iloilo.
english: The man who entered and participated in the disco of the closing event of the Provincial Boy Scout of the Philippines (BSP) Jamboree in Calinog, Iloilo was brought to the Calinog Municipal Police Station.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Myles Dieron,hepe sang Calinog Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nakasulod ang lalaki matapos nga wala matalupangdan sang kapulisan nga isa ini ka outsider bangud naga-anggid ang iya ginasuksok nga uniform sa mga staff kag mga manunudlo sa sulod sang campsite.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Myles Dieron, chief of the Calinog Municipal Police Station, said the man entered the campsite after the police did not notice that he was an outsider because he was wearing a uniform that matched the staff and teachers inside the campsite.

text: Suno kay Dieron, gindesisyonan na lang nga dal-on ini sa police station bangud indi na ma-settle ang reklamo sang menor-de-edad matapos ini nga nasalapay sa abaga sang nasambit man nga lalaki.
english: According to Dieron, it was decided to take him to the police station because the complaint of the minor could not be settled after he fell on the shoulder of the same man.

text: Nagpangayo man sang pasensya ang indibidwal kag nagpaathag nga indi niya tuyo ang natabo bangud nga nakainom ini sang makahulunog nga ilimnon.
english: The individual also apologized and explained that he did not intend to do what happened because he was under the influence of alcohol.

text: Mas hugot nga security measures ang ipatuman sang University of the Philippines Visayas sa duha sini ka campus sa Iloilo kasunod sang pagpamahog nga dala sang bomb threat.
english: The University of the Philippines Visayas will implement tighter security measures at its two campuses in Iloilo following a bomb threat.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Gerthrode Charlotte Tan-Mabilog, Director sang UPV Information and Publications Office, iya ginpahayag nga kasunod sang threat, nag-focus gid ang Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) sa Miagao Campus sang UPV bangud ini ang may mas malapad nga sakop kag madali nga masekyar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Gerthrode Charlotte Tan-Mabilog, Director of the UPV Information and Publications Office, said that following the threat, the Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) focused on the Miagao Campus of UPV because it has a wider scope and is easier to check.

text: Suno kay Tan-Mabilog, gin-clear ang tanan nga dormitories bangud may dako ini nga population sang mga estudyante.
english: According to Tan-Mabilog, all dormitories were cleared because they have a large population of students.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga alas-4:00 na sang hapon sang nagpaguwa ang talatapan sang opisyal nga statement nga nagaathag nga clear sa bomba ang nasambit nga campus.
english: He also explained that it was 4:00 pm when the office issued an official statement explaining that the campus was clear of bombs.

text: Nahibaluan nga pasado ‘las-6:00 sa aga sang ila nabaton ang mensahe nga nagasaad sang “may bomba nga malupok sa office niyo”.
english: It was learned that around 6:00 am they received a message promising “a bomb will explode in your office”.

text: Yara na sa 90% ang completion sang legislative building sang Iloilo City Hall.
