english: The legislative building of Iloilo City Hall is now 90% complete.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay City Architect Regina Gregorio, iya ginpahayag nga ginalauman nga matapos ang proyekto sa first quarter sang 2025.
english: City Architect Regina Gregorio said the project is expected to be completed in the first quarter of 2025.

text: Suno kay Gregorio, ang imprastruktura ang may bag-o ukon moderno nga disensyo sa bahin sang session hall, cafeteria, kag auditorium.
english: According to Gregorio, the infrastructure will have a new or modern design in terms of session hall, cafeteria, and auditorium.

text: Pahamtangan man ang opisina sang Sangguniang Panlungsod.
english: The City Council office will also be located.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan nga lakip man ibutang sa building amo ang Office of the Building Official (OBO).
english: He also said that the Office of the Building Official (OBO) will also be placed in the building.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang legislative building ang may walo ka panalgan kag tatlo ka mga elevators.
english: The legislative building has eight floors and three elevators.

text: Ginpatibusok sang United Nations peacekeeping mission sa Lebanon ang drone sang Israel.
english: The United Nations peacekeeping mission in Lebanon shot down an Israeli drone.

text: Suno sa UN, nagalupad ang drone nga agresibo samtang sila ang nagapatrolya sa border sang syudad sang Kfar Kila.
english: According to the UN, the drone was flying aggressively while they were patrolling the border of Kfar Kila city.

text: Ginakabig nila nga isa ka ‘defensive countermeasures’ ang ila ginhimo.
english: They consider what they did as a ‘defensive countermeasures’.

text: Nagpatibusok pa sang Granada ang drone malapit sa ila ginaplastaran.
english: The drone even fired a grenade near their position.

text: Pahayag naman sang Israeli military nga nagapatigayon lamang sila sang ‘routine intelligence gathering-activity’ sa lugar.
english: The Israeli military said it was conducting a routine intelligence gathering activity in the area.

text: GOOD to learn nga ginatukod na sang aton gobyerno, paagi sa Department of Science and Technology (DOST), ang isa ka research center agud mag-develop sang local vaccine against COVID-19.
english: GOOD to learn that our government, through the Department of Science and Technology (DOST), is already establishing a research center to develop a local vaccine against COVID-19.

text: Lakip diri ang pagtukod sang Virology Institute sa New Clark City kag ang reactivation sang Pharmaceutical Development Unit at DOST- Industrial Technology Development Institute bilang Tuklas Lunas Center for Pharmaceuticals Development.
english: These include the establishment of the Virology Institute in New Clark City and the reactivation of the Pharmaceutical Development Unit at DOST- Industrial Technology Development Institute as the Tuklas Lunas Center for Pharmaceuticals Development.

text: Angot diri, ang Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF) nagtukod man sang sub-technical working group, nga ginapangunahan sang DOST, agud makig-coordinate sa Department of Health, Food and Drug Administration, Research Institute of Tropical Medicine, kag sa World Health Organization (WHO) para magpili sang mga myembro sini.
english: In this regard, the Inter-Agency Task Force (IATF) also established a sub-technical working group, led by DOST, to coordinate with the Department of Health, Food and Drug Administration, Research Institute of Tropical Medicine, and the World Health Organization (WHO) to select its members.

text: Luas sa sining research center nga ginatukod sang DOST agud mag-develop sang vaccine kontra COVID-19, naga-partisipar na gani kita sa Solidarity Trials sang WHO nga ginapasakupan sang mga myembro sini.
english: In addition to this research center that DOST is building to develop a vaccine against COVID-19, we are already participating in the Solidarity Trials of WHO with its members.

text: Sa subong sini, sunu sa kay Presidente Duterte, may mga 24 na gani ka ospital sa pungsod ang naga-partisipar sa Solidarity Trials.
english: Currently, according to President Duterte, there are about 24 hospitals in the country participating in the Solidarity Trials.

text: At least 12 sini ang aktibo na nga naga-recruit para sa clinical trials.
english: At least 12 of these are already actively recruiting for clinical trials.

text: Sa panugod, may ara na gani sang mga 87 nga nag-presentar sang ila kaugalingon agud mag-partisipar sa trials halin sa Clinical Trial I tubtub III tubtub maseguro nga ang ma-develop nga vaccine “effective and safe”.
english: Initially, there are already about 87 who have presented themselves to participate in trials from Clinical Trial I to III to ensure that the developed vaccine is “effective and safe”.

text: May mga indibidwal man gani nga mga Filipino ang nakapakigbahin sa mga clinical trials sang iban nga pungsod, katulad sang Saudi kag United Kingdom.
english: Some Filipino individuals have even participated in clinical trials in other countries, such as Saudi Arabia and the United Kingdom.

text: Nakapakig-angot man kita sa mga ka-myembro naton sa ASEAN agud pasanyugon ang scientific cooperation, partikular sa pagtuon kag pag-develop sang vaccine kag sang anti-viral treatment research and development.
english: We have also engaged with our ASEAN members to enhance scientific cooperation, particularly in the study and development of vaccines and anti-viral treatment research and development.

text: Sa karon, may at least apat ka siyudad sa pungod nga naga-recruit para sa clinical trials batok sa Covid-19.
english: Currently, there are at least four cities in the country recruiting for clinical trials against Covid-19.

text: Ini ang mga siyudad sang Angeles (Pampanga), Baguio, Cagayan de Oro kag Caloocan.
english: These are the cities of Angeles (Pampanga), Baguio, Cagayan de Oro and Caloocan.

text:
***

Importante ang pagtukod sining research center, sunu sa aton gobyerno, agud may aton nga pagtuon kag pag-develop sang mga vaccine para sa aton self-reliance kag self-sufficiency.
english:
***

The establishment of this research center is important, according to our government, so that we can study and develop vaccines for our self-reliance and self-sufficiency.

text: Matuod, dapat indi lang kita pirme gapanglaghap kon diin magkuha sining life-saving nga mga vaccine, nga masami ginabakal naton sa iban nga pungsod.
english: Of course, we should not always be wondering where to get these life-saving vaccines, which we often buy in other countries.

text: In fact, importante man nga kita mismo may kaugalingon nga pagtuon, ihibalo kag pag-develop sang mga bulong kag vaccine agud mahibal-an kon ano ang bagay sa kinaiya sang aton mga pumuluyo tungod sa ethnic, racial, geographical ukon climatic conditions, lakip na ang klase sang mikrobyo nga nagaluntad partikular diri sa aton.
english: In fact, it is also important that we ourselves have our own study, knowledge and development of drugs and vaccines to know what is suitable for the characteristics of our people because of ethnic, racial, geographical or climatic conditions, including the type of microbes that exist particularly here in our country.

text: Kag kon pwede man ma-generalize, kon kis-a ugaling kinahanglan pa ma-adjust ang dosage ukon may warning issues bag-o magamit ini sang mga Filipino.
english: And if it can be generalized, sometimes the dosage needs to be adjusted or there are warning issues before Filipinos can use it.

text: Tungod sini, sa kaso sang COVID-19, kinahanglan nga mahibal-an ta gid kon ano nga strain ukon type sang mikrobyo ang nagahalit diri sa aton, agud mahibal-an man ang bagay nga bulong, therapeutic remedy ukon supportive care, nga mapanugyan naton diri mismo sa aton research center.
english: Therefore, in the case of COVID-19, we need to know exactly what strain or type of microbe is harming us, in order to know the right medicine, therapeutic remedy or supportive care, which we can recommend right here in our research center.

text: May anom (6) ka type ukon strain sang COVID-19, sunu sa pagtuon sang mga  researchers sang King’s College London nga ginpartisipahan sang mga 1,600 ka pasyente sa United Kingdom kag sa US, nga nag-log sang ila sintoma sa COVID Symptom Tracker App sadtong Marso kag Abril 2020.
english: There are six (6) types or strains of COVID-19, according to a study by researchers at King's College London involving about 1,600 patients in the United Kingdom and the US, who logged their symptoms on the COVID Symptom Tracker App in March and April 2020.

text: Angot diri, pwede na kita magtutok sa paghibalo diri sa aton research center kon ano ining strain, ukon mga strain, ang naga-atake sa aton, nga ang kada isa may kaugalingon nga kinaiya.
english: In this regard, we can now focus on finding out here in our research center what this strain, or strains, are attacking us, each with its own characteristics.

text: Ang aton pagtuon kag pag-develop sang COVID-19 vaccine sa research center mapatutok man naton sa pag-ihibalo sang at least lima ka klase sang vaccine nga mapilian naton paagi sa isa ka randomized controlled trial nga ginapatigayon sa karon agud mahibal-an gid ang bagay ukon mas maayo nga vaccine para sa aton.
english: Our study and development of the COVID-19 vaccine at the research center will also focus on identifying at least five types of vaccines that we can choose from through a randomized controlled trial that is currently being conducted to determine the right or better vaccine for us.

text: Ining lima ka klase sang vaccine amo ang: Live-attenuated vaccine nga gamit ang buhi ukon napaluya (weakened) nga mikrobyo; Inactivated vaccine nga nagagamit sing patay nga mikrobyo; Toxoid vaccine nga naga-target sa mikrobyo mismo; Subunit Vaccine nga nagagamit lang sang bahin (pieces) sang mikrobyo agud ma-provoke ang immune response; kag ang Conjugate Vaccine nga nagagamit sang bahin sang mikrobyo upod (combined) sa carrier protein.
english: These five types of vaccines are: Live-attenuated vaccine using a live or weakened microbe; Inactivated vaccine that uses a dead microbe; Toxoid vaccine that targets the microbe itself; Subunit Vaccine that uses only parts of the microbe to provoke an immune response; and the Conjugate Vaccine which uses the microbial part in combination with the carrier protein.

text: More power sa Covid-19 research center sang Filipinas!
english: More power to the Philippines' Covid-19 research center!

text: /PN
english: /PN

text: Duha ka mga unibersidad sa Iloilo City ang nakakuha sang 100% nga passing rate sa bag-o lang ginpaguwa nga resulta sang November 2024 Philippine Nurses Licensure Examination (PNLE).
english: Two universities in Iloilo City scored 100% passing rate in the recently released results of the November 2024 Philippine Nurses Licensure Examination (PNLE).

text: Ini amo ang West Visayas State University (WVSU) La Paz kag ang Saint Paul University-Iloilo.
english: These are West Visayas State University (WVSU) La Paz and Saint Paul University-Iloilo.

text: Suno sa Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 108 sa mga estudyante sa WVSU ang nagkuha sang pasinawan kag lunsay nakapasar samtang 110 naman ang nag-take halin sa Paulinians nga lunsay man nangin madinalag-on.
english: According to the Professional Regulation Commission (PRC), 108 of the students at WVSU took the exam and all passed while 110 took from Paulinians who were also successful.

text: Ini ang nagbutang sa West kag Saint Paul sa Rank 1 sa Top Performing Schools kaupod sa siyam ka iban pa nga mga buluthuan sa Pilipinas.
english: This placed West and Saint Paul in Rank 1 in the Top Performing Schools along with nine other schools in the Philippines.

text: Apat man ka mga estudyante sang WVSU College of Nursing-Batch Zephyr ang nakasulod sa lista sang topnotchers.
english: Four WVSU College of Nursing-Batch Zephyr students also made the list of topnotchers.

text: Rank 8 si Ma.
english: Rank 8 is Ma.

text: Dead-on-arrival sa hospital ang isa ka lalaki matapos nga natirohan samtang nagalakat ini pauli sa Barangay Lopez Jaena Norte, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: A man was shot dead on arrival at the hospital after he was shot while walking home in Barangay Lopez Jaena Norte, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Ang biktima amo si Antonio “Boy-boy” Baybayanon, 26-anyos, may live-in partner, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Antonio “Boy-boy” Baybayanon, 26, with a live-in partner, resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Iloilo kay Punong Barangay Relendes Soberano, iya ginpahayag nga antes natabo ang insidente, may nakit-an nga naka-standby nga motorsiklo sa lugar nga amo gingamit sang suspek sa paghimo sang krimen.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Iloilo, Punong Barangay Relendes Soberano said that before the incident, a motorcycle was found on standby in the area which was used by the suspect to commit the crime.

text: Suno kay Soberano, gilayon nga nagpadulong sa Gustilo, La Paz ang suspek agud nga magpalagyo.
english: According to Soberano, the suspect immediately went to Gustilo, La Paz to flee.

text: Nag-agum naman sang pilas sa ulo kag liug ang biktima nga nangin rason sang iya nga kamatayon.
english: The victim sustained head and neck injuries which led to his death.

text: Gintuad naman sang himata sang biktima nga nakasuksok sang jacket kag naka-facemask nga duag itom ang suspek samtang ini ang sakay sa motorsiklo.
english: The victim's relative admitted that the suspect was wearing a black jacket and facemask while riding a motorcycle.

text: Nahibaluan nga mabakal lang kontani sang sigarilyo ang biktima sa tyangge, apang wala na ini nakapauli kasunod sang insidente.
english: It was learned that the victim was about to buy a cigarette at the stall, but did not return home after the incident.

text: Mas istriktohon sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) ang ila nga pag-implementar sang road safety matapos nga na-record ang sunod-sunod mga vehicular accident.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) will stricter its implementation of road safety after recording a series of vehicular accidents.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga padayon ang ila pagpatuman sang check points ilabi na nga mas masako ang dalan subong nga holiday season.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said they continue to implement check points especially as the roads are busier this holiday season.

text: Suno kay Araño, lakip sa mga information drive kag pamulong-pulong sa kabarangayan ang pila ka mga importante nga pahanumdom nga likwan ang mag-drive kon may impluwensya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: According to Araño, among the information drives and speeches in the barangays are some important reminders to avoid driving under the influence of alcohol.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ini sa motorista nga maggamit sang husto nga protection gears samtang nagamaneho kag sundon ang traffic rules agud nga makalikaw sa disgrasya.
english: He also reminded motorists to use proper protection gears while driving and follow traffic rules to avoid accidents.

text: Nagpasalig man ang natungdan nga nakipag-angot na sila sa mga Local Government Unit (LGU) agud nga matakdan sang mga street lights kag early warning devices ang mga dalan nga madulom kag prone sa disgrasya.
english: He also assured that they have already contacted the Local Government Units (LGUs) to install street lights and early warning devices on the roads that are dark and prone to accidents.

text: Nagalaom si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga makaayo ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas hopes that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: kag Vice President Sara Duterte ang ila indi pag-intindihanay sa maayo nga paagi.
english: and Vice President Sara Duterte their misunderstanding in a good way.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson ni Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga ang alkalde nagapati nga ang democratic system sang pungsod ang nagahatag sang framework agud ma-address ang mga concerns nga ginaatubang sang duha sa pinakamataas nga opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ms. Joy Fantilaga, spokesperson of Mayor Treñas, said the mayor believes that the country's democratic system provides a framework to address the concerns faced by the two highest government officials.

text: Suno kay Fantilaga, apisar sang nagakalatabo sa national nga bahin, padayon nga nagatrabaho ang alkalde kag nagapakig-angot sa administrasyon agud nga makaimplementar sang mga programa.
english: According to Fantilaga, despite what is happening on the national side, the mayor continues to work and liaise with the administration to implement programs.

text: Nangin emosyonal man ang alkalde matapos nga nagpabutyag ini sang pagpasalamat sa administrasyon sa pag-ugyon sa iya nga mga plano para sa syudad sa mga nabilin sini nga adlaw bilang alkalde.
english: The mayor also became emotional after he expressed his gratitude to the administration for supporting his plans for the city in the remaining days as mayor.

text: Ginhatagan man sang pagtamod ni Treñas ang isa sa pinakadako nga nangin proyekto ni Marcos sa Iloilo nga Jalaur River Multipurpose Project Phase 2.
english: Treñas also highlighted one of Marcos' biggest projects in Iloilo, the Jalaur River Multipurpose Project Phase 2.

text: ILOILO CITY- Sang panahon nga yara pa kita sa kasagsagan sang Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic, halos indi naton ma- imagine nga makaangkon kita sang amo nga balatian bangud kabaylo sini amo nga ma-quarantine kita sang pila ka semana, indi naton mapalapitan ang aton pamilya, kag madamo pa nga konsekwensiya nga dala.
english: ILOILO CITY- When we were still in the midst of the Coronavirus disease (COVID-19) pandemic, we could hardly imagine that we would get such a disease because in return we would be quarantined for several weeks, we would not be able to approach our families, and many other consequences.

text: Apang wala ina kun ipaanggid sa inagihan sang isa ka pasyente sa Netherlands nga ang iya pag-antos sang COVID-19, naglawig sang 613 ka adlaw ukon kapin sa 20 ka bulan.
english: But that's nothing compared to the experience of a patient in the Netherlands whose suffering from COVID-19, lasted 613 days or more than 20 months.

text: Ang pasyente isa ka 72-anyos nga lalaki nga na-infect sang Omicron variant sang 2022 apang nag-angkon sang severe immunity deficiencies matapos gintublukan sang multiple Covid shots.
english: The patient is a 72-year-old man who was infected with the Omicron variant in 2022 but developed severe immunity deficiencies after receiving multiple Covid shots.

text: Humalin sadto, wala na nag-untat ang pag- positibo niya sa coronavirus nga naglab-ot sa 613 ka adlaw.
english: Since then, he has not stopped testing positive for the coronavirus for 613 days.

text: Sa amo nga kalawig nga pag-antos, gintinguhaan sang mga doctor nga buligan ang tigulang apang ang iya lawas ang indi makasarang nga magbato sa virus bisan pa sa bulig sang antibody medication.
english: During the long suffering, doctors tried to help the elderly but his body was not able to fight the virus even with the help of antibody medication.

text: Sa malain nga palad, siya ang napatay gid sang Oktubre sang nagligad nga tuig kag siya subong ang ginakabig sang mga researchers nga longest-ever known case of SARS-CoV-2 infection.
english: Unfortunately, he did die in October last year and he is now considered by researchers to be the longest-ever known case of SARS-CoV-2 infection.

text: ANG balita nagasiling nga isa ka biktima sang vehicular accident sadtong Setyembre 5, 2020 ang gin-sulod sa Emergency Room (ER) sang West Visayas Medical Center (WVMC) upod sa mga pasyente nga may COVID-19.
english: The news says that a victim of a vehicular accident on September 5, 2020 was admitted to the Emergency Room (ER) of the West Visayas Medical Center (WVMC) along with patients with COVID-19.

text: Gani ang una naton nga pamangkot amo ini: “Ngaa dira gid ini gin-upod sa mga pasyente nga may COVID-19?” Indi bala dapat ibulag ang mga may COVID-19 sa wala sining balatian?
english: So our first question is: “Why was it included in the patients with COVID-19?” Shouldn't those with COVID-19 be isolated from those without the disease?

text: Natural indi pwede!
english: Of course not!

text: Luas lang seguro kon ma-medyosan nga may separasyon, bisan temporary lang apang makapaseguro nga indi maglatonay ang mga pasyente.
english: Unless it is possible to separate, even temporarily, it will ensure that patients do not spread each other.

text: Ang probema dira ugaling kay sa masami, lakip na sa WVMC, gamay lang nga kwarto ang ER sang ospital nga indi maka-okupar dungan sang may COVID-19 kag ang wala.
english: The problem here, however, is that often, including at WVMC, the ER of the hospital is a small room that cannot occupy both those with COVID-19 and those who do not.

text: In fact, sunu sa balita, namalibad gid ang WVMC sa pagbaton sa sining 9 anyos nga babaye nga nabungguan sang isa ka multicab.
english: In fact, according to the news, the WVMC refused to accept this 9-year-old woman who was hit by a multicab.

text: Ugaling namilit kuno ang iloy nga tatapon gid ang iya bata sa ER, kon diin lang may kagamitan sa pagtatap sa pasyente, agud mahingagaw nga maluas sa kamatayon ang iya anak.
english: However, the mother insisted that her son be taken care of in the ER, where there is only equipment to care for the patient, so that her son can be saved from death.

text: Tungod ma-konsyensya man seguro ang taga-ER kon indi dayon matatap ang bata, gani ginbaton ila ini agud mahingawgaw nga mabuhi ang bata.
english: Because the ER would probably feel guilty if the child was not treated immediately, they accepted it in order to save the child's life.

text: Ugaling napatay gid ini bisan pa ang tanan ginhimo na sang ER.
english: But it did die even after everything the ER had done.

text: Isa ato ka desisyon nga “come hell or high water” sa tunga sang iloy kag sang mga nars kag doktor, agud maluas ang bata bisan pa pwede na malatnan ini sang COVID-19.
english: It was a decision of “come hell or high water” between the mother and the nurses and doctors, to save the child even though he could be infected with COVID-19.

text: Between ini sa posibilidad nga mapatay ang bata kag ang posibilidad nga malatnan lang ini sing COVID-19 nga posible mapaayo pa ini.
english: This is between the possibility of the child dying and the possibility of being infected with COVID-19 that can be cured.

text: Kon sa akon lang, pwede ko irisgo ang pag-violate sang isolation rule sa amo ina nga kahimtangan tungod sa akon moral responsibility sa Diyos sa iya kasuguan nga “Thou shalt not kill” paagi sa pagpatumbaya.
english: If it were up to me, I could risk violating the isolation rule in such a situation because of my moral responsibility to God in his law of “Thou shalt not kill” by negligence.

text: Tungod sini indi naton mabasol ang duha ka bahin – ang ER kag ang iloy.
english: Because of this we cannot blame both sides – the ER and the mother.

text: Ikaduha naton nga pamangkot: Ngaa nga ginpa-swab pa ang bata bisan pa nga patay na ini kag sa pagpamalibad gid sang iloy?
english: Our second question: Why was the child swabbed even though he was dead and the mother refused?

text: Sa bahin sang ER, ina tungod na-expose ang bata sa ER kon diin may pasyente nga may COVID-19 kag tungod man sa DILG MC 2020-063 nga nagapatuman sang cremation sang  mga biktima nga may COVID-19.
english: As for the ER, that's because the child was exposed to the ER where there is a patient with COVID-19 and also because of DILG MC 2020-063 that implements the cremation of victims with COVID-19.

text: Tungod sini indi naton mabasol ang ER kon ngaa ipa-swab gid ang bata bisan patay na ini.
english: Therefore, we cannot blame the ER for swabbing the child even though he is dead.

text: In fact, ang swab nagpakita nga nalatnan gid sang COVID-19 ang bata sa iya pagsulod sa ER.
english: In fact, the swab showed that the child was infected with COVID-19 when he entered the ER.

text: Siling sang DILG MC 2020-063 nga ang tanan nga napatay sa COVID-19 (suspect, probable kag confirmed) dapat ma-cremate sa sulod sang 12 ka oras pagkatapos mapatay.
english: DILG MC 2020-063 states that all COVID-19 deaths (suspected, probable and confirmed) must be cremated within 12 hours of death.

text: Ugaling nagareklamo ang iloy kon ngaa ipa-cremate gid ang bangkay sang iya bata.
english: But the mother complained why her son's body would be cremated.

text: Gapati siya nga napatay lang ang iya bata tungod sa vehicular accident kag indi sa COVID-19 kag luyag nila ini ihamyang kag ipalubong sa tradisyonal nga paagi sa duta ukon sa nitso man.
english: She believes that her son died in a vehicular accident and not from COVID-19 and they want to bury him in the traditional way in the ground or in a grave.

text: Well, ina ang ginapatuman sang DILG MC 2020-063 bisan pa may exception man para sa Muslim kag iban seguro nga relihiyon nga wala gapati sa cremation.
english: Well, that's what DILG MC 2020-063 is implementing although there is an exception for Muslims and other religions that do not believe in cremation.

text: May suspetso ugaling ang iban nga ang pagpa-cremate sang bangkay sang may COVID-19 pwede ma-negosyohan sang mga sindikato nga bisan wala COVID-19 pagwaon nga may ara.
english: However, some suspect that the cremation of the body of a person with COVID-19 can be done by syndicates that even if there is no COVID-19, it will be revealed that there is.

text: Ambot lang, pero dapat evidence-based ini nga akusasyon.
english: I don’t know, but this accusation should be evidence-based.

text: Kon sa hambal lang, indi kita sina magpati.
english: In other words, we don't believe that.

text: Ang ikatatlo naton ng pamangkot: Ngaa exempted ang mga Muslim sa pagpa-cremate?
english: Our third question: Why are Muslims exempt from cremation?

text: Tungod lang sang ila relihiyon?
english: Just because of their religion?

text: Wala sa relihiyon ang pagpati ukon indi pag-ugyon sa cremation.
english: Religion does not believe in or disapprove of cremation.

text: Yara ina sa konsyensya sang tawo nga makahatag sa iya sing lubos nga kalinungan sang kaisipan kag balatyagon.
english: It is in the conscience of man that can give him complete peace of mind and feeling.

text: In fact, ang isa ka tawo pwede ka “take exception” sang pila ka ginatudlo sang iya relihiyon tungod sa sugo sang iya konsyensya nga para sa iya halin man sa Diyos.
english: In fact, a person may “take exception” to some of the teachings of his religion because of the command of his conscience that for him comes from God.

text: Labi na gid kon lain-lain ang bersyon.
english: Especially when there are different versions.

text: In other words, indi dapat did-an ang pagpalubong sang bangkay basta mapatuman lang sing nagkaigu ang health protocol.
english: In other words, the burial of the body should not be banned as long as the health protocol is properly implemented.

text: Sa Brazil ginapasugtan man gani ang pagpalubong sang mga bangkay nga may COVID-19 sa sulod sang selyado nga ataul sa public cemeteries.
english: In Brazil, it is even allowed to bury bodies with COVID-19 inside sealed containers in public cemeteries.

text: Diri, ginatagaan ang pamilya sang 10 minutos agud magpaalam kag magtambong kag maghaboy sing bulak sa ginapalubong./PN
english: Here, the family is given 10 minutes to say goodbye and attend and throw flowers at the funeral.

text: Nagtibusok sa South China ang duwa ka aircraft sang US Navy nga pareho naghalin sa aircraft carrier nga USS Nimitz.
english: Two US Navy aircraft, both from the aircraft carrier USS Nimitz, have crashed in South China.

text: Suno sa report, pareho nga naglugdang kahapon ang FA-18F Super Hornet kag MH-60R Sea Hawk helicopter.
english: According to reports, both the FA-18F Super Hornet and MH-60R Sea Hawk helicopter crashed yesterday.

text: Yari ang statement halin sa US INDOPACOM.
english: Here is the statement from US INDOPACOM.

text: “At approximately 2:45 p.m. local time, a U.S. Navy MH-60R Sea Hawk helicopter, assigned to the ‘Battle Cats’ of Helicopter Maritime Strike Squadron 73 went down in the waters of the South China Sea while conducting routine operations from the aircraft carrier, reads a statement from U.S. Pacific Fleet.
english: “At approximately 2:45 p.m. local time, a U.S. Navy MH-60R Sea Hawk helicopter, assigned to the ‘Battle Cats’ of Helicopter Maritime Strike Squadron 73 went down in the waters of the South China Sea while conducting routine operations from the state’s aircraft carrier, a refinery from U.S. Pacific. Fleet.

text:
“Search and rescue assets assigned to Carrier Strike Group 11 safely recovered all three crew members.”

Kasunod sang insidente, nagtibusok man sa separado nga area ang F/A-18F Super Hornet fighter nga assigned sa “Fighting Redcocks” sang Strike Fighter Squadron (VFA) 22.
english:
“Search and rescue assets assigned to Carrier Strike Group 11 safely recovered all three crew members.”

Following the incident, an F/A-18F Super Hornet fighter assigned to the “Fighting Redcocks” of Strike Fighter Squadron (VFA) 22 also crashed in a separate area.

text: Natabo ini samtang nagapatigayon sang routine operations halin sa Nimitz.
english: This happened while conducting routine operations from Nimitz.

text: Pareho naman nga nakaluwas ang crew members.
english: Both crew members survived.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente.
english: The investigation into the incident is ongoing.

text: Maaari nang bumalik sa kanilang operasyon ang mga komersyal na mangingisda sa conservation area ng Visayan Sea matapos i-lift ang ipinatupad na fishing ban.
english: Commercial fishermen in the conservation area of ​​the Visayan Sea will be able to resume their operations after the lifting of the fishing ban.

text: Batay sa anunsyo ng Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR), natapos kahapon, Pebrero 15, ang closed fishing season para sa haul-haol (sardinas), japayuki (mackerel), at tawilis (herring).
english: According to the announcement of the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR), the closed fishing season for haul-haol (sardines), japayuki (mackerel), and tawilis (herring) ended yesterday, February 15.

text: Sinimulan ang pagbabawal sa pangingisda ng naturang mga species noong Nobyembre 15, 2025.
english: The ban on fishing for native species will take effect on November 15, 2025.

text: Sa panayam ng Bombo Radyo kay BFAR Region 6 Director Remia Aparri, sinabi niya na layunin ng taunang closure na mapanatili at maparami ang populasyon ng mga nabanggit na isda sa Visayan Sea—isa sa pinakamalaki at pinakamahalagang fishing ground sa bansa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, BFAR Region 6 Director Remia Aparri said the annual closure aims to maintain and increase the population of these fish in the Visayan Sea—one of the largest and most important fishing grounds in the country.

text: Mahalaga rin ang hakbang na ito para sa pangmatagalang seguridad sa pagkain at katatagan ng ekonomiya ng mga nakapalibot na bayan, lalo’t tinatayang mahigit 100,000 mangingisda ang nakadepende rito para sa kanilang kabuhayan.
english: This step is also important for the long-term food security and economic stability of the surrounding towns, especially as it is estimated that more than 100,000 fishermen depend on it for their livelihood.

text: Ayon pa sa ahensya, ang pagtaas ng suplay ng sardinas at mackerel sa Northern Iloilo at Antique tuwing tag-init ay patunay na epektibo ang taunang pagpapatupad ng fishing ban.
english: According to the agency, the increase in the supply of sardines and mackerel in Northern Iloilo and Antique every summer is proof that the annual implementation of the fishing ban is effective.

text: Nagtulungan din ang mahigit 20 lokal na pamahalaan sa mga lalawigan ng Iloilo, Capiz, Negros Occidental, at Cebu, kasama ang marine authorities at mga lokal na komunidad ng mangingisda, sa pagpapatupad ng rest period o tinatawag ng mga lokal na “pahuway sang baybay.”
english: More than 20 local government units in the provinces of Iloilo, Capiz, Negros Occidental, and Cebu, along with marine authorities and local fishing communities, also helped implement the rest period.

text: Ginbuksan na liwat ang iconic nga Quezon Hall sang West Visayas State University (WVSU) sa La Paz, Iloilo City matapos nga gin-restore ini.
english: The iconic Quezon Hall of the West Visayas State University (WVSU) in La Paz, Iloilo City has been reopened after it was restored.

text: Ang maragtason nga building nga nahuman sang 1926 ang ginpaidalom sa isa ka komprehensibo nga renovation agud ma- address ang mga concerns sa struktura kag himuon nga mas mangin moderno ang pasilidad.
english: The historic building, completed in 1926, underwent a comprehensive renovation to address structural concerns and make the facility more modern.

text: Sa interviewsang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Joselito Villaruz, presidente sang unibersidad, iya ginpahayag nga ang Quezon Hall project ang nagapakita sa paghatag sang balor sa pagkonekta sa mga manami nga buildings kag structures sa mas ginpaayo nga learning kag working environment padulong sa mas malawig nga investments sa edukasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Joselito Villaruz, president of the university, said the Quezon Hall project shows the value of connecting beautiful buildings and structures to an improved learning and working environment towards longer-term investments in education.

text: Suno kay Villaruz, tuman ang iya kalipay nga paagi sini nga proyekto, napreserba sang unibersidad ang estado sini bilang cultural icon of education kag history.
english: Villaruz said he is very happy that through this project, the university has preserved its status as a cultural icon of education and history.

text: Ang restored Quezon Hall ang may yara subong sang 24 ka bag-o nga classrooms nga may mga bangko kag lamesa, faculty rooms, kag administrative offices.
english: The restored Quezon Hall now has 24 new classrooms with benches and desks, faculty rooms, and administrative offices.

text: Ang magadumala sini nga pasilidad amo ang College of Arts and Sciences.
english: This facility will be operated by the College of Arts and Sciences.

text: Mahumok kag mapino ina bangud sa kolesterol.
english: Those are soft and delicate because of the cholesterol.

text: Kun sa aton pagdumdom, kun maghambal gani kolesterol, malain na gilayon sa aton nga ikaayong lawas.
english: If we think about it, if we talk about cholesterol, it's bad for our health.

text: Apang sa pagkamatuod suno kay Dr. Eric Rimm, professor of epidemiology and nutrition , 70% sang enerhiya nga ginagamit sang aton lawas ang naghalin sa kolesterol.
english: But in reality, according to Dr. Eric Rimm, professor of epidemiology and nutrition , 70% of the energy our bodies use comes from cholesterol.

text: Naga-function ang aton central nervous system bangud man sa kolesterol.
english: Our central nervous system functions because of cholesterol.

text: 80 percent sang kolesterol sa aton lawas ang nagahalin sa aton atay.
english: 80 percent of the cholesterol in our body comes from our liver.

text: Apang kun masobrahan ang pagkaon sang makolesterol nga pagkaon ilabi na ang may saturated fat kaangay sang mga prito, ginpataas sini ang kadamuon sang dugo.
english: However, if you eat too much high-cholesterol foods, especially those with saturated fat such as fried foods, it raises your blood pressure.

text: Bangud sini pahayag niya, gina-atake sa tagipusuon ukon nagaka-stroke ang tawo.
english: Because of this, he said, people have heart attacks or strokes.

text: Agud mahibaluan kun nagtaas ang bad cholesterol, kinahanglan magpa-blood test nga ginatawag nga lipid profile.
english: To determine if you have elevated bad cholesterol, you need to have a blood test called a lipid profile.

text: Arestado na ang pila ka mga suspek sa pagpangawat sang mga malahalon nga alahas sang pamosong Louvre Museum sa Paris, France.
english: Several suspects have been arrested in connection with the theft of expensive jewelry from the famous Louvre Museum in Paris, France.

text: Suno sa mga otoridad, nadakpan ang isa sa mga suspek sa Charles de Gaulle airport sang ini nag-attempt nga magpalagyo pagguwa sa pungsod.
english: According to authorities, one of the suspects was arrested at Charles de Gaulle airport when he attempted to flee the country.

text: Base sa mga report, duha ka mga suspek ang yara na sa kustodiya sang mga pulis, apang indi pa ini makumpirma sang French authorities.
english: According to reports, two suspects are now in police custody, but this cannot be confirmed by French authorities.

text: Matandaan nga ginsulod sang mga kawatan ang Louvre Museum sa Paris sang Oktubre 19, sa diin nataban nila ang pila ka mga malahalon nga mga alahas antes makapalagyo gamit ang motorsiklo.
english: It can be recalled that thieves broke into the Louvre Museum in Paris on October 19, where they stole several valuable jewelry before fleeing on a motorcycle.

text: Sa pihak sang ginapangatubang nga reklamo nga grave threat sang iya anak nga si Vice President Sara Duterte batok kay President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., wala sang kahadlok nga ginpahayag ni anay President Rodrigo Duterte nga mas maayo nga ipapatay ang mga senador nga mabaskog sa survey.
english: Despite the complaint of grave threats by his daughter, Vice President Sara Duterte against President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr., former President Rodrigo Duterte fearlessly said that it is better to kill senators who are strong in the survey.

text: Ini agud makapungko suno sa natungdan ang mga PDP-Laban candidates sa Senado sa eleksyon subong nga tuig.
english: This is to ensure that the PDP-Laban candidates can sit in the Senate in this year's election.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang anay Presidente kadungan sang proclamation rally sang PDP-Laban senatorial slate sa Club Filipino, San Juan City kagab-i, Pebrero 13.
english: The former President said this during the proclamation rally of the PDP-Laban senatorial slate at Club Filipino, San Juan City last night, February 13.

text: Sang amo nga tion, yara man ang kaalyado sini nga si incumbent No.

text: WALA sing dapat i-panic ang aton pumuluyo angot sa COVID-19, bisan sa sige taas sang mga kaso sang COVID-19 diri sa pungsod.
english: There is nothing to panic about COVID-19, even with the increasing number of COVID-19 cases in the country.

text: Una, tungod indi man lang kita ang pinasahe sa sining hitabo.
english: First, because we are not the only ones in this situation.

text: Ang mga nasyon nga mas abanse sa kinaalam kag kagamitan sa pag-away sa mga balatian, katulad sang Estados Unidos, Brazil, India kag Russia nga may lapaw sa isa ka milyon nga mga kaso, daw sa wala lang gani sa ila ang COVID-19.
english: Countries that are more advanced in knowledge and equipment to fight diseases, such as the United States, Brazil, India and Russia with more than a million cases, seem to have no COVID-19.

text: Sige man ang pagpasaway sang ila pumuluyo nga daw wala sing kamatayon.
english: Their people keep scolding them as if there is no death.

text: Ang Filipinas, sunu sa Sept.
english: The Philippines, according to Sept.

text: 2, 2020 nga report sang John Hopkins Univerity Center sa Estados Unidos, yara sa ika-22 lang nga pwesto sa kaso sang Covid-19.
english: 2, 2020 report of the John Hopkins University Center in the United States, ranks only 22nd in terms of Covid-19 cases.

text: Gin-report ini nga may 226,440 ka kaso (212 sa kada 100,000 sang populasyon) kag 3,623 nga napatay, ukon 3.6%, sang aton sobra 100 ka milyon nga populasyon.
english: It was reported with 226,440 cases (212 per 100,000 of the population) and 3,623 deaths, or 3.6%, of our over 100 million population.

text: In fact, bisan sa amo ina nga istastika, sige gihapon ang pagpasaway sang aton man mga pumuluyo.
english: In fact, even with that statistic, our citizens are still being criticized.

text: Ginkasubo gani ni DILG Undersecretary Jonathan Malaya, samtang ginatudlo ang NEDA report, nga tubtub sa 50 ka porsyento lang ang compliance sa minimum health standards sang aton mga pumuluyo sa pagtuman sang paggamit sang face mask, physical distancing kag disinfection.
english: DILG Undersecretary Jonathan Malaya, while pointing to the NEDA report, regretted that up to 50 percent of the compliance with the minimum health standards of our residents in complying with the use of face masks, physical distancing and disinfection.

text: Ang rason, sunu sa contact tracing czar Baguio Mayor Benjamin Magalong, amo ang “human behavior” sang mga pumuluyo nga nabudlayan pa gihapon sa pag-adjust sa “new normal”.
english: The reason, according to contact tracing czar Baguio Mayor Benjamin Magalong, is the “human behavior” of the residents who are still struggling to adjust to the “new normal”.

text: Ikaduha nga rason kon ngaa indi man kita lubos magkabalaka amo nga, bisan madasig ang paglapta sang COVID-19, mga 80 ka porsyento sang naigu sini mga “mild” nga pagbalatian lang nga madale mapaayo.
english: The second reason why we should not be too worried is that, although COVID-19 spreads rapidly, about 80 percent of those affected are “mild” illnesses that can be easily cured.

text: Ikatatlo, nga nagapasalamt gid kita, kay ang mga palangga naton nga mga kabataan daw indi madutlan sang COVID-19 kay tuman kanubo sang ila kaso.
english: Third, we are very grateful, because our beloved children seem to be immune to COVID-19 because their cases are very low.

text: Isa ka rason nga ginatudlo sang mga siyentipiko amo ang ila mabakud nga immune system kag temprano nga pagpabakuna sa MMR (mumps, measles, rubella) nga, sunu sa sining mga siyentipiko, “nakatuon” na sang ulihi sa pag-away bisan sa iban nga mikrobyo lakip ang COVID-19 virus katulad sang innate (natural) immune system nga wala pili kon ano ang awayon.
english: One reason scientists point to is their strong immune system and early vaccination against MMR (mumps, measles, rubella) which, according to these scientists, later “learned” to fight even other microbes including the COVID-19 virus like the innate (natural) immune system that does not choose what to fight.

text: Ikaapat, wala man kita nagkulang sa paghatag sing prioridad sa pag-amlig sa aton mga katigulangan kag may delikado nga mga balatian katulad sang diabetes, high blood, heart failure, asthma kag iban pa, rason nga diri sa Filipinas wala gid man sing madamo ang napatay sa ila.
english: Fourth, we have not failed to give priority to the protection of our elderly and dangerous diseases such as diabetes, high blood, heart failure, asthma and others, which is why here in the Philippines not many of them died.

text: Tungod kay ginadumilian naton ang pagusto nga pagwa nila sa puluy-an.
english: Because we forbid them to leave the house at will.

text: Taliwas sa nagakatabo diri sa aton, sa Uropa, ginbalita nga ang nagkalamatay sa COVID-19 nga mga tigulang, nga laban yara sa nursing homes, naglab-ut gid sa 88 ka porsyento sang nagmalasakit!
english: In contrast to what is happening here in Europe, it is reported that the death toll from COVID-19 among the elderly, most of whom are in nursing homes, has reached 88 percent of the sick!

text: Ikalima, nagapanikasug man kita nga mapatuman sing husto ang mga health protocols upod sa mga masaligan man nga mga health measures kag kagamitan naton.
english: Fifth, we are also striving to properly implement health protocols along with our reliable health measures and equipment.

text: Ugaling lang kay may “confusion” sa pagpatuman sang mga health protocols sa tunga sang national government kag mga local government units (LGUs) nga mabasol sa indi pag-intiendihanay sang mga lideres sang nagkalain-lain nga mga ahensya sang gobyerno sa ibabaw, nga luyag sang madamo islan na, katulad ni Health Secretary Francisco Duque III.
english: However, there is confusion in the implementation of health protocols between the national government and local government units (LGUs) which can be blamed on the misunderstanding of the leaders of the various government agencies above, which many want to be replaced, such as Health Secretary Francisco Duque III.

text:
***

Sa indi gihapon mapunggan sa pagpakulba, una naton nga panugyan amo ang pirme pag-upod sa mabuligon naton nga Ginuo kag itugyan sa Iya ang maayo naton nga maabtan.
english:
***

Still unable to control our excitement, our first advice is to always be with our helpful Lord and leave to Him what is good for us.

text: Indi man malipat nga “Sa Diyos ang awa, sa tao ang gawa”.
english: Don't forget that “God has mercy, man has mercy”.

text: Gani, sundon ang mga panugyan nga health protocols sang aton mga health authorities agud indi kita matapikan sang COVID-19.
english: Therefore, follow the recommended health protocols of our health authorities so that we do not get infected with COVID-19.

text: Sa lugar nga hadlukan sa mga balita parti sa mga nagakalamatay sa COVID-19, pamatian man ang rason sang balita kon ngaa sila natapikan agud malikawan naton ini.
english: Instead of being afraid of the news about those who are dying of COVID-19, listen to the reason for the news why they were infected so that we can avoid it.

text: Indi magpakuribong sing isahanon.
english: Don't worry alone.

text: Lingawon ang kaugalingon sa mga mapuslanon nga hilikuton sa balay, katulad sang gardening, household chore kag pagtan-aw ukon pagpamati sa radyo sang makalilingaw nga talan-awon kag programa.
english: Entertain yourself with useful activities at home, such as gardening, household chore and watching or listening to the radio of entertaining shows and programs.

text: Makigsadya sa mga kaupod sa balay.
english: Have fun with roommates.

text: Magbasa sing libro, magpinta kon may huyog sini, mamati sing mabungahon nga mga ambahanon, magtokar sang guitara ukon piano, ukon mag-meditate agud mapakalma ang panghuna-huna.
english: Read a book, paint if inclined, listen to upbeat songs, play the guitar or piano, or meditate to calm the mind.

text: Apang kon may ginabatyag ka sang “severe anxiety” makigkita sa isa ka psychologist ukon psychiatrist agud matudluan ka kon paano pakalmahon ang imo kaugalingon.
english: But if you are experiencing “severe anxiety” see a psychologist or psychiatrist to teach you how to calm yourself.

text: Okey?/PN
english: Okay?/PN

text: Ang pag-angkon sang stress kag depression ang isa sa pinakamayor nga rason sang erectile dysfunction sa mga kalalakihan.
english: Stress and depression are one of the biggest causes of erectile dysfunction in men.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Elvin Tiangha, iya ginpahayag nga ang erectile dysfunction amo ang male impotence kag isa ka medikal nga kondisyon sa diin ang isa ka lalaki ang nabudlayan magpatindog sang iya kinatawo samtang nagapakighilawas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Elvin Tiangha, he said that erectile dysfunction is male impotence and a medical condition where a man has difficulty erect his penis while having sex.

text: Suno kay Tiangha, common ini sa mga lalaki nga naga-edad 75 anyos pasaka apang mahimo man ini maeksperyensya sang mga lamharon nga lalaki.
english: Tiangha said it is common in men aged 75 years and older but can also be experienced by younger men.

text: Ginpahayag sang doktor nga dako ang epekto sini sa psychological health kag sexual life sang isa ka lalaki.
english: The doctor said it has a big impact on a man's psychological health and sexual life.

text: Yari ang pila ka sintomas sang erectile dysfunction: stress, altapresyon, depresyon, sakit sa dughan, diabetes, obesity, pagkakapoy kag panghina.
english: Here are some symptoms of erectile dysfunction: stress, high blood pressure, depression, chest pain, diabetes, obesity, fatigue and weakness.

text: Ginpahayag ni Tiangha nga ang urine kag blood test ang mga pamaagi agud mahibaluan kun may erectile dysfunction ang isa ka lalaki.
english: Tiangha said urine and blood tests are the ways to determine if a man has erectile dysfunction.

text: Magluwas diri, importante man suno sa iya ang magpacheck up sa doktor.
english: Besides, he said, it is also important to check up with a doctor.

text: Agud malikawan ang nasambit nga balatian, nagpanugyan man ang doktor sa mga lalaki nga magkaon sang healthy kag maglikaw sa malain nga mga bisyo.
english: To prevent the disease, the doctor also advised men to eat healthy and avoid bad habits.

text: Makabulig man suno sa natungdan ang pag-exercise, kag pagdiet ilabi na kun may yara sang suporta halin sa asawa.
english: He said exercise and diet can also help especially if there is support from his wife.

text: Naglab-ot sa 46 ka mga indibidwal ang napatay matapos nagbunguanay ang pila ka mga salakyan sa Uganda.
english: At least 46 people were killed after several vehicles collided in Uganda.

text: Base sa initial investigation, duha ka bus ang nagdungan nga nag-overtake sa Kampala-gulu Highway tubtob nga nakasumalang nila ang truck kag kotse.
english: Based on initial investigation, two buses overtook on the Kampala-gulu Highway at the same time until they collided with a truck and a car.

text: Ginhimakasan pa sang mga bus nga likawan ang ila nasumalang, apang nalab-ot gihapon ang mga ini sa diin isa sa mga bus ang nagbalintuwad.
english: The buses tried to avoid the collision, but they were still caught where one of the buses overturned.

text: Gindala naman sa hospital ang pila ka mga pasahero nga nakaangkon sang samad sa ila mga lawas.
english: Several passengers were taken to hospital with injuries.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang simpatiya si Uganda President Yoweri Museveni kun sa diin ginahatagan sini ang mga himata sang biktima sang tig-$1,430 bilang bulig.
english: Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni expressed his condolences and gave $1,430 each to the victim's relatives.

text: Ginmandi man sang president ang hugot nga imbestigasyon sa nasambit nga insidente.
english: The president also ordered a thorough investigation into the incident.

text: Gin-klaro sang isa ka eksperto nga ang ”aro” ukon leprosy isa ka sakit nga puwede mag-ayo kag indi dapat pagkahadlukan.
english: One expert clarified that leprosy is a curable disease and should not be feared.

text: Ini kaangay man sang impeksyon nga naghalin sang bacteria ukon mikrobyo nga naga-epekto sa immune system sang isa ka tawo.
english: This is similar to an infection caused by bacteria or germs that impacts a person's immune system.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Aileen Adela Montero, iya ginpahayag nga indi dapat pagkabalak-an sang publiko ang ”aro” ukon leprosy bangud ang bulong para diri libre halin sa World Health Organization kag ginahatag bisan pa maglab-ot sang duha ka tuig nga pag-inom sini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Aileen Adela Montero, she said the public should not worry about leprosy because the medicine for it is free from the World Health Organization and is given even after two years of taking it.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Dr. Montero nga ndi ini isa ka salot kag indi pareho sang mga sakit nga madali makalaton sa iban.
english: He also said that Dr. Montero said it is not a plague and is not like diseases that can easily spread to others.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga nagadepende ang pag-develop sini sa kahimtangan sang immune system sang isa ka tawo.
english: He also explained that its development depends on the state of a person's immune system.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga kun ang pasyente naga-inom na sang bulong, indi na ini makalalaton.
english: He said that once the patient is taking the medicine, it is no longer contagious.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Dr. Montero ang mga early signs nga mahimo makita bilang patchy ang panit sang tawo nga daw kaangay sang alap-ap.
english: He also said that Dr. Montero explained the early signs that can be seen as patchy skin that looks like alap-ap.

text: Gin-athag man nila nga health authorities nga tanan nga komplikasyon kaangay sang ”aro” mahimo malikawan kun timprano pa ini mahibaluan kag matatapan sang pagbulong.
english: They also explained to the health authorities that all complications such as leprosy can be avoided if it is detected early and treated.

text: Suno pa kay Dr. Montero, katuyuan sang selebrasyon sang Leprosy Month amo ang pag-edukar sa publiko, mapalapnag sang husto nga impormasyon nahanungod diri kag importante nga mapa-intindi sa iban nga tawo nga mabulong ini kag indi dapat pagsikwayon ang iban nga naga-experiensya sang ”aro” ukon leprosy.
english: According to Dr. Montero, the purpose of the celebration of Leprosy Month is to educate the public, disseminate accurate information about it and it is important to make other people understand that it can be cured and that others who experience leprosy should not be ignored.

text: Labi pa gid nga na-excite ang mga pageant fans para sa Miss Universe Philippines 2025 nga ginabansagan subong nga “Puksaan” edition.
english: Pageant fans are even more excited for the Miss Universe Philippines 2025 which is now being dubbed the “Puksaan” edition.

text: Ini matapos nga nakit-an ang pageant veteran nga sio Athisa Manalo sa ginpatigayon nga Miss Universe Philippines contract signing sa Makati, kahapon.
english: This is after pageant veteran sio Athisa Manalo was spotted at the Miss Universe Philippines contract signing in Makati, yesterday.

text: Si Manalo, nga amo ang reigning The Miss Philippines-Cosmo 2024, ang kaupod sang iban nga 2025 MUPH delegates sa venue.
english: Manalo, who is the reigning The Miss Philippines-Cosmo 2024, was among the other 2025 MUPH delegates at the venue.

text: Mismo ang isa ka insider halin sa Miss Universe Philippines Organization (MUPH) ang nag-confirm nga ang entrepreneur halin sa Quezon Province ang present sa contract signing event, kag liwat nga magaintra sa national pageant.
english: An insider from the Miss Universe Philippines Organization (MUPH) confirmed that the entrepreneur from Quezon Province will be present at the contract signing event, and will again participate in the national pageant.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, nag-intra si Manalo sa MUPH 2024 kag nagtapos ini nga third sa finals kun sa diin nakuha ni Chelsea Manalo ang titulo.
english: Last year, Manalo participated in MUPH 2024 and finished third in the finals where Chelsea Manalo won the title.

text: Sunod nga ginhatagan si Ahtisa sang iya national title bilang The Miss Philippines-Cosmo 2024 kag gintiglawas ang Pilipinas sa first edition sang Vietnam-based Miss Cosmo pageant.
english: Ahtisa was subsequently awarded her national title as The Miss Philippines-Cosmo 2024 and represented the Philippines in the first edition of the Vietnam-based Miss Cosmo pageant.

text: kun sa diin nalakip ini sa Top 10.
english: where it was included in the Top 10.

text: Madumduman nga nag-compete man si Manalo kaupod kay 2018 Miss Universe Catriona Gray sa Binibining Pilipinas pageant kun sa diin nakuha niya ang Bb.
english: Manalo also competed with 2018 Miss Universe Catriona Gray in the Binibining Pilipinas pageant where she won Bb.

text: Pilipinas international title kag nangin 1st runner-up naman sa Miss International 2018.
english: Philippines international title and became 1st runner-up in Miss International 2018.

text: Sa subong, indi pa maathag kun ano matabo sa iya The Miss Philippines-Cosmo title bangud sa liwat niya nga pag-intra sa Miss Universe Philippines pageant.
english: At present, it is not clear what will happen to her The Miss Philippines-Cosmo title due to her re-participation in the Miss Universe Philippines pageant.

text: UNLESS maglisu naman ang panghun-huna sang powers-that-be – nga kon kis-a gulpyada lang kag makakilibut – yara na ang siyudad sang Iloilo sugod sining Setyembre 2020 sa idalom sang Modified General Community Quarantine (MGCQ) nga mas maluag-luag sangsa GCQ nga yara kita sadtong nagligad nga bulan.
english: UNLESS the powers-that-be change their minds – which is sometimes sudden and surprising – Iloilo City will be under Modified General Community Quarantine (MGCQ) as of September 2020, which is more relaxed than the GCQ we were in last month.

text: Sa kabug-usan, sunu sa IATF Omnibus Guidelines on the Implementation of Community Quarantine in the Philippines nga ginpatuman sini sadtong Mayo 22, 2020, ang tanan nga pumuluyo sa siyudad sang Iloilo pwede na makagwa sa ila mga puluy-an.
english: Overall, according to the IATF Omnibus Guidelines on the Implementation of Community Quarantine in the Philippines that it implemented on May 22, 2020, all residents in Iloilo City can now leave their homes.

text: Ugaling lang, dapat gihapon sundon ang minimum health standards, katulad sang paggamit sang face mask (lakip na sa karon ang face shield), ang physical distancing kag ang pila ka limitasyon sa mga aktibidades nga pwede ipatuman sang siyudad paagi sa igapagwa ni Mayor Jerry Treñas nga Executive Order.
english: However, minimum health standards, such as the use of face masks (including face shields), physical distancing and some limitations on activities that may be implemented by the city through Mayor Jerry Treñas' Executive Order, must still be followed.

text: Tani mangin responsable kita nga mga pumuluyo sa pagtuman sang sining bagay nga health protocols.
english: May we be responsible citizens in following these health protocols.

text:
***

Samtang gainit ang tension sa tunga sang United States kag China, madamo ang nagakahadlok kon mag-allout war na gid sila.
english:
***

As tensions between the United States and China heat up, many fear an allout war.

text: Ina tungod pareho ini sila nga mga nuclear power, nga may mga armas nuclear nga, sa nahibal-an naton makapatay sang madamo sa isa lang ka lupok.
english: That’s because they are both nuclear powers, with nuclear weapons that, as far as we know can kill many with a single shot.

text: Matandaan naton ang paghulog sang atomic (nuclear) bomb sadtong Agosto 6 kag 9, 1945 sa Hiroshima kag Nagasaki, Japan.
english: We remember the dropping of atomic (nuclear) bombs on August 6 and 9, 1945 on Hiroshima and Nagasaki, Japan.

text: Sa pagkaligad sang apat ka bulan sang matabo ato, ang isip sang napatay sa Hiroshima naglab-ut sa 90,000 tubtub 146,000 ka tawo kag mga 39,000 tubtub 80,000 sa Nagasaki.
english: Four months after that, the death toll in Hiroshima reached 90,000 to 146,000 people and about 39,000 to 80,000 in Nagasaki.

text: Napatay ini sila sa direkta nga pagtupa sang atomic bomb kag sa padayon nga pagluntad sang makamamatay nga atomic radiation.
english: They were killed by the direct dropping of the atomic bomb and the continued existence of deadly atomic radiation.

text: Ang iban nga nabuhi nangin inutil tubtub buhi.
english: Some who survived became disabled for life.

text: Indi man mapuslan ang lugar nga naigu sang bomba.
english: The area hit by the bomb is also useless.

text: Kag ini tungod sang una pa lang nahimo nga atomic bomb nga ginhulog sang US sa kaaway sini sadto nga pungsod sang Japan!
english: And this is because of the first atomic bomb that the US dropped on its enemy Japan!

text: Sa karon, sa padayon nga pag-testing sang US, sunod sang Rusya pati na sang China, may mas mabaskug na nga mga nuclear bomb nga nahimo.
english: Now, with the continuous testing of the US, followed by Russia and China, more powerful nuclear bombs have been developed.

text: Lakip diri ang hydrogen bomb kag ang neutron bomb, nga ginsiling nga ma-testingan lang sa “space” sa gwa sang kalibutan tungod sang tuman pagkamahaliton sini.
english: These include the hydrogen bomb and the neutron bomb, which are said to be tested only in outer space because of their extreme destructiveness.

text: Tungod sini, sin-o man abe ang indi mahadlukan kon matabo ang all-out nuclear war sa tunga sa sining dalagku nga mga pungsod?
english: Therefore, who would not be afraid of an all-out nuclear war between these great nations?

text: Aba, amo na ina seguro ang katapusan sang kadam-an sa aton nga indi makapanagu sa mga nuclear shelters sang sining dalagku nga mga pungsod.
english: Well, that's probably the end of most of us who can't hide in the nuclear shelters of these great countries.

text: In fact, basi ang gwa sang katauhan mangin katulad sang mga dinosaur nga napatay sang gin-ulanan sila sang madamo nga mga meteor halin sa kahawaan.
english: In fact, maybe the outside of humanity will be like the dinosaurs that died when they were hit by many meteors from space.

text: Ukon tungod sa isa ka pandemic nga nag-igu sa ila.
english: Or because of a pandemic that hit them.

text:
***

Well, nagapati kita nga indi pa matabo ang The Great Tribulation ukon ang Last Judgment, nga gina-predict sang iban, kon san-o maguba na ang kalibutan kag ang magabangon nga mga patay tagaan na sang Diyos sang Iya final nga paghusga kag ibulag na ang mga Maayo kag ang mga Malain tubtub sa katubtuban.
english:
***

Well, we believe that before The Great Tribulation or the Last Judgment, which some predict, when the world is destroyed and the dead rise, God will give His final judgment and separate the Good and the Evil forever.

text: So, ang matabo seguro nga ang magaluntad anay ang pagbalik sang cold war – “a state of political hostility and military tension between two countries or power blocs, involving propaganda, subversion, threats, economic sanctions, and other measures short of open warfare” – katulad sang natabo sa tunga sang United States kag Russia pagkatapos sang 2nd World War.
english: So, what will probably happen is that there will be a return to the cold war – “a state of political hostility and military tension between two countries or power blocs, involving propaganda, subversion, threats, economic sanctions, and other measures short of open warfare” – as happened between the United States and Russia after the 2nd World War.

text: Meantime, sige gihapon ang pagtuon kag pagpabakud sang mga defense system sang mga indi mag-intiendihanay nga mga pungsod.
english: Meantime, the defense systems of the countries that do not understand each other are still being studied and strengthened.

text: Aton-aton lang  ini, pero may naisipan kita nga solusyon agud indi matabo ang 3rd World war nga gamit ang mga armas nuclear katulad sang mga ballistic missile nga may nuclear warhead kag nuclear bombs halin sa kon diin nga launch pad – ground, underwater ukon sa kahanginan.
english: It's up to us, but we have come up with a solution to prevent the 3rd World war using nuclear weapons such as ballistic missiles with nuclear warheads and nuclear bombs from any launch pad - ground, underwater or in the air.

text: Ini amo ang pagka-diskubre sang defense system nga maka-pabalik sining nuclear weapons sa ila launch pad kag ang halitan amo mismo ang nagpalupad sini.
english: It is the discovery of the defense system that can return these nuclear weapons to their launch pad and the damage itself has sent them flying.

text: Kon matigayon ini, tan-awon ta abe kon may luyag pa maggamit sang nuclear weapons batok sa kaaway.
english: If this is achieved, let's see if anyone still wants to use nuclear weapons against the enemy.

text: Segurado mapilitan lang sila sa pagpatigayon sing conventional warfare kon mag-initay.
english: They will surely be forced to conduct conventional warfare if they fight.

text: Gyera Patani lang bala kita!
english: War Are we just Patani!

text: Wala lang gamitay nuclear nga armas, a. Kon pwede lang gani magkusianay lang kita.
english: Just don't use nuclear weapons, a. If only we could just hug each other.

text: Indi bala Beautiful?
english: Isn’t Beautiful?

text: Indi kay manupungol ka gid imo ya.
english: Not because you're a stupid person.

text: Okey?/PN
english: Okay?/PN

text: Nahibalo ka bala nga mas madasig makapoy kag makabatyag sang stress ang mga tawo nga masami gina-istorbo sa trabaho?
english: Did you know that people who are often interrupted at work get tired and stressed more quickly?

text: Sa pagtuon sang Swiss health foundation, ila natukiban nga mas nagapaguwa sang stress hormones ang mga tawo nga masami gina-istorbo.
english: In a study by the Swiss health foundation, they found that people who are often disturbed release more stress hormones.

text: Kun maglala ang nagakabatyagan nga physical stress sang isa ka tawo, posible ini nga magresulta sang tuman nga kakapopy nga magahatag naman sang negatibo nga epekto sa ikaayong lawas.
english: If a person's physical stress gets worse, it can result in excessive fatigue which will have a negative impact on health.

text: Ginpangunahan sang psychologist nga si Dr. Jasmine Kerr, kaupod ang mathematician nga si Mara Nagelin kag computer scientist nga si Dr. Raphael Weibel ang nasambit nga eksperimento nga may katuyuan nga madiskubrehan ang isa ka early warning device nga makatumod sa mga kabangdanan kag makapauntat sa stress nga mahimo mabatyagan sang tawo ilabi na kun sila ang gina-istorbo.
english: Led by psychologist Dr. Jasmine Kerr, along with mathematician Mara Nagelin and computer scientist Dr. Raphael Weibel said the experiment aims to discover an early warning device that can identify the causes and stop the stress that people can feel especially when they are disturbed.

text: Ginhikayan ni Senator Robin Padilla ang mga kabataan sa subong nga henerasyon kag gintawag niya nga weak ukon mahina nga mga indibidwal ang mga ini.
english: Senator Robin Padilla criticized the children of the current generation and called them weak individuals.

text: Ini nga pahayag naggwa sa hearing sang Senate Committee on Public Information and Mass Media kahapon nga adlaw nahanungod sa Children’s Safety in Social Media Act.
english: This statement came out during a hearing of the Senate Committee on Public Information and Mass Media yesterday on the Children’s Safety in Social Media Act.

text: Suno sa senador, ang mga kabataan sa karon indi kaangay sang ila tyempo sang una nga indi palahibi kag indi pa sa ila uso ang ginatawag nga depression.
english: According to the senator, children today are not like their time in the past when they did not cry and the so-called depression was not in fashion.

text: Ginpahayag man sang senador nga may pila ka mga mamalidha nga gusto i-regulate ang pagdumili sang social media sa mga kabataan lakip na diri ang pagbutang sang age limit nga 16.
english: The senator also said that there are some lawmakers who want to regulate the ban on social media for children including setting an age limit of 16.

text: Suno naman sa Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center nga kinahanglan nga ibalansehon ang interes sa mga ini.
english: According to the Cybercrime Investigation and Coordinating Center, it is necessary to balance the interests of these.

text: Dugang pa sini nga maayo para sa Pilipinas nga mahibaluan halin sa iban nga pungsod ang pagpatuman sang ila tagsa-tagsa ka resolusyon sa sini nga regulasyon sa pagdumili sang paggamit sag social media.
english: He added that it is good for the Philippines to know from other countries the implementation of their respective resolutions in this regulation to prohibit the use of social media.

text: Indi makahibalo ang mga tawo sa isa ka bangko sa Brazil kun makulbaan, madalagan, ukon malipong na insigida bangud sa isa ka eksena kun sa diin gindala sang isa ka babaye ang isa ka bangkay agud nga magpirma para sa iya loan.
english: People in a bank in Brazil don't know whether to panic, run, or faint immediately because of a scene where a woman carries a body to sign for her loan.

text: Gin-identify ang bank customer nga si Erika de Souza Vieira Nunes.
english: The bank customer was identified as Erika de Souza Vieira Nunes.

text: Nagalab-ot sa $3,400 ukon masobra P194,000 ang iya kuntani nga utangon sa bangko.
english: He was supposed to borrow $3,400 or more than P194,000 from the bank.

text: Sa nakit-an sa video, gina-buligan ni Nunes ang lalaki nga nagapungko sa wheelchair apang talalupangdon nga nagalungi na ang ulo sang tawo kag wala gid naga-steady apisar pila ka beses ini nga ginakaptan sang babaye.
english: In the video, Nunes helps the man in the wheelchair but it is noticeable that the man's head is shaking and he is not steady despite the woman holding him several times.

text: Apisar sini, nagasige sa pag-istorya ang babaye kag ginatawag pa ang tawo nga “uncle”.
english: Despite this, the woman continued to talk and even called the man “uncle”.

text: Iya ini ginapilit nga magpirma sa financial documents, kag ginapilit man sini nga ibutang ang ballpen sa tudlo sang tawo kag ginasilingan ini nga hugton ang pagkapot.
english: He forces her to sign financial documents, and he also forces her to put a ballpen on the man's finger and tells him to hold it tight.

text: Sang ginmuno sang bank worker nga nagapalamuti na ang tawo kag posible nga indi maayo ang pamatyag sini, nagrason si Nunes nga amo gid ina ang kinaandan sang tawo kag wala ini nagahambal.
english: When the bank worker mentioned that the man was sweating and possibly not feeling well, Nunes reasoned that that was normal for the man and that he was not talking.

text: Bangud sa kakulba, nagtawag ang staff sang pulis.
english: Panicked, the police staff called.

text: Gilayon nga gin-aresto ang babaye.
english: The woman was immediately arrested.

text: Natumod man ang tawo nga amo si Paulo Roberto Braga, 68-anyos, nga pila ka oras na nga napatay antes ini gindala sa sulod sang bangko.
english: The man was also identified as Paulo Roberto Braga, 68, who had been dead for several hours before being taken inside the bank.

text: Magapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon suno sa pulis kun sa diin igalakip ang rason sang kamatayon sini, kun matuod nga hinablos sini ang babaye, kag kun involved ang iban pa nga himata sa amo nga aktwasyon nga nagtuyo nga magkomiter sang fraud sa bangko.
english: Police said the investigation will continue to include the cause of death, whether the woman was his niece, and whether other relatives were involved in the act of attempting to commit bank fraud.

text: Sa bahin ni Nunes, mahimo ini pasakaan sang kaso nga fraud, embezzlement, kag pag-abuso sa bangkay sang isa ka tawo.#
english: Nunes, for her part, could face charges of fraud, embezzlement, and abuse of a human corpse.#

text: Napilian ang isa ka babaye nga prime minister sa labing-una nga tion sa maragtas sang Japan.
english: A female prime minister was elected for the first time in Japanese history.

text: Ini amo si Sanae Takaichi, 64-anyos, presidente sang Liberal Democratic Party nga amo ang magabulos sa anay Prime Minister nga si Shigeru Ishiba.
english: This is Sanae Takaichi, 64-year-old, president of the Liberal Democratic Party who will succeed former Prime Minister Shigeru Ishiba.

text: Nakakuha si Takaichi sang 237 votes nga lapaw sa majority nga 233 sa first round.
english: Takaichi received 237 votes, more than the majority of 233 in the first round.

text: Siya na ang ika-apat nga prime minister sang Japan sa sulod lamang sang lima ka tuig matapos nga nagsarurot tanan ang ratings kag nalamhitan sang eskandalo ang termino sang iya predecessors.
english: He becomes Japan's fourth prime minister in just five years after ratings plummeted and his predecessors' terms were marred by scandal.

text: Natabo ang eleksyon matapos nagsugtanay ang iya partido kag ang Nippon Ishin no Kai (Japan Innovation Party) nga magtukod sang coalition government kasunod sang paghalin sang Komeito sa ruling bloc.
english: The election took place after his party and the Nippon Ishin no Kai (Japan Innovation Party) agreed to form a coalition government following Komeito’s departure from the ruling bloc.

text: Matandaan nga sang Septyembre, nagpanaog sa pwesto ang anay prime minister bangud sang major setbacks sang partido sa eleksyon sa House of Representatives sang 2024 kag sa House of Councillors election sang nagligad nga Hulyo.
english: It can be recalled that in September, the former prime minister stepped down due to major setbacks of the party in the House of Representatives elections in 2024 and the House of Councilors elections last July.

text: Anom ka tuig humalin sang natapos ang iya reign bilang Miss Universe, ginagamit sa gihapon ni Catriona Gray ang iya nga platform agud suportahan ang mga advocacies nga malapit sa iya tagipusuon.
english: Six years after her reign as Miss Universe ended, Catriona Gray is still using her platform to support advocacies close to her heart.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, gin-anunsyo sang former beauty queen nga madinalag-on ini nga nakatipon sang pondo para sa cleft charity nga Smile Train.
english: The other day, the former beauty queen announced that she had successfully raised funds for cleft charity Smile Train.

text: Ginpasalamatan niya ang iya mga abyan kag fans sa pagbulig agud makatipon siya sang P250,000, nga gamiton niya para sa cleft care sa mga Filipino nga kabataan.
english: He thanked his friends and fans for helping him raise P250,000, which he will use for cleft care for Filipino children.

text: Gin-engganyo man niya ang iya social media followers nga magbulig man sa ano man nga pamaagi.
english: He also encouraged his social media followers to help in any way.

text: Kilala ang Miss Universe 2018 titleholder bangud sa iya efforts para sa madamo nga charities.
english: The Miss Universe 2018 titleholder is known for her efforts for many charities.

text: Sang nagligad nga tuig, ginhiwat niya ang iya pinakauna nga Legacy Ball agud magtipon sang pondo para sa Young Focus, isa ka non-government organization nga para sa mga underprivileged nga mga pamatan-on.
english: Last year, he held his first-ever Legacy Ball to raise funds for Young Focus, a non-government organization that caters to underprivileged youth.

text: Tanan kita ang yara sang paborito nga musika ukon huni nga kun aton mabatian, maka-relax gid ang aton paminsaron.
english: We all have a favorite music or sound that when we hear, it can relax our minds.

text: Apang paano kun ang mga huni nga ini nga para sa iban normal lang ang makahatag naman sa imo sang lain nga reaksyon, kaangay sang pagkaakig?
english: But what if these sounds that seem normal to others can give you a different reaction, such as anger?

text: pagkairita?
english: irritation?

text: kag pagpanic?
english: and panic?

text: Posible nga nagabatyag ka na sang misophonia suno kay Dr. Marsha Johnson, isa ka audiologist sang Oregon Audiology Clinic.
english: You may already be experiencing misophonia according to Dr. Marsha Johnson, an Oregon Audiology Clinic audiologist.

text: Ang mga tawo nga may kondisyon nga misophonia ang emosyonal nga nagakaapektuhan sang mga ordinaryo nga huni.
english: People with the condition misophonia are emotionally affected by ordinary sounds.

text: Kadam-an sa mga huni nga ini ang ginabalewala lang sang iban apang sa mga tawo nga may nasambit nga kondisyon, bastante na ang ini nga mga huni para maglain ang ila reaksyon.
english: Most of these sounds are just ignored by others but for people with the condition, these sounds are enough to cause a bad reaction.

text: Nagapakita sang mataas nga senyales sang physiological stress ang mga tawo nga misophonic kaangay sang pagpalamahalhas kag pagbag-o sa heart rate.
english: Misophonic people show high signs of physiological stress such as sweating and changes in heart rate.

text: Mahimo mangin mild ukon severe ang ma-eskperyensyahan nga reaksyon sang mga may sini nga sahi sang kondisyon.
english: The reactions experienced by those with this type of condition can be mild or severe.

text: Posible man pahayag sang eksperto nga maapektuhan ang social life sang tawo nga may ini nga kondisyon apang ang good news, may yara ini sang medical treatment nga makabulig sa imo.
english: Experts say it is possible that the social life of a person with this condition will be affected but the good news is that there is a medical treatment that can help you.

text: Ginpaguwa na ang panibag-o nga warrant of arrest batok sa negosyante nga si Charlie ”Atong Ang”‘ kag lima pa.
english: A new warrant of arrest has been issued against businessman Charlie ”Atong Ang”‘ and five others.

text: Ini gin-paguwa sang San Pablo Regional Trial Court sa Laguna halin sa RTC Branch 29 ni Judge Luvina Roque sa kaso nga kidnapping with serious illegal detention kaangot sa pagkadula sang mga sabungeros.
english: This was issued by the San Pablo Regional Trial Court in Laguna from RTC Branch 29 of Judge Luvina Roque in the case of kidnapping with serious illegal detention in connection with the disappearance of the sabungeros.

text: Lakip man sa listahan nga ginhatagan sang warrant sanday Ryan Jay Orapa, Alfredo Uy Andes, Philip Almedilla, Joey Encarnacion kag Aaron Ezrah Cabillan.
english: Also on the list were Ryan Jay Orapa, Alfredo Uy Andes, Philip Almedilla, Joey Encarnacion and Aaron Ezrah Cabillan.

text: Ang nasambit nga kaso ang wala sang piyansa.
english: The said case is without bail.

text: Sa matandaan nga padayon nga ginapangita sang mga otoridad si Ang kag may ara sang nakapatong nga P10 million para sa pagpangita sa iya.
english: It can be recalled that the authorities are still searching for Ang and there is a P10 million reward for his search.

text: NAGAPATI kita nga malutos naton ang COVID-19 pandemic, ukon ang SARS-CoV-2, bisan wala pa ma-producir ang bagay nga vaccine.
english: WE BELIEVE that we can defeat the COVID-19 pandemic, or SARS-CoV-2, even before the right vaccine is produced.

text: Kag indi lang basta pagpati naton ini.
english: And it's not just a matter of belief.

text: Ang experyensya naton sa kalibutan sa pagpakigbatu sa mga bacterial kag viral pandemic nagapamatuod sini.
english: Our global experience in fighting bacterial and viral pandemics confirms this.

text: Naagyan na naton sa kalibutan ang pagpamintas sang Black Death nga dala sang ilaga, cholera, polio, measles, tuberculosis, Spanish flu, ebola, ang coronavirus katulad sang SARS-CoV-1 strain, kag iban pa.
english: We have already experienced in the world the ravages of the Black Death brought by rats, cholera, polio, measles, tuberculosis, Spanish flu, Ebola, coronaviruses such as the SARS-CoV-1 strain, and others.

text: Apang na-survive ini sang madamo nga katauhan bag-o pa madiskubrihan ang vaccine (bakuna), although binayaran naton ini sang minilyon nga kabuhi.
english: But many people survived it before the vaccine was discovered, although we paid millions of lives for it.

text: Binubuot seguro sang Diyos nga indi pa lubos madula ang tawo kay indi pa dapat matabo ang Great Tribulation ukon Last Judgment.
english: God must have wanted mankind not to be completely destroyed because the Great Tribulation or Last Judgment was not yet due.

text: Gani gapati kita nga malutos pa naton ang COVID-19, ukon ang SARS-CoV-2, bisan wala pa ma-producir ang vaccine, nga may manubo lang nga kadamuon sang ma-infect kag magkalamatay.
