english: So we believe that we can defeat COVID-19, or SARS-CoV-2, even before the vaccine is produced, with a low number of infections and deaths.

text: Ina tungod sang karon nga mas epektibo nga pamaagi sang modern science kag healthcare methodology kag equipment sa pagtatap sa pasyente ikumparar sa nagliligad nga panahon.
english: This is due to the more effective methods of modern science and healthcare methodology and equipment in patient care compared to the past.

text: In fact, makakita kita sing leksyon sa kon ano ang natabo sa pagpakig-away sa SARS-CoV-1.
english: In fact, we can find a lesson in what happened in the fight against SARS-CoV-1.

text: Nagtuhaw ini sadtong 2002 kag nadula lang bisan wala pa sing nadiskubrihan nga vaccine para diri sang 2004 pagkatapos iguon sini ang mga 29 ka pungsod kag teritoryo sa kalibutan.
english: It emerged in 2002 and disappeared without a vaccine being discovered in 2004 after it struck about 29 countries and territories around the world.

text: Nag-infect ini sang mga 8,000 kag nagpatay sang mga 774 ka tawo.
english: It infected about 8,000 and killed about 774 people.

text: Relatively, mas mapintas ini sa pagpatay sang 10 ka porsyento ka tawo.
english: Relatively, it’s crueller to kill 10 percent of people.

text: Ang COVID-19, tubtub karon, nagapatay lang sang mga isa ka porsyento (one percent) sang mga nabiktima sini.
english: COVID-19, so far, kills only about one percent of its victims.

text: Madugay nga indi ma-explicar sang mga siyentipiko ang pagkadula sini kay indi man masiling nga tungod ini sa “herd immunity” kay diutay lang ang nabiktima nga, consequently,  nangin immune sila.
english: For a long time, scientists could not explain its disappearance because it could not be said to be due to “herd immunity” because few victims, consequently, became immune.

text: Wala pa madiskubrihan ang vaccine para sa SARS-CoV-1 sadto; in fact, wala na ginpadayon ang pag-producir sang vaccine sang madula lang ini.
english: A vaccine for SARS-CoV-1 had not been discovered at the time; in fact, the vaccine was discontinued as soon as it disappeared.

text: Sa madamo nga kaso ang “herd immunity” matigayon lang kon mga 70-80 ka porsyento ang nagmasakit kag, consequently, na-immune na kag kaya na pangapinan pa ang nabilin nga wala pa malab-ut sang bakuna.
english: In many cases, herd immunity is only achieved when about 70-80 percent of the population is infected and, consequently, is immune and can protect the rest who have not yet been vaccinated.

text: Nag-“burn out” lang nga indi maintiendihan?
english: Just “burned out” beyond comprehension?

text: Sang ulihi, gintudlo na sang mga siyentipiko ining pagkadula sang SARS-CoV-1 sa “simple” nga pagpatuman sang mga public health measures, katulad sang pag-testing sang mga tawo nga may sintoma, pag-isolate kag pag-quarantine sang suspected cases, kag ang pag-restrict sang pagbyahe.
english: Later, scientists attributed this disappearance of SARS-CoV-1 to the “simple” implementation of public health measures, such as testing people with symptoms, isolating and quarantining suspected cases, and restricting travel.

text: Wala diri ginpatuman ang physical distancing tungod ang mga pasyente diri mga “symptomatic” tanan, nga mahibal-an dayon sa pagpakita sang mga sintoma, nga indi katulad sang iya himata nga SARS-CoV-2.
english: Physical distancing was not implemented here because the patients here were all “symptomatic”, which can be identified immediately by the appearance of symptoms, unlike its relative SARS-CoV-2.

text: Sa SARS-CoV-2, ang isa ka biktima pwede ma-infect nga indi dayon makitaan sing mga sintoma.
english: With SARS-CoV-2, a victim can become infected without immediately showing symptoms.

text: In fact, ang iban wala gid sing mapakita nga sintoma, ukon “asymptomatic”.
english: In fact, some may show no symptoms at all, or are “asymptomatic”.

text: Tungod sini, mas challenging ang pag-away sa COVID-19 tungod gani ang tawo na-infect na samtang ang sintoma magapakita pa mga duha ukon tatlo ka adlaw tubtub gani sa mga 14 ka adlaw pa despues.
english: Because of this, it is more challenging to fight COVID-19 because the person is already infected while the symptoms will appear about two or three days to about 14 days later.

text: Nonetheless, katulad sang natabo sa SARS-CoV-1, ang COVID-19 pwede matuod malutos kon mapunggan man sang aton health protocols nga indi makasulod kag makapuyo ini sa host cells sang lawas sang tawo paagi sa nagakaigu nga health protocols kag matumanon nga disiplina naton nga mga pumuluyo.
english: Nonetheless, as happened with SARS-CoV-1, COVID-19 can be defeated if our health protocols prevent it from entering and living in the host cells of the human body through proper health protocols and discipline.

text: Syempre, katulad sang pagpatuman sang paggamit sang face mask kag face shield; handwashing; physical distancing; paglikaw sa pagtandug sang mahigko nga kamot sa ilong, baba kag mata; paglikaw sa mga gutok ukon sarado nga mga lugar; kag iban pa nga mapanugyan sang aton health department.
english: Of course, such as the implementation of the use of face masks and face shields; handwashing; physical distancing; avoiding touching the nose, mouth and eyes with dirty hands; avoiding crowded or enclosed spaces; and others as recommended by our health department.

text: In fact, sunu sa  findings sang mga health experts pwede “mapatay” ang virus sa palibut kon magpabilin ini sa gwa sang lawas sang tawo, halin sa sulod sang duha ka oras tubtub 11 ka adlaw.
english: In fact, according to the findings of health experts, the virus can be “killed” in the environment if it remains outside the human body, from two hours to 11 days.

text: Meaning, “mapatay” ini kon magapabilin ini sa palibut sa subong kalawig nga pagtener, nga pwede na gani “mapatay” paagi sa bagay nga disinfection.
english: Meaning, it will “die” if it stays in the environment for such a long time, which can even be “killed” by disinfection.

text: Kon indi gid man lubos “mapatay” ukon ma-inactive ini ina tungod wala kita sing lubos nga control sa ining virus nga indi naton makita sing hayag.
english: If it doesn't completely “die” or become inactive, it's because we don't have complete control over this virus that we can't see openly.

text: At least amat-amat naton ma-reduce ang panghalit sini tubtub madula na gid lang ini katulad sang SARS-CoV-1 kay wala na ini masayluhan nga tawo, ukon lubos na “mapatay” sang ginapaabot naton nga vaccine./PN
english: At least we can gradually reduce its damage until it disappears like SARS-CoV-1 because it can no longer be transmitted to humans, or completely “killed” by the vaccine we expect./PN

text: Tuman ang pagpasalamat sang Filipina beauty queen nga si Dia Mate sa iya mga taga-suporta matapos nga ginkoronahan ini bilang Reina Hispanoamericana 2025.
english: Filipina beauty queen Dia Mate is very grateful to her supporters after she was crowned Reina Hispanoamericana 2025.

text: Ini ang pangaduha nga titulo sang Pilipinas sa amo nga pageant kasunod sang una nga nakuha ni Winwyn Marquez sang 2017.
english: This is the Philippines' second title in the pageant following the first won by Winwyn Marquez in 2017.

text: Suno sa 22-anyos nga singer-songwriter, wala siya naghaum nga magdaog sa kumpetisyon apang nagsalig siya sa destiny matapos ang anum ka bulan nga preparasyon.
english: The 22-year-old singer-songwriter said she did not expect to win the competition but she relied on destiny after six months of preparation.

text: “I feel like I’m on cloud nine.
english: “I feel like I’m on cloud nine.

text: I did not expect to win, but I gave it all to God.
english: I did not expect to win, but I gave it all to God.

text: I told myself, if I’m meant to win, it’s my destiny—and it was my destiny,” pahayag sini.
english: I told myself, if I’m meant to win, it’s my destiny—and it was my destiny,” he said.

text:
“It hasn’t really sunk in yet but everything was worth it in the end for me.”

Ginpakigbahin sini nga gab-i antes ang koronasyon, naga-send pa siya sang videos sa iya coach nga si Miss Grand International 2024 runner-up CJ Opiaza para nga malantaw ang iya nga pasarela.
english:
“It hasn’t really sunk in yet but everything was worth it in the end for me.”

Shared this night before the coronation, he even sends videos to his coach Miss Grand International 2024 runner-up CJ Opiaza to watch his catwalk.

text: Magluwas sa iya triple turns kag stunning pasarela, isa pa ka standout moment kay Mate amo ang pagkanta sini sang Selena classic nga “Como La Flor” sa swimsuit competition.
english: Aside from his triple turns and stunning catwalk, another standout moment with Mate was his performance of the Selena classic “Como La Flor” in the swimsuit competition.

text: Nagpasalamat ini sa oportunidad nga mapakita ang iya talent ilabi na bangud suno sa iya, first home sini ang music.
english: He was grateful for the opportunity to showcase his talent especially because he said music is his first home.

text: Tatlo ka semana ini nga yara sa Boliva para maenad sa kultura, lenggwahe, kag iban pa antes ang kumpetisyon.
english: It was three weeks in Boliva to get used to the culture, language, etc. before the competition.

text: Bag-o nakuha ang korona, si Mate man ang ginhingadlan nga Best in National Costume.
english: Before winning the crown, Mate was also named Best in National Costume.

text:
Ang iya runners-up sa kumpetisyon amo sanday:

Primera Finalista – Miss ColombiaSegunda Finalista – Miss EspañaTercera Finalista – Miss PerúCuarta Finalista – Miss BrasilQuinta Finalista – Miss Polonia
english:
His runners-up in the competition were:

First Finalist – Miss ColombiaSecond Finalist – Miss SpainThird Finalist – Miss PeruFourth Finalist – Miss BrazilFifth Finalist – Miss Poland

text: ISA KA senior citizen (60 anyos ang edad paibabaw), nga katulad naton, ang nagreklamo batok sa isa ka tinawo sang security agency nga nagabantay sa ganhaaan sang Gaisano Capital nga mall sa La Paz sadtong ugto sang Lunes, Agosto 10.
english: A senior citizen (60 years of age and above), like us, complained against a security agency personnel guarding the entrance of the Gaisano Capital mall in La Paz on Monday afternoon, August 10.

text: Ginhingadlan ang sekyu nga si Lozada nga ginpabugal gid ang iya agency nga MD Force.
english: The security guard was named Lozada who was very proud of his agency, MD Force.

text: Bag-o lang si senior citizen kasulod sa isa ka bangko agud mag-withdraw sang madumduman niya nga manugtomar na gali siya sang iya maintenance nga bulong sa high blood sinang ugto.
english: The senior citizen had just entered a bank to withdraw when he remembered that he was about to take his maintenance medicine for high blood that afternoon.

text: Gani dale-dale siya nga nagpadulong sa Gaisano Capital sa La Paz nga malapit sa iya agud magbakal sa botika dira sa sulod.
english: So he hurried to the Gaisano Capital in La Paz near him to buy something at the pharmacy inside.

text: Apang ginpunggan siya ni sekyu Lozada sang mahibal-an nga isa siya ka senior citizen.
english: But security guard Lozada stopped him when he learned that he was a senior citizen.

text: May upod ini sang isa pa ka sekyu sang iya agency sa ganhaan sang mall.
english: He was accompanied by another security guard from his agency at the entrance of the mall.

text: “Sorry, indi ka pwede makasulod,” siling sini nga may gintudlo nga kon ano nga aviso sa ganhaan nga kuno nagadumili sa tigulang sa pagsulod sa mall.
english: “Sorry, you can't come in,” he said, pointing to a notice on the door that allegedly prohibited the elderly man from entering the mall.

text: Natingala si senior citizen kay nakasulod siya gani sa bangko bag-o lang nga wala sing problema.
english: The senior citizen was surprised because he had just entered the bank without any problems.

text: Ginsiling niya ini sa kay sekyu, apang namilit gid ini nga indi pasudlon si lolo.
english: He told the security guard, but he insisted that Grandpa not be allowed inside.

text: Gindugang pa siling ni sekyu nga “private” ining establishment sang Gaisano.
english: The security guard added that the Gaisano establishment is “private”.

text: Aba, paano nangin “private” ang isa ka mall kay pam-publiko ini?
english: Well, how does a mall become “private” because it is public?

text: Ini nga daan nagapatimaan nga ignorante ang ining sekyu sa dapat niya hibaluon sa iya trabaho.
english: This old indicates that this security guard is ignorant of what he should know in his job.

text: Gintudlo lang sini sa tigulang nga may pagka-arogante kon diin ini pwede makabakal sang bulong sa tabuk sang dalan nga indi man niya ma-specify.
english: He just pointed out to the old man with arrogance where he could buy medicine across the street which he could not specify.

text: Kita man gani indi makatudlo sa botika nga malapit dira.
english: We can't even point to the pharmacy nearby.

text: Naggwa si senior citizen kag nangayo sing pagpaathag sa isa ka pulis nga nagabantay man sa gwa sang mall malapit man lang sa ganhaan sang mall kon diin nagabantay si sekyu Lozada.
english: The senior citizen came out and asked for an explanation from a policeman who was also guarding outside the mall near the entrance of the mall where security guard Lozada was guarding.

text: Masubo ugaling kay nanginwala man ang pulis sa pagbulig.
english: Sadly, the police refused to help.

text:
Siling niya: “Obligasyon ina sang security…”

So, agud indi maalang-alang ang iya pagtomar sang bulong, naghingagaw na gid lang si senior citzen sa pagsakay sa taksi pauli.
english:
He said: “That is the obligation of the security…”

So, in order not to delay his medication, the senior citizen decided to take a taxi home.

text: “Pwede gani magbakal bulong didto sa Iloilo Supermart kag sa bangko, ngaa abe indi pwede diri sa Gaisano Capital,” kumod sini samtang nagapalayo.
english: “You can buy medicine at the Iloilo Supermart and the bank, why not here at Gaisano Capital,” he joked as he walked away.

text: Apang nagsiling ini nga paylan nya sing kaso ang sekyu kag ang agency sini nga MD Force.
english: But he said he will file a case against the security guard and his agency, MD Force.

text: Pahibaluon man niya kuno ang Gaisano management parti sini.
english: He will also inform the Gaisano management about this.

text: Delikado ang malipatan mo ang imo bulong nga may talana nga oras kay mabalik na sina ang imo ginabatyag sa paglampuwas sang epekto sang bulong, labi na gid kon mataas ang imo high blood pressure ukon nakaagi ka stroke.
english: It is dangerous to forget to take your medication at the appointed time because it can cause you to feel overwhelmed by the effects of the medication, especially if you have high blood pressure or have had a stroke.

text:
***

Sang matabo ini sa tigulang, sa kategoriya nga General Community Quarantine (GCQ) ang siyudad.
english:
***

When this happened to the elderly, the city was in the category of General Community Quarantine (GCQ).

text: Husto bala ining ginapapati sa iya sang sekyu nga indi siya pwede makabakal sing bulong sa Gaisano Capital sa Lapaz tungod senior citizen siya?
english: Is it true that the security guard is telling him that he cannot buy medicine at the Gaisano Capital in Lapaz because he is a senior citizen?

text: Nag-research kita diutay kag ini ang aton nadiskubrihan.
english: We did a little research and this is what we discovered.

text: May Executive Order parti sina.
english: There is an Executive Order on that.

text: Ining Executive Order amo ang EO No.
english: This Executive Order is EO No.

text: 112 nga, upod sa IATF Resolution No.
english: 112 which, together with IATF Resolution No.

text: 30, dated June  1, s. 2020, nagasiling sa isa ka bahin sini sing: “Not Allowed, with Exceptions.
english: 30, dated June  1, p. 2020, states in part: “Not Allowed, with Exceptions.

text: .Persons aged below 21 years, 60 years and above, immunodeficient, with comorbidities, or pregnant are not allowed to go out except when going out for essentials.”.
english: .Persons aged below 21 years, 60 years and above, immunodeficient, with comorbidities, or pregnant are not allowed to go out except when going out for essentials.”.

text: In other words, sa aton pulong nga Hiligaynon, pwede makagwa si senior citizen agud magbakal sang iya bulong dira sa sulod sang Gaisano Capital sa Lapaz, katulad sang ginahimo ko man kon kinahanglan ko magbakal sang bulong kon wala ako sing malihog.
english: In other words, in our Hiligaynon language, a senior citizen can go out to buy his medicine inside the Gaisano Capital in Lapaz, just like I do when I need to buy medicine when I have no one to help.

text: In other words man, sala atong tindug ni sekyu Lozada nga indi makasulod si senior citizen agud magbakal sang iya bulong dira.
english: In other words, Sekyu Lozada's position that senior citizens cannot enter to buy their medicines is wrong.

text: Kon sadto nakabatyag na si senior citizen sing senyales, katulad sang panghugot na sang iya liig, may delikado na ini kon ma-delay pa ang pagtomar sini sang iya bulong.
english: If a senior citizen has already experienced symptoms, such as a tightness in his neck, he is in danger if he delays taking his medication.

text: Maayo lang kon wala sing may natabo sa senior citizen tungod sa delay nga indi siya makatomar sang iya bulong.
english: It would be good if nothing happened to the senior citizen because of the delay in taking his medicine.

text: Kon may natabo, pwede si sekyu, kag ang iya security agency, maakusahan kag manabat.
english: If something happens, the security guard, and his security agency, can be charged and held accountable.

text: In fact, bisan wala sing natabo kay old.
english: In fact, even if nothing happened to old.

text: Indi bala, Attorney?
english: Isn't it, Attorney?

text: Kag, ano naman ang masiling sang OSCA agud tadlungon ining pagka-ignorante sang sekyu nga nagabantay sa ganhaan sang Gaisano Capital sa La Paz?/PN
english: And, what can the OSCA say to correct this ignorance of the security guard guarding the entrance of the Gaisano Capital in La Paz?/PN

text: Normal lang nga pamalhason ka kun magtulog ka kun gab-i; apang ang indi normal amo ang pagbugtaw nga basa-basa na gid ang imo nga pajamas kag ang imo nga kutson bangud sang indi kinaandan nga pagpamalhas.
english: It is normal to sweat when you go to bed at night; but what is not normal is waking up with your pajamas and your mattress soaking wet from unusual washing.

text: Suno kay Dr.Laura M. Rosch, isa ka osteopathic internal medicine specialist sa Wheaton, Illinois, ang pagpalamalhas kun gab-i ang mahimo maangot sa stress kag anxiety.
english: According to Dr. Laura M. Rosch, an osteopathic internal medicine specialist in Wheaton, Illinois, sweating at night can be linked to stress and anxiety.

text: Pwede man ini maangot sa hormonal issues kaangay sang menopause, low testosterone, carcinoid syndrome kag hyperthyroidism.
english: It can also be linked to hormonal issues like menopause, low testosterone, carcinoid syndrome and hyperthyroidism.

text: Kun may yara ka sang hormonal issues, magluwas sa pagpalamalhas, makaangkon ka man sang indi mapaathag nga weight changes, pagbag-o bag-o sang energy level, kasakit sa ulo, sexual dysfunction kag menstrual changes.
english: If you have hormonal issues, in addition to sweating, you may also experience unexplained weight changes, fluctuations in energy levels, headaches, sexual dysfunction and menstrual changes.

text: Ukon posible man nga may ginainom ka nga bulong kag basi side effects niya ini.
english: Or it's possible that you're taking some medicine and maybe it's side effects.

text: Ang mas seryoso nga mga kondisyon nga mahimo maangot sa pagpalamalhas amo ang sleep apnea, cancer, kag neurological disorders.
english: More serious conditions that can be linked to sweating include sleep apnea, cancer, and neurological disorders.

text: San-o mo dapat bisitahon ang doktor?
english: When should you visit the doctor?

text: Dapat ka nga magpakonsulta kun basa basa ka na gid kun magbugtaw, indi ka na makatulog, kag kun dala sini ang iban pa nga sintomas kaangay sang pagpalanakit sang lawas kag hilanat.
english: You should seek medical attention if you are very wet when you wake up, cannot sleep, and if it is accompanied by other symptoms such as body aches and fever.

text: Sa masami, ang away sang magkarelasyon amo ang iban nga babaye ukon lalaki ukon ang third party sa ila nga relasyon.
english: Often, the fight between a relationship is with another woman or man or a third party in their relationship.

text: Amo gani nga pinasahi gid ang ginhimo sang isa ka babaye sa Malaysia nga nagbulig pa sa pagpangita sang ikaduha nga misis para sa iya bana!
english: That's why a woman in Malaysia did something special when she helped find a second wife for her husband!

text: Ang rason sang babaye amo nga gusto sini nga makatutok sa iya nga karera bilang isa ka singer amo man sa iya nga personal development.
english: The woman's reason is that she wants to focus on her career as a singer as well as her personal development.

text: Ini amo si Azline Ariffin, 42, ukon si Ezlynn, nga popular bangud sa iya energetic kag avant-garde song nga Hi Hi Bye Bye sang 2003.
english: This is Azline Ariffin, 42, or Ezlynn, popular for her energetic and avant-garde song Hi Hi Bye Bye in 2003.

text: Apisar nga wala na ini sang bag-o nga mga kanta, sikat ini gihapon bangud aktibo sa Malaysian television.
english: Although he has no new songs, he is still popular because he is active on Malaysian television.

text: Gin-ako sini nga siya kag ang iya 47-anyos nga bana ang nagkasugot sa polygamous marriage.
english: She admitted that she and her 47-year-old husband had agreed to a polygamous marriage.

text: 2021 sang sila ang ginkasal, samtang sang nagligad nga Marso, nagpakasal ang lalaki sa iya ikaduha nga misis nga 26-anyos nga doktor.
english: 2021 when they tied the knot, while last March, the man married his second wife who is a 26-year-old doctor.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Ezlynn nga iya mismo ideya nga mangita sang bag-o nga asawa ang iya bana para nga ang iya co-wife ang makaupod sa iya bana samtang nga masako naman ini sa iya nga karera.#
english: Ezlynn said it was her own idea for her husband to find a new wife so that his co-wife could be with her husband while he was busy with his career.

text: LET us face it.
english: LET us face it.

text: Indi lang kita may kinahanglan sang COVID-19 vaccine, labi na gid kay wala man sa aton ikasarang ang mag-producir sini kag magasalig lang sa kon ano ang makuha naton halin sa mga pungsod nga maka-produce sini.
english: We not only need a COVID-19 vaccine, especially since we do not have the ability to produce it and will rely on what we get from countries that can produce it.

text: In fact, indi man kita dapat maglaum nga i-prioridad kita sang China kag Russia sa ano man nga ma-produce nila.
english: In fact, we shouldn't expect China and Russia to prioritize us over whatever they can produce.

text: Sa subong, pulos man lang gani sugid kay tubtub sa sining ulihi sige pa lang ang ila clinical trial agud maka-manufacture na sang vaccine.
english: For now, it's just a rumor because until recently they are still conducting clinical trials to manufacture a vaccine.

text: Basi mauna pa gani ang iban nga pungsod.
english: Maybe other countries will even go ahead.

text: Tandaan naton nga unahon gid nila ang ila pumuluyo.
english: Let us remember that they will always put their people first.

text: Natural lang nga ang sentimiento sang ila pumuluyo amo nga sila gid ang unahon nga hatagan sang vaccine.
english: Naturally, the sentiment of their people is that they should be given the vaccine first.

text: Nga daan sobra ka damo sang ila populasyon kag indi madale-dale matagaan ini sila tanan.
english: That their population is already too large and it is impossible to provide for them all.

text: Ang China may populasyon nga 1.393 ka bilyon (2018) kag ang Russia may 144.5 ka milyon (2018), nga sa kabilugan nagadangat sa 1.5375 ka bilyon ka tawo.
english: China has a population of 1.393 billion (2018) and Russia has 144.5 million (2018), which collectively amounts to 1.5375 billion people.

text: Tungod mga 70 ka porsyento lang ang kinahanglan mabakunahan para sa “herd immunity”, that means nga pwede malab-ut lang sang vaccine ang mga 1.0725 ka bilyon ka tawo sa China kag Russia, kon diin naluyagan ni Presidente Duterte mangayo sing vaccine.
english: Since only about 70 percent need to be vaccinated for herd immunity, that means the vaccine can only reach about 1.0725 billion people in China and Russia, where President Duterte likes to ask for vaccines.

text: Kay duha ka shot ang itublok sa kada isa, mga 2.1525 ka bilyon ka shot ina tanan.
english: Because two shots will be fired at each, that’s about 2.1525 billion shots in total.

text: Tungod sa kadamuon nga ini, ti san-o gid kita makabaton sang nabilin halin sa China kag Russia kon mag-upod sila sa pag-producir sining vaccine, kon may mabilin gid man?
english: Given this amount, when will we receive the rest from China and Russia if they produce this vaccine together, if there is any left?

text: Basi kulang pa gani sa ila!
english: Maybe even less than them!

text: Pensaron ta man nga may 7.5 ka bilyon ang populasyon sang kalibutan,  nga kon itugyan man sa World Health Organization (WHO) ang pagpanagtag sang vaccine, indi man mahimo ini tanan sang WHO.
english: Let's also consider that there are 7.5 billion people in the world, and if the distribution of vaccines is entrusted to the World Health Organization (WHO), the WHO cannot do it all.

text: Man ang may ikasarang nga mga pungsod mamakal ina sang vaccine halin sa mga individual manufacturers kag distributors nga indi una mag-agi sa WHO.
english: Also, the able countries will buy the vaccine from individual manufacturers and distributors without first going through the WHO.

text: Natural lang nga ang mga nasyon nga makasarang magbakal sang vaccine mauna gid nga makakuha sini.
english: Naturally, the countries that can afford the vaccine will be the first to get it.

text: Kag pobre lang ang mga pigado nga mga nasyon.
english: And only poor countries are poor.

text: Natabo na gani ina sa Indonesia kag iban pa nga “third world” nga pungsod nga nagahulat-hulat sadto sa flu vaccine.
english: That has even happened in Indonesia and other “third world” countries that were waiting for the flu vaccine.

text: Man indi ina sila makasarang magbakal sang vaccine kag magahulat gid lang sila sa pwede ihatag libre sang WHO halin sa mga mabilin, samtang sige gihapon ang pagpamintas sang COVID-19 sa ila tungod sa kahuyang sang ila health system.
english: They cannot afford to buy a vaccine and will wait for what the WHO can provide free of charge from those who are left behind, while COVID-19 continues to torment them because of the weakness of their health system.

text: Well, medyo mabakud man ang aton health facilities kag measures apang indi kita magpatumbaya tungod sa paghulat nga malakip kita nga unahon sang China kag Russia nga ginapasalig ni Presidente Duterte.
english: Well, our health facilities and measures are quite strong but let's not neglect because of waiting for China and Russia to prioritize us as President Duterte assures us.

text: Maniguro kita, Mr. President!
english: Let's make sure, Mr. President!

text: Indi gani mapasalig sang China nga indi pahilabtan ang aton pila ka isla sa West Philippine Sea, ini pa ang vaccine nga kinahanglan gid sang ila pumuluyo.
english: China can't even promise not to interfere with our few islands in the West Philippine Sea, this is the vaccine that their people really need.

text:
Tungod sini, sugot kita sa obserbasyon ni WHO Western Pacific Regional Director Dr Takeshi Kasai nga “we continue to improve our response and not just hope for the vaccine.”

Tungod man sini, dapat may “sustainable plan” kita agud mapadayon nga “viable” ang aton ekonomiya kag ang aton “health system” agud indi kita matam-an sa madugayon nga paghulat sa vaccine kag mapaseguro ang kabuhian kag ikaayong lawas sang tanan.
english:
For this reason, we agree with the observation of WHO Western Pacific Regional Director Dr. Takeshi Kasai that “we continue to improve our response and not just hope for the vaccine.”

Therefore, we must have a sustainable plan to keep our economy and our health system viable so that we will not be overwhelmed by the long wait for the vaccine and ensure the lives and health of all.

text: Importante nga may pirme hulagon (liquidity) ang aton gobyerno agud mapadayon ang “viability” sini sa pagserbisyo sa mga pumuluyo, pagsuporta sa kinahanglanon sang mga negosyo, pagkinahanglan sing trabaho sang mga pumuluyo, kag ang wala pagkulang nga pagbulig sa mga labing kubos sa aton.
english: It is important that our government has liquidity to maintain its viability in serving the people, supporting the needs of businesses, the needs of the people, and the unfailing assistance to the poorest of us.

text: Importante man ang aton pagsalig sa aton gobyerno agud patigayunon ang kinahanglanon nga disiplina agud masunod ang nagakabagay nga mga health protocols.
english: It is also important that we trust our government to maintain the necessary discipline to follow the appropriate health protocols.

text: Indi man kita magbulag sa Ginuo sa mahatag niya nga grasya kag pagdampig sa aton nga iya mga tumuluo.
english: Let us not be separated from the Lord in His grace and protection for us His believers.

text: Kag kon may ara man dira nga nagalibak pa gani sa aton Amay sa Langit, abaw indi man kay basi kamo pa ang mabasulan kag matum-ukan sang kaakig sang Diyos!
english: And if there are those who even make fun of our Heavenly Father, don't because you might be the ones to blame and be the wrath of God!

text: Dayawon ang Labing Makagagahum kag Maluluy-on ta nga Diyos!/PN
english: Praise be to our Almighty and Merciful God!/PN

text: Padayon nakasirado sa publiko ang Louvre Museum sa Paris matapos ginkawatan.
english: The Louvre Museum in Paris remains closed to the public after being robbed.

text: Nakuha sang mga kawatan ang walo ka mga nagkalain-ain kag malahalon nga mga alahas.
english: The thieves took eight different and expensive pieces of jewelry.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, nagdungan ang mga suspek sa pagbukas sang msuseum takna ‘las-9:30 sang aga.
english: According to the investigation, the suspects opened the museum at 9:30 am.

text: Naggamit ang apat ka suspek sang salakyan nga may mechanical lift para makasulod sa Galerie d’Apollon sa tunga sang balcony malapit sa River Seine.
english: The four suspects used a vehicle with a mechanical lift to enter the Galerie d'Apollon in the middle of the balcony near the River Seine.

text: Duha sa mga suspek ang nakasulod pinaagi sa pagguba sang bintanan gamit ang power tools.
english: Two of the suspects gained entry by breaking the window using power tools.

text: Ginpahog nila ang mga guwardiya bag-o ginbuka ang duha ka display nga nagaunod sang mga alahas.
english: They threatened the guards before opening two displays containing jewelry.

text: Ginhimo nila pagpangkawat sang apat ka minute kag nakapalagyo sakay sa duha ka scooters.
english: They committed a four-minute robbery and escaped on two scooters.

text: Pila sa mga ginkawat amo ang emerald necklace kag isa ka pares sang aritos halin kay Empress Marie Louise; brooch nga kilala bilang “reliquary brooch”; Tiara kag brooch nga ginapanag-iyahan ni Empress Eugene ang asawa ni Napoleon III kag isa ka tiara, necklace kag single earing halin sa sapphire set na halin kay Queen Marie-Amelie kag Queen Hortense.
english: Among the items stolen were an emerald necklace and a pair of earrings from Empress Marie Louise; brooch known as a “reliquary brooch”; Tiara and brooch belonging to Empress Eugene the wife of Napoleon III and a tiara, necklace and single earring from the sapphire set already from Queen Marie-Amelie and Queen Hortense.

text: Padayon ang ginapatigayon nga imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad sa nasambit nga insidente.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident.

text: Patigayunon diri sa syudad sang Iloilo ang CHED RAISE Summit 2026 isa ka national higher education forum nga ginapangunahan sang Commission on Higher Education (CHED), nga magatutok sa papel sang artificial intelligence (AI) kag iban pa nga emerging technologies sa pagbag-o sang sistema sang edukasyon sa Pilipinas.
english: The CHED RAISE Summit 2026, a national higher education forum led by the Commission on Higher Education (CHED), will be held here in Iloilo City, which will focus on the role of artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging technologies in transforming the education system in the Philippines.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Raul Muyong, Regional Director sang CHED Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga pagatambungan sang nagkalain-lain nga representante halin sa 18 ka rehiyon ang nasambit nga forum.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Raul Muyong, Regional Director of CHED Region 6, said the forum will be attended by various representatives from 18 regions.

text: Ang RAISE summit nagakahulugan sang ”Responding through AI for Societal Empowerment,” nga may katuyuan nga palapron ang innovation, inclusivity kag ang responsable nga paggamit sang AI sa pagtudlo, pagtuon, research kag community engagement sang mga kolehiyo kag unibersidad sa pungsod.
english: The RAISE summit stands for ”Responding through AI for Societal Empowerment,” with the goal of expanding innovation, inclusivity and the responsible use of AI in teaching, learning, research and community engagement by colleges and universities in the country.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga paghiwat sang nasambit nga summit kag patigayunon ini sa Visayas kag diri mismo sa Iloilo Convention Center sa Pebrero 25-27, 2026.
english: This is the third edition of the summit and it will be held in the Visayas and here at the Iloilo Convention Center on February 25-27, 2026.

text: Maga-upod man diri ang mga opisyal sang CHED kag mga partner institutions kun sa diin ginapaabot man nga magatambong si DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara kag Department of Science and Technology Secretary Dr. Renato U. Solidum Jr.
english: CHED officials and partner institutions will also be present. DepEd Secretary Sonny Angara and Department of Science and Technology Secretary Dr. Renato U. Solidum Jr.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Muyong nga ila ginhandaan ang kaangay sini nga summit sa bulig sang Northern Iloilo State University (NISU) kag West Visayas State University (WVSU) nga amo ang nagapanguna sa preparasyon sang aktibidad sa rehiyon.
english: Muyong said they are preparing for such a summit with the help of Northern Iloilo State University (NISU) and West Visayas State University (WVSU) which are leading the preparation of the activity in the region.

text: Kabahin sang summit ang paghatag kahigayunan sa mga estudyante nga makapakita sang ila abilidad paagi sa Artificial Intellegence.
english: Part of the summit was to give students the opportunity to showcase their skills through Artificial Intelligence.

text: Ginpabutyag man sini ang kaimportansya sang AI sa edukasyon ilabi na sa digital transformation kag confirmation sang mga academic outputs.
english: He also highlighted the importance of AI in education especially in digital transformation and confirmation of academic outputs.

text: Apang, gin-athag ni Direktor Muyong nga ang AI isa lamang ka tool kag indi dapat pagsaligan bangud posible ini magdula sang critical thinking skills sang mga estudyante.
english: However, Director Muyong explained that AI is only a tool and should not be trusted as it is likely to eliminate students’ critical thinking skills.

text: Katuyuan man sang CHED RAISE Summit nga palaparon ang ihibalo sang higher education institutions kun paano gamiton ang AI para sa transformation kag empowerment sang komunidad.
english: The CHED RAISE Summit also aims to expand the knowledge of higher education institutions on how to use AI for community transformation and empowerment.

text: Ginalauman nga pinaagi sa summit, ma-inspire ang mga estudyante kag manunudlo nga maghimo sang mas madamo pa nga innovation gamit ang AI nga may ara sang balanse sa teknolohiya kag critical thinking skills.
english: It is hoped that through the summit, students and teachers will be inspired to do more innovation using AI with a balance of technology and critical thinking skills.

text: LAWLAW nga PLDT.
english: BRIGHT PLDT.

text: May pila man ka okasyon nga madasig nag-akto ang PLDT sa amon reklamo.
english: There were also several occasions when PLDT acted quickly on our complaint.

text: Pero, indi sa sini nga tion.
english: But, not this time.

text: Natumba sadtong Agosto 8 ang poste nga naangtan sang telephone line sang PLDT diri sa amon  – nga nagasakop sang at least apat ka balay diri sa amon sa Mandurriao.
english: On August 8, the pole connected to the PLDT telephone line here in our area fell – which covers at least four houses here in Mandurriao.

text: Indi namon ma-contact ang ila upisina sa Manila kag diri sa siyudad.
english: We could not contact their office in Manila and here in the city.

text: Sang daw milagro nga na-contact namon ini, nagpasalig ang tinawo sini sang Biyernes, Agosto 14, nga aktuhan dayon ining amon problema.
english: When we miraculously contacted him, his staff assured us on Friday, August 14, that our problem would be addressed immediately.

text: Apang wala gid tubtub nga ginasulat ko ining kolum sadtong Agosto 18.
english: But never until I was writing this column back on August 18th.

text: Samtang ang Globe naangot na sini ang koneksyon sang ila kliyente diri sa amon sadtong Agosto 10 pa lang.
english: Meanwhile, Globe has already connected their client's connection to us as early as August 10.

text: Tsk, tsk, tsk!
english: Tsk, tsk, tsk!

text:
***

Natingala kita kon ngaa indi mga siyentipiko ang nagapasalig nga may bulong na ukon vaccine kontra COVID-19.
english:
***

We wonder why scientists are not assuring that there is a cure or vaccine against COVID-19.

text: Duha sang nagpasalig nga “effective and safe” ang mga ini amo si US President Donald Trump kag si Russian President Vladimir Putin, nga indi mga siyentipiko kundi mga pulitiko.
english: Two of those who have assured that they are “effective and safe” are US President Donald Trump and Russian President Vladimir Putin, who are not scientists but politicians.

text: Ginapilit papatihon ni Trump ang paggamit sang antimalarial drug nga Chloroquine (hydroxychloroquine) batok sa COVID-19, samtang wala pa ini mapamatud-an (unproven) nga bulong ukon treatment diri, although ginapanugyan man niya nga konsultahon ang doktor kon sundon ang iya panugyan.
english: Trump insists on the use of the antimalarial drug Chloroquine (hydroxychloroquine) against COVID-19, while it is not yet an unproven cure or treatment here, although he also advises to consult a doctor if his advice is followed.

text: Gut-feeling lang ining iya, samtang “science and fact” ga-require sang clinical trial bag-o magamit ining bulong ukon treatment.
english: This is just a gut-feeling, while “science and fact” requires a clinical trial before this drug or treatment can be used.

text: Subong man sini ang pasalig ni Putin nga basta nagpahayag nga “effective and safe” ang Russian candidate vaccine (samtang ginatun-an pa lang), sa lugar nga tani gintugyan ining pahayag sa mga siyentipiko nga nagtuon kag nagpatigayon sining candidate vaccine.
english: Similarly, Putin's assurance that as long as the Russian candidate vaccine is "effective and safe" (while still being studied), instead of leaving this statement to the scientists who studied and conducted this candidate vaccine.

text: Sa matuod, wala pa ini sing approval sang Russian Food and Drug Administration (FDA) kag, sunu sa kay presidential spokesperson Harry Roque, magasugod pa lang ang Clinical Trial 3, kag inug-review pa lang ang Clinical1 kag 2 sa palaabuton nga Setyembre 2020.
english: In fact, it has not yet received approval from the Russian Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and, according to presidential spokesperson Harry Roque, Clinical Trial 3 is just beginning, and Clinical 1 and 2 will be reviewed in September 2020.

text: Sa Clinical 3, tun-an na ang “safety” sang ining Russian candidate vaccine.
english: In Clinical 3, the safety of this Russian candidate vaccine will be studied.

text: In fact, ang Moscow-based Association of Clinical Trials Organization (ACTO) nagpamilit gid nga indi anay aprubahan ang candidate vaccine tubtub nga ang final trial (# 3) ma-kumpleto sing madinalag-on.
english: In fact, the Moscow-based Association of Clinical Trials Organization (ACTO) has been adamant about not approving the candidate vaccine until the final trial (#3) is successfully completed.

text: Ang risgo nagalab-ut pa gani sa pag-producir sang vaccine sang mga accredited nga mga manufacturer.
english: The risk even extends to the production of the vaccine by accredited manufacturers.

text: Nga matabo ini may basehan sa kasaysayan sang pag-producir kag distribution sang vaccine sa ginsiling nga Cutter Incident sadtong Abril 30, 1955.
english: That this will happen is based on the history of production and distribution of the vaccine in the so-called Cutter Incident on April 30, 1955.

text: Ang Public Health Service sang Bethesda, Maryland nagpauntat sang paghatag sing polio vaccine sang madiskubrihan nga nagsala ang pag-manufacture sini.
english: The Public Health Service of Bethesda, Maryland stopped administering polio vaccine when it was discovered that it had been manufactured incorrectly.

text: Sa lugar nga patay nga virus ang gamiton, live (buhi) virus ang nagamit.
english: Instead of using a dead virus, a live virus is used.

text: Ang resulta amo nga madamo ang napatay, na-paralyze kag nagmasakit pa sang polio sa lugar nga bulngon ini sila sang vaccine.
english: The result was that many died, were paralyzed and even contracted polio instead of being treated with the vaccine.

text: Ginliwat gid ang pag-manufacture sang vaccine kag ginpabayad sing danyos ang manufacturer.
english: The vaccine was completely remanufactured and the manufacturer was fined.

text: Gin-producir ining poliomyelitis vaccine sang Cutter Laboratories sang Berkeley, California.
english: This poliomyelitis vaccine was produced by Cutter Laboratories of Berkeley, California.

text: Ginkilala ang Cutter Incident nga “one of the worst biological disasters in American history”.
english: The Cutter Incident was recognized as “one of the worst biological disasters in American history”.

text:
***

Sa nasiling ta na, sa Setyembre 2020 pa ang pag-review sang Clinical 1 kag 2 sang Gamaleya Research Institute sa Russia.
english:
***

As mentioned earlier, the review of Clinical 1 and 2 by the Gamaleya Research Institute in Russia will be held in September 2020.

text: Gin-imbitar pa gani sang Russia ang sobra 1,000 ka Filipino volunteers sa pag-participar sa Clinical Trial 3 nga hiwaton dungan sa Russia sa Oktubre 2020 tubtub Marso 2021, nga pundohan gasto sang Russia.
english: Russia has even invited more than 1,000 Filipino volunteers to participate in Clinical Trial 3 to be held simultaneously in Russia from October 2020 to March 2021, funded at Russia's expense.

text: May isa na ka Filipino ang nangisug sa pagpasakop sa clinical trial sang Saudi Arabia.
english: One Filipino has already dared to participate in Saudi Arabia's clinical trial.

text: May nauna na man gani nga report parti sa isa ka virologist nga Filipino nga nagapasakop sa clinical trial sa Covid-19 vaccine sa Uropa – sa United Kingdom ukon Germany bala.
english: There has even been a previous report about a Filipino virologist participating in a clinical trial of a Covid-19 vaccine in Europe – in the United Kingdom or Germany.

text: Sa karon, ang Filipinas lakip man gani sa sobra 100 ka pungsod nga gapatigayon sang Solidarity Trial sang WHO “to evaluate the safety and efficacy of four drugs and drug combinations”.Samtang, kinahanglan ang mas madamo nga volunteers sa Clinical Trial 3 agud mapamatud-an gid nga “safe” ang vaccine batok sa posible nga mga adverse effects sini, lakip ang pag-participar sang mga volunteer nga mahuyang ang ikaayong lawas nga makapalala pa sang ila pamatyag.
english: Currently, the Philippines is among more than 100 countries conducting the WHO's Solidarity Trial “to evaluate the safety and efficacy of four drugs and drug combinations”. that poor health can make them feel worse.

text: Samtang man, may mga clinical trials naman nga na-report sa Germany, Estados Unidos kag iban pa nga lugar, nga gaangan-angan lang agud makakuha sang rekomendasyon sang World Health Organization (WHO) agud ma-aprubahan./PN
english: Meanwhile, there are clinical trials reported in Germany, the United States and other places, which are just waiting to get the recommendation of the World Health Organization (WHO) for approval.

text: Ginbuyagyag ni US President Donald Trump nga magabisita ini sa China sa masunod nga tuig.
english: US President Donald Trump has revealed that he will visit China next year.

text: Suno kay Trump nga gin-imbitaran siya mismo ni Chinese President Xi Jinping kun sa diin possible sa Enero sang masunod nga tuig.
english: Trump said he was invited by Chinese President Xi Jinping himself, possibly in January next year.

text: Sa mga masunod nga semana, possible masapol niya sa South Korea si Chinese President Xi.
english: In the coming weeks, he is likely to meet with Chinese President Xi in South Korea.

text: Matandaan nga may yara sang indi manami nga relasyon ang US kag China bangud sa pagtaas sang taripa sa mga produkto sang kada pungsod.
english: The US and China have a strained relationship due to the increase in tariffs on each country's products.

text: Bad news sa mga motorista!
english: Bad news for motorists!

text: Liwat naman nga nagsaka ang presyo sang gatong epektibo subong nga adlaw.
english: Fuel prices rose again effective today.

text: Gasoline – P1.35/LDiesel- P1.30/LKerosene- P1.10/L
english: Gasoline – P1.35/LDesel- P1.30/LKerosene- P1.10/L

text: MADAMO nga global news outfit ang nagdala, sang sining karon lang, sang balita nga ang Rusya naka-develop na sang COVID-19 vaccine, nga pwede na ma-mass produce bag-o matapos ang ining tuig, 2020.
english: MANY global news outfits have brought, recently, the news that Russia has developed a COVID-19 vaccine, which can be mass produced before the end of this year, 2020.

text: Ini mismo ang ginpahayag ni Russian President Vladimir Putin, nga ginpabugal pa nga ang isa sang na-injectionan (inoculated) sang vaccine sa Clinical Trial 3, isa sang iya mga anak nga babaye.
english: This was stated by Russian President Vladimir Putin, who boasted that one of those injected with the vaccine in Clinical Trial 3 was one of his daughters.

text: Maayo man kuno ang pamatyag sang iya anak kag may “high number of antibodies”.
english: Her daughter is also said to be feeling well and has a “high number of antibodies”.

text: Ini nga kadamuon sang antibodies importante kay amo ini ang lubos nga makalutos sang COVID-19 virus.
english: This amount of antibodies is important because it is what can completely defeat the COVID-19 virus.

text: Indi lang kita ugaling kaseguro kon matuod ang ining ginapahayag ni Putin.
english: However, we are not sure if Putin's claim is true.

text: Una, kinahanglan may masaligan nga ebidensya nga mapahayag sang clinical trial data ang Moscow’s Gamaleya Institute nga amo kuno ang nag-develop sining Russian vaccine.
english: First, there must be reliable evidence that the clinical trial data of Moscow’s Gamaleya Institute, which is said to have developed this Russian vaccine, must have reliable evidence.

text: Wala pa ugaling napakita ini (clinical trial data) for scrutiny sang scientific world.
english: However, it has not been shown (clinical trial data) for scrutiny by the scientific world.

text: Kinahanglan man ini sang World Health Organization (WHO) agud ma-rekomendar ini para sa global use, nga wala pa man mahimo sini.
english: It also needs the World Health Organization (WHO) to recommend it for global use, which it has yet to do.

text: Ikaduha, nagaduha-duha kita nga samtang yara pa lang sa Clinical Trial 3, nga wala pa matapos ang pagtilaw sang tanan nga gin-testingan, nga tugtan ni Putin nga mag-partisipar sa sining trial ang iya anak.
english: Secondly, we doubt that while still in Clinical Trial 3, having not finished testing everything tested, that Putin would allow his son to participate in this trial.

text: Ina tungod kon ako ang amay sang anak ni Putin indi gid ako magsugot nga i-risgo ang akon anak sa isa ka trial nga padayon pa ginahiwat kon “effective and safe” ukon indi ining vaccine.
english: That’s because if I were the father of Putin’s child I would never agree to risk my child in a trial that is still ongoing as to whether or not this vaccine is “effective and safe”.

text: Ano gid bala ang diperensya sang iya anak sa iban nga nag-voluntario agud mag-partisipar tubtub sa Clinical Trial 3?
english: What is the difference between her son and the others who volunteered to participate up to Clinical Trial 3?

text: Luas sa mga nag-boluntad baylo sa ano man nga pabor, madamo dira nga nasentensyahan death penalty baylo sa pagpanubo sang ila sentensya.
english: In addition to those who volunteered in exchange for any favor, many were sentenced to death in exchange for a reduction in their sentences.

text: Ti, ngaa anak mo gid President Putin?
english: Well, why is President Putin your son?

text: Kon luyag gid niya, siya ang personal nga mag-boluntad sa pag-partisipar sa ining ulihi nga trial – Clinical Trial 3.
english: If he really wanted to, he would personally volunteer to participate in this later trial – Clinical Trial 3.

text: Indi lang ang iya anak!
english: Not just his son!

text: Dapat siya ang mag-risgo sang iya kabuhi agud ipalayo ang iya anak sa katalagman.
english: He should be the one to risk his life to keep his son out of danger.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Well, okey lang ina sa iya seguro.
english: Well, that’s okay with his insurance.

text: Ruso siya kag indi Filipino nga handa pangapinan ang iya mga anak sa ano man nga katalagman.
english: He is a Russian and not a Filipino who is ready to defend his children from any danger.

text:
***

Isa pa, ginapabugal gid ni Putin nga una gid ang Rusya sa pag-develop sining vaccine.
english:
***

Moreover, Putin is very proud that Russia is ahead in the development of this vaccine.

text: Pang-pogi points lang ini seguro, katulad sang una nga satellite (Sputnik) nga ginpalupad sang Rusya.
english: It's probably just for pogi points, like the first satellite (Sputnik) launched by Russia.

text: Ano abe ang mapabugal pa sang Rusya kay sa katapus-tapusan ang Estados Unidos man ang una nga nakatapak sa bulan, nga amo gid man ang target sang Rusya sa ila pagpalupad sang Sputnik 1 tubtub 4 nga ugaling naunahan pa sang Estados Unidos.
english: What else can Russia be proud of because in the end the United States was the first to step on the moon, which is the target of Russia in their launch of Sputnik 1 to 4 but ahead of the United States.

text: Ginatawag na sa karon sang Rusya ang pag-develop sang vaccine nga Sputnik 5.
english: Russia is now calling the development of the vaccine Sputnik 5.

text: Basi bala ang Estados Unidos, Germany, United Kingdom ukon Saudi pa ang una maka-mass produce sang Covid-19 vaccine nga hipus-hipos lang sang ila ginahikot agud maseguro gid nga “effective and safe” ini.
english: Maybe the United States, Germany, United Kingdom or Saudi Arabia will be the first to mass produce a Covid-19 vaccine that they are doing quietly to ensure that it is “effective and safe”.

text: May balita na gani nga maka-mass produce na sang vaccine ang Germany sa Oktubre 2020.
english: There is even news that Germany will be able to mass produce the vaccine in October 2020.

text: Duha ini ka bulan bag-o ang plano sangRusya sa pag-mass produce.
english: This was two months before Russia's plan to mass produce.

text:
***

Sa Filipinas, una si Presidente Duterte nga nagpahayag sa China nga kon pwede isa ang Filipinas makabaton ang COVID-19 vaccine nga i-produce sini.
english:
***

In the Philippines, President Duterte first told China that if possible, the Philippines would receive the COVID-19 vaccine it would produce.

text: Karon, sa sining balita sang Rusya, ang Rusya mismo ang nag-offer sa paghatag libre (kuno) sang kinahanglanon nga vaccine sini.
english: Now, with this Russian news, Russia itself has offered to provide free (allegedly) its much-needed vaccine.

text: Aba, pauna-una man gali ang pagbaton ni President Duterte sang vaccine sa Filipinas kag indi kay seguruhay.
english: Well, President Duterte's acceptance of the vaccine in the Philippines is premature and not because of insurance.

text: In fact, nag-boluntad siya nga una magpa-inoculate sang vaccine.
english: In fact, he volunteered to be vaccinated first.

text: Basi pa-pogi points lang seguro a. Man indi man siya qualified nga magbaton sing vaccine tungod sa iya katigulangon kag kahimtangan sang ikaayong lawas.
english: Maybe it's just for handsome points. He is also not qualified to receive the vaccine because of his age and health condition.

text: Basi indi mabaton sang iya lawas ang “adverse effect” sini sa iya.
english: Maybe his body can't accept the adverse effect.

text: Hulaton na lang seguro ni Presidente Duterte (kag ako man) nga malakip sa herd immunity nga madala sang 70-80% nga qualified bakunahan kag sang mga may natural immunity, kon may ara man.
english: President Duterte (and I) will probably wait for the herd immunity to be included in the 70-80% qualified vaccine and those with natural immunity, if any.

text: Isa pa, sa luyag nga isa kita sa maka-una, indi ayhan pareho man ini sa Dengvaxia nga samtang yara pa sa clinical trial ginpagamit na sa linibu naton nga mga kabataan, nga madamo sini ang nagkalamatay sa alegasyon kag ginpasaka nga court cases nga amo gid ini ang ginbangdan sang ila kamatayon?/PN
english: Also, in order to be one of the first, isn't it the same as Dengvaxia which while still in clinical trial has been used on thousands of our children, many of whom died in allegations and court cases that it was the cause of their deaths?/PN

text: Ginakabig nga mabudlay nga proseso ang pag-atubang sa isyu sa pagpangluib sa isa ka relasyon.
english: It is considered a difficult process to deal with the issue of infidelity in a relationship.

text: Ini ang kaangot man sa natabo nga pagbulagay sang actress nga si Andi Eigenmann kag sa bana sini nga si Philmar Alipayo bangud sa Swedish nga babaye nga ginatudlo third party sa ila relasyon.
english: This is also in connection with the separation of actress Andi Eigenmann and her husband Philmar Alipayo because of a Swedish woman who is allegedly a third party in their relationship.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Francis Ray Subong, registered guidance counselor, iya ginpahayag nga wala sang insakto nga formula kun paano ini atubangon, apang may mga pamaagi nga mahimo himuon agud mag-ayo kag makadesisyon kun ano ang masunod nga tikang.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Francis Ray Subong, registered guidance counselor, said there is no right formula on how to deal with it, but there are ways that can be done to get better and decide what the next step is.

text: Suno kay Subong, tuman nga maapektuhan sa tion nga may yara sang nasambit nga isyu amo ang psychological, social kag emotional nga aspeto sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: According to Subong, the psychological, social and emotional aspects of an individual are most affected when there is an issue.

text: Panugyan sini, agud maka-move on, nagakadapat nga pabay-an ang kaugalingon nga makabatyag sang emosyon kag batunon nga ini ang normal.
english: He advised that in order to move on, one should let oneself feel emotions and accept that they are normal.

text: Makabulig man ang suporta sang pamilya, mga abyan ukon isa ka therapist agud mabuligan nga magproseso sang emosyon kag makadesisyon sang insakto.
english: Support from family, friends or a therapist can also be helpful to help process emotions and make informed decisions.

text: Sa tion nga handa na, makig-istorya sa inyo partner agud mahibalunan ang rason sang pagpangluib.
english: Once ready, have a conversation with your partner to determine the reason for the cheating.

text: Ginpahayag sang natungdan nga ang maayo nga komunikasyon ang makabulig agud makuha ang sabat nga kinahanglan agud makadesisyon.
english: He said that good communication will help to get the answer needed to make a decision.

text: MAY dugang na nga kategoriya sang COVID-19 transmission diri sa Iloilo City kag sa pungsod – ang “community transmission” – sa diin ang tanan nga pumuluyo suspect na kay indi na lubos ma-identify ang mga na-close contact sang infected.
english: THERE is an additional category of COVID-19 transmission here in Iloilo City and in the country – the “community transmission” – where all residents are suspects because those who have been in close contact with the infected cannot be fully identified.

text: Angot diri, ang ginahimo sa karon sang siyudad sa pagpanguna ni Mayor Treñas, amo ang selective  quarantine ukon lockdown – bisan may isa lang ang mag-positive – sa mas malawak nga lugar sangsa immediate contact area, katulad sang bug-os nga barangay, kag dayon ipatuman ang mass testing sa ina nga mas malawak nga lugar.
english: In this regard, what the city is doing now under the leadership of Mayor Treñas, is selective quarantine or lockdown – even if there is only one positive – in a wider area than the immediate contact area, such as the entire barangay, and then implement mass testing in that wider area.

text: Sadto ang ginabantayan lang ang transmission sang COVID-19 halin sa mga pangayaw (turista, etc.) kag OFWs nga nakabalik sa pungsod, kag ang mga lokal nga residente nga nalatnan sang pangayaw kag sang ila na-close contact.
english: Previously, only the transmission of COVID-19 from foreigners (tourists, etc.) and OFWs who returned to the country, and local residents who were infected by foreigners and their close contacts were monitored.

text: Ginabaton man ang pagbalik sang mga local stranded individuals (LSI) halin sa iban nga lugar sang pungsod, nga dapat ma-quarantine anay kag ma-testing ang ila COVID-19 status bag-o papulion kon negative na.
english: The return of local stranded individuals (LSI) from other parts of the country is also accepted, who must be quarantined and tested for their COVID-19 status before being sent home if they are negative.

text: Ready man ang mga quarantine kag isolation facilities agud tatapon ang dapat masulod dira.
english: Quarantine and isolation facilities are also ready to take care of those who need to enter.

text:
***

Tungod wala sing matudlo sing lubos kon sin-o ang na-close contact sang na-identify nga infected – sa kaso sang community transmission – ang mayor nga ginasuspetsahan subong sang pila ka siyentipiko amo ang mga asymptomatic carrier, ukon wala nagapakita sintoma  sang COVID-19 nga daw wala lang masakit.
english:
***

Because no one can fully identify who was in close contact with the identified infected – in the case of community transmission – the main suspect now of some scientists are asymptomatic carriers, or those who do not show symptoms of COVID-19 as if they are not sick.

text: Ang symptomatic naman nagapakita sang sintoma katulad sang hilanat, ubo kag pagpin-ut sang pagginhawa, kundi dayon sa pila pa ka masunod nga inadlaw.
english: Symptomatic shows symptoms such as fever, cough and shortness of breath, but then for the next few days.

text: Sa inisyal nga findings sa China, wala nila ginasapak ang asymptomatic kay indi kuno ini makalaton, kag kon makalaton man, “rare” lang.
english: In the initial findings in China, they ignore the asymptomatic because they say it is not contagious, and if it is contagious, it is “rare”.

text: Ang pila ka siyentipiko sa iban nga pungsod wala ugaling gapati sini kag nagapati nga basi amo pa ini ang mayor nga kabangdanan sang madasig nga transmission.
english: Some scientists in other countries, however, do not believe this and believe that it may be the main cause of rapid transmission.

text: Nga-a man?
english: Why is that?

text: Sunu kay Catherine Beauchemin, isa ka propesor sa Virophysics sa Ryerson University, tatlo ka klase ang pag-infect sang COVID-19 virus.
english: According to Catherine Beauchemin, a professor of Virophysics at Ryerson University, there are three types of infection with the COVID-19 virus.

text: Ang duha sini amo nga ang infection ulihi ukon una indi anay magpakita sang sintoma.
english: Both of these are that the infection later or earlier will not show symptoms.

text: Ang una, kon madugay maka-react ang immune system sa infection kag ang sintoma makapakita sing ulihi na, nga laban-laban sa kaso sang symptomatic; kag, ikaduha, kon  mauna mag-react ang immune system kag wala pa makapakita sing sintoma, nga pwede sa kaso sang asymptomatic.
english: The first is that the immune system takes longer to react to the infection and symptoms appear later, especially in symptomatic cases; and, second, if the immune system reacts first and has not yet shown symptoms, which is possible in the case of asymptomatic.

text: Ang ikatatlo nga kahigayunan nga maka-infect ang COVID-19 amo nga laban nga infection “very mild” kag kulang sang kabaskug agud awayon ang mabaskug nga immune response sang tawo kag “mapatay” pa gani ini sang immune system.
english: The third way to infect COVID-19 is that most infections are “very mild” and lack the strength to fight the strong immune response of the person and even “kill” the immune system.

text: Posible man ugaling, sunu man sa iban nga siyentipiko, nga may makapalagyo nga virus kag makapanago sa kon diin ini makapamuad sang ulihi, nga kaya na sini halitan ang iya biktima pagkatapos nga ma-deklarar na nga negative ang carrier.
english: It is also possible, however, according to some scientists, that the virus can escape and hide where it can reproduce later, that it can harm its victim after the carrier is declared negative.

text: Tungod sini, kinahangln nga ma-follow up ang nag-alayo nga asymptomatic agud maseguro nga lubos gid sila nga hilway sa COVID-19 virus, samtang ginatultol kon diin ang pila ka virus nagapanago.
english: Because of this, it is necessary to follow up those who have recovered asymptomatic to ensure that they are completely free of the COVID-19 virus, while pinpointing where some viruses are hiding.

text: Katulad bala sa kaso ni Typhoid Mary, ang ginbansag nga ngalan kay Mary Mallon (1869-1938).
english: As in the case of Typhoid Mary, nicknamed Mary Mallon (1869-1938).

text: Napamatud-an sang mga health authorities nga carrier siya sang salmonella typhi, ang bacteria nga nagadulot sang masakit nga typhoid, samtang wala siya iya nagabatyag sining balatian.
english: Health authorities confirmed that he was a carrier of salmonella typhi, the bacteria that causes typhoid, while he did not feel the disease.

text: Bilang manugluto (cook) sa Sloane Maternity sa Manhattan, ginlatnan niya sang typhoid, sa sulod lang sang tatlo ka bulan, ang indi  magnubo sa 25 ka mga doktor, nars, kag iban pa nga staff.
english: As a cook at Sloane Maternity in Manhattan, she infected typhoid, in just three months, with at least 25 doctors, nurses, and other staff.

text: Nangin cook man siya sa iban nga lugar kag didto may nagmasakit man sing typhoid.
english: He also worked as a cook in another place and there someone also got sick with typhoid.

text: Tungod sini napilitan ang mga otoridad nga ipa-quarantine siya sa North Brother Island sing duha ka  beses sa kabug-usan nga 26 anyos tubtub siya napatay diri, pagkatapos nga ginbangdan siya sing outbreak sang typhoid sa  New York sa diin mga 3,000 ka mga tawo ang nagmasakit sa amo nga balatian.
english: This forced authorities to quarantine him on North Brother Island twice for a total of 26 years until he died here, after he caused an outbreak of typhoid in New York where about 3,000 people became ill with the disease.

text: Ang post mortem niya ginsugid nga nagpakita sang presensya sang salmonella typhi bacteria sa iya gallstones, nga nangin “factory” gali sang ini nga mikrobyo sa iya lawas.
english: His post mortem reportedly showed the presence of salmonella typhi bacteria in his gallstones, which turned out to be a “factory” of this microbe in his body.

text: Kon  ngaa wala siya iya nag-sufrir sang balatian nga typhoid, ang paathag amo ang exceptional nga naturalisa sang iya immune system agud ma-kontrol ang pagpanghalit sang bacteria sa iya ikaayong lawas bisan nagapabilin ini sila sa iya lawas./PN
english: The explanation for why he did not suffer from typhoid is the exceptional naturalization of his immune system to control the damage caused by bacteria to his health even though they remain in his body.

text: ILOILO CITY- Adlaw-adlaw, kabahin na sang kabuhi naton ang pagkaon sang kan-un.
english: ILOILO CITY- Every day, eating food is part of our lives.

text: Ang iban, indi gid kompleto ang isa ka adlaw kun indi makakaon sang manamit kag mainit nga tinig-ang.
english: Others, a day is not complete without eating a delicious and hot meal.

text: Apang, kun paano ini gina-enjoy sang kalabanan, ini naman ang nagahatag sang kahadlok sa isa ka babaye didto sa may Massachussets.
english: However, as much as most people enjoy it, it scares a woman in Massachusetts.

text: Siya amo si Caroline Cray, 24, nga may yara sang rare chronic illness nga nagresulta kun ngaa allergic ini sa halos tanan nga butang bisan pa ang pagkaon kaangay sang tinapay kag kan-on.
english: She is Caroline Cray, 24, who has a rare chronic illness that results in her being allergic to almost everything even food like bread and rice.

text: Suno kay Caroline, ang iya nalang ginakaon amo ang ginrekomendar sang doktor- gatas para sa bata kag oatmeal.
english: According to Caroline, she only eats what the doctor recommended - milk for the baby and oatmeal.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, apisar updanay sila sang iya pamilya sa panyapon, haloson man ini mag-enjoy bangud nga halos bawal sa iya ang ginakaon sang iya pamilya kaangay sang isda, peanuts, sesame, kiwis kag mustard.
english: In fact, although they are with his family for dinner, he almost enjoys it because he is almost forbidden to eat what his family eats such as fish, peanuts, sesame, kiwis and mustard.

text: Ang ano man nga pagkaon ang posible mangin last supper niya kun indi siya maghalong.
english: Any meal could be his last supper if he's not careful.

text: Bisan sa paglagaw, may dala gid ini nga kaugalingon nga balon agud kun abuton siya sang kagutom, may yara ini sang sarang makaon nga safe para kaunon niya.
english: Even when traveling, he always carries his own lunch so that if he is hungry, he has something safe to eat.

text: Sa masami, ginatulok siya sang mga tawo ilabi na kun yara ini sa mga restaurants kag cafe bangud may yara siya sang balunan nga ginasudlan sang iya pagkaon.
english: People often stare at him especially when he is in restaurants and cafes because he has a bag to put his food in.

text: Pilason ang lalaki matapos mabun-an sang iya boardmate nga ginpahayag nga ginlingling niya samtang nagapakighilawas sa iya girlfriend sa West Habog-habog, Molo, Iloilo City sang Pebrero 13, 2026.
english: A man was injured after being stabbed by his boardmate who allegedly glanced at him while having sex with his girlfriend in West Habog-habog, Molo, Iloilo City on February 13, 2026.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas Raymond, driver, samtang ang suspek amo si alyas Janjan, pahinante, lunsay pangayaw kag legal ang pang-edaron.
english: The victim was identified as Raymond, driver, while the suspect was identified as Janjan, driver, both foreigners and legal age.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 4, iya ginpahayag nga isa lang ka boarding house ang ginatiniran sang suspek kag biktima kun sa diin ginaakupa ni alyas Raymond ang lower bunk kag sa upper bunk naman si alyas Janjan.
english: Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 4, said the suspect and the victim were living in the same boarding house where Raymond occupied the lower bunk and Janjan occupied the upper bunk.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, kun kaisa, ginahulam ni alyas Janjan ang kwarto kun magkadto ang iya nobya.
english: According to the investigation, sometimes, alias Janjan borrows the room when his girlfriend comes.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan nga nagkomprontahanay ang duha bangud nga ginapalapta sang biktima nga nakita niya ang suspek kag ang iya nobya nga nagapakighilawas.
english: He added that the two confronted each other because the victim spread the word that he saw the suspect and his girlfriend having sex.

text: Didto na nabun-an ang biktima.
english: The victim was stabbed.

text: Gilayon nagpalagyo ang suspek padulong sa Baluarte, apang na-recover ang gin-gamit sini nga kitchen knife.
english: The suspect immediately fled to Baluarte, but the kitchen knife he used was recovered.

text: Yara naman sa estable nga kondisyon ang biktima matapos nakaagum sang pilas sa iya wala nga butkon.
english: The victim is in stable condition after sustaining injuries to his left arm.

text: Posible nga magpangatubang sang kaso nga frustrated homicide ang suspek sa tion nga magpasaka na sang reklamo ang biktima.
english: The suspect is likely to face charges of frustrated homicide once the victim files a complaint.

text: Reported by: Bombo Phauline Pillora
english: Reported by: Bombo Phauline Pillora

text: May mga pilas nga wala nagaayo.
english: There are wounds that don’t heal.

text: Masami nga ginaangot naton ini nga mga tinaga sa mga naagyan nga kasakit sa paghigugma ukon pag-abyanay ukon anuman nga malain nga eksperyensya sa kabuhi, apang may literal gid nga pilas sa imo lawas nga indi mo dapat pagpabay-an ilabi na kun malawig na ini nga wala nagaayo.
english: We often associate these words with past pain in love or friendship or any bad experience in life, but there is a very literal wound in your body that you should not neglect especially if it has not healed for a long time.

text: Suno kay Dr. Christi Cavaliere, Medical Director sang Wound Care sa Cleveland, Ohio, ini nga chronic wound ang posible magatuga sang mas delikado nga komplikasyon.
english: According to Dr. Christi Cavaliere, Medical Director of Wound Care in Cleveland, Ohio, this chronic wound is likely to cause a more dangerous complication.

text: Ang chronic wound suno kay Cavaliere ang nagaumpisa lang nga kaangay kagamay sang scratch ukon daw punggod apang nagalala nga nagalala kag wala na nagakipot.
english: A chronic wound, Cavaliere said, starts as small as a scratch or bump but gets worse and worse and doesn't heal.

text: Posible nga naangot ini sa diabetic ulcers, venous leg ulcers kag pressure ulcers.
english: It is likely associated with diabetic ulcers, venous leg ulcers and pressure ulcers.

text: Suno naman kay Dr. Bruce Ruben, Founder kag Medical Director sang Encompass HealthCare, isa ka outpatient facility nga naga-feature sang advanced wound care, posible man nga maangot ang wala nagaayo nga pilas sa: Poor Circulation, Infection, Edema ukon fluid nga nagatipon sa panit, dermis ukon fatty tissue nga masami nagakatabo sa lower extremities, Inadequate Nutrition, kag sulit-sulit nga trauma sa pilas.
english: According to Dr. Bruce Ruben, Founder and Medical Director of Encompass HealthCare, an outpatient facility featuring advanced wound care, it is also possible to link a non-healing wound to: Poor Circulation, Infection, Edema or fluid buildup in the skin, dermis or fatty tissue that often occurs in the lower extremities, Nutrition, Nutrition repeated wound trauma.

text: Suhestyon sang mga medical experts, likawi gid ang paggamit sang anti-inflammatory drugs, magkaon gid sang maayo, ilakip ang vitamin C sa imo diet, i-dress ang imo pilas, maghimo sang regular exercise bangud ginapaayo sini ang imo blood flow, kag indi gid magpanigarilyo.
english: Medical experts suggest that you avoid using anti-inflammatory drugs, eat well, include vitamin C in your diet, dress your wound, do regular exercise because it improves your blood flow, and never smoke.

text: Labaw sa tanan,importante gid nga magpakonsulta sa doktor kun may pilas ka nga amo sini.
english: Above all,it is very important to consult a doctor if you have an injury like this.

text: BILIB kita kay Iloilo City Treasurer Jinny Hermano sa pag-amlig sa kaban (finances) sang siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: We admire Iloilo City Treasurer Jinny Hermano for protecting the finances of Iloilo City.

text: Tandaan ta pa sadtong Abril 2019 sang wala hadlok-hadlok nga gin-blanka sini si anay Mayor Jose Espinosa III sa legislative inquiry sang Sangguniang Panlungsod kon bala bayaran ang sweldo sang mga “excess job hires” ukon indi sa natalana nga quota sang kada departamento.
english: Let us remember in April 2019 when he fearlessly blanked former Mayor Jose Espinosa III in the legislative inquiry of the Sangguniang Panlungsod on whether to pay the salaries of the “excess job hires” or not to the quota of each department.

text: Siling niya nga indi niya mapasugtan nga pirmahan ang payroll sang mga “excess job hires”, nga gintugtan idugang sang administrasyon ni Mayor Espinosa sa idalom sang 2018 reenacted budget.
english: He said he will not allow the signing of the payroll of the “excess job hires”, which was allowed to be added by the administration of Mayor Espinosa under the 2018 reenacted budget.

text: Ining mga dugang nga mga job hires naglab-ut sa 189 sadtong Enero 2019 kag 199 sang Pebrero 2019.
english: These additional job hires totaled 189 in January 2019 and 199 in February 2019.

text: Ang balayran sang siyudad nga mga swedlo sa sining dugang nga job hires naglab-ut sa P784,000 para sa 189 sa ila kag P1,057,000 para sa 199.
english: The city's salary payments to these additional job hires amounted to P784,000 for 189 of them and P1,057,000 for 199.

text: Ginpilit ni Treasurer Jinny nga ipabilin ang kadamuon sang mga job hires nga gintalana lang sa 2018 reenacted budget.
english: Treasurer Jinny insisted on keeping the number of job hires just set in the 2018 reenacted budget.

text: Angot diri, ginbalewala man niya ang opinyon sang City Legal Office (CLO) kag DILG nga mapasugtan ang pagbayad sa mga sweldo sang mga “excess job hires”.
english: In this regard, he also ignored the opinion of the City Legal Office (CLO) and DILG to allow the payment of salaries of excess job hires.

text: Sunu sa ila, pwede man wala siya sing liability sa idalom sang kasuguan kon isulat sini ang iya objection.
english: According to them, he may not be liable under the law if he writes his objection.

text: Indi niya kuno mahimo ini, ugaling, kay kon himuon niya ini mawad-an sing pondo ang mga job hires sa masunod nga anom ka bulan kag wala naman siya mahatag sa ila sa pag-abot sinang tion.
english: He said he could not do this, however, because if he did the job hires would lose their funds for the next six months and he would not be able to give them back by then.

text: Bilib a!
english: Impress!

text: imagine, gin-blanka niya ang CLO, ang DILG kag si Mayor Espinosa.
english: imagine, he blanked the CLO, the DILG and Mayor Espinosa.

text: Daw “genie” sa kapoderoso si Treasurer Jinny ba!
english: Treasurer Jinny is like a “genie” to the powerful!

text:
***

Bilib man kita kay Treasurer Jinny sang gin-pamulta gid niya ang isa ka senior citizen sang magpalya ini sa pagbayad sa burial fee sang iya tiya bisan pa sa paathag sini.
english:
***

We also admire Treasurer Jinny when she fined a senior citizen for failing to pay her aunt's burial fee despite her explanation.

text: “Reklamo ka lang kay meyor kon luyag mo,” siling pa niya sa iya paathag nga amo gid ina ang ginapatuman nila nga wala exception.
english: “You can just complain to the mayor if you want,” he said, explaining that that is what they are enforcing without exception.

text: Kon nagpalya man sa pagbayad ang 80 anyos nga tigulang, ina tungod wala ginbaton sang manugsukot ni Treasurer Jinny ang iya bayad nga abanse sadtong Nobyembre ukon Disyembre 2019 kay pwede man kuno sa 2020 lang ini himuon.
english: If the 80-year-old failed to pay, it was because Treasurer Jinny's collector did not accept his payment in advance in November or December 2019 because it could only be done in 2020.

text: Masadya (nga indi masadya) kay nalimtan sang tigulang ang magbayad sang burial fee sa nitso sang iya tiya sa Tanza Cemetery – nga siya gid ang naga-atipan tungod wala na ini sing iya kaugalingon nga pamilya – pag-abot sang Enero 2020 tubtub sining ulihi.
english: Happy (not happy) because the old man forgot to pay the burial fee for his aunt's grave in Tanza Cemetery – which he was taking care of because he had no family of his own – until January 2020 until recently.

text: Tungod seguro medyo mahina na ang memorya sang tigulang nga 80 anyos, nadumduman lang niya magbayad sining Agosto 3, 2020, nga natabo lang sang ulayhon siya nangayo sing prescription para sa iya maintenance sa kay Dra.
english: Because the memory of the 80-year-old is probably a bit weak, he only remembered to pay this August 3, 2020, which happened only when he asked for a prescription for his maintenance from Dra.

text: Calsas sa inang adlaw mismo.
english: Calsas on the same day.

text: Thanks Doc!
english: Thanks Doc!

text: Kon nadumduman man niya sang ulihi, indi naman siya makagwa tungod ang siyudad nagdeklarar sang lockdown sang Marso, sa diin gina-prohibir ang paggwa sang mga senior citizen, tubtub ginpaluag-luag na ang regulasyon.
english: If he remembered later, he could not go out because the city declared a lockdown in March, where senior citizens were prohibited from going out, until the regulations were relaxed.

text:
***

Gahatag gani kita 20 percent discount sa bulong sang senior citizen kag five percent sa grocery, discount sa electricity bill, ginlibre nga VAT, kag iban pa nga privelegio, ngaa abe indi gid mapasensyahan ni Treasurer Jinny ang ining senior citizen nga nag-ofrescer pa sa pagbayad abanse, ugaling lang kay wala pagbatuna.
english:
***

Even if we give 20 percent discount on senior citizen's medicine and five percent on grocery, discount on electricity bill, exempted VAT, and other privileges, why can't Treasurer Jinny be patient with this senior citizen who offered to pay in advance, but was not accepted.

text: Dapat tani natagaan pa ini sing discount sa pagbayad abanse.
english: It should have been given a discount for paying in advance.

text: Pero, ginmulthan pa sang magbayad sang ulihi nga indi man siya mabasol tungod sa mga circumstancia.
english: However, the payer was fined later that he was not to blame because of the circumstances.
