text: “Not by the letter but the spirit of the law” ang tani gin-apply ni Treasurer Jinny, nga tapos sa abogasiya, sa kaso sining tigulang nga luyag magbayad sing abanse, ugaling lang kay wala pagbatuna, kag, in consequence, namultahan pa.
english: “Not by the letter but the spirit of the law” should have been applied by Treasurer Jinny, who graduated from law, in the case of this old man who wanted to pay in advance, but was not accepted, and, in consequence, was fined.

text: Wala patawad matuod si Treasurer Genie, este, Jinny!
english: Treasurer Genie is not forgiving, or Jinny!

text: Nanotaran nman naton nga wala ngalan – nameplate ukon kasubong man nga paghingadlan – ang mga manugsukot ni Treasurer Jinny.
english: We also note that Treasurer Jinny's collectors do not have nameplates or similar designations.

text: Ti, kay sin-o na lang maka-reklamo ang mga pumuluyo nga nagabayad sang ila fees kag buhis sa Treasurer’s Office?
english: Well, to whom can the citizens who pay their fees and taxes to the Treasurer's Office complain?

text: In fact, kon pamangkuton mo indi man gani maghatag sang ila ngalan kag pabudlayan ka pa sa pagpangutana dito sa sulod sa mga dalagku ulo.
english: In fact, if you ask them they won't even give you their names and they'll make it harder for you to ask the big heads in here.

text: Siling ko anay “transparency” nga polisa ang ginapatuman sa Treasurer’s Office.
english: I said earlier that a “transparency” policy is being implemented in the Treasurer’s Office.

text: Ti, ngaa wala sing luyag maghatag sing ngalan ang nagreklamo nga tigulang sa mga empleyado mo, Treasurer Jinny?/PN
english: Well, why doesn't anyone want to give the name of the complaining old man to your employees, Treasurer Jinny?/PN

text: Ginaduso ni 5th District Representative Binky April Tupas ang pagtukod sang separado nga Schools Division sa Northern Iloilo.
english: 5th District Representative Binky April Tupas is proposing the establishment of a separate Schools Division in Northern Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo, ginpahayag sang representante nga ang Schools Division of Iloilo amo ang ikatlo sa pinakadako sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the representative said the Schools Division of Iloilo is the third largest in the country.

text: May ara ini sang ginabulubanta 20,000 ka mga empleyado, rason nga suno sa iya, “physically impossible” nga matutukan ang 1,174 ka mga eskwelahan.
english: It has approximately 20,000 employees, making it “physically impossible” to focus on 1,174 schools.

text: Dugang pa niya, ang pagtukod sang Schools Division of Northern Iloilo mangin pabor gid para sa mga pumuluyo sa norte, ilabi na gid sa mga island schools.
english: He added that the establishment of the Schools Division of Northern Iloilo will be very favorable for the people in the north, especially the island schools.

text: Sa subong, wala pa sang pinal nga desisyon kun diin ibutang ang opisina sang nasambit nga schools division bangud yara pa lamang ini sa 2nd Reading sa Kongreso kag ginatinguhaan nga maistorya ang Chair sa Committee on Ways and Means agud nga mapondohan.
english: At present, there is no final decision on where to locate the office of the said schools division as it is still in 2nd Reading in Congress and efforts are being made to talk to the Chair of the Committee on Ways and Means to be funded.

text: Nangabay man si Tupas kay Senator Bam Aquino, chair sang Senate Committee on Education, nga mag-file sang counterpart bill sa Senado agud mapabakod ang pagtukod sang separado nga Schools Division sa Northern Iloilo.
english: Tupas also asked Senator Bam Aquino, chair of the Senate Committee on Education, to file a counterpart bill in the Senate to strengthen the establishment of a separate Schools Division in Northern Iloilo.

text: PAALAM Larry!
english: GOODBYE Larry!

text: Sa madamo, lakip na ang amon pamilya, wala na seguro sing pamilya nga may kaalwan kasubong sang Familia Jamora.
english: For many, including our family, there is probably no family as generous as the Jamora Family.

text: Wala sing kubos nga nagpalapit sa ila nga wala nabuligan, kag kon sin-o pa nga nakita nila nga dapat buligan sa ila  kinawala ukon sa ano man nga talabangan.
english: There was not a poor man who came to them who was not helped, and whoever else they saw should be helped in their need or in any other way.

text: Madamo sila iskolar halin sa kubos nga panimalay nga napatapos sa pagtuon tubtub sa kolehiyo.
english: They have many scholars from poor families who have completed their studies up to college.

text: Madamo man sila natagaan sing trabaho sa ila mga negosyo kag napabilin sa Ginuo tungod familia religiosa sila.
english: They also gave many jobs in their businesses and remained in the Lord because they were religious families.

text: Gani ginakasubo gid sang amon pamilya, nga nangin malapit sa ila ginikanan kag kabataan sing madugay, kag sang madamo pa, ang balita sa radyo, nga na-confirm sang iya hinablos nga si anay konsehal Dave Jamora, nga nagtaliwan na si Larry sadtong Hulyo 30.
english: So our family, who has been close to their parents and children for so long, and many others, is deeply saddened by the news on the radio, confirmed by his nephew former councilman Dave Jamora, that Larry had passed away on July 30th.

text: Malapit man si Larry sa amon nga mga journalist.
english: Larry is also close to us journalists.

text: Daw amay kag abyan lang siya namon kon magpakighambaro sa amon.
english: He was like a father and a friend to us.

text: Masinadyahon siya kag may pagka-tarso, nga daw pareho lang ang iya tindug – tag-iya sila sang MaryMart Mall kag may madamo nga negosyo kag propiedad – sa  katulad namon nga mga ordinaryo nga journalist.
english: He was cheerful and sarcastic, as if he were on the same level – they owned the MaryMart Mall and had many businesses and properties – with ordinary journalists like us.

text: Wala sing bugal.
english: There is no pride.

text: Wala man siya sing pagdumot sa mga journalist nga naga-kritikar sa iya sa mga tindug niya sa pulitika kag sa ano man nga isyu pang-sosyedad.
english: He also has no grudge against journalists who criticize him for his political positions and any social issue.

text: Gani abyan siya sang tanan!
english: So he's everyone's friend!

text: We miss you, Larry!
english: We miss you, Larry!

text: Segurado naton nga kaupod mo na (kag ang imo ginikanan nga si Atty Juan Jr.
english: We are sure that you (and your parents, Atty Juan Jr.

text: kag Mrs. Jamora kag si Angelo) ang Ginuo sa tion nga ini sa iya matahum nga Kaharian sa katubtuban.
english: and Mrs. Jamora and Angelo) the Lord at this time in his beautiful Kingdom forever.

text:
***

Ang experyensya naton sa “mild” kag “asymptomatic” cases nagapakita nga pwede naton dag-on ang COVID-19 bisan paagi lang sa innate immune system (immune system at birth), samtang wala pa ang bulig sang acquired immune system nga hatag sang vaccine, nga tubtub subong wala pa sing kapihuan kon san-o magamit na sang publiko.
english:
***

Our experience with “mild” and “asymptomatic” cases shows that we can defeat COVID-19 even through the innate immune system (immune system at birth), while without the help of the acquired immune system provided by the vaccine, which is still uncertain when it will be available to the public.

text: Ang innate immune system (IIS) isa ka rapid response system, nga dayon nagaaway sa “foreign invader”, nga wala nagakilala kon ini virus, bacteria, fungi ukon toxins man nga gina-producir sang microbes.
english: The innate immune system (IIS) is a rapid response system, which then fights the “foreign invader”, without recognizing whether it is a virus, bacteria, fungi or even toxins produced by microbes.

text: Indi ini katulad sang vaccine nga nagaaway lang sa specific nga target, nga nagagamit sang napaluya (weakened) nga mga virus agud mag-invoke sang immune response sang IIS kag mag-producir sang antibodies nga ipaaway sa kasahi sini nga “invading” virus, katulad sang COVID-19.
english: This is not like a vaccine that fights only a specific target, which uses weakened viruses to invoke the immune response of IIS and produce antibodies to fight this type of “invading” virus, such as COVID-19.

text: Pero, paano ini ginahimo sang IIS?
english: But, how does IIS do this?

text: Sunu sa mga siyentipiko nga nagatuon parti sa viruses, katulad sang COVID-19, kinahanglan nga makaya sang IIS ang nagaatake nga mga virus.
english: According to scientists who study viruses, such as COVID-19, IIS needs to cope with invading viruses.

text: Kinahanglan lang nga makaaway sang IIS ang viral load, ukon ang kadamuon sang virus, nga kaya niya dag-on.
english: IIS only needs to be able to fight the viral load, or the amount of virus, that it can beat.

text: Ang away sang IIS paagi sa iya immune cells, ukon phagocytes, nagasugod sa pagsulod pa lang sang virus sa mga ganhaaan sang lawas tubtub sa pagsulod sini nga wala pa makapuyo sa host body cells kon diin mamuad, kag bisan nakagwa na ini agud manghalit sa iban nga bahin sang lawas.
english: The fight against IIS through its immune cells, or phagocytes, begins as soon as the virus enters the body's doorways until it enters the host body cells where it reproduces, and even out to harm other parts of the body.

text: Ining low viral load sang COVID-19 mapaseguro sa pagsunod sa health protocols katulad sang physical distancing, paggamit sang face mask, handwashing, kag paglikaw sa pagtandug sang mahigko nga kamot sa ilong, baba kag mata.
english: This low viral load of COVID-19 can be ensured by following health protocols such as physical distancing, wearing face masks, handwashing, and avoiding touching the nose, mouth and eyes with dirty hands.

text: Importante man nga mabakud, ukon napabakud, ang IIS paagi sa healthy diet, bastante nga ehersisyo, indi magpa-stress kag may maayo nga tulog, labi na gid kon naghina na ang IIS.
english: It is also important to strengthen, or strengthen, the IIS through a healthy diet, sufficient exercise, avoiding stress and getting good sleep, especially if the IIS has weakened.

text: Sa malip-ut, a healthy lifestyle means a healthy immune system.
english: In short, a healthy lifestyle means a healthy immune system.

text: Sa amo ina nga kahimtangan – gasunod sa health protocols kag mabakud ang IIS – either mahilway ka sa infection, ukon ma-infect lang sing “mild” nga mahapos paayuhon, ukon wala nagapakita sing sintoma (asymptomatic) tungod lubos na nga “napatay” ukon “rendered inactive” sang phagocytes ang mga “invading” virus.
english: In that case – following health protocols and having a strong IIS – either you will be free of infection, or you will be infected mildly, or asymptomatic because the invading viruses have been completely “killed” or “rendered inactive” by the phagocytes.

text: Ang pag-away sang phagocytes sang IIS ginahimo sini paagi sa pagputos (envelope) sang mga virus nga na-overwhelm nila tubtub “mapatay”.
english: The phagocytes of IIS do this by enveloping viruses that they overwhelm until they “die”.

text: Sa masami, ang mga linghod ang may mabakud nga IIS, nga nagahina ugaling sa pagdugang sang edad, luas lang kon ma-boost sing nagakaigu.
english: Usually, young people have strong IIS, which weakens with age, unless boosted appropriately.

text: In fact, indi ini imposible bisan sa mga tigulang na.
english: In fact, it is not impossible even for the elderly.

text: Pila ka kaso sang COVID-19 nagapakita nga naka-survive ini sila samtang “critical” ang ila sitwasyon.
english: Several cases of COVID-19 show that they survived while their condition was “critical”.

text: Ina seguro kay bisan high viral load ang nag-atake sa ila nabuligan tambag ini sang napabakud nga IIS nga padayon nagaaway sa COVID-19 virus./PN
english: That's probably because even high viral load attacked them helped this advice of the strengthened IIS that continues to fight the COVID-19 virus./PN

text: May pagsaka sang presyo sang mga isda sa pila ka mga merkado sa Iloilo City, partikular sa La Paz Public Market subong nga Semana Santa.
english: There is an increase in the price of fish in some markets in Iloilo City, particularly in the La Paz Public Market this Easter Season.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Miss Joy, iya ka fish vendor, iya ginpahayag nga nagtaas ang presyo sang mga isda bangud sa limitado ang sakayan nga ginagamit sa pagpangisda.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Miss Joy, her fish vendor, said the price of fish has increased due to the limited number of boats used for fishing.

text: Suno kay Joy, kalabanan sa iya supply nga isda ang naghalin sa Estancia, Banate, Carles, kag Concepcion.
english: According to Joy, most of her fish supply comes from Estancia, Banate, Carles, and Concepcion.

text: Gintuad sini nga ang presyo sang kasag ang yara sa P550 kada kilo, samtang ang tamodyos ang P300 per kilo, bulaw nga P340 per kilo kag ang bukaw-bukaw nga P360 tubtob P380 kada kilo.
english: He admitted that the price of kasag is at P550 per kilo, while tamodyos is P300 per kilo, bulaw is P340 per kilo and bukaw-bukaw is P360 to P380 per kilo.

text: Ginpahayag man sang natungdan lauman pagid ang pagtaas sang presyo inadlaw antes ang Huwebes kag Byernes Santo.
english: He also said that price increases are expected in the days before Thursday and Good Friday.

text: Nagkasugtanay na ang Afghanistan kag Pakistan nga magpatuman sang temporaryo nga ceasefire matapos ang pila ka semana nga inaway nga nagresulta sa kamatayon sang madamo nga mga tawo.
english: Afghanistan and Pakistan have agreed to impose a temporary ceasefire after weeks of fighting that left scores of people dead.

text: Ang nasambit nga ceasefire, nga ginpangunahan sang Qatar kag Turkey, gilayon man nga ginpatuman agud mapunggan anay ang bayluhanay sang lupok sa border sang duha ka pungsod.
english: The ceasefire, led by Qatar and Turkey, was also immediately implemented to prevent the exchange of fire on the border between the two countries.

text: Matandaan nga naglala ang tensyon umpisa pa sa sini bulan.
english: Tensions have been escalating since this month.

text: Ginapanginwala naman sang Taliban-led government sang Afghanistan ang mga alegasyon nga nagahatag ini sang refuge sa mga militante nga naga-atake sa border areas.
english: Afghanistan's Taliban-led government has denied allegations that it provides refuge to militants attacking border areas.

text: Suno sa spokesperson sang Taliban nga si Zabihullah Mujahid, naghisugtanay ang duha ka kampi nga indi magpatigayon sang bisan ano man nga indi manami nga lihok sa isa kag isa.
english: According to Taliban spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid, the two sides agreed not to carry out any unpleasant moves against each other.

text: Lakip sa ceasefire ang pagdumili sa pagsuporta sa mga grupo nga nagapatigayon sang pag-atake sa pihak nga kampo.
english: The ceasefire includes a refusal to support groups conducting attacks on the other camp.

text: Dugang pa, may mga tikang nga ginahimo kaupod sang mga pungsod nga naga-serbe bilang mediator, agud masiguro ang matawhay nga implementasyon sang ceasefire kag ang posible nga diplomatic nga resolusyon sa mga indi pag-intindihanay.
english: In addition, steps are being taken in conjunction with mediating countries, to ensure the peaceful implementation of the ceasefire and the possible diplomatic resolution of differences.

text: SA SONA ni President Duterte sadtong Lunes, Hulyo 27, gin-proponer sini sa Kongreso ang pagpabalik sang death penalty, ukon ang silot nga kamatayon.
english: In President Duterte's SONA on Monday, July 27, he proposed to Congress the restoration of the death penalty.

text: By the way, nakalamho ang isa naton ka abyan sa sining panawagan ni Presidente Duterte sa Kongreso agud ipasar gid ang kasuguan, nga mayor sa iya isip ang pagpapapas sa mga ilegalista sa droga, labi na gid ang mga mayor nga personalidad sa sining salot sa sosyedad.
english: By the way, one of our friends has heard of President Duterte's call to Congress to pass the law, which is mainly in mind to eradicate drug illegals, especially the major personalities in this plague in society.

text: Siling niya indi na ini kinahanglan tungod actually padayon man ini ginapatuman sang Duterte Administrasyon sa linibu na nga napatay sa Gyera Kontra Droga.
english: He said it is no longer necessary because actually the Duterte Administration continues to implement it for the thousands who have died in the War on Drugs.

text: Ugaling lang kay madamo sini ang ginatudlo sang mga human rights advocates sa extrajudicial killings, ukon pagpatay nga indi ayon sa kasuguan sa “due process” kag “fair trial” bag-o husgaran ang isa ka akusado.
english: However, many of these human rights advocates point to extrajudicial killings, or killings that are not in accordance with the law in due process and fair trial before an accused is tried.

text: Well, iya nga panghuna-huna ina sang aton abyan.
english: Well, that's our friend's opinion.

text: Indi lang ako da magtugda a. Tutok lang ako sa kon ano man ang tindug ko sa pagduso ni Presidente Duterte sang pagpabalik sang death penalty, pagkatapos nga na-suspende ini sadtong 2006 sa panahon ni anay Presidente Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo (2001-2010).
english: I'm not the only one who suggests. I am focused on whatever my position is on President Duterte's proposal to restore the death penalty, after it was suspended in 2006 during the time of former President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo (2001-2010).

text: Nanotaran niya sadto nga wala man makapauntat ining death penalty sa mga kriminal sang mga “heinous crimes” katulad sang murder, rape, kidnapping, drug trafficking kag iban pa.
english: He noted that the death penalty has not stopped criminals from committing “heinous crimes” such as murder, rape, kidnapping, drug trafficking and others.

text:
***

Upod kita sa panindugan ni Presidente Arroyo nga indi na dapat matuod ibalik ang death penalty nga ginpatuman niya sa idalom sang RA 9346 of 2006 nga amo subong ang nagagahum.
english:
***

We share President Arroyo's position that the death penalty imposed by her under RA 9346 of 2006 should not be restored.

text: Una nga rason amo ang obserbasyon ni Presidente Arroyo nga sige gihapon ang nagakatabo nga mga “heinous crimes” halin sa 1946 tubtub sa pagsugod sang iya termino sadtong 2001, pagkatapos nga napatalsik sa pwesto si President Erap Estrada tungod sa graft and corruption.
english: The first reason is President Arroyo's observation that heinous crimes continue to occur from 1946 until the beginning of her term in 2001, after President Erap Estrada was ousted for graft and corruption.

text: In fact, naglala na gid ang pagtuhaw sang mga “heinous crimes” nga dapat patawan sing death penalty.
english: In fact, the emergence of “heinous crimes” punishable by death has worsened.

text: Halin sa murder kag rape lang sadtong 1946, gindugangan na ini sang drug trafficking, tubtub nga naglala na gid nga naglakip na sang big-time drug trafficking, kidnapping for ransom, treason, piracy, qualified bribery, parricide, infanticide, plunder, kidnapping kag serious illegal detention, robbery with violence or intimidation, qualified vehicle theft kag arson.
english: From murder and rape in 1946, it was supplemented by drug trafficking, until it worsened to include big-time drug trafficking, kidnapping for ransom, treason, piracy, qualified bribery, parricide, infanticide, plunder, kidnapping and serious illegal detention, robbery or violence with qualified intimidation and violence. arson.

text: Obviously, sa ini lang nga rason, indi matuod solusyon sa aton peace and order ang death penalty.
english: Obviously, for this reason alone, the death penalty is not a real solution to our peace and order.

text: In fact, ang pagka-kriminal, labi na gid ang mga makasulumpa nga mga krimen, yara sa nadak-an sang tawo kag pamatasan nga nagsul-ob na sa iya pagkatawo.
english: In fact, criminality, especially heinous crimes, is part of a person's upbringing and behavior that is already ingrained in his or her personality.

text: Tungod sini, ang solusyon dira amo ang pagbag-o sining pamatasan padulong sa tadlong nga banas nga mabuligan maligwat sang “rehabilitation” nga mapatuman sa prisuhan.
english: Therefore, the solution is to change this behavior towards the right path that can be helped by the rehabilitation that can be implemented in prison.

text: Of course, importante anay ang epektibo nga pagdakop sang mga suspetsado nga mga kriminal kag pagpasaka sang kaso sa ila agud mapabilin ang kalinong kag hilway nga panghulag sang aton matarong mga mga pumuluyo nga wala sila nagapanabad sa aton palibut.
english: Of course, it is important to effectively arrest suspected criminals and prosecute them in order to maintain the peace and freedom of movement of our righteous citizens without harming our environment.

text: Sa sining duha lang ka rason, segurado naton nga magalinong ang aton palibut.
english: For these two reasons alone, we can be sure that our environment will be peaceful.

text: Syempre, kon lubos na sila mabulag sa kadam-an samtang nagabayad sang ila kasal-anan sa prisuhan – tubtub sa life imprisonment ukon reclusion perpetua kon nagakabagay – sin-o pa ang kahadlukan naton sa gwa?
english: Of course, when they are completely separated from the crowd while serving their sentences in prison – up to life imprisonment or reclusion perpetua if appropriate – who else do we have to fear outside?

text: Sa Article 3 Section 19 (1) sang aton 1987 Constitution, amo lang ini ang pinakabug-at nga silot, samtang wala man ginadilian ang death penalty sang mapasar nga “enabling law” kon iduso gid man sang Kongreso.
english: In Article 3 Section 19 (1) of our 1987 Constitution, this is the most severe punishment, while the death penalty is not prohibited by the enabling law if proposed by Congress.

text: Tani indi na!
english: I wish it wasn't!

text: Upod man kita sa panghuna-huna nga i-abolish na gid lang ang death penalty bilang signatory ang Filipinas sa Second Optional Protocol to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, nga naga-prohibir sa mga nasyon nga katapo sini sa pag-imponer sang death penalty.
english: We are also of the opinion that the death penalty should be abolished as the Philippines is a signatory to the Second Optional Protocol to the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights, which prohibits its member countries from imposing the death penalty.

text: Sa karon, 140 ka nasyon sa kalibutan ang wala nagapatuman sang death penalty.
english: Currently, 140 countries in the world do not implement the death penalty.

text: Tindug nila amo nga isa ini ka “inhuman” nga penalidad kag indi masaligan tungod sa “unfair trial” nga nagakatabo sa madamo nga mga pungsod, labi na gid kon batok sa mga political opponents.
english: They insist that it is an “inhuman” penalty and unreliable because of the “unfair trial” that occurs in many countries, especially against political opponents.

text: Madugang naton dira ang kakulangan sang mga kubos nga makakuha sang maayo nga mga abogado nga ang mga manggaranon lang ang makasarang.
english: We can add to that the lack of access to good lawyers that only the rich can afford.

text: Bilang Kristiyano, personal man nga oppose kita sa death penalty tungod sa Kasuguan sang Diyos nga “Indi ka Magpatay”.
english: As Christians, we are personally opposed to the death penalty because of God's Law “Thou shalt not kill”.

text: Samtang kinamatarong naton ang makakuha sing hustisya,  obligasyon man naton sa Ginuo nga tagaan gihapon ang tagsa-tagsa sing kahigayunan nga makapanumbalik sa aton Ginuo./PN
english: While it is our right to get justice, it is also our obligation to the Lord to give everyone the opportunity to return to our Lord./PN

text: Mas madali nga mag-angkon sang balatian nga Goiter ang mga babayi nga lapit na nga magmenopause.
english: Women who are close to menopause are more likely to develop Goiter disease.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Elvin Tiangha, iya ginpahayag nga ang Goiter amo ang balatian nga epekto sang pagbanog sang thyroid gland nga nagatubo sa tutunlan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Elvin Tiangha, he said that goiter is a disease caused by the swelling of the thyroid gland that grows in the throat.

text: Bangud sa pagbanog, naga-angkon sang bukol sa liog ang isa ka tawo sa bahin sang ‘adam’s apple’ kag larynx.
english: Due to the swelling, a person develops a lump in the neck in the area of ​​the 'adam's apple' and larynx.

text: Ini ang ginatunaan sang pagkapaos, mabudlay nga pagginhawa kag pagtulon.
english: This causes fatigue, difficulty breathing and swallowing.

text: Suno kay Dr. Tiangha, ang thyroid gland sang isa ka tawo ang nagaobra sang thyroid hormones nga kinahanglan sang lawas.
english: According to Dr. Surprisingly, a person's thyroid gland makes thyroid hormones that the body needs.

text: Ang pag-angkon sang Goiter ang epekto sang pagkakulang sang Iodine ukon ‘Iodine Deficiency’ sa lawas sang tawo.
english: Goiter is the effect of Iodine Deficiency in the human body.

text: Ang padayon nga pagdako sang Goiter ang isa ka patimaan nga may problema sa thyroid gland.
english: Goiter that continues to grow is a sign of a problem with the thyroid gland.

text: Gin-athag ni Tiangha nga bisan sin-o lamang ang mahimo matubuan sang Goiter ilabi na sa mga babayi nga yara sa 40 ang edad kag lapit na sa menopausal stage.
english: Tiangha explained that anyone can develop goiter especially women in their 40s and near the menopausal stage.

text: Agud nga makalikaw sa balatian nga Goiter, nagpanugyan ang doktor sa publiko nga magkaon sang mga pagkaon nga may mataas nga iodine, tyrosine, kag antioxidants kaangay sang isda, utan kag gatas.
english: To prevent Goiter, the doctor advised the public to eat foods high in iodine, tyrosine, and antioxidants such as fish, vegetables and milk.

text: Balantayan umpisa 1:30 sa Lunes sa kaagahon (oras sa Pilipinas) ang pag-atubang ni Alex Eala sa reigning Australian Open champion kag world No.
english: Alex Eala will face reigning Australian Open champion and world No.

text: 5 nga si Madison Keys sa third round sang Miami Open sa Hard Rock Stadium, Florida, USA.
english: 5 Madison Keys in the third round of the Miami Open at Hard Rock Stadium, Florida, USA.

text: Kasugpon ini sang underdog role sang 19-anyos nga Pinay star sa amo nga tournament sang Women’s Tennis Association (WTA).
english: This is in addition to the underdog role of the 19-year-old Filipina star in the Women's Tennis Association (WTA) tournament.

text: Pang-140 si Eala sa world rankings apang nakaplastar na sang iya pangalan sa Miami Gardens matapos duha na ka beses nga nakahimo sang upset — una batok sa world No.
english: Eala is ranked 140th in the world rankings but has made a name for himself at Miami Gardens after two upsets — first against world No.

text: 73 nga si Katie Volynets sang US, kag ikaduha batok sa former French Open champion nga si Jelena Ostapenko sang Latvia.
english: 73 Katie Volynets of the US, and second against former French Open champion Jelena Ostapenko of Latvia.

text: Sa sini nga round of 32, indi lamang Grand Slam champion ang atubangon ni Eala kundi isa sa ginakabig nga most in-form players sa WTA circuit subong nga season.
english: In this round of 32, Eala will face not only a Grand Slam champion but one of the most in-form players on the WTA circuit this season.

text: Ang 30-anyos nga player ang naglutos sa kaangay niya nga American kag world no.
english: The 30-year-old beat fellow American and world no.

text: 4 nga si Jessica Pegula sa finals sang WTA 500 Adelaide International sa Australia.
english: 4 Jessica Pegula in the finals of the WTA 500 Adelaide International in Australia.

text: Duha ka semana ang nakaligad, naghimo ini sang maragtas bilang oldest first-time women’s Grand Slam champion sang nagpangibabaw ini sa Australian Open.
english: Two weeks ago, she made history as the oldest first-time women’s Grand Slam champion when she dominated the Australian Open.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, sa sini nga tournament, madamo naman sang record nga nahimo ang Pinay tennis star kaangay sang una nga pagdaog batok sa multiple Grand Slam winner; una nga pagdaog sa player nga sulod sa top 25 sa kalibutan; kag una nga tion nga nakaabante sa third round sang isa ka WTA event.
english: On the other hand, in this tournament, the Filipino tennis star has set many records such as his first victory against the multiple Grand Slam winner; first win by a player inside the top 25 in the world; and first time advancing to the third round of a WTA event.

text: Ginlutos sang 19-anyos nga Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala ang 2017 French Open champion nga si Jelena Ostapenko sa Round of 64 sang Miami Open sa Florida, USA.
english: 19-year-old Pinay tennis star Alex Eala defeated 2017 French Open champion Jelena Ostapenko in the Round of 64 of the Miami Open in Florida, USA.

text: Maga-abante na ang world no.
english: The world no.

text: 140 nga bugal sang Pilipinas sa Round of 32.
english: 140 pride of the Philippines in the Round of 32.

text: Naghilibion si Eala sang nahimo sini ang panibag-o nga upset, 7-6, 7-5, nga amo ang ginalantaw pinakadaku nga kadalag-an sa iya karera sa tennis.
english: Eala was in tears when she scored a new upset, 7-6, 7-5, which is seen as the biggest win of her tennis career.

text: Indi halos ini makapati bangud pang-numero 25 si Ostapenko sa world rankings kag kilala man nga nabulsa ang 2024 US Open women’s doubles title kaupod ang isa ka player halin sa Ukraine.
english: He could hardly believe it because Ostapenko is number 25 in the world rankings and is also known to have pocketed the 2024 US Open women's doubles title with a player from Ukraine.

text: Antes nag-atubang sa 27-anyos nga Latvian player, ginlutos man ni Eala sa imbukada nga hampang ang world no.
english: Before facing the 27-year-old Latvian player, Eala also defeated the world no.

text: 73 nga si Katie Volynets sang United States, 6-3, 7-6 (7-3).
english: 73 Katie Volynets of the United States, 6-3, 7-6 (7-3).

text: Buwas na ang masunod nga round sa hampang ni Eala apang ginabantayan pa kun sin-o ang makasambuwa sini.
english: The next round of Eala's match is tomorrow but it is still being watched who will win.

text: GAPAKADTO ako sa Iloilo (Manduriao) Supermart agud mang-grocery sang nagligad nga Lunes sang makalabay ako sa Manduriao National High School, nga temporaryo anay ginagamit nga upisina sang Animal Bite Section sang siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: I WAS going to the Iloilo (Manduriao) Supermart to buy groceries last Monday when I passed the Manduriao National High School, which was temporarily used as the office of the Animal Bite Section of Iloilo City.

text: Malawig ang linya sa gwa sang gate sang eskwelahan.
english: There was a long line outside the school gate.

text: Nanotaran ko man nga ang tanan naka-facemask.
english: I also noticed that everyone was wearing facemasks.

text: Ugaling lang kay nagadikitanay nga wala naga-observe sang social/physical distancing, nga ginapanugyan gid sang health authorities.
english: However, they are meeting without observing social/physical distancing, which is strongly recommended by health authorities.

text: In fact, sunu sa napamatian kag nabasa ta nga mga report, amo man ini ang problema sa pila ka okasyon sang paglinyahanay sang mga tawo agud makakuha sang ila Social Amelioration Program (SAP) subsidy.
english: In fact, according to reports we have heard and read, this is also the problem on some occasions of people lining up to get their Social Amelioration Program (SAP) subsidy.

text: Ngaa ayhan?
english: Why maybe?

text: Wala nahadlok nga malatnan sang COVID-19?
english: Not afraid of getting infected with COVID-19?

text: Ukon nadaug sang ila gutom ang kahadlok sa COVID-19?
english: Or did their hunger overcome the fear of COVID-19?

text: Ukon tungod nagapati sila nga lubos sila ma-protektahan sang ila facemask?
english: Or because they believe that their facemask will fully protect them?

text:
***

Ma-focus lang kita sa pamangkot kon bala ang facemask makahatag gid man sing lubos nga proteksyon sa nagagamit sini agud indi siya malatnan sang COVID-19 bisan sa close contact.
english:
***

We will only focus on the question of whether the facemask can really provide full protection to the wearer from being infected with COVID-19 even in close contact.

text: Believe you me, may gapati gani nga pumuluyo nga ang COVID-19 balatian lang sang manggaranon, ukon maisug-isug lang ini nga trangkaso, nga pwede pangisugan sa paglagaw kon diin man.
english: Believe you me, there are even people who believe that COVID-19 is only a disease of the rich, or that it is just a brave flu, which can be braved to walk anywhere.

text: Amo gani seguro nga may mga dungol gid.
english: That's probably why there are so many deaf people.

text: Kon ano man ang inyo pagpati, ini ugaling ang napamatud-an sang aton mga siyentipiko – nga makuha lang ang COVID-19 virus kon mahaklo mo, ukon mapahaklo mo, ang respiratory droplets halin sa ubo, pangatsi, panupla kag pagpakigsugilanon sa infected sang sining balatian.
english: Whatever you believe, this is what our scientists have proven – that you can only get the COVID-19 virus if you breathe, or breathe, respiratory droplets from coughing, sneezing, sneezing and talking to someone infected with this disease.

text: Sa estimate sang World Health Organization (WHO) malab-ut ka sining respiratory droplets tubtub sa isa ka metro, ukon 3.2 ka tapak, ukon sa malayo pa gawa para mas seguro.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) estimates that these respiratory droplets can reach you up to one meter, or 3.2 feet, or even farther for safety.

text: In other words, kon wala lang sing may ga-ubo, gapangatsi, ukon gapanupla, ukon nagapakigsugilanon sa imo sa sina nga kalayuon indi ka malatnan sang COVID-19.
english: In other words, as long as no one is coughing, sneezing, or sneezing, or talking to you at that distance you will not be infected with COVID-19.

text: In fact, sang una ang panugyan lang sang WHO amo nga mag-distancia (social/physical distancing) ka lang, ukon ang kaatubang mo, nga infected sing indi maglapit sa isa ka metro kag “safe” ka na.
english: In fact, in the past, the WHO's only advice was to social/physical distance yourself, or the person in front of you, who is infected at least one meter away and you are safe.

text: Ugaling lang, agud malikawan ang paglapta sang virus samtang nagapabilin pa sa kahanginan, ukon agud indi mahulog sa kon diin lang ini nga makuha naton kag madala sa aton ilong, baba kag mata, ginapanugyan na sang health authorities, upod man sang WHO, nga maggamit gid sang facemask, upod sa social distancing kag nagakaigu nga hygienic practices.
english: However, to prevent the spread of the virus while it remains in the air, or to avoid falling wherever we get it and carry it in our nose, mouth and eyes, health authorities, including the WHO, recommend the use of facemasks, along with social distancing and appropriate hygienic practices.

text: Apang, bastante na bala ang facemask agud maseguro nga indi kita malatnan sang COVID-19 kon kaupod sing malapitan ang infected, symptomatic ukon asymptomatic man?
english: However, is a facemask enough to ensure that we do not get infected with COVID-19 if we are in close contact with an infected person, whether symptomatic or asymptomatic?

text: Ang symptomatic nga infected nagapakita sang mga sintoma sang hilanat, pag-ubo kag pagpin-ut sang pagginhawa kag iban pa kasubong sang ginabatyag sang may trangkaso.
english: A symptomatic infected person shows symptoms of fever, cough and shortness of breath and other symptoms similar to those of the flu.

text: Ang asymptomatic wala nagapakita sing sintoma, ugaling, sunu sa pila ka siyentipiko, posible man makapanglaton.
english: Asymptomatic does not show symptoms, but, according to some scientists, can also be contagious.

text: Ang sabat sang health authorities sa aton pamangkot amo nga indi ini makapaseguro nga indi na kita malatnan sang COVID-19.
english: The answer of the health authorities to our question is that it does not guarantee that we will not be infected with COVID-19.

text: Wala pa, siling nila, sing facemask nga indi malutsan sang virus tungod sang pagkagamay (micro size) sini, although mapahagan-hagan ang paglusot sini sa facemask.
english: There is no facemask that cannot penetrate the virus because of its micro size, although it is easier to penetrate the facemask.

text: Gani, panugyan gihapon sang health authorities amo nga magpatuman gid sang social/physical distancing bisan naka-facemask na kita, regardless kon ang facemask surgical, N95 ukon cloth mask.
english: Therefore, the health authorities still advise us to observe social/physical distancing even if we are wearing a facemask, regardless of whether the facemask is surgical, N95 or cloth mask.

text: Malutsan pa gani ang Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) sang doktor ukon nars, kon indi ini garantisado – tungod fake ukon substandard – ang pagkahimo sini.
english: The Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) of a doctor or nurse can even be lost, if it is not guaranteed – because it is fake or substandard – it is made.

text: Tungod sini, madamo na gani nga health workers ang napatay.
english: As a result, many health workers have even died.

text: Indi lang diri sa Filipinas kundi bisan sa iban pa nga pungsod.
english: Not only here in the Philippines but also in other countries.

text: Amo gani nga nagreklamo na sila parti sini kag nagpanawagan nga tagaan sing mas masaligan nga PPE.
english: That's why they complained about it and called for more reliable PPE.

text: In fact, gin-islan na gani ang mga PPE nga napamatud-an nga indi masaligan.
english: In fact, it has even replaced PPE that proved to be unreliable.

text: Ginaliwat-liwat man gani sang aton Department of Health nga sa gihapon mag-observe ang publiko sang social/physical distancing bisan naka-facemask, labi na gid kon nagapakita sing sintoma ang katupad.
english: Our Department of Health also repeatedly urges the public to observe social/physical distancing even if wearing a facemask, especially if the person showing symptoms.

text: Tungod ang mga asymptomatic wala nagapakita sing sintoma, samtang posible makalaton man, mag-amlig gid sa padayon nga pagpakigsalamuha ang mga frontliners  sa bisan sa wala sintoma agud malikawan ang mataas nga viral load, ukon paghaklo sang madamo nga virus, agud kon maigu gid man “mild” lang kag madale mapaayo./PN
english: Because asymptomatic people do not show symptoms, while it is possible to be infectious, frontliners should be careful to continue to interact with even those without symptoms to avoid high viral load, or inhalation of many viruses, so that if they are infected, they will be “mild” and easily recovered./PN

text: Yara na subong sa deportation area sa Kuwait ang isa ka Ilongga Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) nga napreso bangud sa ginapahayag nga paglapas sa Labor Law sang amo nga pungsod.
english: An Ilongga Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) who was arrested for allegedly violating the country's Labor Law is now in the deportation area in Kuwait.

text: Ginkilala ini kay Maricris Lapatero Sacatin, residente sang Poblacion, San Rafael, Iloilo kag 13 na ka tuig nga naga-ubra bilang domestic helper sa luwas sang pungsod sa isa lamang ka employer.
english: The suspect was identified as Maricris Lapatero Sacatin, resident of Poblacion, San Rafael, Iloilo and has been working as a domestic helper abroad for 13 years with only one employer.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Maeb Lapatero, utod ni Maricris, iya ginpahayag nga nagapasalamat gid sila bangud bisan paano, may development na sa kahimtangan sang ila utod sa Kuwait matapos nga gindangop nila ang ila problema diri sa Bombo Radyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Maeb Lapatero, Maricris' sister, said they are very grateful because anyway, there is a development in the situation of their brother in Kuwait after they turned to Bombo Radyo.

text: Apang, indi sa gihapon nila mapunggan ang magkabalaka bangud wala sa gihapon sang direkta nga komunikasyon sa ila utod.
english: However, they still can't help but worry because there is still no direct communication with their brother.

text: Gintuad man sang natungdan nga nagpromisa ang amo ni Maricris nga siya ang mabayad sang plane ticket sini kag ipadala ang nabilin nga gamit sini sa Pilipinas.
english: He also admitted that Maricris' employer promised to pay for her plane ticket and send the rest of her belongings to the Philippines.

text: Madumduman nga nalapas sang amo nga Ilongga ang Labor Law sang Kuwait bangud nagaubra ini bilang part-time cook sa negosyo mismo sang iya amo nga ginapahayag nga wala sang nagakaigo nga permiso.
english: It can be recalled that the Ilongga employer violated the Labor Law of Kuwait because he worked as a part-time cook in his employer's own business without proper permit.

text:
Liwat nga igatiglawas ni Manny Pacquiao ang Pilipinas — indi sa boxing ring — kundi sa survival competition show sang Netflix nga “Physical: Asia” nga spinoff sang hit Korean reality series nga “Physical: 100.”

Ini amo ang ikatatlo nga season kun sa diin may 100 ka magapaindis-indis nga atleta, bodybuilders, celebrities, kag madamo nga iban pa.
english:
Manny Pacquiao will once again represent the Philippines — not in the boxing ring — but in Netflix’s survival competition show “Physical: Asia” a spinoff of the hit Korean reality series “Physical: 100.”

This is the third season where there will be 100 competing athletes, bodybuilders, celebrities, and many others.

text: Diri nga kumpetisyon mapamatud-an ang ila kusog, balance, agility, endurance, willpower, kag strategy.
english: This competition will test their strength, balance, agility, endurance, willpower, and strategy.

text: Ang magadaog amo ang tagpalasakop nga may ideal human physique.
english: The winner is the contestant with the ideal human physique.

text: Sang 2023 kag 2024 gin-ere ang nauna nga duha ka seasons sini kun sa diin ang nadeklarar nga winners amo ang anay snowboarder kag CrossFit athlete nga si Woo Jin-yong kag CrossFit YouTuber nga si Amotti.
english: In 2023 and 2024 aired its first two seasons with the declared winners being former snowboarder and CrossFit athlete Woo Jin-yong and CrossFit YouTuber Amotti.

text: Gin-share man sang platform ang Filipino boxing legend kag iya asawa nga si Jinkee nga nag-abot na sa airport sa South Korea.
english: The platform also shared the Filipino boxing legend and his wife Jinkee who have arrived at the airport in South Korea.

text: “Raise your ‘southpaw’ in greeting!
english: “Raise your ‘southpaw’ in greeting!

text: Boxing legend Manny Pacquiao is joining Netflix’s intense competition reality series, Physical: Asia,” kabahin sang gin-post sang Netflix sa TikTok video sang nag-abot na ang people’s champ sa Incheon International Airport.
english: Boxing legend Manny Pacquiao is joining Netflix’s intense competition reality series, Physical: Asia,” was part of what Netflix posted in a TikTok video once the people’s champ arrived at Incheon International Airport.

text: Si Pacquiao amo ang ginakabig nga “Pambansang Kamao” (national fist) kag ginakabig man nga isa sa legendary athletes sa Pilipinas.
english: Pacquiao is considered the “Pambansang Kamao” (national fist) and is also considered one of the legendary athletes in the Philippines.

text: Siya ang isahanon nga boksidor nga nangin eight-division world champion kag siya man ang oldest welterweight world champion sa edad nga 40 anyos.
english: He is the only boxer to become an eight-division world champion and he is also the oldest welterweight world champion at the age of 40 years.

text: Pormal siya nga nag-retiro sa boksing sang 2021.
english: He formally retired from boxing in 2021.

text: Nag-file sang not-guilty plea ang anay national security adviser ni US President Donald Trump nga si John Bolton bangud sa kaso nga mishandling classified information.
english: Former US President Donald Trump's national security adviser John Bolton has pleaded not guilty to mishandling classified information.

text: Ang 18 nga numero sang kaso ang naghalin sa alegasyon nga ginapakigbahin sini ang mga sensitibo nga materyales lakip ang ginakabig nga top secret.
english: The 18-count case stems from allegations that it shares sensitive materials including what is considered top secret.

text: Ginpasulod sini ang not guilty plea matapos nga personal sini nga nag-surrender sa mga otoridad sa federal court hearing sang Byernes.
english: He entered a not guilty plea after personally surrendering to authorities at a federal court hearing on Friday.

text: Ang 76-anoys nga si Bolton ang nagserbe kay Trump sa una nga termino sini, apang naghalin man ini kag nangin kritiko na sang US President.
english: The 76-year-old Bolton served Trump in his first term, but he also left and has become a critic of the US President.

text: Nakatalan naman sa Nobyembre 21 ang hearing sa nasambit nga kaso.
english: The hearing in the case is scheduled for November 21.

text: Gin-akusaran sang Prosecutors si Bolton sang paggamit sang personal messaging apps kag emails para iligal nga ipalaptaa ang mga sensitibo nga impormasyon.
english: Prosecutors accused Bolton of using personal messaging apps and emails to illegally disseminate sensitive information.

text: SA NAGLIGAD naton nga kolum (July 17, 2020) ginpahanumdum naton si Presidente Duterte sa iya pagpanglagas sa mga “oligarch”.
english: IN OUR LAST column (July 17, 2020) we reminded President Duterte of his pursuit of the “oligarchs”.

text: Tungod basi bala indi  pa sila ang “Big Bad Wolf” nga ginaisgan lang ang mga “helpless” nga “3 Little Pigs” nga mabasahan naton sa Aesop’s fable.
english: Because maybe they are not the "Big Bad Wolf" that just encourages the "helpless" "3 Little Pigs" that we read in Aesop's fable.

text: Matuod man.
english: It's true.

text: Basi bala nga ang iya ginalagas amo pa ang nagabulig sa aton ekonomiya nga mga maulikdon nga mga kompaniya.
english: Maybe he's still chasing the companies that help our economy.

text: Hinisa ina ya nga lagson ang mga kompaniya nga nagakita sing maayo tungod sa maayo nila nga pagpalakat sang negosyo, samtang nagasunod naman sila sa aton kasuguan.
english: He is eager to pursue companies that make good money because of their good business practices, while they comply with our laws.

text: Labi na gid ang naga-hire sang madamo nga mga trabajente kag may madamo nga proyekto sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Especially those who hire many workers and have many projects for the people.

text: Ang “oligarch”, sa pagtumod sang Presidente, nagatudlo sa dalagku nga mga negosyo nga gina-kontrol sang pila lang ka tawo nga may ikasarang agud diktahan – kag nagadikta gid – ang pagpalakat sang ekonomiya sang pungsod kag pati ang pagpalakat sang gobyerno agud magpauswag lang ang kaugalingon.
english: The “oligarch”, as the President referred to it, refers to large businesses controlled by a few people who have the ability to dictate – and do dictate – the running of the country's economy and even the running of the government for self-interest.

text: Of course, sa nasiling ta na, indi buot silingon nga kon daku ka nga negosyo pwede mo na diktahan ang kabuhi sang pungsod para sa imo kaayuhan.
english: Of course, as we have said, it does not mean that if you are a big business you can dictate the life of the country for your benefit.

text: May yara nga mga “enlightened rich”, labi na gid ang halin sa pagka-imol, nga may balatyagon sa kubos kon diin man sila naghalin.
english: There are the “enlightened rich”, especially those who come from poverty, who have feelings for the poor wherever they come from.

text: Ang iban mapunggan man sang aton mga kasuguan sa ila pagpamentaha, katulad sang antitrust laws.
english: Others are also restricted by our laws in their exploitation, such as antitrust laws.

text: Of course, may ara gid man nga makapalusot sang ila katontohan, labi na gid kon gina-tolerar man sang mga opisyales sa gobyerno nga kasosyo nila sa kadalok sa manggad kag poder.
english: Of course, there are those who can get away with their stupidity, especially if it is tolerated by government officials who are their partners in the greed for wealth and power.

text: Syempre diri na masulod ang rolyo sang isa ka matarong nga gobyerno sa pagtadlong sang dapat taladlungon paagi sa bagay nga mga kasuguan kag nagakaigu nga pagpatuman sini.
english: Of course, this is where the role of a just government comes in to correct what needs to be corrected through appropriate laws and their proper enforcement.

text: Apang, sa pagpahanumdum gani naton sa kay Presidente Duterte, dapat seguruhon sini kon sin-o ining mga manggaranon kag mga poderoso nga dapat punggan sa ila pag-abuso sang kumpiyansya sang mga pumuluyo.
english: However, as we remind President Duterte, he must ensure who these rich and powerful are who must be stopped from abusing the trust of the people.

text: Pero, isa bala ang ABS-CBN sa sining mga “oligarch” sunu sa paghangop ni Presidente Duterte?
english: But, is ABS-CBN one of these “oligarchs” as President Duterte understands it?

text: Sa aton nahibal-an, nagahatag ang ABS-CBN sing mapuslan nga kalingawan sa mga pumuluyo kag may madamo ini nga proyekto para sa kabataan kag mga proyekto nga nagapreserbar sang duna naton nga manggad sa palibut.
english: As far as we know, ABS-CBN provides wholesome entertainment to the people and has many projects for children and projects that preserve our natural resources.

text: Sunu sa presidential spokesman Harry Roque, wala ang ABS-CBN sa mga oligarch nga ginatumod sang Presidente sa isa sini nga pagpamulong-pulong sining ulihi lang.
english: According to presidential spokesman Harry Roque, ABS-CBN is not among the oligarchs referred to by the President in one of his recent speeches.

text: Ginhingadlan pa gani ni Roque kon sin-o ining mga “oligarch” nga luyag lagson ni Presidente.
english: Roque even named who these “oligarchs” are that the President wants to pursue.

text: Ini sila amo sanday Lucio Tan sang Philippine Airlines (PAL), Manny Pangilinan kag ang Ayala Group.
english: They are Lucio Tan of Philippine Airlines (PAL), Manny Pangilinan and the Ayala Group.

text: Kon indi man gali oligarch ang ABS-CBN – ang kompaniya kag management sini – ti ano gid ang rason nga ginalagas sini ang ABS-CBN kag ang Lopez Family nga tag-iya sang ABS-CBN?
english: If ABS-CBN – its company and management – ​​is not an oligarch, then what is the real reason it is pursuing ABS-CBN and the Lopez Family who own ABS-CBN?

text: Sa matandaan sang publiko, daku gid ang kaakig ni Presidente sa ABS-CBN tungod wala mapagwa sini ang iya campaign advertisement sadtong eleksyon sang Mayo 2016.
english: As the public remembers, the President was very angry with ABS-CBN for not releasing his campaign advertisement during the May 2016 elections.

text: Ang mga kaalyado sini sa Kongreso, labi na gid sadtong mga hearing sa pag-renew sang frankisa sini, nagpautwas man sang ila kaugot sa kuno “bias” reporting sang ABS-CBN, lakip na ang wala nila nauyunan nga kaundan sang pila ka “creative” drama series sa diin ginapahayag diri ang natural nga balatyagon sang mga manunulat.
english: Its allies in Congress, especially during the hearings on the renewal of its franchise, also expressed their displeasure with the alleged “bias” reporting of ABS-CBN, including their disapproval of the content of some “creative” drama series where the natural feelings of the writers are expressed.

text: Aba, luyag lang gali nila dayawon!
english: Why, they just want to be praised!

text: Imposible ina sa Alternative Politics naton sa Demokrasya.
english: That is impossible in our Alternative Politics in Democracy.

text: Kon may reklamo kamo, iakusar lang ang media kay may kasuguan man kita sa libel batok sa mga abusado.
english: If you have a complaint, just sue the media because we have libel laws against abusers.

text: Indi kay diktahan sila kon ano ang ila i-report ukon ang personal nga panghuna-huna sang mga kolumnista.
english: Not to dictate to them what to report or the personal thoughts of columnists.

text: Diniktador ina ya!
english: He's a dictator!

text: Idugang ta man diri ang indi pag-akto ni Presidente sa ulihi nga version sang Anti-Dynasty Bill nga nagapalawak sang coverage sang prohibition batok sa dynasty politics agud matagaan man oportunidad ang aton linghod kag maalam nga mga pumuluyo nga luyag man mag-serbisyo sa pumuluyo.
english: Let us add to this the President's inaction on the latest version of the Anti-Dynasty Bill that expands the coverage of the prohibition against dynasty politics to give opportunities to our young and intelligent people who also want to serve the people.

text: Pwede mo ipa-urgent bill ina sa Kongreso, Mr. President, sa diin super majority ang imo grupo.
english: Can you urgently bill that in Congress, Mr. President, where your group is a super majority.

text: Sa matuod, amo gid ini ang mas mapintas nga oligarchy sa pungsod – ang paggahum sang mga political dynasties kay indi lang kontrolado nila ang gobyerno kundi pati na ang ekonomiya sang pungsod pabor sa ila.
english: In fact, it is actually the more vicious oligarchy in the country – the rule of political dynasties because they not only control the government but also the country’s economy in their favour.

text: Otherwise, nada kag kahalamhutan inang siling mo nga awayon ang mga “oligarch”, nga madamo sini upod mo pa sa pulitika./PN
english: Otherwise, it's stupid and stupid to fight the oligarchs, many of whom are still with you in politics./PN

text: ILOILO CITY- Panumduma kun isa ka adlaw, nagbugtaw ka na lang nga ang nawong sang mga tawo sa imo palibot daw iya sang demonyo!
english: ILOILO CITY- Imagine if one day, you woke up and the faces of the people around you looked like they belonged to demons!

text: Makahaladlok kag makapalanindog balahibo.
english: Scary and feather-raising.

text: Amo ina ang naeksperyensiyahan sang isa ka lalaki sa Tennessee sa Amerika nga isa ka adlaw, nagbugtaw nalang siya nga ang panulukan niya sa mga tawo sa iya palibot daw mga demonyo nga ang dulunggan, ilong, kag baba ang nagahitad kag ang panit sa nawong ang may kihad-kihad.
english: That's what happened to a man in Tennessee, USA, who woke up one day and saw that the people around him looked like demons with their ears, noses, and mouths swollen and the skin on their faces swollen.

text: Ini am si Victor Sharrah, 59 anyos nga humalin sang Nobyembre 2020, nagbag-o na ang iya kabuhi.
english: This is Victor Sharrah, 59 years old who since November 2020, has changed his life.

text: Sang amo nga adlaw, sa iya pagbugtaw, ang panulok niya sa iya roommate, demonyo, paggwa niya sa kwarto, ang panulok niya sa iban nga upod sa ginaistaran nga apartment, puro demonyo.
english: That day, when he woke up, he looked at his roommate, demon, when he left the room, he looked at the others in the apartment, all demons.

text: Sa iya pagdumdom, nadula na siya sa iya husto nga paminsaron.
english: As he thought, he was out of his right mind.

text: Didto na ini nagdesisyon nga magpalantaw sa doktor.
english: That's when he decided to see a doctor.

text: Kag siya ang na- diagnose nga may prosopometamorphopsia ukon PMO nga isa ka rare neurological disorder nga ginahimo sini ang nawong sang mga tawo nga mala-demonyo apisar normal man sila sa panulukan sang iban nga tawo.
english: And he was diagnosed with prosopometamorphopsia or PMO, a rare neurological disorder that makes people's faces look demonic even though they are normal in the eyes of other people.

text: Nahibaluan nga tubtob subong, wala pa mahibaluan sang mga siyentipiko kun ano gid ang kabangdanan sang amo nga sahi sang kondisyon.
english: It is known that until now, scientists do not know what exactly causes this type of condition.

text: Napa-wow ang mga fans sang megastar nga si Sharon Cuneta matapos ginpakita ang resulta sang iya balik-alindog program.
english: Fans of megastar Sharon Cuneta were wowed after the results of her balik-alindog program were shown.

text: Sa iya post, gintuad niya nga nabuhinan siya sang 15 pounds sa iya weight loss journey agud ma- achieve ang iya fitness goal subong nga tuig.
english: In her post, she confessed that she lost 15 pounds in her weight loss journey to achieve her fitness goal this year.

text: Sa gin-share niya nga video sa Instagram, makit-an nga nagakanta ini sang ambahanon nga “Ikaw” bilang birthday gift sa iya Tita Cherrie Pie Lazatin nga ginakabig niya nga iloy.
english: In the video he shared on Instagram, he can be seen singing the song “Ikaw” as a birthday gift to his Tita Cherrie Pie Lazatin whom he considers his mother.

text: Gin-ako naman sang aktres nga tuman ka budlay man ang iya nine-year fitness journey.
english: The actress admitted that her nine-year fitness journey was also very difficult.

text: Suno sa iya, nagdesisyon siya nga magbuhin sang bug-at sang 2016.
english: He said he decided to lose weight in 2016.

text: Humalin sadto, gina-document niya ang iya weight loss milestones.
english: Since then, she has been documenting her weight loss milestones.

text: Sang 2023, gin-ako niya ng nagpaidalom siya sa surgery agud kuhaon ang excess nga panit sa iya lawas matapos nabuhinan ini ang pila ka pounds.
english: In 2023, she admitted that she underwent surgery to remove excess skin from her body after she lost several pounds.

text: Balantayan ang pagbalik sang Filipina tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa court Sabado sang kaagahon (oras sa Pilipinas) matapos ang daku nga kadalag-an nga nahimo sa imbukada nga hampang sa Miami Open.
english: Watch Filipina tennis star Alex Eala return to the court Saturday morning (Philippine time) after a big victory in the opening match of the Miami Open.

text: Sa Round of 128, nakuha ni Eala ang ginakabig pinakadaku sini nga kadalag-an subong nga tuig matapos gin-upset ang home bet kag world no.
english: In the Round of 128, Eala scored what is considered his biggest victory this year after upsetting the home bet and world no.

text: 73 nga si Katie Volynets sa skor nga 6-3, 7-6.
english: 73 Katie Volynets 6-3, 7-6.

text: Ini man ang una nga daog sang 19-anyos nga Pinay halin sang nagpasakop siya sa amo nga tournament sang 2021.
english: This is also the 19-year-old Filipina's first win since she participated in the tournament in 2021.

text: Isa ka oras kag 52 minutos ang ginlawig sang tennis match antes sini nalutos ang American player.
english: The tennis match lasted one hour and 52 minutes before the American player was defeated.

text: Ikaduha man ini nga tion nga nakalampas si Eala sa first round sang Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) 1000 event halin sang nahimo man ini sa Madrid Open sa Spain sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: It is also the second time Eala has advanced past the first round of the Women’s Tennis Association (WTA) 1000 event since doing the same at the Madrid Open in Spain last year.

text: Si Eala nga three-time Junior Grand Slam champion ang magaatubang sa world No.
english: Eala, a three-time Junior Grand Slam champion, will face world No.

text: 25 nga si Jelena Ostapenko sang Latvia sa round of 64 pasado alas dose sa kaagahon, Marso 21.
english: 25 Jelena Ostapenko of Latvia in the round of 64 past 12 a.m., March 21.

text: Indi basta-basta ang kasumpong sang Pinay star bangud nakadaog ini anay sa 2017 French Open batok kay Simona Halep sang Romania.
english: The Filipina star's opponent is no ordinary one as she previously won the 2017 French Open against Romania's Simona Halep.

text: Ini nga 27-anyos nga Latvian ang nagkampyon man sa 2024 US Open women’s doubles title kaupod sa isa pa ka player halin sa Ukraine.
english: This 27-year-old Latvian also won the 2024 US Open women’s doubles title alongside another player from Ukraine.

text: Ano ang himuon mo kun nainit ikaw sa isa ka tawo kag gusto mo gid magbalos sa iya ginhimo sa imo?
english: What would you do if you were angry with someone and wanted to get even with them?

text: Kun kis-a, pwede mo nga i-block, i-iunfollow, ukon i-unfriend sa Facebook, ukon pwede man nga indi mo na lang pagbugnuhon forever!
english: Sometimes, you can block, unfollow, or unfriend on Facebook, or you can just ignore them forever!

text: Pero may ara nga tawo nga bangud sa iya kaugot, nagpatindog ini sang balay nga subong makabig na nga record-holder sa bilog nga kalibutan!
english: But there is a man who, in his anger, built a house that is now considered a record-holder in the world!

text: Indi ini basta-basta nga balay, bangud ang rason… gusto lang sini nga matabunan ang manami nga view sang iya kasilingan nga iya ginakaugtan!
english: This is not an ordinary house, because the reason... it just wants to cover the good view of his neighborhood that he hates!

text: Didto ini sa Petralia Sottana sa Sicily sa Southern Italy.
english: It was in Petralia Sottana in Sicily in Southern Italy.

text: Kilala ini nga Casa du Currivu ukon ang ‘House of Spite’ — isa ka pinasahi nga building nga nagauyat sang unofficial title nga pinaka-kitid nga balay sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: It is known as the Casa du Currivu or the ‘House of Spite’ — a unique building that holds the unofficial title of the narrowest house in the world.

text: Duha ini ka panalgan kag yara lamang sa tatlo ka tapak ang iya nga kalapadon nga daw haluson gani makasugat-anay ang duha ka mga tawo kag sigurado nga indi gid maistaran!
english: It was two stories high and only about three feet wide, almost so that two people could meet each other and it was definitely uninhabitable!

text: Ngaa gintawag ini nga House of Spite?
english: Why is it called House of Spite?

text: 1950s sang gintukod ini bangud sa away sang magkasilingan.
english: 1950s when it was built due to a neighborly fight.

text: Indi pa uso sadto ang duha ka panalgan nga mga balay, apang para mahimo ina, kinahanglan nga may pahanugot halin sa tupad-balay.
english: Two-story houses were not in vogue, but to do that, you had to have permission from the neighbor.

text: Sa sini nga kaso, wala nagpasugot ang tupad-balay sang tag-iya sang Casa du Currivu gani nagdesisyon na lang siya nga magbalos.
english: In this case, the neighbor of the owner of Casa du Currivu did not agree so he decided to take revenge.

text: Nagpatukod ini sang second floor apang nag-distansya lang gamay sa iya tupad balay para indi na siya mangayo sang permiso, apang sigurado siya nga kun maglaaw sa bintana ang iya kasilingan, wala ini sang iban nga makit-an kundi ang iya manipis nga balay nga gintukod.
english: He built a second floor but kept a little distance from his neighbor so that he would not have to ask for permission, but he was sure that if his neighbor looked out the window, he would see nothing but his thin house.

text: Wala man sang iban nga pulos ang amo nga balay bangud indi man ini maistaran.
english: The house is of no other use because it is not habitable.

text: Magluwas sa bintana kag hagdan, wala na ini sang sulod… bangud sa liwat, gintukod lang ini agud mag-init ang ulo sang iya tupad balay.
english: Apart from the window and the stairs, it was empty… because again, it was only built to piss off his neighbor.

text: Sa subong, isa ini sa pinakabantog nga building sa Sicily, kag makabig pa nga main-attraction rason sang pagbalik-balik sang mga tawo sa amo nga komunidad sa Petralia Sottana.#
english: Today, it is one of the most famous buildings in Sicily, and is still considered the main attraction that keeps people coming back to the community in Petralia Sottana.

text: MAY mga 409,757 ka manunudlo kag iban nga school personnel sa private educational institutions sa bug-os nga pungsod, sunu sa report sang Coordinating Council of Private Educational Associations (Cocopea) sadtong Abril 29, 2020.
english: THERE are about 409,757 teachers and other school personnel in private educational institutions nationwide, according to a report by the Coordinating Council of Private Educational Associations (Cocopea) on April 29, 2020.

text: Samtang, as of Hulyo 16, sunu naman sa Department of Education (DepEd), mga 305,842 na ka mga estudyante sa private schools ang nakasaylo sa public schools para sa natalana nga school opening sa Agosto 24, 2020.
english: Meanwhile, as of July 16, according to the Department of Education (DepEd), about 305,842 students in private schools have transferred to public schools for the scheduled school opening on August 24, 2020.

text: Ina tungod naapektuhan man sang COVID-19 ang ginakita sang ila mga ginikanan sa paghina, ukon indi gid man lubos nadulaan sang ila ginakita, sa pagkadula man sang ila mga trabaho tungod sang quarantine kag lockdown.
english: This is because COVID-19 has also affected their parents' income by decreasing, or not completely losing their income, by losing their jobs due to quarantine and lockdown.

text: Sa sining mga nagsalaylo sa pag-enrol sa public schools, sunu pa gid sa DepEd, mga 192,471 sini ang mga bumulutho sa elementarya, 77,369 sa junior high school, 29,956 sa senior high school, kag 6,046 ang halin sa grupo sang mga PWDs ukon ang mga non-graded.
english: Of these, according to the DepEd, about 192,471 are elementary school students, 77,369 are junior high school students, 29,956 are senior high school students, and 6,046 are from the group of PWDs or non-graded students.

text: Sa DepEd report sang Hulyo 17, 2020, sunu sa Panay News, mga 1,169,976 pa lang ang naka-enrol sa private schools sa 17 ka rehiyon sang pungsod.
english: In the DepEd report of July 17, 2020, according to Panay News, only about 1,169,976 students are enrolled in private schools in 17 regions of the country.

text: Mga 27 porsyento lang ini sang naka-enrol sang nagligad nga tuig nga mga 4,304,676.
english: This is only about 27 percent of last year's enrollment of about 4,304,676.

text: Samtang nagabaton pa ang DepEd sang mga late enrollees.
english: Meanwhile, DepEd is still accepting late enrollees.

text: Tungod sining pagnubo sang enrolment sa private schools, mangin manubo man ang masukot nga tuition kag iban nga fees sa mga estudyante, nga daan indi na sila mapahanugutan sa pagpasaka pa sang ila sulukton sa eskwelahan.
english: Due to this decrease in enrollment in private schools, tuition and other fees will also be lower for students, who will not be allowed to increase their school fees.

text: In fact, indi man gani sila makasukot sing mas mataas kay impractical na ini sa subong nga kahimtangan sang pangabuhi bisan sa mga may ikasarang.
english: In fact, they can't even charge higher because it's impractical in today's living conditions even for those who can afford it.

text: Ginaayu pa gani sang iban nga ginikanan nga panubuon ang tuition sa private schools.
english: Some parents are even asking for tuition increases in private schools.

text: Magadugang man ang kinahanglan nga mga manunudlo sa “distance education”, partikular sa online learning, tungod ideally sa online learning diutay lang ang mga estudyante ang kinahanglan per teacher, nga mangin dugang man nga galastuhon sang eskwelahan.
english: The need for teachers in distance education, particularly in online learning, will also increase, because ideally in online learning fewer students are needed per teacher, which will also be an additional expense for the school.

text: Ang bug-os nga klase, sa public school (galab-ut 60 kada klase) ukon sa private (maximum nga 40), pwede tungaon ukon tatlo pa ini ka parti para sa duha ukon tatlo man ka manunudlo.
english: The entire class, in public school (up to 60 per class) or in private (maximum 40), can be divided into two or three parts for two or three teachers.

text: Ining dugang nga manunudlo sa paggamay sang klase sa private school dugang man ini nga galastuhon sang eskwelahan samtang diutay na lang ang masukot sa mga estudyante.
english: This additional teacher to reduce class sizes in private schools is also an additional expense for the school while less is charged to the students.

text: Sa isa ka bahin, tungod sa madamo nga nagasalaylo nga mga estudyante sa public schools, posible man nga may mawad-an ubra nga mga manunudlo sa private schools tungod indi na sila kinahanglan nga ma-rehire kag mawad-an sing trabaho.
english: On the one hand, due to the large number of students transferring to public schools, it is also possible that there will be job losses for teachers in private schools because they do not have to be rehired and lose their jobs.

text: Tungod sini nagapanawagan ang Cocopea sing bulig halin sa gobyerno.
english: Cocopea is calling for government assistance.

text: Sunu gani sa Cocopea managing director nga si Joseph Noel Estrada, either magabaton sila sing kubos nga sweldo ukon wala na gid tungod sa “no work no pay” policy nga skema sa private schools sa pag-abot sang school opening sa Agosto 24, 2020.
english: According to Cocopea managing director Joseph Noel Estrada, they will either receive less salary or nothing at all because of the “no work no pay” policy scheme in private schools when the school opening comes on August 24, 2020.

text: Ginpahanumdum man niya nga ang mga manunudlo sa private schools gina-hire by contract kag mawad-an na ini sila ubra pagkatapos sang ila mga kontrata kon indi na sila kinahanglan.
english: He also reminded that teachers in private schools are hired by contract and they will lose their jobs after their contracts expire if they are no longer needed.

text: Ang ginapangabay gani niya nga mabuligan ang ining mga manunudlo nga malakip sa Social AmeliarationProgram (SAP) sang DSWD kon mawad-an na gid man sila sing ubra.
english: He is asking for help to include these teachers in the Social AmeliarationProgram (SAP) of the DSWD if they lose their jobs.

text: Sa magapabilin pa sa pagtudlo sa private schools, ginapangabay ni Estrada nga tagaan sing subsidy ang ining mga eskwelahan para sa sweldo sang mga manunudlo kag sa iban pa nga kinahanglanon sang eskwelahan.
english: For those who will remain teaching in private schools, Estrada asked that these schools be given subsidies for teachers' salaries and other school needs.

text: Salamat kay napamatian sang DepEd ang ila ginapangabay.
english: Thankfully, DepEd listened to their request.

text: Nagpasalig ang DepEd nga matagaan gid man ang mga private schools sing bulig, labi na gid para sa mga estudyante kag mga manunudlo nga ma-apektuhan sang Covid-19.
english: The DepEd promised to provide assistance to private schools, especially for students and teachers affected by Covid-19.

text: “Iyan po ay ibinibigay natin doon sa mga paaralan para mabigyan ng assistance in the form of tuition and teachers’ subsidy ‘yung mga paaralan natin para hindi po magsarado (That’s given to schools to provide assistance in the form of tuition and teachers’ subsidy so that the schools will not shut down),” siling gani ni DepEd Undersecretary for Planning Service and Field Operations Jesus Mateo sa isa ka virtual public briefing./PN
english: “That's given to schools to provide assistance in the form of tuition and teachers' subsidy so that the schools will not shut down,” said the Department of Economic and Financial Planning Services. Operations Jesus Mateo in a virtual public briefing./PN

text: Isa sa mga ginabantayan sang Task Force on Moral Values and Formation subong nga Valentine’s Day amo ang room boys sa mga accommodation establishments nga ginpahayag nga nagapangbugaw.
english: One of the targets of the Task Force on Moral Values ​​and Formation this Valentine's Day is room boys in accommodation establishments who are allegedly prostitutes.

text: Ini matapos nga may ara sang isa ka staff sang isa man ka lodging house ang nagsugid sa nasambit nga opisina nga may ara sang mga staff sang pila ka mga establisyamento ang nagabugaw sang mga sex worker.
english: This is after a staff of another lodging house told the said office that some staff of some establishments are harassing sex workers.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Nestor Canong, Head sang Task Force on Moral Values and Formation, iya ginpahayag nga sandig sa nahatag nga impormasyon nga halin mismo sa mga kustomer, may yara sang room boys nga naga-sideline kag sila ang nagapangbugaw.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Nestor Canong, Head of the Task Force on Moral Values ​​and Formation, said that based on information provided by the customers themselves, there are room boys who are on the sidelines and they are the ones who are bullying.

text: Nagpaandam man ang talatapan nga mabug-at ang penalidad kun madakpan, kag may yara pa sang posible nga ma-preso.
english: The office also warned of severe penalties if caught, and some may face imprisonment.

text: Pahayag ni Canong, bisan nga ginatos-gatos lang ang madugang sa income sang room boys, daku naman ini nga halit sa buwas-damlag sang iban ilabi na kun mga menor de edad ang ila nga ginabugaw.
english: Canong said that although the income of room boys will increase by hundreds, it will be a big damage to the future of others especially if they abuse minors.

text: Padayun man sila nga nagapangbisita sa mga accommodation establishments agud man nga ma-imbestigaran kun may ara sang mga nagalapas sa pagsulundan kaangay sang wala dapat sang mga menor de edad sa establisyamento sa idalom sang child protection program.
english: They also continue to visit accommodation establishments to investigate if there are any violations of the rules such as minors should not be in the establishment under the child protection program.

text: Dugang pa niya nga kinahanglan man nga mangin mahinalungon sang publiko ilabi na ang may mga partners agud nga malikawan ang mga sexuallty-transmitted diseases.
english: He added that the public should also be vigilant especially those who have partners to avoid sexually-transmitted diseases.

text: Nagpaandam si U.S. President Donald Trump batok kay Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, lakip ang pagpadala sang ground troops, pag-ako sang mga covert operation, kag pagpalupad sang nuclear-capable bombers malapit sa baybayon sang Venezuela.
english: U.S. President Donald Trump has warned against Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, including sending ground troops, admitting to covert operations, and flying nuclear-capable bombers near the Venezuelan coast.

text: Sang Huwebes, ginkumpirma sang isa ka opsiyal sang U.S.nga nagpatigayon ang Amerika sang ika-anom nga lethal boat strike subong nga tuig batok sa isa ka ginapahayag nga drug boat sa Caribbean Sea.
english: On Thursday, a U.S. official confirmed that America conducted its sixth lethal boat strike this year against an alleged drug boat in the Caribbean Sea.

text: Depensa sang White House, kabahin ini sang ila kampnya batok sa iligal nga droga.
english: The White House defended it as part of its campaign against illegal drugs.

text: Suno kay White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt, ginakabig ni Trump nga isa ka “illegitimate regime” ang gobyerno ni Maduro nga ginaalegar may kahilabtanan sa illegal drug trade.
english: According to White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt, Trump considers Maduro's government an "illegitimate regime" that is allegedly involved in the illegal drug trade.

text:
Sang ginpamangkot naman kun may mando sa Central Intelligence Agency nga pahalinon ukon patyon si Maduro, gintawag lamang ini ni Trump nga isa ka “ridiculous question,” apang suno sa iya ang “Venezuela is feeling heat.”

Ginpahayag man ni Trump nga pagatun-an na sang iya administrasyon ang posibilidad sang pagpangbomba sa Venezuela.
english:
When asked if there was an order from the Central Intelligence Agency to remove or kill Maduro, Trump called it a "ridiculous question," but said "Venezuela is feeling heat.

Trump also said his administration would study the possibility of bombing Venezuela.

text: Samtang, ginpakamalaot naman Venezuelan Foreign Ministry ang Estado Unidos, sa diin gintawag pa ini nga ”policy of aggression, threats, and harassment.”
english: Meanwhile, the Venezuelan Foreign Ministry condemned the United States, calling it a "policy of aggression, threats, and harassment.

text: Kita nga mga Filipino, madamo sang ginasunod nga pamahiin kag pagpati nga naghalin sa aton nga mga lolo kag lola.
english: We Filipinos, follow many superstitions and beliefs that came from our ancestors.

text: Kaangay na lang sa una nga pagpagunting sang bata nga ginapahayag dapat ginahimo kun naga edad na ini sang isa ka tuig bangud kun mas timprano pa mahimo nga magsunggod ukon indi na magtubo sang maayo ang buhok ni baby.
english: Like the first haircut of a child that is said to be done when he is one year old because if it is earlier, the baby's hair may start or not grow properly.

text: Apang suno kay Dr. Cindy Gellner, isa ka pediatrician, indi matuod ang mga pagpati sa mga pagbag-o nga matabo sa buhok sang bata kun ini ang utdan ukon guntingon.
english: But according to Dr. Cindy Gellner, a pediatrician, said beliefs about the changes that will happen to a child's hair if it is cut or cut are not true.

text: Bangud ang hair texture kag growth rate sang kada tawo ang madetermina sa iya genetics kag maangkon lang ang pagbag-o kun siya ang mapaidalom sa chemotherapy.
english: Because the hair texture and growth rate of each person is determined by his genetics and can only be changed if he undergoes chemotherapy.

text: Isa sa kinahanglan nga panumdumon sang ginikanan antes guntingan ang buhok ni baby — kun bala masarangan na sini nga magpungko ukon mabalanse sang maayo ang iya ulo.
english: One of the things parents need to remember before cutting their baby's hair is whether they can sit up or balance their head properly.

text: Pangpatyon ang mga katapo sang militante nga Hamas kun magapadayon sila sa pagpangpatay sa mga tawo sa Gaza.
english: Members of the militant Hamas will be killed if they continue to kill people in Gaza.

text: Ini ang pinakaulihi nga paandam ni United States President Donald Trump.
english: This is the latest warning from United States President Donald Trump.

text: Kasunod ini sang naglapta nga videos nga ginapangtiro sang Hamas ang mga Palestinian nga mga sibilyan kasunod sang ila ceasefire sa Israel.
english: This follows the circulation of videos of Hamas shooting Palestinian civilians following their ceasefire with Israel.

text: Matandaan nga ang Hamas mismo ang nagsapubliko sang video kun sa diin makit-an nga nagatindog ang armado nga mga lalaki sa atubang sang walo ka nakaluhod nga mga tawo nga may tabon sa mata.
english: Hamas itself released a video showing armed men standing in front of eight kneeling people wearing blindfolds.

text: Ginpangtiro ang walo sa atubang man mismo sang iban nga mga tawo bangud suno sa Hamas, silot ini bangud nagalapas sila sa mga layi sa Gaza.
english: The eight were shot in front of other people because, according to Hamas, it was punishment for violating the laws in Gaza.

text:
Una na nga nagsiling si Trump nga wala man siya nahangawa sa amo nga krimen, bangud para sa iya, ginapangpatay ang mga “gang members.”
