Apang sa latest statement sini, ginsiling sini nga kun magpadayon ang Hamas sa pagpangpatay, wala sang mahimo ang US kundi patyon man ang amo nga militante nga grupo.
english:
Earlier, Trump said he was not surprised by the crime, because for him, gang members are being killed.

But in its latest statement, it said that if Hamas continues to kill, the US has no choice but to kill the militant group.

text: Wala sini ginklaro kun sin-o ang maga-intra kag magapatay sa militante, pero sang tinalikdan nga Myerkules, ginsiling sini nga indi na kinahanglan nga manghilabot pa ang US military sa sitwasyon sa Gaza.
english: He did not specify who would intervene and kill the militant, but last Wednesday, he said there was no need for the US military to interfere in the situation in Gaza.

text: Matandaan nga may partial withdrawal sang pwersa sang Israel sa Gaza kasunod sang 20-point ceasefire plan nga napatigayon paagi sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: It can be recalled that there was a partial withdrawal of Israeli forces from Gaza following the 20-point ceasefire plan reached through the United States of America.

text: Kasunod sadto, ang top US commander sa Middle East nga si Admiral Brad Cooper ang nag-demand sa Hamas nga untaton ang pagpangpatay sa mga Palestino nga sibilyan kag magsunod na lamang sa kun ano ang plano ni Trump.
english: Subsequently, the top US commander in the Middle East, Admiral Brad Cooper, demanded that Hamas stop killing Palestinian civilians and follow Trump's plan.

text: Ipaidalum sa istrikto nga quarantine sa Manila ang mga pinoy nga magapauli nagikan sa mga pungsod nga nakared-flag ukon nakatravel ban sa Pilipinas.
english: Filipinos returning from red-flag or travel ban countries in the Philippines will be placed under strict quarantine in Manila.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Mary Jane Juanico, COVID-19 spokesperson kag pinuno sang Infectious Disease Section sang DOH Region VI, iya ginpahayag nga gilayon nga ipaidalum sa Real-Time Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-PCR) test ang mga pumuluyo nga halin sa mga pungsod nga nakatravel ban sa Pilipinas.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Mary Jane Juanico, COVID-19 spokesperson and head of the Infectious Disease Section of DOH Region VI, said that residents from countries with travel bans in the Philippines will be immediately subjected to real-time Reverse Transcription Polymerase Chain Reaction (RT-PCR) test.

text: Suno kay Juanico, matapos ang tatlo ka adlaw, magapatigayon liwat sang swab test.
english: According to Juanico, after three days, the swab test will be conducted again.

text: Kun magnegatibo ang resulta sang duha ka swab test, diri na kag mapahanugutan nga makapuli ang mga indibidwal sa ila banwa.
english: If the results of the two swab tests are negative, the individuals will be allowed to return to their hometowns.

text: Nakadepende naman suno kay Juanico sa pagsulundan sang kada Local Government Unit ang pag-akomodar sang ila pumuluyo nga magapauli.
english: Juanico said it depends on the policy of each Local Government Unit to accommodate their residents who will return home.

text: Matandaan nga una na nga ginpahayag ni Presidential Spokesman Atty. Harry Roque nga indi dali-dali nga makasulod sa pungsod ang mga naghalin sa abroad bangud kinahanglan nga mag-agi sila sa hugot nga health screening kaupod na diri ang pagpaidalom sa swab test kag quarantine.
english: It can be recalled that Presidential Spokesman Atty. Harry Roque said those from abroad cannot enter the country immediately because they must undergo strict health screening including swab test and quarantine.

text: Ginklaro nanday Senator Bong Go kag Senador Robin Padilla nga indi sila magbiya sa Senate minority bloc.
english: Senator Bong Go and Senator Robin Padilla made it clear that they will not leave the Senate minority bloc.

text: Ini sa tunga sang huring-huring nga may pila ka mga senador nga nagatuyo nga magsaylo sa majority bloc.
english: This comes amid rumors that some senators are aiming to switch to the majority bloc.

text: Antes nag-adjourn ang session, nakit-an sanday Padilla kag Go nga may ginasulat.
english: Before the session adjourned, Padilla and Go were seen writing something.

text: Nagpakita man sila sang Duterte signature fist bump kag ginpakita ang papel nga may nakasulat nga: “Duterte bloc kami.
english: They also displayed a Duterte signature fist bump and showed a piece of paper that read: “We are Duterte bloc.

text:
Kayo na lang sumama!”

Nag-caption naman si Go sa iya post nga: “Solid Duterte bloc kami!
english:
You just go!”

Go captioned his post: “We are solid Duterte bloc!

text:
Kahit tatlo na lang kami maiwan.”

Ang ginatumod sini nga tatlo amo siya, si Padilla, kag si Senador Bato dela Rosa nga nangindulaan halin sang Nobyembre 2025 bangud sa report nga nagguwa na ang arrest warrant sang International Criminal Court (ICC) para sa iya.
english:
Even if there are only three of us left.”

The three are referring to him, Padilla, and Senator Bato dela Rosa who have been missing since November 2025 due to reports that the International Criminal Court (ICC) has issued an arrest warrant for him.

text: “Unahin ang trabaho, at huwag ang pulitika dahil serbisyong maayos at totoo ang nais makita at maramdaman ng taumbayan,” kabahin sang press release ni Go.
english: “Prioritize work, and not politics because good and true service is what the people want to see and feel,” Go said in a press release.

text: Gin-rekomendar sang International Olympic Committee (IOC) executive board nga ilakip ang boxing sa Los Angeles 2028 Summer Olympics.
english: The International Olympic Committee (IOC) executive board has recommended the inclusion of boxing in the Los Angeles 2028 Summer Olympics.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, matandaan nga nag-grant man ang committee sang provisional recognition sa World Boxing nga isa ka daku nga tikang para dalayon nga malakip ang boxing sa sports events sa masunod nga Olympiada.
english: Last month, it can be recalled that the committee also granted provisional recognition to World Boxing which is a big step to continue to include boxing in sports events in the next Olympics.

text: Suno kay IOC president Thomas Bach, kinahanglan pa nga ipaagi sa session sa Greece subong nga semana ang opisyal nga pag-apruba sini, apang suno sa iya, kampante siya nga makuha sang World Boxing ang approval.
english: IOC president Thomas Bach said it still needs to go through a session in Greece this week for official approval, but he said he was confident World Boxing would get the approval.

text: Matandaan nga sa Paris 2024 Games, ang IOC ang nagpanguna sa boxing competition matapos ginkakasan na sang pagkilala ang International Boxing Association sang 2023 bangud napaslawan nga maghimo sang reporma sa governance and finance.
english: It can be recalled that at the Paris 2024 Games, the IOC took the lead in the boxing competition after the International Boxing Association was removed from recognition in 2023 for failing to reform governance and finance.

text: Popular ang boxing sa mga kumpetisyon sa Olympics, kag isa man ini sa mga sports nga naga-excel ang Pilipinas.
english: Boxing is popular in Olympic competitions, and it is also one of the sports in which the Philippines excels.

text: Sang 2024, duha ka Pinay boxers ang nagdala-pauli sang bronze medals halin sa Paris nga amo nanday Nesthy Petecio kag Aira Villegas.
english: In 2024, two Filipino boxers brought home bronze medals from Paris, Nesthy Petecio and Aira Villegas.

text: Ikaduha na ini nga Olympic medal ni Petecio matapos nadag-an ang silver sa Japan sang 2021.
english: This is Petecio’s second Olympic medal after winning silver in Japan in 2021.

text: Natiruhan sa guya ang isa ka lalaki matapos gin-agawan sini sang mikropono ang upod niya sa videokehan sa Tagum City, Davao del Norte.
english: A man was stabbed in the face after he robbed his companion of a microphone at a videokehan in Tagum City, Davao del Norte.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, magkaupod sila nga nagainom sang ginkuha sang biktima ang mikropono sa suspek samtang nagakanta ini.
english: According to the investigation, they were drinking together when the victim took the microphone from the suspect while he was singing.

text: Nagbais ang duha kag didto na nagbunot sang pusil ang suspek kag gintiro sa guya ang biktima.
english: The two had an argument and the suspect pulled out a gun and shot the victim in the face.

text: Madasig nga gindala sa ospital ang biktima samtang nakapalagyo naman ang suspek.
english: The victim was rushed to the hospital while the suspect fled the scene.

text: Naga-ugtas ang mga pulis didto sa New Orleans, Louisiana, USA bangud makumpiska matuod nila ang marijuana kun ara sa guwa, apang may ara gid sila nga indi mapunggan nga makonsumo ini kun ara na sa sulod sang evidence room!
english: The police in New Orleans, Louisiana, USA are angry because they can confiscate marijuana when it is outside, but they can't stop consuming it when it is inside the evidence room!

text: Ang problema sang otoridad indi amo ang police officers nga abi mo adik sa droga, kundi ang mga ilaga nga amo ang pakadto-pakari sa building kag makasarang magtultol sang mga marijuana nga ginagamit sang mga pulis bilang ebidensya sa mga kaso.
english: The problem of the authorities is not the police officers who you think are addicted to drugs, but the rats who are coming and going in the building and can trace the marijuana used by the police as evidence in cases.

text: Ginpahayag pa sang hepe nga si Anne Kirkpatrick sa city council meeting nga nakit-an nila nga nagaka-“high” pa ang mga ilaga bangud sa pag-it-it sang marijuana — butang nga indi kahalam-utan kundi makailinit para sa ila.
english: Chief Anne Kirkpatrick told the city council meeting that they have found that rats are still getting “high” from smoking marijuana — something that is not unpleasant but hot for them.

text: Problemado sila suno sa hepe bangud posible maapektuhan sang ilaga ang mga kaso-kriminal nga naangot sa marijuana.
english: The chief said they are worried because the rat may affect criminal cases related to marijuana.

text: Nahibaluan nga lakip man sa ginplastar sini sa criminal justice committee sang amo nga syudad amo nga indi na maayo para sa ila trabaho ang building nga ila nahamtangan nga natukod pa sadtong 1968.
english: It was learned that among the things he presented to the criminal justice committee of the city is that the building they are located in, which was built in 1968, is no longer suitable for their work.

text: Magluwas sa problema sa ilaga kag sa ila higko, lakip man sa ulugtasan suno sa iya amo ang mga tanga kag ang problema sa maintenance kaangay sang guba nga elevator kag wala nagagana nga plumbing kag amo man ang air conditioning system nga nag-collapse sang nagligad pa nga summer.
english: Besides the problem of rats and their droppings, he said, also the problem is the lice and the problem of maintenance such as the broken elevator and not working plumbing as well as the air conditioning system that collapsed last summer.

text: WALA kita natingala kon ngaa gustuhon sang mga pumuluyo nga ipabilin ang frankisa sang ABS-CBN kag ipadayon ang pagpagwa sang iya mga programa sa ila mga puluy-an.
english: WE ARE not surprised why the people want to keep the ABS-CBN franchise and continue to broadcast its programs in their homes.

text: Ang resulta sang survey sang Social Weather Station (SWS) nga ginpagwa sini sadtong Hulyo 11 nagasiling nga 75 porsyento sang mga pumuluyo luyag i-renew ang frankisa sang ABS-CBN agud  makita nila liwat ang mga matahum nga mga programa sini sa TV.
english: The results of a survey by the Social Weather Station (SWS) released on July 11 say that 75 percent of the people want to renew the ABS-CBN franchise so that they can see its beautiful TV programs again.

text: Sa isa gani ka survey sang isa ka lokal nga radyo, ang tanan nga nag-react nagpahayag nga luyag gid nila nga i-renew ang frankisa sang ABS-CBN.
english: In a survey by a local radio station, all respondents expressed their desire to renew the ABS-CBN franchise.

text: Ginakahidlawan nila gihapon ang paborito nila nga mga programa dira kag ginakasubo nga nauntat ini.
english: They still miss their favorite programs there and are sad that they have stopped.

text: Naluoy man sila sa mga 11,000 ka empleyado sini nga nawad-an sing trabaho.
english: They also felt sorry for its approximately 11,000 employees who lost their jobs.

text: Ginapasalamatan pa gani nila ang mga kaayuhan nga nahatag sini sa mga pumuluyo, katulad sang 163 Foundation nga nagabulig sa mga kabataan kag ang wala puknat nga pagbulig sa mga nalisdan sa bagyo kag bisan sa sining pagpamintas sang Covid-19.
english: They even thank the benefits it has brought to the people, such as the 163 Foundation that helps children and the tireless help to those affected by the typhoon and even this Covid-19 pandemic.

text: Wala gani nila ginasapak ang akusasyon ni Presidente Duterte kag sang iya mga kaalyado sa pulitika batok sa ABS-CBN.
english: They even ignore the accusations of President Duterte and his political allies against ABS-CBN.

text: Ina tungod ang nakita lang nila amo ang kaayuhan nga nahimo sini, labi na gid kay wala man sing may napamatud-an sa mga akusasyon batok diri, nga ginpanginwala man gani sang ABS-CBN.
english: That's because they only see the good it has done, especially since none of the accusations against it have been proven, which ABS-CBN has denied.

text: Nagagwa gani nga ang pagpamatok nila sa ABS-CBN bunga lang sang ila interes personal kag interes sa pulitika nga natapakan sang ABS-CBN sa obligasyon sini agud dampigan ang Demokrasya, labi na gid ang pagpasanyog sang Freedom of Speech sang mga pumuluyo, Freedom of Expression sang mga manunulat kag mga artista, kag sang Free Press sang aton mga mamahayag.
english: It turns out that their opposition to ABS-CBN is the result of their personal interests and political interests that ABS-CBN has trampled on its obligation to defend democracy, especially the promotion of Freedom of Speech of the people, Freedom of Expression of writers and artists, and our Free Press.

text: Essentially, ang paghatag sang frankisa sa ABS-CBN, katulad sa iban nga public utilities katulad sa elektrisidad kag tubig, ina tungod sa ikasarang kag katutom sini sa pagserbisyo sa mga pumuluyo kag indi kon sa ano pa nga rason.
english: Essentially, the franchise to ABS-CBN, like other public utilities such as electricity and water, is because of its ability and loyalty to serve the people and not for any other reason.

text: Kon may lagas dira ang gobyerno sa ila, ina tungod sa palpak sini nga pagserbisyo sa mga pumuluyo.
english: If the government is angry with them, it is because of its failure to serve the people.

text: Apang kon wala man lang ining reklamo nila, binuang ina ya nga lagson ini sang gobyerno.
english: But if they don't have this complaint, it's foolish for the government to pursue it.

text: Lagson mo ang isa ka public utility nga nagahimo sing kaayuhan sa mga pumuluyo tungod lang sa interes personal kag interes sa pulitika?
english: Would you go after a public utility that does good to the citizens just because of personal interest and political interest?

text: Indi amo ina ang rason, kundi kon bala gaserbisyo ini sing maayo ukon indi sa pumuluyo.
english: That's not the reason, but whether it serves the people well or not.

text: Apang testigo ang mga pumuluyo nga naluyagan nila ang serbisyo sang ABS-CBN sa ila kag sa Demokrasya nga ginsumpaan ta nga klase sang pagpangabuhi sa aton Konstitusyon.
english: But the people are witnesses that they like the service of ABS-CBN to them and to the Democracy that we swore to as a way of life in our Constitution.

text: Kon may dapat masaway ang gobyerno sa ABS-CBN amo lang kon nagpalpak ini sa pagserbisyo sa mga pumuluyo.
english: If the government should criticize ABS-CBN, it is only if it failed to serve the people.

text: Pero wala, kay naluyagan pa gani sini ang pagserbisyo sini.
english: But no, because it even likes serving it.

text: Kon may ara gid man nga masaway ang gobyerno ina lang kon may nalabag ini nga kasuguan.
english: If the government can be criticized, it is if it has broken the law.

text: Apang wala man, kay wala man gani may napamatud-an nga kasal-anan ini.
english: But no, because it was not even proven guilty.

text: Puro man lang pagmulay sa kuno “bias” ang ABS-CBN sa ila.
english: ABS-CBN is just criticizing their alleged “bias” against them.

text:
***

Aba, natural lang nga “bias” ang ano man nga media institution batok sa pang-abuso kag korapsyon sa gobyerno kag ang pagbale-wala sini sa kinamatarong sang mga pumuluyo sa aton Demokrasya, nga dapat tani nila respetuhon.
english:
***

Well, it is natural for any media institution to be biased against government abuse and corruption and its disregard for the rights of the people in our Democracy, which they should respect.

text:
Siling gani ni French philosopher nga si Voltaire, nga naghatag inspirasyon sa pagtukod sang Konstitusyon sang Estados Unidos, nga aton man ginasunod: “I may not like what you say against me, but I will defend to death your right to say it!”

Ginpanindugan man ni Voltaire ang Freedom of Religion kag Separation of Church and State, nga ginasunod man sang konstitusyon sang Estados Unidos kag sang aton man konstitusyon.
english:
French philosopher Voltaire, who inspired the founding of the United States Constitution, said: “I may not like what you say against me, but I will defend to death your right to say it!”

Voltaire also advocated Freedom of Religion and Separation of Church and State, which are also followed by the US constitution and our constitution.

text: Siling man ni Abraham Lincoln: “A government of the people, by the people and for the people,” indi bala?
english: Abraham Lincoln also said: “A government of the people, by the people and for the people,” right?

text: Indi kay “a government by the government against the people”.
english: Not because “a government by the government against the people”.

text: In  fact, panindugan man ini sang mga tapos sa Philippine Military Academy kag PNPA kag sang mga military academy sa Estados Unidos nga na-train sa Demokrasya.
english: In fact, this is also the position of graduates of the Philippine Military Academy and PNPA and of military academies in the United States who are trained in Democracy.

text: Panindugan ta man ang Bill of Rights sa aton Demokrasya nga nagadampig sa wala pinilian nga kinamatarong sang tanan, inosente man siya ukon akusado sang krimen.
english: Let us also uphold the Bill of Rights in our Democracy that stands for the indiscriminate rights of all, whether innocent or accused of crime.

text: Tani indi pagkalimtan ini sang aton mga opisyales sa gobyerno.
english: I hope our government officials don't forget this.

text: Otherwise, gobyerno kita sang oligarkiya sang nagagahum sa gobyerno.
english: Otherwise, we are a government of an oligarchy of those who rule the government.

text: Nga kaaway sang aton Demokrasya!/PN
english: Who is the enemy of our Democracy!/PN

text: Nagkuyampad kag halos indi makahibalo kun sa diin makadto ang duha ka kawatan matapos sila nakibot sang naghambal sa closed-circuit television (CCTV) nga amo gali ang tag-iya sang balay kag live sila nga ginalantaw sa ila tuyo nga magpangawat!
english: The two thieves were shocked and almost did not know where to go after they were surprised to hear on closed-circuit television (CCTV) that it was the owner of the house and they were being watched live in their attempt to steal!

text: Natabo ini sa Naga City, Camarines Sur sang ginsulod sang duha ka lalaki ang isa ka daku nga balay pasado ‘las kuatro sa kaagahon.
english: The incident occurred in Naga City, Camarines Sur when two men broke into a large house around 4:00 am.

text: Pagkasulod sang duha ka lalaki, nakit-an gilayon nila ang camera gani nag-uba ang isa sang isa nga bayo kag gingamit ini agud tabunan ang nawong.
english: When the two men entered, they immediately saw the camera so one took off the other's clothes and used it to cover his face.

text: Naka-hoodie naman ang isa ka upod sini nga amo ang nagsaka sa second floor kag ginpatay pa sini ang suga.
english: One of his companions, wearing a hoodie, went up to the second floor and turned off the light.

text: Samtang naga-flashlight ang isa ka kriminal sa sala kag nagapangita sang pwede matakab, baw, may naghambal sa CCTV rason nga daw diutayan lang ini ma-heart attack!
english: While a criminal was flashlighting the living room and looking for something to escape, someone said something on the CCTV that made him feel like he was about to have a heart attack!

text: Pila pa ka segundos ang nagligad sang nareyalisar sini nga tag-iya sang balay ang naghambal rason nga gintawag sini ang kaupod kag nagdalagan pa-guwa.
english: A few seconds passed when he realized that the owner of the house was speaking so he called his companion and ran outside.

text: Isa ka combat engineer sang militar sa Amerika ang lalaki nga nabatian sa CCTV kag na-access sini ang surveillance camera sa bulig sang internet.
english: The man was heard on CCTV and accessed the surveillance camera with the help of the internet.

text: Natukiban sang ulihi nga ginguba sang duha ka lalaki ang padlock rason nga nakasulod sila sa balay.
english: It was later discovered that the two men broke the padlock allowing them to enter the house.

text: Wala sila sang nabitbit nga bisan ano nga gamit.
english: They were not carrying any equipment.

text: Mas ginpahugot naman sang barangay ang ila nga seguridad batok sa mga kawatan kag nagpahanumdom naman ang pulis sa mga pumuluyo nga mag-aligmat gid ilabi na kun may makaduluda nga tawo sa palibot.#
english: The barangay has tightened its security against thieves and the police reminded residents to be vigilant especially if there are suspicious people around.

text: Sa una nga kahigayunan, ginpakigbahin ni Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray ang rason sang breakup nila sang aktor nga si Sam Milby.
english: For the first time, Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray shared the reason for her breakup with actor Sam Milby.

text: Ginpahayag sini kun paano ini tuman nga nasakitan sang mahibaluan nga indi pa handa si Sam sa commitment sa ila relasyon nga duha matapos ang engagement sini.
english: She expressed how she was hurt to learn that Sam was not ready to commit to their relationship after his engagement.

text: Suno pa sa beauty queen-actress nga naghimakas pa ini nga maghimo sang madamo nga mga adjustments para mapabilin ang ila relasyon, apang suno pa sa iya nga kinahanglan na sini nga untaton bangud sobra na ang iya ginhimo agud nga mapabilin ini apang indi sa gihapon makita ni Sam nga ma-engage kay Cat.
english: The beauty queen-actress said she struggled to make many adjustments to keep their relationship, but she said she had to stop because she did too much to keep it but Sam still couldn't see her engaged to Cat.

text: Ginlaragway man ni Catriona bilang isa sa pinakamabudlay nga desisyon nga ginhimo sini sa iya nga kabuhi bangud matuod gid sini nga ginahigugma ang aktor.
english: Catriona also described it as one of the hardest decisions she made in her life because she truly loved the actor.

text: Ginakonsiderar man ni Catriona ang na-eksperiensyahan nga sakit bilang isa ka lesson kag gin-ako ang man sini ang madamo nga mga kabudlayan nga gin-agyan sini sa relasyon nga ginkabig sini nga importante.
english: Catriona also considers the illness as a lesson and acknowledged the many difficulties she went through in the relationship she considered important.

text: Suno pa sa beauty queen nga nagpaidalom man ini sa isa ka therapy matapos ang ila break up kag nakabulig man ini para mas mangin malapit pa ini sa iya mga ”core group.” kaangay sang iya pamilya kag mga kaabyanan.
english: The beauty queen said she also underwent therapy after their break up and it helped her to be closer to her core group. like his family and friends.

text: Sa pihak sang natabo sini sa ila relasyon ni Sam, ginpakigbahin ni Catriona ang pagpati sa gihapon sa paghigugma kag padayon ini nga nagapangamuyo sa iya mangin bana sa pila kaadlaw.
english: Despite what happened to her relationship with Sam, Catriona shared that she still believes in love and continues to pray for her future husband.

text: Sa karon, nagapakig-date na ini isa ka non-showbiz guy, apang wala pa sini ginpasapubliko ang identity sini.
english: She is currently dating a non-showbiz guy, but she has not yet made his identity public.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginpasapubliko ni Catriona kag Sam Milby ang ila nga engagement sang tuig 2023 kag ila ginkumpirmar ang ila break up sang tuig 2025.
english: Catriona and Sam Milby announced their engagement in 2023 and confirmed their break up in 2025.

text: Nag-initay ang diskusyon nanday Senator Kiko Pangilinan kag Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano sa plenaryo kun sa diin gina-istoryahan ang Senate Resolution No.
english: Senator Kiko Pangilinan and Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano had a heated discussion in plenary where Senate Resolution No.

text: 256 nga nagakondena sang mga pahayag sang Chinese embassy sa Manila batok sa mga opisyal kag institusyon sang Pilipinas.
english: 256 condemning statements by the Chinese embassy in Manila against Philippine officials and institutions.

text: Nagsentro ang baisay sang duha ka mga senador sa paggamit ni PCG spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Commodore Jay Tarriela sang caricature ni Chinese President Xi Jinping kadungan sang isa ka speaking engagement.
english: The argument between the two senators centered on PCG spokesperson for the West Philippine Sea Commodore Jay Tarriela's use of a caricature of Chinese President Xi Jinping during a speaking engagement.

text: Sa amo nga debate, gin-insister ni Cayetano nga nakasala si Tarriela.
english: During the debate, Cayetano insisted that Tarriela was guilty.

text: Delikado ini suno sa iya kun diplomasya ang istoryahan.
english: He said this is dangerous when it comes to diplomacy.

text: Ini ang rason suno sa iya nga indi masuportahan sang Senate minority si Tarriela sa amo nga resolusyon ni Pangilinan.
english: This is the reason, he said, that the Senate minority cannot support Tarriela in Pangilinan's resolution.

text: Nagsabat naman si Pangilinan nga wala man gani na-mensyonar ang pangalan ni Tarriela sa resolusyon.
english: Pangilinan replied that Tarriela's name was not even mentioned in the resolution.

text: Ang ginatumod suno kay Pangilinan amo ang pangkabug-usan nga social media operations sang embahada sang China.
english: Pangilinan said the reference is to the overall social media operations of the Chinese embassy.

text: Kun istoryahan naman ang caricature suno kay Pangilinan, amo man gani sini ang ginahimo sang China kaangay sang Chinese state-controlled media outlet nga Xinhua nga masami naga-publish sang caricatures ni President Bongbong Marcos.
english: When it comes to caricatures, Pangilinan said China is doing the same thing like the Chinese state-controlled media outlet Xinhua which often publishes caricatures of President Bongbong Marcos.

text: Gin-suspend na ang sesyon sang nagpamangkot si Cayetano nga kun amo sini ang panindugan ni Pangilinan, mahimo bala suno sa iya nga maka-post man ang iya staff sang meme nga nagapakita sang itsura sang senador.
english: The session was suspended when Cayetano asked if Pangilinan's position was this, could his staff also post a meme showing the senator's appearance.

text: ANO GID BALA ANG GINA-KONDENA?
english: WHAT IS CONDEMNING?

text: Liwat nga nagtaas ang tensyon sa tunga nanday Cayetano kag Pangilinan sang gina-istoryahan kun ano gid nga statement sang Chinese embassy ang gina-istoryahan nila sa Senate Resolution No.
english: Tension between Cayetano and Pangilinan rose again when they discussed what statement the Chinese embassy was making on Senate Resolution No.

text: “Lahat ng sabihin ng Chinese embassador, mali, eh paano kung sabihin niya ‘good morning’, ‘ni hao’?
english: “Everything the Chinese ambassador says is wrong, how can he say 'good morning', 'ni hao'?

text: Iku-condemn natin yun?
english: Do we condemn that?

text: Bawal nang mag-good morning sa Pilipinas?,” pamangkot ni Cayetano.
english: Is it illegal to say good morning in the Philippines?,” Cayetano asked.

text: Ginsabat ini ni Pangilinan nga klaro man ang mga ‘whereas’ sa resolusyon, kag kun mag-research si Cayetano, mahibaluan sini kun ano ang ginatumod.
english: Pangilinan replied that the whereas in the resolution are clear, and if Cayetano does research, he will know what is being referred to.

text: Nag-raise sang point of order si Cayetano, apang nanindugan si Pangilinan nga wala pa ini nakatapos sa paghambal.

text: SA MASAMI, ang kahadlok (fear) gina-trigger ini sang pamahog sa aton kabuhi (life threatening), sa ikaayong lawas (health), kag sa aton ikaayo nga kahimtangan (well-being) sa kabug-usan – matuod man ukon imagined lang.
english: OFTEN, fear is triggered by a threat to our life (life threatening), our health (health), and our well-being in general – whether real or imagined.

text: Sakop na sini ang mga pamahog sa aton pisikal, emosyonal, ukon sikolohikal nga kaayuhan.
english: This includes threats to our physical, emotional, or psychological well-being.

text: In fact, ang kahadlok bahin sang aton kinaiya nga udyok (instinct).
english: In fact, fear is part of our instinct.

text: Matun-an man naton ang kahadlok sa aton experyensya ukon sa aton matudlo sa aton kaugalingon ukon sang matudlo man sang iban.
english: We can also learn fear from our own experience or from what we can teach ourselves or what others can teach us.

text: Ang masaktan (harmed), por ejemplo, gahatag sa aton sing instinctive nga kahadlok sa pamahog sini sa aton padayon nga pagkabuhi (survival).
english: Being harmed, for example, gives us an instinctive fear of its threat to our survival.

text: Ang kahadlok matun-an man naton sa aton pakig-relasyon sa iban nga tawo, lugar, ukon sitwasyon sa diin may negatibo kita nga asosasyon ukon experyensya.
english: Fear can also be learned in our relationships with other people, places, or situations where we have a negative association or experience.

text: Ang pila ka kahadlok pwede man naton itudlo sa aton kaugalingon, katulad sang pagpa-abenturar sa mga hilimuon nga samtang makahatag sing kahadlok sa aton matantiya man naton nga masarangan atubangon.
english: Some fears can also be taught to ourselves, such as adventuring in activities that while frightening us can also be manageable.

text: Katulad sang amat-amat nga pagtudlo, sa diin pwede man kita makapatudlo sa iban, sang kahadlok sa aton kaugalingon sa una nga experyensya sa paglangoy,  pagdalagan sing madasig, ang pag-risgo sa mountain biking, kag iban pa tubtub nga mahimo na naton ang sobra sangsa kinaandan naton nga masarangan, nga natural igakalipay naton tungod gani sa matigayon nga dugang ukon bag-o nga abilidad.
english: Like gradual teaching, where we can also teach others, the fear of ourselves in the first experience of swimming, running fast, taking risks in mountain biking, etc. until we can do more than we usually can, which naturally we will enjoy because of the additional or new skills acquired.

text: In other words, may benepisyo man ang mag-experyensya sing kahadlok.
english: In other words, there is a benefit to experiencing fear as well.

text:
***

Sa likud sining mga kahadlok, yara man ang instinctive nga kaisug sang tawo, ang natun-an naton sa aton asosasyon kag experyensya, ukon ang matudlu man sa aton sang iban.
english:
***

Behind these fears, there is also the instinctive courage of man, what we learn from our association and experience, or what others teach us.

text: Yara dira sa aton ang instinctive nga kaisug (courage) agud pangapinan ang aton kabataan kag mga pinalangga, sa diin ginarisgo naton ang aton personal nga kaayuhan.
english: We have the instinctive courage to defend our children and loved ones, at the risk of our personal well-being.

text: Yara man ang kaisug agud ibato ang palangga naton nga pungsod batok sa mga kaaway, kag tindugan sing matuod-tuod ang aton mga kinamatarong nga indi naton mayaub sa kon sin-o man, isahanon man ukon may kaugyon, batok sa mga manuglupig.
english: There is also the courage to defend our beloved country against the enemies, and to stand up for our rights that we cannot bow to anyone, alone or in concert, against the oppressors.

text: Subong man ang tinun-an ta nga kaisug agud tindugan ang aton pagtuo sa Ginuo bilang martir ukon hangaway agud ipadaug ang kagamhanan sang Ginuo sa aton katilingban.
english: Likewise, we learn courage to stand up for our faith in the Lord as martyrs or warriors to overcome the power of the Lord in our society.

text: Yara pa gid ang kaisug nga matudlo naton sa aton kaugalingon agud irisgo ang aton kaugalingon agud mabuhi ang aton pamilya.
english: There is still the courage we can teach ourselves to risk ourselves to save our families.

text: Katulad bala sang mangingisda nga gasulay sa kalain sang panahon sa lawod agud makahulik sang isda agud ipakaon sa iya kabataan kag asawa samtang nagapangamuyo sang pag-amlig sa iya sang Ginuo samtang nagapangisda.
english: Is it like a fisherman who braves the bad weather at sea to catch fish to feed his children and wife while praying for the Lord's protection while fishing.

text: Kag katulad man sa matun-an naton nga kaisug kag pagpangisug (daring) sa pag-risgo sang kaugalingon agud malutsan ang kapintas sang COVID-19, agud padayon kita nga mabuhi kag ang aton pamilya nga indi mapitsil sang kahadlok samtang nagapatigayon sang aton kabuhian.
english: And as we learn the courage and daring to risk ourselves to overcome the cruelty of COVID-19, so that we and our families can continue to live without being overwhelmed by fear while living our lives.

text:
***

Salamat kay sa karon indi naton kinahanglan magyaub sa COVID-19 nga nagapakuribong nga wala sing mahimo sadtong wala pa kita sing nahibal-an parti sini.
english:
***

Thankfully, we don't have to worry about COVID-19 making us helpless when we didn't know anything about it.

text: Karon natun-an na naton ang bagay nga kaisug sa bulig sang masaligan nga ihibalo kag panugyan sang aton mga scientist kag health authorities agud padayon nga mabuhi sing may pagsalig bisan sa tunga sa sining pamahog sang COVID-19.
english: Now we have learned the right courage with the help of reliable knowledge and advice from our scientists and health authorities to continue to live with confidence even in the midst of this threat of COVID-19.

text: In other words, okey lang kita basta ginasunod naton ang panugyan sa paggamit sang face mask sa publiko, pag-distancia halin sa iban, paglikaw sa gutok nga mga lugar, pagpanghugas gamit ang habon kag tubig ukon sanitizer, paglikaw sa pagtandug sang mahigko nga kamot sa ilong, baba kag mata kay dira nagasulod ang COVID-19 virus, pagpabakud sang aton immunity sang bagay nga mga pagkaon, indi pagpalya sa bulong kon may ginabatyag nga makapahina sa aton, kag ang indi gid pagbulag sa Ginuo.
english: In other words, we are okay as long as we follow the advice to wear face masks in public, keep distance from others, avoid crowded places, wash with soap and water or sanitizer, avoid touching dirty hands to the nose, mouth and eyes because that's where the COVID-19 virus enters, strengthen our immunity feels to weaken us, and to never be separated from the Lord.

text: Kag kon magmasakit gid man sa COVID-19, daku man ang aton paglaum nga ma-survive naton ini tungod 80 porsyento sini mga “mild” lang nga mga kaso kag may mga bagay man nga bulong nga mahatag sang gobyerno.
english: And if we do get sick with COVID-19, we have great hope that we will survive it because 80 percent of them are “mild” cases and there are good medicines that the government can provide.

text: Tungod sini, sin-o pa ang nahadlok sa COVID-19?
english: Because of this, who else is afraid of COVID-19?

text: Kon may kahadlok pa gid man, na-overwhelm na ini sang kaisug nga natun-an naton gani sa panugyan sang mga health authorities, upod sa lubos nga pagtugyan naton sang aton kaugalingon kag pamilya sa Ginuo./PN
english: If there is still fear, it has been overwhelmed by the courage that we have learned from the advice of the health authorities, along with our full surrender of ourselves and our families to the Lord./PN

text: Nagsungka na ang nabilin nga anom sa 14 ka mga pulis nga involved sa ginaalegar pagpangawat kag paghimulos sa isa ka ­18-anyos nga Grade-9 student sa Bacoor City, Cavite.
english: The remaining six of the 14 policemen involved in the alleged robbery and rape of an 18-year-old Grade-9 student in Bacoor City, Cavite have surrendered.

english: According to PNP-Drug Enforcement Group Acting Director P/Brig.

text: Elmer Ragay, all accounted na ang 14 ka pulis nga involved sa robbery-rape sa Bacoor City.
english: Elmer Ragay, all accounted for the 14 policemen involved in the robbery-rape in Bacoor City.

text: Isa-isa nga nagsungka ang “at large” nga mga pulis kag gin-updan sang ila nga mga pamilya sa pagsurrender sa PDEG Headquarters.
english: One by one, the “at large” policemen surrendered and were accompanied by their families to surrender at the PDEG Headquarters.

text: MADUGAY ang aton pagpangabuhi sa pungsod sa idalom sang “Rule of Law”, nga ang pagpatuman sini sandig sa “universal principles of law”, katulad sang Bill of Rights kag Separation of Powers sa tunga sang Executive, Legislative kag Judiciary sa aton advocacy sa Demokrasya.
english: We have long lived in the country under the “Rule of Law”, whose implementation is based on “universal principles of law”, such as the Bill of Rights and Separation of Powers between the Executive, Legislative and Judiciary in our advocacy for Democracy.

text: Gani mabudlay nga magbalik pa kita sa “Rule by (any) Law” sa pagpatuman sang isa ka authoritarian nga pagginahum nga supak sa Rule of Law.
english: So it is difficult for us to go back to “Rule by (any) Law” to impose an authoritarian rule that is contrary to the Rule of Law.

text: In fact, ginpangisugan ta gid nga mapukan ang martial law regime ni Marcos.
english: In fact, we worked hard to overthrow Marcos' martial law regime.

text: Tungod sini, ang ano man nga kasuguan nga nagabalewala sa kaundan sang 1987 Constitution nga nagpabalik sang Demokrasya sa aton pungsod dapat lang pamalabagan naton sing may kaisug sing panghuna-huna kag pag-protesta.
english: Therefore, any law that ignores the contents of the 1987 Constitution that restored democracy in our country should be opposed with courageous thought and protest.

text: Isa sa sining kasuguan amo ang Anti-Terror Bill nga ginpirmahan na ni President Duterte sadtong Hulyo 3.
english: One of these laws is the Anti-Terror Bill that President Duterte signed on July 3.

text: Nagahatag ini sing poder sa Presidente (Executive) agud mag-interpreter sa iya kaugalingon kag sang iya instrumentalities kon ano ang “terrorism”, “inciting to terrorism”, kag ang pag-authorize sang arrest kag detention sa Anti-Terrorism Council nga ginapasakupan sang cabinet secretaries nga tani yara sa poder sang korte sunu sa mga legal experts.
english: It gives the President (Executive) the power to interpret for himself and his instrumentalities what is “terrorism”, “inciting to terrorism”, and the authorization of arrest and detention in the Anti-Terrorism Council which is composed of cabinet secretaries which should be in the power of the court according to legal experts.

text: In other words, ang ining Anti-Terror Law (tapos ma-publish sa sulod sang 15 ka adlaw) labag sa aton 1987 Constitution nga dapat naton i-protesta sa tanan nga lehitimo nga palaagyan tubtub sa Korte Suprema.
english: In other words, this Anti-Terror Law (after being published within 15 days) is against our 1987 Constitution which we must protest through all legitimate channels up to the Supreme Court.

text: Isa kita sa sining naga-protesta sa sining Anti-Terror Law kay daku ini nga tunok sa Free Expression sang mga pumuluyo, kinamatarong sang alternative position sang established political opposition agud makigsuay sa gobyerno nga yara sa poder, kag sa obligasyon sang Free Press agud pangapinan ang mga pumuluyo sa “excesses” sang abusado kag corrupt nga gobyerno.
english: We are one of those protesting against this Anti-Terror Law because it is a big thorn in the Free Expression of the people, the right of the alternative position of the established political opposition to challenge the government in power, and the obligation of the Free Press to defend the people against the excesses of the abusive and corrupt government.

text: Labi na gid kay kilala si Presidente Duterte sa pagka-sensitibo sa criticismo kag sang mga nagapamatok sa iya luyag ipatuman, nga tungod sini pwede niya gamiton ining iya poder sa Anti-Terror Law sa indi nagakabagay nga pagpanglagas sang kontra sa pulitika kag mga media practitioners.
english: Especially since President Duterte is known for his sensitivity to criticism and those who oppose his policies, which allows him to use his power in the Anti-Terror Law to unduly persecute political opponents and media practitioners.

text: Tungod sini, upod kita sa pag-protesta sa sining Anti-Terror Law sa kon diin man nga lehitimo nga fora tubtub sa Korte Suprema.
english: Therefore, we join in protesting against this Anti-Terror Law in any legitimate forum up to the Supreme Court.

text:
***

Madamo gid nga mga pumuluyo ang nagpasalamat nga ginbalik ang pagbukas sang mga borders sang mga probinsya sang Iloilo, Antique, Capiz kag Aklan.
english:
***

Many residents expressed their gratitude for the reopening of the borders of the provinces of Iloilo, Antique, Capiz and Aklan.

text:
Personal gani nga nagpasalamat si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry P. Treñas sa pagbukas liwat sang bug-os nga isla sang Panay agud, sunu sa iya, “Maka-move on na kita agud pasanyugon ang aton ekonomiya nga nagasandig sa pag-ulugyon sang tanan…”

Obserbasyon ni meyor nga ang padayon nga pagsarado sang mga borders, although indi gid man total lockdown, nakahatag problema sa siyudad sa hulag sang ekonomiya sini kag sa iban pa nga kaingud nga mga lugar.
english:
Iloilo City Mayor Jerry P. Treñas personally expressed his gratitude for the reopening of the entire island of Panay so that, he said, “We can move on to develop our economy that relies on the cooperation of all...”

The mayor observed that the continuous closure of borders, although not a total lockdown, has caused problems in the city's economic movement and other neighboring areas.

text: Sunu sa iya, nagdugang sa pagpapin-ut ini sang “aton pangabuhi” nga naga-antos na sing madugay tungod sa binulan nga lockdown kag quarantine sang mga pumuluyo kag mga negosyo.
english: He said this has added to the shortening of “our lives” that have been suffering for a long time due to the months of lockdown and quarantine of residents and businesses.

text: “Salamat kay liwat makahulag kita sing maluag-luag agud mapasanyog ang aton ekonomiya, kag mabalik ang madamo nga trabaho sa aton pumuluyo kag ang pagbukas man sang mga negosyo,” dugang pa niya.
english: “Thankfully, we can once again move freely to boost our economy, and bring back more jobs to our people and the opening of businesses,” he added.

text: “Tutal indi ta man mapauntat pa ang COVID-19.
english: “After all, we can't stop COVID-19.

text: Gani sige lang ang ining luag gawa ta nga pagpangabuhi kag sige man ang away naton sa COVID-19 nga napamatud-an naton nga kaya naman naton himuon,” siling gani ni meyor.
english: So we will continue to live our lives and we will continue to fight against COVID-19 which we have proven that we can do,” said the mayor.

text: Sa subong, nakapalukmat pa sang pilas naton ang nagahimali na sa aton padayon nga away sa COVID-19 ang problema ta sa mga LSI kag OFW nga nagbalalik nga dala pa sang iban ang COVID-19 virus.
english: At present, our problem with LSIs and OFWs who have returned with others carrying the COVID-19 virus has added to our wounds.

text: “Apang handa kita sini sa ini nga problema.
english: “But we are prepared for this problem.

text:
Sa gilayon ginapa-quarantine naton anay sila bag-o tugtan sa ila pagpauli sa ila mga puluy-an kon hilway na sa COVID-19.”

“Nangin madasig man ang aton aksyon sa mga salawayon, samtang nagapangabay gid kita nga tumanon nila ang health protocols nga ginapanugyan sa ila kay para man ini sa aton tanan kaayuhan,” pahingapos na ni meyor.
english:
We will immediately quarantine them before allowing them to return home when they are free of COVID-19.”

“Our action against the perpetrators has been swift, while we strongly urge them to follow the health protocols that are advised to them because it is for the benefit of all of us,” the mayor concluded.

text: Nagalaum si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: Ini nga tuig amo man ang 80th anniversary sang diplomatic relations sa tunga sang Manila kag Washington.
english: This year also marks the 80th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Manila and Washington.

text: Ginhinambit ini ni Marcos kadungan sang presentasyon sang logo sang pagkomemorar sang Philippines-US Diplomatic Relations sa Malacañang, Pebrero 9.
english: Marcos said this during the presentation of the logo to commemorate the Philippines-US Diplomatic Relations in Malacañang, February 9.

english: It was at Philippa's Bakery headquarters in Melbourne, Australia where the female criminal was caught on surveillance cameras.

text: Lunsay itom ang suksok sini pati na ang iya nga sapatos.
english: He was wearing black and his shoes were all black.

text: Halos duha ka minutos ang ginlawig sang iya nga stretching sang ‘las tres sa kaagahon antes sini dalayon na nga ginsulod ang establisyemento.
english: He stretched for almost two minutes at 3 am before he immediately entered the establishment.

text: Suno sa bakery nga involved sa insidente, lakip sa ginkuha sang babaye amo ang almond croissant, isa ka pares sang sapatos, iPad, kag mga produkto nga ginagamit sa pagpaninlo.
english: According to the bakery involved in the incident, the woman took an almond croissant, a pair of shoes, an iPad, and cleaning products.

text: Gin-report man sang outlet nga ginkasuhan ini sang theft kag burglary apang nakaguwa man matapos nakapyansa.
english: The outlet also reported that he was charged with theft and burglary but was released on bail.

text: Natalana ini nga mag-atubang sa Melbourne Magistrates’ Court sa Mayo 22.#
english: He is scheduled to appear in Melbourne Magistrates’ Court on May 22.#

text: Ikaw bala nagapanag-iya sang motorsiklo kag ari ikaw diri sa Siudad sang Iloilo?
english: Do you own a motorcycle and are you here in Iloilo City?

text: Ka-Bombo, halungi gid ang imo motorsiklo kun indi mo gusto nga mangin ikaanom nga biktima sa serye sang motornapping nga mga kaso.
english: Ka-Bombo, take care of your motorcycle if you don't want to be the sixth victim in a series of motornapping cases.

text: Humalin sang Enero tubtob subong nga tunga-tunga sang Pebrero, may lima na ka mga kaso sang pagpangawat sang motorsiklo.
english: From January to this mid-February, there have been five cases of motorcycle theft.

text:
Yari ang lima ka mga insidente sang motornapping nga narekord sang Bombo Radyo:

Sa lima ka mga insidente, apat gid ang natabo sa Jaro kag wala gid sang bisan isa ang nadakpan.
english:
Here are five incidents of motornapping recorded by Bombo Radyo:

Of the five incidents, four occurred in Jaro and no one was arrested.

text: Ginalantaw man ang posibilidad nga pareho lang ang tawo sa likod sang sini nga motornapping sa Jaro.
english: The possibility that the same person is behind this motornapping in Jaro is also being looked into.

text: ANO ANG TIKANG SANG PNP?
english: WHAT IS THE PNP DOING?

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang otoridad sa pagpanguna ni PCol.
english: Authorities led by PCol.

text: Wilbert Parilla nga OIC director sang Iloilo City Police Office.
english: Wilbert Parilla, OIC director of the Iloilo City Police Office.

text: Ginausisa man sang maayo ang mga CCTV footages agud madasig nga makilal-an ang mga suspek.
english: CCTV footages are also being thoroughly examined to quickly identify the suspects.

text: Nagpahanumdom man ini sa publiko nga magdoble-halong ilabi na kun naga-park sa pampubliko nga lugar paagi sa pagsiguro nga naka-lock ang motorsiklo kag wala nabilin ang yabe.
english: He also reminded the public to be doubly careful especially when parking in public places by making sure that the motorcycle is locked and the key is not left behind.

text: Dugang niya, kun mabiktima gid man sang motornappers, mas mayo nga mag-report gilayon sa otoridad agud madasig nga makaimbestigar kag malagas ukon mapangita ang mga kawatan.
english: He added that if you are a victim of motornappers, it is better to report immediately to the authorities so that they can quickly investigate and find the thieves.

text: GABUYLOG kita sa kasubo sang pamilya ni former Mayor kag Congressman Arcadio Gorriceta sa iya pagtaliwan sadtong Hulyo 2.
english: We join the grief of the family of former Mayor and Congressman Arcadio Gorriceta on his passing on July 2.

text: Isa siya ka maayo nga abyan, nga gapadumdum sa aton nga wala sing imol kag manggaranon sa pag-enjoy upod sa isa ka tasa nga kape.
english: He is a good friend, reminding us that there are no poor and rich to enjoy with a cup of coffee.

text:
***

Isa ang Sweden sa walo ka pungsod sa Uropa nga nagahatag sing “most generous” welfare programs sa iya pumuluyo.
english:
***

Sweden is one of eight European countries that provide the “most generous” welfare programs to its citizens.

text: Kalakip diri ang Belgium, Italy, Denmark, Austria, Greece kag Germany.
english: These include Belgium, Italy, Denmark, Austria, Greece and Germany.

text: Indi lang ini nagahatag sing nagapanguna nga kaseguruhan sa pangabuhi sang mga pumuluyo paagi sa unemployment benefits, employment services, job guarantees, starter jobs kag sang European Social Fund.
english: It not only provides basic life security for citizens through unemployment benefits, employment services, job guarantees, starter jobs and the European Social Fund.

text: May ara man diri sang low-cost housing, child-support payments, child-care subsidies, mandatory four-week vacation sa workers, unemployment insurance, kag dugang nga old-age pension benefits.
english: It also has low-cost housing, child-support payments, child-care subsidies, mandatory four-week vacation to workers, unemployment insurance, and increased old-age pension benefits.

text: Ang tanan nga pumuluyo,  kubos man ukon may ikasarang, benepisyado man sang Swedish health care nga ginagastuhan mayormante sang gobyerno.
english: All citizens, whether poor or able, benefit from Swedish health care, which is financed mainly by the government.

text: Libre man diri ang pag-eskwela sa kolehiyo kag unibersidad.
english: College and university education is also free here.

text: Tungod sini, wala kita makita sing problema kon istriktuhon man nga ipatuman ang mga health protocols agud malikaw ang mga pumuluyo sa Covid-19 paagi sa lockdown, quarantine, kag iban pa nga measures.
english: Therefore, we do not see a problem if the health protocols are strictly implemented to prevent the people from Covid-19 through lockdown, quarantine, and other measures.

text: Wala man gani kita makita nga problema kon indi mapatuman ang National State of Emergency nga labag sa ila konstitusyon kay may lokal man nga measures nga pwede ipatuman.
english: We don't even see a problem if the National State of Emergency is not implemented which is against their constitution because there are local measures that can be implemented.

text: Katulad sang pagdumili sa mass gathering sang sobra 50 ka tawo, ang pagpatuman sang physical distancing kag hygienic practices katulad sang handwashing kag indi pagtandug sang kamot sa ilong, baba kag mata.
english: Like the ban on mass gatherings of more than 50 people, the implementation of physical distancing and hygienic practices such as handwashing and not touching the nose, mouth and eyes.

text: Ugaling lang kay ang pagpatuman sini sang subong nga gobyerno sunu lang sa “civic responsibilities” sang mga pumuluyo.
english: However, the implementation of the current government is based on the “civic responsibilities” of the people.

text: So, ang nagakatabo nga pagusto ang mga pumuluyo sa kon ano ang luyag nila himuon.
english: So, what happens is that the people like what they want to do.

text: Bukas man ang madamo nga restaurants, bars, shops kag retail stores, beaches kag parks nga may dalagku lang nga pahibalo (posted sign) katulad sang “Please Observe Physical Distancing” (sa Swedish nga pulong).
english: Many restaurants, bars, shops and retail stores, beaches and parks are also open with large posted signs such as “Please Observe Physical Distancing” (in Swedish).

text: Kon may “pagdumili” man, katulad sang “Stay at Home”,  ginapaagi lang ini sa mga incentives kasubong sang extended paid leaves para sa mga ginikanan.
english: If there is a “ban”, such as “Stay at Home”, it is done through incentives such as extended paid leaves for parents.

text:
***

Sang sining ulihi lang, ang Sweden may 65,000 na ka kaso sang Covid-19 kag 5,200 ang napatay – nga pinakataas sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english:
***

Until recently, Sweden already had 65,000 cases of Covid-19 and 5,200 deaths – the highest in the world.

text: Mga 8% ini, samtang ang gakapatay sa iban nga pungsod mataas na ang 3%.
english: This is about 8%, while the death rate in other countries is already as high as 3%.

text: Nagahingyu na gani karon ang mga kontra partido sang gobyerno sini agud imbestigahan ining madasig nga pagsaka sang mga kaso kag sang nagkalamatay sa Covid-19, nga ginareklamo man gani sang World Health Organization./PN
english: The opposition parties are now calling on the government to investigate the rapid increase in cases and deaths from Covid-19, which the World Health Organization is also complaining about.

text: Gin-aresto kag ginpahalin sa pwesto ang kapin 70 ka miyembro sang Philippine National Police-Regional Mobile Battalion 14-B sa idalom sang Police Regional Office-Bangasamoro Autonomous Region bangud sa pagsakit sa 128 ka mga bag-o nga pulis sa reception rites sa Lamitan City, Basilan.
english: More than 70 members of the Philippine National Police-Regional Mobile Battalion 14-B under the Police Regional Office-Bangasamoro Autonomous Region were arrested and dismissed for torturing 128 new policemen at reception rites in Lamitan City, Basilan.

text: Ang mga biktima ang lunsay bag-o gin-assign sa headquarters sang RMFB 14-B kag bag-o lamang nakagradwar sang Basic Internal Security Traininig.
english: The victims were all newly assigned to the headquarters of RMFB 14-B and had just graduated from Basic Internal Security Training.

text: Ang natabo nga hazing ang nakuhaan pa sang video kag nag-viral.
english: The hazing incident was even caught on video and went viral.

text: Ginkakas man sa pwesto ang 12 ka police non-commissioned officers nga direkta nga involved sa hazing.
english: Twelve police non-commissioned officers directly involved in the hazing were also removed from their posts.

text: Sa mga biktima, 18 ang nag-file na sang reklamo.
english: Of the victims, 18 have filed complaints.

text: Ginalauman naman nga magapasaka man sang complaint ang iban pa.
english: Others are expected to file complaints.

text: Mangatubang sang administrative kag criminal cases ang mga pulis nga involved sa pagpanakit.
english: The police officers involved in the assault will face administrative and criminal charges.

text: Makit-an sa video nga ginpaluhod, ginhampak, ginsumbag, kag ginkastigo ang mga biktima.
english: The video shows the victims being kneed, slapped, punched, and beaten.

text: Detained naman subong ang mga pulis nga nagpanakit sang mga bag-o nga miyembro sang RMFB 14.
english: The policemen who tortured the new members of RMFB 14 are now detained.

text: Atubangon sang two-time Olympian nga si EJ Obiena ang makabig “best of the best” pole vaulters sa 2025 Mondo Classic sa Uppsala, Sweden subong nga semana.
english: Two-time Olympian EJ Obiena will face what is considered the “best of the best” pole vaulters at the 2025 Mondo Classic in Uppsala, Sweden this week.

text: Apisar indi na makasulod sa World Indoor Championship, magapasakop si Obiena sa sini nga tournament nga amo ang iya katapusan nga indoor event antes magliso ang atensyon sa outdoor season.
english: Despite missing out on the World Indoor Championship, Obiena will compete in this tournament which will be her last indoor event before attention turns to the outdoor season.

text: Lakip sa makasumpong sang Pinoy Olympians sa Sweden amo ang world no.
english: Among the opponents of the Filipino Olympians in Sweden is world no.

text: 1 kag two-time Olympic champion nga si Mondo Duplantis nga nakaguba sang iya kaugalingon nga world record sang nalukso sini ang 6.27m sa World Athletics Indoor Tour silver meeting sa France sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: 1 and two-time Olympic champion Mondo Duplantis who broke his own world record when he jumped 6.27m at the World Athletics Indoor Tour silver meeting in France last month.

text: Yara man sa kumpetisyon ang mga nakasumpong ni Obiena sa 2024 Olympics nga sanday Paris Olympics silver medalist Sam Kendricks sang United States kag bronze winner Emmanouil Karalis sang Greece.
english: Also in competition are Obiena’s 2024 Olympics opponents Paris Olympics silver medalist Sam Kendricks of the United States and bronze winner Emmanouil Karalis of Greece.

text: Tanan nga participants ang may average nga 5.80m sa ila personal ukon seasonal bests, amo man sa performances sa nagligad nga Olympics.
english: All participants averaged 5.80m in their personal or seasonal bests, the same as performances in previous Olympics.

text: Pagkatapos sini, magatutok na si Obiena sa preparasyon sa outdoors para sa iya pag-compete sa tatlo ka dalagku nga events kaangay sang Asian Championships sa Gumi, South Korea sa May 21 to 31; World Outdoor Championships sa Tokyo, Japan sa Sept.
english: After that, Obiena will focus on outdoor preparation for his competition in three major events such as the Asian Championships in Gumi, South Korea on May 21 to 31; World Outdoor Championships in Tokyo, Japan on Sept.

text: 13 to 21; kag ang Southeast Asian Games sa Bangkok, Thailand sa Dec.
english: 13 to 21; and the Southeast Asian Games in Bangkok, Thailand on Dec.

text: Nagapang-apat subong ang Pinoy pride sa world rankings kasunod sang injury nga iya naangkon nga rason kun ngaa temprano nga natapos ang iya 2024 season.
english: The Filipino pride is currently fourth in the world rankings following an injury that led to the early end of his 2024 season.

text: Pormal nga ginbaton ni Luis Antonio Cardinal Tagle ang iya Titular Diocese, ang Suburbicarian See of Albano, sa isa ka solemne kag espirituhanon nga seremonya kahapon nga adlaw, Oktubre 12.
english: Luis Antonio Cardinal Tagle formally accepted his Titular Diocese, the Suburbicarian See of Albano, in a solemn and spiritual ceremony yesterday, October 12th.

text: Ini pinaagi sa papal Bull halin kay Pope Leo XIV, nga opisyal nga nag-appoint kay Cardinal Tagle bilang Cardinal Bishop sang Albano, isa ka mataas nga pagkilala sa iya kinaadman, katutom, kag masanag nga serbisyo bilang Pro-Prefect sang Dicastery for Evangelization.
english: This is through a papal Bull from Pope Leo XIV, who officially appointed Cardinal Tagle as Cardinal Bishop of Albano, a high recognition of his wisdom, faithfulness, and brilliant service as Pro-Prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization.

text: Ang Diocese sang Albano isa sa pito ka sinauna nga suburbicarian dioceses sa palibot sang Roma nga masami ginahatag lamang sa mga Cardinal Bishops nga may pinakamataas nga ranggo sa College of Cardinals.
english: The Diocese of Albano is one of seven former suburbicarian dioceses around Rome usually given only to Cardinal Bishops with the highest rank in the College of Cardinals.

text: Present man sa seremonya ang lokal nga obispo sang Albano nga si Bishop Vincenzo Viva, mga pari, kag mga myembro sang Filipino community sa Roma.
english: Also present at the ceremony were the local bishop of Albano, Bishop Vincenzo Viva, priests, and members of the Filipino community in Rome.

text: Suno sa Pontificio Collegio Filippino, may tatlo ka obispo, duha ka kardinal, kag kapin 100 ka mga pari ang nagtambong sa misa.
english: According to the Pontifical College Filippino, three bishops, two cardinals, and more than 100 priests attended the mass.

text: Gin-appoint si Cardinal Tagle sa Diocese sang Albano matapos mabakante ang pwesto sang gin-appoint si Cardinal Robert Prevost bilang Pope Leo XIV sang Mayo.
english: Cardinal Tagle was appointed to the Diocese of Albano after the post became vacant when Cardinal Robert Prevost was appointed Pope Leo XIV in May.

text: Pormal nga ginhatag kay Tagle ang titulo sang Mayo 24, bilang kahalili sang Santo Papa.
english: Tagle was formally given the title on May 24, as the Pope's successor.

text: KUMPORME kita nga ang GMRC (Good Manners and Right Conduct) itudlo sa mga kabataan tubtub sa hayskul.
english: We AGREE that GMRC (Good Manners and Right Conduct) should be taught to children up to high school.

text: Sa akon panahon indi maayo sa palamatin-an, labi na gid sang mga katigulangan, ang pagpamuyayaw sang mga kabataan.
english: In my day it was not good to hear, especially by the elders, the ridicule of children.

text: In fact, kon indi ka masupalpal sing kaakigon nila basi matampaan ka pa nga bata ka.
english: In fact, if you don't get angry with them, you might be slapped as a child.

text: Labi na gid ang pamuyayaw nga “son of a bitch”, nga sa lokal nga pulong amo ang “p…ang ina mo!” sa tagalog ukon “al…ut nanay mo!” sa Hiligaynon.
english: Especially the insult “son of a bitch”, which in the local language is “p…ang ina mo!” in Tagalog or “al…ut your mother!” in Hiligaynon.

text: Masakit ini nga patungod sa mga iloy, samtang pila man lang ang bagay patungdan sini.
english: This is a painful thing for mothers, while few things are right for it.

text: Masubo pa gid kay may luyag gihapon mag-akusa sini sa mga iloy bilang pagpakalain bisan indi ini matuod.
english: It's sad that some people still want to accuse mothers of this as an insult even though it's not true.

text: Nagapakanubo kag nagapakalain ini sang matuod nga rolyo sang iloy, nga ginatindugan sang kadam-an sa aton sa ngalan ni Santa Maria nga iloy sang Anak sang Diyos nga si Hesukristo kag sang Sagrada Familia, nga, sa luyag naton ukon indi, nagaapekto sa relasyon niya sa iya kabataan, bana kag suod nga pamilya.
english: It belittles and denigrates the true role of the mother, which many of us stand for in the name of St. Mary the mother of the Son of God Jesus Christ and the Holy Family, which, whether we like it or not, affects her relationship with her children, husband and immediate family.

text: In fact, mas masakit ini nga pagtumod sa iloy sa bahin sang mga kabataan nga gapalangga sang ila mga iloy bisan pa gani matuod ini,  kay ang iloy mo iloy mo bisan ano pa siya.
english: In fact, this is a more painful reference to the mother on the part of children who love their mothers even though it is true, because your mother is your mother no matter what she is.

text: Sa matuod man, Indi maayo nga kondehanon naton ang isigkatawo.
english: In fact, it is not good for us to judge our neighbor.

text: “The sin, not the sinner” kag “condemn and you will be condemned” ang laygay gani sang aton Kristohanon nga pagtuo.
english: “The sin, not the sinner” and “condemn and you will be condemned” is the advice of our Christian faith.

text: Sa lugar sina, dapat naton pa gani buligan  sila, sa pagpanguna sang gobyerno sa pagtamod sini sa mga kubos, agud makapanibag-o sing kabuhi nga indi man madalahig sa kalainan ang mga kabataan.
english: Instead, we should even help them, led by the government in its attitude towards the poor, to change their lives without children being involved in evil.

text: Katulad sang paghatag sing pangabuhian sa luyag magbag-o nga mga babaye nga manubo sing lupad kag sang paghingyu nga makabalik sila sa Diyosnon nga kabuhi.
english: Such as providing livelihood to low-ranking women who want to change and asking them to return to the divine life.

text: Sa bahin sang mga kabataan,  sa kabug-usan, nga matudluan naton sila sa eskwelahan, kag diin man, sang maayo nga pamatasan kag pag-ulikid sa ano man nga mabulig nila sa ila ginikanan sangsa mag-lando-lando lang.
english: As for the children, in general, that we can teach them in school, and everywhere, good manners and care for whatever they can do to help their parents rather than just hanging out.

text: Indi kay kondenahon ang mga kabataan sa kapaslawan sang ila mga ginikanan, katulad sa pagtawag sing “pu…ang ina mo!” sa ila iloy.
english: Not to condemn children for their parents' failures, such as calling them “pu...ang ina mo!” to their mother.

text: Kag indi kay kita mismo nga mga dapat mangin ejemplo nila sa tadlong nga banas – presidente, senador, congressman, kag iban pa – amo pa ang magtudlo sa ila sang kabastusan kag kawalanghiyaan.
english: And not because we ourselves who should be their example on the right path – president, senator, congressman, and others – are the ones who teach them rudeness and shamelessness.

text:
***

Padayon pa ang pagtuon sang mga scientist kon bala may lain-lain nga strain ang COVID-19 ukon bala ordinaryo lang nga mutation, ukon pagbag-o sang forma, sang orihinal nga virus nga wala naman sing significante nga pagbag-o sang functionality  (kakayahan) sini.
english:
***

Scientists are still studying whether there are different strains of COVID-19 or whether it is just an ordinary mutation, or change in form, of the original virus without a significant change in its functionality.

text: Ang padayon nga pagtuon nagapakita man, sunu sa Journal of Translational Medicine, sang mga specific mutation patterns sa lain-lain nga geographical regions agud maseguro kon bala ano ang impluwensya sang lain nga lugar sa functionality  sang COVID-19 virus.
english: Ongoing studies are also showing, according to the Journal of Translational Medicine, specific mutation patterns in different geographical regions to determine what influence different areas have on the functionality of the COVID-19 virus.

text: Ang mga pagtuon nagalakip sang paggamit sang lima naton ka natural senses (gamit sang mata, panimaho, pagnamnam, pagpamati, kag pamatyag), correct thinking (logic), kag paggamit sang mga models kag patterns nga mabasehan sang pagdiskubre.
english: Learning includes the use of our five natural senses (sight, smell, taste, hearing, and feeling), correct thinking (logic), and the use of models and patterns based on discovery.

text: Kon ang ining mutations ga-identify sang bag-o nga strain, ang buot silingon sini nga indi kapareho ang ila kapinasahe nga nagakinahanglan sang lain man nga pag-preparar sang angay nga vaccine.
english: If these mutations identify a new strain, it means that their effectiveness is not the same and requires a different preparation of a suitable vaccine.

text: Ang patient samples sa sining pagtuon ginkuha sang University of Maryland  sa Baltimore, USA, kag sang Italian Biotech Company Ulisse Biomed sa Trieste halin sa pila ka rehiyon sa North America kag Europe.
english: Patient samples in this study were obtained by the University of Maryland  in Baltimore, USA, and the Italian Biotech Company Ulisse Biomed in Trieste from several regions in North America and Europe.

text: Apang kon ang mutations indi man maka-produce sang lain nga strain, pwede man ang pag-preparar sang isa lang ka klase sang vaccine nga magamit sang kadam-an.
english: But if the mutations do not produce a different strain, it is also possible to prepare a single type of vaccine that can be used by the masses.

text: Apang wala pa sing pat-ud kon ano gid ang maabtan sang sining mga pagtuon sa nagakatabo nga mutations sang COVID-19 sa lain-lain nga lugar.
english: But it is not yet clear what these studies will reveal about the mutations of COVID-19 in different places.

text: Gani, para seguro, ang mga scientist sang Filipinas dapat may kaugalingon nga pagtuon agud kon lain nga strain ang ma-produce handa kita sa pag-produce lang sang angay nga vaccine.
english: So, for sure, the scientists of the Philippines should have their own study so that if a different strain is produced we are ready to produce the appropriate vaccine.

text: Dapat man kita handa kag mag-stockpile sang anti-viral drugs batok sa “replication” kag “shedding” sang virus sa posible nga pagbalik –balik sang infection tungod sa abilidad sini sa pagpanagu, meantime, kon madelikado ini batok sa bagay nga treatment samtang wala pa ang vaccine./PN
english: We must also be prepared and stockpile anti-viral drugs against the replication and shedding of the virus in the event of a possible recurrence of infection due to its ability to hide, meantime, if it is dangerous against appropriate treatment while the vaccine is not available.

text: Magatukod sang team ang Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO) agud nga makabulig sa pagpatigayon sang mga inspeksyon agud matapna ang isyu sang overloading sa mga modernized jeepneys sa Iloilo City.
english: The Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO) will set up a team to help conduct inspections to curb the issue of overloading on modernized jeepneys in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang amo nga opisina, iya ginpahayag nga magasapol siya sa iya mga personnel agud ma-assign ang mga mahimo i-deploy kadungan sang inspeksyon nga patigayunon upod sa concerned agencies.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the office, said he will meet with his personnel to assign those who can be deployed during the inspection to be conducted with the concerned agencies.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, kabahin na ini sang agenda sa Local Public Transport Route Committee kun sa diin yara man ang presensya sang mga tiglawas sang Land Transportation Office (LTO) kag ang Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB).
english: According to Garbanzos, this is part of the agenda of the Local Public Transport Route Committee where representatives of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) and the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) are also present.

text: “Isa sa mga gin-agreehan nga may joint operation nga matabo —checking and inspection — para ma-prevent ang the same operation nga gina-obra sang mga driver kag PAO,” pahayag sini.
english: “One of the agreements is that there will be a joint operation — checking and inspection — to prevent the same operation that drivers and PAOs are doing,” he said.

text:
Dugang niya: “Kami willing gid kami mag-support kag mag-dedicate sang tawo para magbulig sa aton nga national agency.”

Pahayag pa ni Garbanzos, indi na bag-o nga isyu ang overloading ukon ang overcrowding sa modernized units kag nagakatabo ini mangin sa probinsya sang Iloilo.
english:
He added: “We are willing to support and dedicate people to help our national agency.”

Garbanzos said overloading is not a new issue in modernized units and it is happening even in Iloilo province.

text: Nakit-an sini nga ang pagpanghangkat sa pagtapna sa sini nga practice amo ang monitoring.
english: It found that the challenge in preventing this practice was monitoring.

text: Ginbalikan ni Garbanzos ang “Anti-Sardinas” policy kun sa diin pareho nga may mandato ang LTO kag ang LTFRB sa pagdumili sa mga pampubliko nga salakyan nga nagakarga sang mga pasahero nga nagalalapaw na sa maximum nga seating capacities.
english: Garbanzos reiterated the “Anti-Sardinas” policy where both the LTO and the LTFRB have a mandate to ban public vehicles carrying passengers that exceed the maximum seating capacities.

text: Sa lebel sang syudad suno pa kay Garbanzos, naga-apprehend sila sa mga unit sa mga terminal nga naga-operate nga lapaw sa ila nga registered seating capacity sa idalom sang Regulation Ordinance 2008-393.
english: At the city level, Garbanzos said, they are apprehending units in terminals that operate beyond their registered seating capacity under Regulation Ordinance 2008-393.

text: “Maayo gid kun may operations, may joint operations, para tanan mangin aware kag mapakita sa tanan nga sinsero [ang operasyon],” dugang ni Garbanzos.
english: “It would be good if there were operations, joint operations, so that everyone would be aware and show everyone that [the operation] is sincere,” Garbanzos added.

text: Una naman nga ginpahayag sang LTO 6 nga bilang kabahin sang mas ginpasangkad nga anti-overloading campaign, may random inspections nga himuon sa modern jeepneys sa bilog nga Western Visayas.
english: Earlier, LTO 6 said that as part of the expanded anti-overloading campaign, random inspections will be conducted on modern jeepneys throughout Western Visayas.

text: Ginmanduan man ni LTO-6 Regional Director Atty. Gaudioso P. Geduspan II ang tanan nga LTO District Offices sa Panay kag Guimaras kaupod sa law enforcement units nga aktibo nga ipatuman ang zero-tolerance crackdown batok sa nagaginutok nga mga pasahero sa sulod sang pampubliko nga salakyan.
english: LTO-6 Regional Director Atty. Gaudioso P. Geduspan II urged all LTO District Offices in Panay and Guimaras along with law enforcement units to actively implement the zero-tolerance crackdown against overcrowded passengers inside public transportation.

text:
“Violators will be penalized under existing transportation laws, including Republic Act 4136, or the Land Transportation and Traffic Code,” kabahin sang latest post sang LTO Region 6.#
